## File: src/use_cases/infinite_level.rs
````rust
  1: //! Deterministic access to the finite window of an infinite planned level.
  2: //!
  3: //! Chunk generation is local, but Level 0 architecture is not: a chunk may
  4: //! sample corridors, assemblies, or anomaly footprints planned by any region
  5: //! that overlaps its voxel halo.  This module makes that query explicit.  The
  6: //! window owns a stable, row-major set of region plans and is otherwise just a
  7: //! world-point-to-plan lookup; callers do not need to reproduce region-range
  8: //! arithmetic or fall back to an unrelated plan when a lookup misses.
  9: 
 10: use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::WorldBounds;
 11: use crate::domain::entities::architecture::RegionPlan;
 12: use crate::entities::models::Position;
 13: use crate::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig;
 14: use crate::use_cases::ports::NoiseProvider;
 15: use crate::use_cases::region_plan::{REGION_SIZE, generate_region_plan, region_index};
 16: 
 17: /// The region plans needed to sample one bounded area of an infinite level.
 18: ///
 19: /// Plans are stored in `(z, x)` row-major order.  That order is deliberately
 20: /// independent of hash maps and request timing, so planning the same area is
 21: /// replayable on the main thread, in a worker, or during a test.
 22: #[derive(Clone, Debug)]
 23: pub(crate) struct InfiniteRegionWindow {
 24:     min_region_x: i64,
 25:     min_region_z: i64,
 26:     max_region_x: i64,
 27:     max_region_z: i64,
 28:     plans: Vec<RegionPlan>,
 29: }
 30: 
 31: impl InfiniteRegionWindow {
 32:     /// Plans every region touched by `area` after expanding it by `halo` world
 33:     /// units.  Boundary-touching regions are included intentionally: a voxel
 34:     /// sampler may ask about the exact far edge while constructing skirts,
 35:     /// meshes, or collision data.
 36:     pub(crate) fn covering(
 37:         area: WorldBounds,
 38:         halo: f32,
 39:         seed: u32,
 40:         config: &GeneratorConfig,
 41:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 42:     ) -> Self {
 43:         assert!(
 44:             halo.is_finite() && halo >= 0.0,
 45:             "region-window halo must be a finite, non-negative world distance"
 46:         );
 47:         let area = area.expanded(halo);
 48:         assert!(
 49:             [area.min_x, area.min_z, area.max_x, area.max_z]
 50:                 .into_iter()
 51:                 .all(f32::is_finite),
 52:             "an infinite-region window requires finite world bounds"
 53:         );
 54: 
 55:         let min_region_x = region_index(area.min_x);
 56:         let min_region_z = region_index(area.min_z);
 57:         let max_region_x = region_index(area.max_x);
 58:         let max_region_z = region_index(area.max_z);
 59:         let width = region_count(min_region_x, max_region_x);
 60:         let height = region_count(min_region_z, max_region_z);
 61:         let capacity = width
 62:             .checked_mul(height)
 63:             .expect("requested region window is too large to address");
 64:         let mut plans = Vec::with_capacity(capacity);
 65: 
 66:         for region_z in min_region_z..=max_region_z {
 67:             for region_x in min_region_x..=max_region_x {
 68:                 plans.push(generate_region_plan(
 69:                     seed,
 70:                     region_origin(region_x, region_z),
 71:                     REGION_SIZE,
 72:                     config,
 73:                     noise,
 74:                 ));
 75:             }
 76:         }
 77: 
 78:         Self {
 79:             min_region_x,
 80:             min_region_z,
 81:             max_region_x,
 82:             max_region_z,
 83:             plans,
 84:         }
 85:     }
 86: 
 87:     /// Convenience constructor for the common chunk-plus-voxel-halo query.
 88:     pub(crate) fn around_chunk(
 89:         chunk_origin: Position,
 90:         chunk_size: f32,
 91:         halo: f32,
 92:         seed: u32,
 93:         config: &GeneratorConfig,
 94:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 95:     ) -> Self {
 96:         assert!(
 97:             chunk_size.is_finite() && chunk_size >= 0.0,
 98:             "chunk size must be a finite, non-negative world distance"
 99:         );
100:         Self::covering(
101:             WorldBounds::new(
102:                 chunk_origin.x,
103:                 chunk_origin.z,
104:                 chunk_origin.x + chunk_size,
105:                 chunk_origin.z + chunk_size,
106:             ),
107:             halo,
108:             seed,
109:             config,
110:             noise,
111:         )
112:     }
113: 
114:     /// Returns the authoritative plan for a world point, or `None` when the
115:     /// caller sampled beyond the area/halo declared at construction time.
116:     pub(crate) fn plan_at(&self, world: Position) -> Option<&RegionPlan> {
117:         self.plan_for_region(region_index(world.x), region_index(world.z))
118:     }
119: 
120:     pub(crate) fn plan_for_region(&self, region_x: i64, region_z: i64) -> Option<&RegionPlan> {
121:         if region_x < self.min_region_x
122:             || region_x > self.max_region_x
123:             || region_z < self.min_region_z
124:             || region_z > self.max_region_z
125:         {
126:             return None;
127:         }
128: 
129:         let width = region_count(self.min_region_x, self.max_region_x);
130:         let local_x = usize::try_from(region_x - self.min_region_x).ok()?;
131:         let local_z = usize::try_from(region_z - self.min_region_z).ok()?;
132:         self.plans
133:             .get(local_z.saturating_mul(width).saturating_add(local_x))
134:     }
135: 
136:     #[cfg(test)]
137:     pub(crate) fn len(&self) -> usize {
138:         self.plans.len()
139:     }
140: 
141:     #[cfg(test)]
142:     pub(crate) fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
143:         self.plans.is_empty()
144:     }
145: 
146:     /// Stable row-major iteration for semantic export and deterministic tests.
147:     pub(crate) fn iter(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = ((i64, i64), &RegionPlan)> {
148:         let width = region_count(self.min_region_x, self.max_region_x);
149:         self.plans.iter().enumerate().map(move |(index, plan)| {
150:             let local_z = index / width;
151:             let local_x = index % width;
152:             (
153:                 (
154:                     self.min_region_x + local_x as i64,
155:                     self.min_region_z + local_z as i64,
156:                 ),
157:                 plan,
158:             )
159:         })
160:     }
161: }
162: 
163: fn region_count(first: i64, last: i64) -> usize {
164:     let count = last
165:         .checked_sub(first)
166:         .and_then(|distance| distance.checked_add(1))
167:         .expect("requested region window exceeds integer address space");
168:     usize::try_from(count).expect("requested region window exceeds platform address space")
169: }
170: 
171: fn region_origin(region_x: i64, region_z: i64) -> Position {
172:     Position::new(region_x as f32 * REGION_SIZE, region_z as f32 * REGION_SIZE)
173: }
174: 
175: #[cfg(test)]
176: mod tests {
177:     use super::*;
178:     use crate::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider;
179:     use crate::use_cases::region_plan::debug_region_ascii;
180: 
181:     #[test]
182:     fn area_and_halo_define_an_explicit_negative_coordinate_window() {
183:         let window = InfiniteRegionWindow::covering(
184:             WorldBounds::new(-0.1, 0.1, 79.9, 79.9),
185:             0.4,
186:             42,
187:             &GeneratorConfig::low_spec(),
188:             &SimpleNoiseProvider::new(),
189:         );
190: 
191:         let keys: Vec<_> = window.iter().map(|(key, _)| key).collect();
192:         assert_eq!(
193:             keys,
194:             vec![
195:                 (-1, -1),
196:                 (0, -1),
197:                 (1, -1),
198:                 (-1, 0),
199:                 (0, 0),
200:                 (1, 0),
201:                 (-1, 1),
202:                 (0, 1),
203:                 (1, 1)
204:             ]
205:         );
206:         assert_eq!(window.len(), keys.len());
207:         assert!(!window.is_empty());
208:     }
209: 
210:     #[test]
211:     fn lookup_never_falls_back_to_an_unrelated_region() {
212:         let window = InfiniteRegionWindow::around_chunk(
213:             Position::new(70.0, -10.0),
214:             20.0,
215:             1.0,
216:             42,
217:             &GeneratorConfig::low_spec(),
218:             &SimpleNoiseProvider::new(),
219:         );
220: 
221:         assert_eq!(
222:             window
223:                 .plan_at(Position::new(79.9, -0.1))
224:                 .unwrap()
225:                 .origin_world,
226:             Position::new(0.0, -80.0)
227:         );
228:         assert_eq!(
229:             window
230:                 .plan_at(Position::new(80.1, 0.1))
231:                 .unwrap()
232:                 .origin_world,
233:             Position::new(80.0, 0.0)
234:         );
235:         assert!(window.plan_at(Position::new(400.0, 400.0)).is_none());
236:     }
237: 
238:     #[test]
239:     fn planning_the_same_window_replays_the_same_architecture() {
240:         let build = || {
241:             InfiniteRegionWindow::around_chunk(
242:                 Position::new(10.0, 10.0),
243:                 10.0,
244:                 0.4,
245:                 42,
246:                 &GeneratorConfig::low_spec(),
247:                 &SimpleNoiseProvider::new(),
248:             )
249:         };
250:         let a = build();
251:         let b = build();
252:         let ascii = |window: &InfiniteRegionWindow| {
253:             window
254:                 .iter()
255:                 .map(|(key, plan)| (key, debug_region_ascii(plan, 2.0)))
256:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
257:         };
258:         assert_eq!(ascii(&a), ascii(&b));
259:     }
260: }

 1: <!doctype html>
 2: <title>webgpu minimal probe</title>
 3: <canvas id="c" width="64" height="64"></canvas>
 4: <script type="module">
 5:   const log = (...a) => console.log('[probe]', ...a);
 6:   try {
 7:     log('navigator.gpu:', !!navigator.gpu);
 8:     if (!navigator.gpu) throw new Error('no navigator.gpu');
 9:     const adapter = await navigator.gpu.requestAdapter();
10:     log('adapter:', adapter ? 'ok' : 'null');
11:     if (!adapter) throw new Error('null adapter');
12:     const device = await adapter.requestDevice();
13:     log('device: ok');
14:     const ctx = document.getElementById('c').getContext('webgpu');
15:     log('getContext(webgpu):', ctx ? 'ok' : 'null');
16:     if (!ctx) throw new Error('null context');
17:     const format = navigator.gpu.getPreferredCanvasFormat();
18:     log('preferred format:', format);
19:     ctx.configure({ device, format, alphaMode: 'opaque' });
20:     log('configure: ok — showcase-style init SUCCEEDED');
21:   } catch (e) {
22:     log('FAILED:', e.message);
23:   }
24: </script>

## File: wasm_frontend/benches/generation.rs
````rust
 1: //! Size-parameterized benchmarks for the chunk-generation entry point real
 2: //! callers use (`LocalChunkSource::load`), targeting two complexity risks
 3: //! flagged in the generation-pipeline audit:
 4: //!
 5: //! - `chunk_by_voxel_size`: a single chunk's generation cost as `voxel_size`
 6: //!   shrinks (chunk_size fixed). `ColumnField::sample` calls the per-column
 7: //!   planning stack `(axis_voxels+2)^2` times, so this should show
 8: //!   roughly-quadratic growth as `axis_voxels = chunk_size/voxel_size` grows.
 9: //! - `neighborhood_redundancy`: total cost of loading a `(2r+1)^2`-chunk
10: //!   neighborhood at r = 0, 1, 2. `LocalChunkSource` has no cross-call cache
11: //!   (confirmed: no cache field on the struct), so `generate_region_plan` is
12: //!   re-derived from scratch for every chunk even when several chunks share
13: //!   one 80-unit region. If that's costing real time, per-chunk cost
14: //!   (total / chunk_count) should stay roughly flat as the neighborhood
15: //!   grows rather than dropping — chunks sharing a region would otherwise
16: //!   amortize the shared planning cost.
17: //!
18: //! `cargo bench -p wasm_frontend --bench generation`.
19: 
20: use criterion::{BenchmarkId, Criterion, criterion_group, criterion_main};
21: use vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider;
22: use vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig;
23: use vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::spawn_point;
24: use wasm_frontend::adapters::local_chunk_source::LocalChunkSource;
25: use wasm_frontend::application::ports::ChunkSourcePort;
26: 
27: fn chunk_by_voxel_size(c: &mut Criterion) {
28:     let mut group = c.benchmark_group("chunk_by_voxel_size");
29:     for voxel_scale in [0.4f32, 0.2, 0.1] {
30:         let mut config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
31:         config.voxel_scale = voxel_scale;
32:         let source = LocalChunkSource::new(SimpleNoiseProvider::new(), 42, config);
33:         let spawn = spawn_point(42);
34:         let origin_x = (spawn.x / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size;
35:         let origin_z = (spawn.z / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size;
36:         let axis_voxels = (config.chunk_size / voxel_scale).round() as u32;
37:         group.bench_with_input(
38:             BenchmarkId::new("axis_voxels", axis_voxels),
39:             &(origin_x, origin_z),
40:             |b, &(x, z)| {
41:                 b.iter(|| source.load(x, z, 0, 0));
42:             },
43:         );
44:     }
45:     group.finish();
46: }
47: 
48: fn neighborhood_redundancy(c: &mut Criterion) {
49:     let mut group = c.benchmark_group("neighborhood_redundancy");
50:     let config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
51:     let source = LocalChunkSource::new(SimpleNoiseProvider::new(), 42, config);
52:     let spawn = spawn_point(42);
53:     let origin_x = (spawn.x / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size;
54:     let origin_z = (spawn.z / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size;
55:     for radius in [0i32, 1, 2] {
56:         let chunk_count = (2 * radius + 1).pow(2);
57:         group.bench_with_input(
58:             BenchmarkId::new("radius", format!("{radius}_{chunk_count}chunks")),
59:             &radius,
60:             |b, &radius| {
61:                 b.iter(|| {
62:                     for dz in -radius..=radius {
63:                         for dx in -radius..=radius {
64:                             let x = origin_x + dx as f32 * config.chunk_size;
65:                             let z = origin_z + dz as f32 * config.chunk_size;
66:                             criterion::black_box(source.load(x, z, 0, 0));
67:                         }
68:                     }
69:                 });
70:             },
71:         );
72:     }
73:     group.finish();
74: }
75: 
76: criterion_group! {
77:     name = benches;
78:     // Full neighborhoods at radius 2 (25 chunks) take real wall-clock time;
79:     // cap sample count so the suite finishes in a reasonable window.
80:     config = Criterion::default().sample_size(20);
81:     targets = chunk_by_voxel_size, neighborhood_redundancy
82: }
83: criterion_main!(benches);
````

## File: wasm_frontend/benches/rendering.rs
````rust
  1: //! Size-parameterized benchmarks for the three rendering-side hot paths
  2: //! flagged in the audit: SVO ray traversal, the CPU rasterizer's full-frame
  3: //! cost, and the brute-force collision query.
  4: //!
  5: //! `cargo bench -p wasm_frontend --bench rendering`.
  6: 
  7: use std::collections::HashMap;
  8: 
  9: use criterion::{BenchmarkId, Criterion, black_box, criterion_group, criterion_main};
 10: use vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider;
 11: use vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig;
 12: use vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::spawn_point;
 13: use wasm_frontend::adapters::cpu_splatter::rasterizer::SoftwareRasterizer;
 14: use wasm_frontend::adapters::cpu_splatter::settings::CpuQualityPreset;
 15: use wasm_frontend::adapters::cpu_splatter::trace_svo;
 16: use wasm_frontend::adapters::local_chunk_source::LocalChunkSource;
 17: use wasm_frontend::application::atlas::{AtlasPool, payload_rows};
 18: use wasm_frontend::application::collision::{Aabb, CollisionWorld};
 19: use wasm_frontend::application::ports::{ChunkDraw, ChunkSourcePort, FrameParams, RendererPort};
 20: use wasm_frontend::application::streaming::chunk_key;
 21: 
 22: const SEED: u32 = 42;
 23: 
 24: struct Scene {
 25:     atlas: Vec<u32>,
 26:     chunks: Vec<ChunkDraw>,
 27:     frame: FrameParams,
 28:     collision_boxes: Vec<Aabb>,
 29: }
 30: 
 31: /// Same assembly as `examples/path_trace.rs`: the production
 32: /// generate -> atlas-pool -> `ChunkDraw` pipeline, at a chosen chunk radius
 33: /// and voxel scale, so bench inputs are real generated worlds, not
 34: /// hand-built stand-ins.
 35: fn load_scene(radius: i32, voxel_scale: f32) -> Scene {
 36:     let mut config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
 37:     config.voxel_scale = voxel_scale;
 38:     let spawn = spawn_point(SEED);
 39:     let origin_x = (spawn.x / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size;
 40:     let origin_z = (spawn.z / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size;
 41:     let source = LocalChunkSource::new(SimpleNoiseProvider::new(), SEED, config);
 42: 
 43:     let mut payloads = Vec::new();
 44:     for dz in -radius..=radius {
 45:         for dx in -radius..=radius {
 46:             let x = origin_x + dx as f32 * config.chunk_size;
 47:             let z = origin_z + dz as f32 * config.chunk_size;
 48:             payloads.push((x, z, source.load(x, z, 0, 0)));
 49:         }
 50:     }
 51:     let max_rows = payloads
 52:         .iter()
 53:         .map(|(_, _, payload)| payload_rows(payload))
 54:         .max()
 55:         .expect("neighborhood is never empty");
 56:     let mut pool = AtlasPool::new();
 57:     pool.ensure_layout(payloads.len(), max_rows);
 58: 
 59:     let mut atlas = Vec::new();
 60:     let mut chunks = Vec::new();
 61:     let mut unique_lights = HashMap::new();
 62:     let mut collision_boxes = Vec::new();
 63:     for (x, z, payload) in &payloads {
 64:         let slot = pool.assign(chunk_key(*x, *z)).expect("atlas sized for all");
 65:         let offset = slot * pool.slot_nodes();
 66:         atlas.extend(pool.rebased_block(slot, payload));
 67:         chunks.push(ChunkDraw {
 68:             origin: [*x, 0.0, *z],
 69:             root_index: (offset + payload.root as usize) as i32,
 70:             world_size: payload.world_size,
 71:             voxel_size: payload.voxel_size,
 72:             svo_depth: payload.svo_depth,
 73:         });
 74:         for light in &payload.lights {
 75:             unique_lights.entry(light.id).or_insert(*light);
 76:         }
 77:         collision_boxes.extend(payload.collision.iter().copied());
 78:     }
 79:     let frame = FrameParams {
 80:         camera_pos: [spawn.x, 1.7, spawn.z],
 81:         yaw: -std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2,
 82:         scene_lights: unique_lights.into_values().collect(),
 83:         ..FrameParams::default()
 84:     };
 85:     Scene {
 86:         atlas,
 87:         chunks,
 88:         frame,
 89:         collision_boxes,
 90:     }
 91: }
 92: 
 93: /// A fixed 32x18 ray fan spanning a ~75-degree FOV from the scene's camera,
 94: /// reused identically across every benchmark iteration and every scene size.
 95: fn ray_fan(frame: &FrameParams) -> Vec<[f32; 3]> {
 96:     let yaw = frame.yaw;
 97:     let forward = [yaw.sin(), 0.0, -yaw.cos()];
 98:     let right = [-forward[2], 0.0, forward[0]];
 99:     let up = [0.0, 1.0, 0.0];
100:     let fov_tan = 0.767_327f32;
101:     let mut rays = Vec::with_capacity(32 * 18);
102:     for row in 0..18 {
103:         for column in 0..32 {
104:             let u = (column as f32 / 31.0 * 2.0 - 1.0) * fov_tan * (32.0 / 18.0);
105:             let v = (1.0 - row as f32 / 17.0 * 2.0) * fov_tan;
106:             let direction = [
107:                 right[0] * u + up[0] * v + forward[0],
108:                 right[1] * u + up[1] * v + forward[1],
109:                 right[2] * u + up[2] * v + forward[2],
110:             ];
111:             let length = (direction[0] * direction[0]
112:                 + direction[1] * direction[1]
113:                 + direction[2] * direction[2])
114:                 .sqrt()
115:                 .max(1e-8);
116:             rays.push([
117:                 direction[0] / length,
118:                 direction[1] / length,
119:                 direction[2] / length,
120:             ]);
121:         }
122:     }
123:     rays
124: }
125: 
126: fn trace_svo_by_chunk_count(c: &mut Criterion) {
127:     let mut group = c.benchmark_group("trace_svo_by_chunk_count");
128:     for radius in [0i32, 1, 2, 3] {
129:         let scene = load_scene(radius, 0.2);
130:         let rays = ray_fan(&scene.frame);
131:         let chunk_count = scene.chunks.len();
132:         group.bench_with_input(
133:             BenchmarkId::new("chunks", chunk_count),
134:             &(scene, rays),
135:             |b, (scene, rays)| {
136:                 b.iter(|| {
137:                     for direction in rays {
138:                         black_box(trace_svo(
139:                             &scene.atlas,
140:                             &scene.chunks,
141:                             scene.frame.camera_pos,
142:                             *direction,
143:                             300.0,
144:                             true,
145:                         ));
146:                     }
147:                 });
148:             },
149:         );
150:     }
151:     group.finish();
152: }
153: 
154: fn trace_svo_by_voxel_size(c: &mut Criterion) {
155:     let mut group = c.benchmark_group("trace_svo_by_voxel_size");
156:     for voxel_scale in [0.4f32, 0.2, 0.1] {
157:         let scene = load_scene(1, voxel_scale);
158:         let rays = ray_fan(&scene.frame);
159:         group.bench_with_input(
160:             BenchmarkId::new("voxel_scale", voxel_scale),
161:             &(scene, rays),
162:             |b, (scene, rays)| {
163:                 b.iter(|| {
164:                     for direction in rays {
165:                         black_box(trace_svo(
166:                             &scene.atlas,
167:                             &scene.chunks,
168:                             scene.frame.camera_pos,
169:                             *direction,
170:                             300.0,
171:                             true,
172:                         ));
173:                     }
174:                 });
175:             },
176:         );
177:     }
178:     group.finish();
179: }
180: 
181: fn cpu_rasterizer_full_frame(c: &mut Criterion) {
182:     let mut group = c.benchmark_group("cpu_rasterizer_full_frame");
183:     for radius in [0i32, 1, 2] {
184:         let scene = load_scene(radius, 0.2);
185:         let mut renderer = SoftwareRasterizer::new(384, 216);
186:         renderer.settings = CpuQualityPreset::Balanced.settings();
187:         renderer.upload_atlas(&scene.atlas);
188:         let chunk_count = scene.chunks.len();
189:         group.bench_with_input(
190:             BenchmarkId::new("chunks", chunk_count),
191:             &scene,
192:             |b, scene| {
193:                 b.iter(|| {
194:                     renderer.draw(&scene.frame, &scene.chunks);
195:                     black_box(renderer.framebuffer());
196:                 });
197:             },
198:         );
199:     }
200:     group.finish();
201: }
202: 
203: fn synthetic_collision_boxes(count: usize) -> Vec<Aabb> {
204:     (0..count)
205:         .map(|i| {
206:             let x = (i % 64) as f32 * 0.6;
207:             let z = (i / 64) as f32 * 0.6;
208:             Aabb::new([x, 0.0, z], [x + 0.5, 2.6, z + 0.5])
209:         })
210:         .collect()
211: }
212: 
213: fn collision_query(c: &mut Criterion) {
214:     let mut group = c.benchmark_group("collision_query");
215:     for count in [100usize, 1_000, 10_000] {
216:         let mut world = CollisionWorld::new();
217:         world.rebuild(&synthetic_collision_boxes(count));
218:         // A point near the middle of the synthetic grid: representative of
219:         // an ordinary query that must scan a meaningful fraction of boxes
220:         // before resolving (worst case for a linear, unindexed scan).
221:         let probe = [19.2, 1.0, 19.2];
222:         group.bench_with_input(BenchmarkId::new("boxes", count), &world, |b, world| {
223:             b.iter(|| black_box(world.collides(black_box(probe))));
224:         });
225:     }
226:     // Realistic anchor: collision boxes actually produced by generation for
227:     // a 3x3 chunk neighborhood, queried at the spawn point.
228:     let scene = load_scene(1, 0.2);
229:     let mut world = CollisionWorld::new();
230:     world.rebuild(&scene.collision_boxes);
231:     let box_count = world.len();
232:     group.bench_with_input(
233:         BenchmarkId::new("boxes", format!("{box_count}_generated")),
234:         &(world, scene.frame.camera_pos),
235:         |b, (world, probe)| {
236:             b.iter(|| black_box(world.collides(black_box(*probe))));
237:         },
238:     );
239:     group.finish();
240: }
241: 
242: criterion_group! {
243:     name = benches;
244:     config = Criterion::default().sample_size(20);
245:     targets = trace_svo_by_chunk_count, trace_svo_by_voxel_size, cpu_rasterizer_full_frame, collision_query
246: }
247: criterion_main!(benches);
````

## File: wasm_frontend/examples/vulkan_snapshot.rs
````rust
  1: //! Native Vulkan test build: renders the real spawn neighborhood through
  2: //! every production WebGPU pipeline and writes one PNG per renderer.
  3: //!
  4: //! This is the browserless way to eyeball the actual game image — same
  5: //! generation (`LocalChunkSource` → renderer artifacts), same pipelines the
  6: //! browser composition root drives, but on wgpu's Vulkan backend:
  7: //!
  8: //! ```sh
  9: //! cargo run -p wasm_frontend --example vulkan_snapshot --release
 10: //! ```
 11: //!
 12: //! Output lands in `target/vulkan-snapshots/*.png`. Environment knobs:
 13: //! `SEED` (default 42), `SNAPSHOT_SIZE` (`WxH`, default 960x540).
 14: 
 15: use std::collections::HashMap;
 16: use std::fs;
 17: use std::path::PathBuf;
 18: use std::sync::mpsc;
 19: 
 20: use vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider;
 21: use vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig;
 22: use vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::spawn_point;
 23: use wasm_frontend::adapters::cpu_splatter::{CpuRenderSettings, CpuShadowMode};
 24: use wasm_frontend::adapters::local_chunk_source::LocalChunkSource;
 25: use wasm_frontend::application::atlas::{AtlasPool, payload_rows};
 26: use wasm_frontend::application::ports::{
 27:     ChunkDraw, ChunkPayload, ChunkSourcePort, Environment, FrameParams, SurfaceChunk,
 28: };
 29: use wasm_frontend::application::render_settings::RenderToggles;
 30: use wasm_frontend::application::streaming::chunk_key;
 31: use wasm_frontend::drivers::webgpu::frame_resources::FrameResources;
 32: use wasm_frontend::drivers::webgpu::gpu_types::{GpuFrameUniforms, collect_frame_lights};
 33: use wasm_frontend::drivers::webgpu::pipelines::{
 34:     CpuPresentPipeline, RaymarchPipeline, RaymarchRuntimeOptions, SplatPipeline, SurfacePipeline,
 35: };
 36: 
 37: const TARGET_FORMAT: wgpu::TextureFormat = wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm;
 38: const FOV_TAN: f32 = 0.767_327;
 39: const MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE: f32 = 48.0;
 40: const TRACE_BUDGET: u32 = 512;
 41: const FACE_BUDGET: u32 = 262_144;
 42: 
 43: struct LoadedWorld {
 44:     payloads: Vec<(f32, f32, ChunkPayload)>,
 45:     chunks: Vec<ChunkDraw>,
 46:     atlas: Vec<u32>,
 47:     frame: FrameParams,
 48: }
 49: 
 50: fn main() {
 51:     let seed: u32 = std::env::var("SEED")
 52:         .ok()
 53:         .and_then(|value| value.parse().ok())
 54:         .unwrap_or(42);
 55:     let (width, height) = snapshot_size();
 56: 
 57:     let (device, queue) = create_vulkan_device();
 58:     let world = load_spawn_world(seed);
 59:     eprintln!(
 60:         "world: {} chunks, {} lights, {} atlas words (seed {seed})",
 61:         world.chunks.len(),
 62:         world.frame.scene_lights.len(),
 63:         world.atlas.len(),
 64:     );
 65: 
 66:     let toggles = RenderToggles::default();
 67:     let lights = collect_frame_lights(&world.frame);
 68:     let uniforms = GpuFrameUniforms::from_frame(
 69:         &world.frame,
 70:         width,
 71:         height,
 72:         FOV_TAN,
 73:         MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE,
 74:         TRACE_BUDGET,
 75:         lights.len(),
 76:         toggles,
 77:     );
 78:     let mut frame_resources = FrameResources::new(&device);
 79:     frame_resources.write(&device, &queue, &uniforms, &lights);
 80: 
 81:     let out_dir = PathBuf::from("target/vulkan-snapshots");
 82:     fs::create_dir_all(&out_dir).expect("create snapshot directory");
 83: 
 84:     // Surface: indexed meshes, one upload per chunk.
 85:     let mut surface = SurfacePipeline::new(
 86:         &device,
 87:         TARGET_FORMAT,
 88:         frame_resources.layout(),
 89:         MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE,
 90:     );
 91:     let surface_chunks: Vec<SurfaceChunk> = world
 92:         .payloads
 93:         .iter()
 94:         .map(|(x, z, payload)| SurfaceChunk {
 95:             key: chunk_key(*x, *z),
 96:             origin: [*x, 0.0, *z],
 97:             mesh: &payload.surface,
 98:         })
 99:         .collect();
100:     surface.upload(&device, &surface_chunks);
101:     let pixels = render_offscreen(&device, &queue, width, height, true, |encoder, color, depth| {
102:         surface.draw(
103:             &queue,
104:             encoder,
105:             color,
106:             depth.expect("surface pass renders with depth"),
107:             &frame_resources,
108:             &world.frame,
109:             toggles,
110:             world.frame.scene_lights.len() as u32,
111:         );
112:     });
113:     write_png(&out_dir, "surface", width, height, &pixels);
114: 
115:     // Splat: compact face pages expanded on the GPU.
116:     let mut splat = SplatPipeline::new(
117:         &device,
118:         TARGET_FORMAT,
119:         frame_resources.layout(),
120:         MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE,
121:         FACE_BUDGET,
122:     );
123:     splat.upload(&device, &surface_chunks);
124:     let pixels = render_offscreen(&device, &queue, width, height, true, |encoder, color, depth| {
125:         splat.draw(
126:             &queue,
127:             encoder,
128:             color,
129:             depth.expect("splat pass renders with depth"),
130:             &frame_resources,
131:             &world.frame,
132:             toggles,
133:             world.frame.scene_lights.len() as u32,
134:         );
135:     });
136:     write_png(&out_dir, "splat", width, height, &pixels);
137: 
138:     // Raymarch: canonical SVO words traced in the fragment shader.
139:     let mut raymarch = RaymarchPipeline::new(
140:         &device,
141:         TARGET_FORMAT,
142:         frame_resources.layout(),
143:         world.chunks.len(),
144:     );
145:     raymarch.configure(RaymarchRuntimeOptions::new(MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE, true, 4));
146:     raymarch.upload_atlas(&device, &world.atlas);
147:     let pixels = render_offscreen(&device, &queue, width, height, false, |encoder, color, _| {
148:         raymarch.draw(
149:             &queue,
150:             encoder,
151:             color,
152:             &frame_resources,
153:             &world.frame,
154:             &world.chunks,
155:             toggles,
156:         );
157:     });
158:     write_png(&out_dir, "raymarch", width, height, &pixels);
159: 
160:     // CPU splatter, presented through the production WebGPU texture pass.
161:     let mut cpu_present = CpuPresentPipeline::new(&device, TARGET_FORMAT, width, height);
162:     cpu_present.upload_atlas(&world.atlas);
163:     let cpu_settings = CpuRenderSettings {
164:         max_draw_distance: MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE,
165:         shadows: CpuShadowMode::Off,
166:         fov_tan: FOV_TAN,
167:         toggles,
168:         ..CpuRenderSettings::default()
169:     };
170:     let pixels = render_offscreen(&device, &queue, width, height, false, |encoder, color, _| {
171:         cpu_present.draw(
172:             &queue,
173:             encoder,
174:             color,
175:             &world.frame,
176:             &world.chunks,
177:             cpu_settings,
178:         );
179:     });
180:     write_png(&out_dir, "cpu", width, height, &pixels);
181: 
182:     eprintln!("snapshots written to {}", out_dir.display());
183: }
184: 
185: fn snapshot_size() -> (u32, u32) {
186:     let requested = std::env::var("SNAPSHOT_SIZE").unwrap_or_default();
187:     let parsed = requested
188:         .split_once('x')
189:         .and_then(|(w, h)| Some((w.parse().ok()?, h.parse().ok()?)));
190:     let (width, height): (u32, u32) = parsed.unwrap_or((960, 540));
191:     // Readback rows must be 256-byte aligned; keep it simple by requiring
192:     // the width itself to align (RGBA8 => 64-pixel multiples).
193:     assert!(
194:         (width * 4) % wgpu::COPY_BYTES_PER_ROW_ALIGNMENT == 0,
195:         "SNAPSHOT_SIZE width must be a multiple of 64 pixels"
196:     );
197:     (width.max(64), height.max(1))
198: }
199: 
200: fn create_vulkan_device() -> (wgpu::Device, wgpu::Queue) {
201:     let mut descriptor = wgpu::InstanceDescriptor::new_without_display_handle();
202:     descriptor.backends = wgpu::Backends::VULKAN;
203:     let instance = wgpu::Instance::new(descriptor);
204:     let adapter = pollster::block_on(instance.request_adapter(&wgpu::RequestAdapterOptions {
205:         power_preference: wgpu::PowerPreference::None,
206:         force_fallback_adapter: false,
207:         compatible_surface: None,
208:         apply_limit_buckets: false,
209:     }))
210:     .unwrap_or_else(|error| {
211:         panic!("no Vulkan adapter; install Mesa (Lavapipe) or expose a Vulkan GPU: {error}")
212:     });
213:     let info = adapter.get_info();
214:     eprintln!(
215:         "Vulkan adapter: {} ({}, {})",
216:         info.name, info.driver, info.driver_info
217:     );
218:     let limits = wgpu::Limits::default().or_worse_values_from(&adapter.limits());
219:     let (device, queue) = pollster::block_on(adapter.request_device(&wgpu::DeviceDescriptor {
220:         label: Some("vackrooms.vulkan-snapshot"),
221:         required_features: wgpu::Features::empty(),
222:         required_limits: limits,
223:         ..Default::default()
224:     }))
225:     .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("failed to create the Vulkan device: {error}"));
226:     (device, queue)
227: }
228: 
229: /// Generates the 3x3 chunk neighborhood around the spawn corridor with the
230: /// same source the browser workers use, and assembles the shared SVO atlas
231: /// exactly like the streaming engine does.
232: fn load_spawn_world(seed: u32) -> LoadedWorld {
233:     let config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
234:     let spawn = spawn_point(seed);
235:     let origin_x = (spawn.x / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size;
236:     let origin_z = (spawn.z / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size;
237:     let source = LocalChunkSource::new(SimpleNoiseProvider::new(), seed, config);
238: 
239:     let mut payloads = Vec::new();
240:     for dz in -1..=1 {
241:         for dx in -1..=1 {
242:             let x = origin_x + dx as f32 * config.chunk_size;
243:             let z = origin_z + dz as f32 * config.chunk_size;
244:             payloads.push((x, z, source.load(x, z, 0, 0)));
245:         }
246:     }
247: 
248:     let max_rows = payloads
249:         .iter()
250:         .map(|(_, _, payload)| payload_rows(payload))
251:         .max()
252:         .expect("spawn neighborhood is never empty");
253:     let mut pool = AtlasPool::new();
254:     pool.ensure_layout(payloads.len(), max_rows);
255: 
256:     let mut atlas = Vec::new();
257:     let mut chunks = Vec::new();
258:     let mut unique_lights = HashMap::new();
259:     for (x, z, payload) in &payloads {
260:         let key = chunk_key(*x, *z);
261:         let slot = pool.assign(key).expect("atlas sized for every chunk");
262:         let offset = slot * pool.slot_nodes();
263:         atlas.extend(pool.rebased_block(slot, payload));
264:         chunks.push(ChunkDraw {
265:             origin: [*x, 0.0, *z],
266:             root_index: (offset + payload.root as usize) as i32,
267:             world_size: payload.world_size,
268:             voxel_size: payload.voxel_size,
269:             svo_depth: payload.svo_depth,
270:         });
271:         for light in &payload.lights {
272:             let quantized = [
273:                 (light.position[0] * 16.0) as i32,
274:                 (light.position[1] * 16.0) as i32,
275:                 (light.position[2] * 16.0) as i32,
276:             ];
277:             unique_lights.entry(quantized).or_insert(*light);
278:         }
279:     }
280: 
281:     let frame = FrameParams {
282:         camera_pos: [spawn.x, 1.7, spawn.z],
283:         yaw: -std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2,
284:         pitch: 0.0,
285:         scene_lights: unique_lights.into_values().collect(),
286:         environment: Environment::interior(),
287:         ..FrameParams::default()
288:     };
289: 
290:     LoadedWorld {
291:         payloads,
292:         chunks,
293:         atlas,
294:         frame,
295:     }
296: }
297: 
298: fn render_offscreen(
299:     device: &wgpu::Device,
300:     queue: &wgpu::Queue,
301:     width: u32,
302:     height: u32,
303:     with_depth: bool,
304:     draw: impl FnOnce(&mut wgpu::CommandEncoder, &wgpu::TextureView, Option<&wgpu::TextureView>),
305: ) -> Vec<u8> {
306:     let extent = wgpu::Extent3d {
307:         width,
308:         height,
309:         depth_or_array_layers: 1,
310:     };
311:     let color = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
312:         label: Some("vackrooms.snapshot-color"),
313:         size: extent,
314:         mip_level_count: 1,
315:         sample_count: 1,
316:         dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
317:         format: TARGET_FORMAT,
318:         usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_SRC,
319:         view_formats: &[],
320:     });
321:     let color_view = color.create_view(&Default::default());
322:     let depth_view = with_depth.then(|| {
323:         device
324:             .create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
325:                 label: Some("vackrooms.snapshot-depth"),
326:                 size: extent,
327:                 mip_level_count: 1,
328:                 sample_count: 1,
329:                 dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
330:                 format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
331:                 usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
332:                 view_formats: &[],
333:             })
334:             .create_view(&Default::default())
335:     });
336: 
337:     let bytes_per_row = width * 4;
338:     let readback = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
339:         label: Some("vackrooms.snapshot-readback"),
340:         size: u64::from(bytes_per_row * height),
341:         usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST | wgpu::BufferUsages::MAP_READ,
342:         mapped_at_creation: false,
343:     });
344:     let mut encoder =
345:         device.create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor { label: None });
346:     draw(&mut encoder, &color_view, depth_view.as_ref());
347:     encoder.copy_texture_to_buffer(
348:         color.as_image_copy(),
349:         wgpu::TexelCopyBufferInfo {
350:             buffer: &readback,
351:             layout: wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout {
352:                 offset: 0,
353:                 bytes_per_row: Some(bytes_per_row),
354:                 rows_per_image: Some(height),
355:             },
356:         },
357:         extent,
358:     );
359:     queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
360: 
361:     let (mapped_tx, mapped_rx) = mpsc::channel();
362:     readback
363:         .slice(..)
364:         .map_async(wgpu::MapMode::Read, move |result| {
365:             let _ = mapped_tx.send(result);
366:         });
367:     device
368:         .poll(wgpu::PollType::wait_indefinitely())
369:         .expect("device poll for snapshot readback");
370:     mapped_rx
371:         .recv()
372:         .expect("map_async callback")
373:         .expect("snapshot readback mapping");
374:     let pixels = readback
375:         .slice(..)
376:         .get_mapped_range()
377:         .expect("snapshot readback range")
378:         .to_vec();
379:     readback.unmap();
380:     pixels
381: }
382: 
383: fn write_png(dir: &std::path::Path, name: &str, width: u32, height: u32, rgba: &[u8]) {
384:     let path = dir.join(format!("{name}.png"));
385:     let image = image::RgbaImage::from_raw(width, height, rgba.to_vec())
386:         .expect("snapshot buffer matches dimensions");
387:     image.save(&path).expect("write snapshot png");
388:     eprintln!("wrote {}", path.display());
389: }

 83: impl SoftwareRasterizer {
 84:     /// Traversal entry point kept narrow for the frame orchestrator.
 85:     pub(super) fn traverse_voxel_chunk(
 86:         &mut self,
 87:         cam: &Camera,
 88:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
 89:         chunk: &ChunkDraw,
 90:         scene_lights: &[LightSource],
 91:         global_hero_id: Option<u64>,
 92:     ) {
 93:         let lighting = ChunkLighting::with_global_hero(scene_lights, global_hero_id);
 94:         self.traverse_voxel_node(cam, chunks, lighting, NodeVisit::root(chunk));
 95:     }
 96: 
 97:     /// Projects, resolves, and dispatches one node. All branch-specific work
 98:     /// is delegated so the recursive control flow remains readable.
 99:     fn traverse_voxel_node(
100:         &mut self,
101:         cam: &Camera,
102:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
103:         lighting: ChunkLighting<'_>,
104:         visit: NodeVisit,
105:     ) {
106:         // These are absolute frame limits, checked before projection, atlas
107:         // decode, lighting, or a secondary visibility ray. In particular,
108:         // reaching the pixel-write cap must not leave an invisible tail of
109:         // expensive shading work in the recursion.
110:         if self.frame_work_budget.writes_exhausted(self.pixel_writes)
111:             || self.frame_work_budget.nodes_exhausted(self.visited_nodes)
112:         {
113:             self.budget_exhausted = true;
114:             return;
115:         }
116: 
117:         let Some(projected) = project_voxel_node(self, cam, visit) else {
118:             return;
119:         };
120: 
121:         // Preserve telemetry semantics: a projected malformed atlas node is
122:         // counted before its failed decode, just as the original traversal.
123:         self.visited_nodes += 1;
124:         let Some(kind) = self.resolve_node(visit) else {
125:             return;
126:         };
127: 
128:         let at_hard_cap = self.frame_work_budget.nodes_exhausted(self.visited_nodes);
129:         let outside_focus_reserve = self
130:             .frame_work_budget
131:             .outside_focus_reserve(self.visited_nodes)
132:             && !node_is_in_flashlight_focus(cam, &projected);
133:         if at_hard_cap || outside_focus_reserve {
134:             self.budget_exhausted = true;
135:             self.render_budget_fallback(cam, chunks, lighting, visit, &projected, kind);
136:             return;
137:         }
138: 
139:         match kind {
140:             NodeKind::Leaf { payload, exposure } => {
141:                 let visit = NodeVisit { exposure, ..visit };
142:                 self.render_leaf(cam, chunks, lighting, visit, &projected, payload)
143:             }
144:             NodeKind::Interior {
145:                 child_base,
146:                 child_mask,
147:             } => {
148:                 self.render_interior(
149:                     cam, chunks, lighting, visit, &projected, child_base, child_mask,
150:                 );
151:             }
152:         }
153:     }
154: 
155:     fn resolve_node(&self, visit: NodeVisit) -> Option<NodeKind> {
156:         if let Some(payload) = visit.virtual_leaf {
157:             return Some(NodeKind::Leaf {
158:                 payload,
159:                 exposure: visit.exposure,
160:             });
161:         }
162: 
163:         let node = decode_node(&self.atlas, visit.node_idx)?;
164:         if node.is_leaf {
165:             let linear_albedo = self
166:                 .mips
167:                 .get(visit.node_idx)
168:                 .map_or([0.0; 3], |mip| mip.linear_albedo);
169:             Some(NodeKind::Leaf {
170:                 payload: LeafPayload {
171:                     voxel_type: node.voxel_type,
172:                     linear_albedo,
173:                     baked_rgb: node.baked_rgb,
174:                 },
175:                 exposure: node.exposure,
176:             })
177:         } else {
178:             Some(NodeKind::Interior {
179:                 child_base: node.child_base,
180:                 child_mask: node.child_mask,
181:             })
182:         }
183:     }
184: 
185:     /// Safety-cap behavior: retain the current fidelity and stop descending.
186:     fn render_budget_fallback(
187:         &mut self,
188:         cam: &Camera,
189:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
190:         lighting: ChunkLighting<'_>,
191:         visit: NodeVisit,
192:         projected: &ProjectedVoxelNode,
193:         kind: NodeKind,
194:     ) {
195:         match kind {
196:             NodeKind::Leaf { payload, exposure } if payload.voxel_type != VOXEL_AIR => {
197:                 let visit = NodeVisit { exposure, ..visit };
198:                 self.draw_leaf_splat(cam, chunks, lighting, visit, projected, payload);
199:             }
200:             NodeKind::Leaf { .. } => {}
201:             NodeKind::Interior { .. } => {
202:                 self.draw_mip_splat(cam, chunks, lighting, visit, projected)
203:             }
204:         }
205:     }
206: 
207:     fn render_leaf(
208:         &mut self,
209:         cam: &Camera,
210:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
211:         lighting: ChunkLighting<'_>,
212:         visit: NodeVisit,
213:         projected: &ProjectedVoxelNode,
214:         payload: LeafPayload,
215:     ) {
216:         if payload.voxel_type == VOXEL_AIR {
217:             return;
218:         }
219:         self.max_virtual_depth_reached = self.max_virtual_depth_reached.max(visit.virtual_depth);
220: 
221:         let should_subdivide = should_subdivide_leaf(&self.settings, visit, projected);
222:         if should_subdivide {
223:             self.visit_children(
224:                 cam,
225:                 chunks,
226:                 lighting,
227:                 visit,
228:                 VoxelChildren::Virtual(payload),
229:                 visit.crowded_siblings,
230:             );
231:         } else {
232:             self.draw_leaf_splat(cam, chunks, lighting, visit, projected, payload);
233:         }
234:     }
235: 
236:     fn draw_leaf_splat(
237:         &mut self,
238:         cam: &Camera,
239:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
240:         lighting: ChunkLighting<'_>,
241:         visit: NodeVisit,
242:         projected: &ProjectedVoxelNode,
243:         payload: LeafPayload,
244:     ) {
245:         let half_px = projected.footprint.enclosing_radius().max(0.85);
246:         let emission_strength = emission_strength(payload.voxel_type);
247:         let emissive = emission_strength.is_some();
248:         let Some(surface_depth) = project_surface_depth(
249:             cam,
250:             projected.center,
251:             visit.size,
252:             payload.voxel_type,
253:             emissive,
254:             visit.exposure,
255:         ) else {
256:             return;
257:         };
258:         if self.settings.toggles.deferred_shading
259:             && !self.surface_splat_may_contribute(
260:                 projected.footprint.center[0],
261:                 projected.footprint.center[1],
262:                 half_px,
263:                 surface_depth,
264:                 emissive,
265:             )
266:         {
267:             return;
268:         }
269:         let hero_visibility = self.resolve_hero_light_visibility(
270:             chunks,
271:             projected.center,
272:             visit.size,
273:             emissive,
274:             surface_depth.representative_depth(),
275:             lighting.hero,
276:         );
277:         self.shade_predecoded_and_splat_with_frame_lighting(
278:             cam,
279:             chunks,
280:             frame_lighting(lighting.fixtures, hero_visibility),
281:             projected.center,
282:             visit.size,
283:             projected.footprint.center[0],
284:             projected.footprint.center[1],
285:             half_px,
286:             surface_depth,
287:             payload.linear_albedo,
288:             payload.baked_rgb.map(f32::from),
289:             emission_strength,
290:             payload.voxel_type,
291:             visit.exposure,
292:             visit.crowded_siblings,
293:         );
294:     }
295: 
296:     fn render_interior(
297:         &mut self,
298:         cam: &Camera,
299:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
300:         lighting: ChunkLighting<'_>,
301:         visit: NodeVisit,
302:         projected: &ProjectedVoxelNode,
303:         child_base: usize,
304:         child_mask: u32,
305:     ) {
306:         // OPTIMIZATION (LOD): a subtree fitting in roughly a pixel becomes
307:         // one prefiltered MIP splat instead of a full descendant walk.
308:         let contains_emissive = self
309:             .mips
310:             .get(visit.node_idx)
311:             .is_some_and(|mip| mip.emissive_coverage > 0.0);
312:         if should_draw_mip_splat(&self.settings, projected) && !contains_emissive {
313:             self.draw_mip_splat(cam, chunks, lighting, visit, projected);
314:             return;
315:         }
316: 
317:         self.visit_children(
318:             cam,
319:             chunks,
320:             lighting,
321:             visit,
322:             VoxelChildren::Atlas {
323:                 base: child_base,
324:                 mask: child_mask,
325:             },
326:             child_mask.count_ones(),
327:         );
328:     }
329: 
330:     fn draw_mip_splat(
331:         &mut self,
332:         cam: &Camera,
333:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
334:         lighting: ChunkLighting<'_>,
335:         visit: NodeVisit,
336:         projected: &ProjectedVoxelNode,
337:     ) {
338:         let mip = self.mips.get(visit.node_idx).copied().unwrap_or_default();
339:         if mip.occupancy < self.settings.min_mip_occupancy {
340:             return;
341:         }
342:         let half_px = projected.footprint.enclosing_radius().max(0.85);
343:         let emissive = mip.emissive_coverage > 0.0;
344:         let mip_voxel_type = if emissive {
345:             vackrooms::domain::entities::voxel_grid::VOXEL_LIGHT as u32
346:         } else {
347:             mip.dominant_voxel_type
348:         };
349:         let Some(surface_depth) = project_surface_depth(
350:             cam,
351:             projected.center,
352:             visit.size,
353:             mip_voxel_type,
354:             emissive,
355:             mip.exposed_area,
356:         ) else {
357:             return;
358:         };
359:         if self.settings.toggles.deferred_shading
360:             && !self.surface_splat_may_contribute(
361:                 projected.footprint.center[0],
362:                 projected.footprint.center[1],
363:                 half_px,
364:                 surface_depth,
365:                 emissive,
366:             )
367:         {
368:             return;
369:         }
370:         let hero_visibility = self.resolve_hero_light_visibility(
371:             chunks,
372:             projected.center,
373:             visit.size,
374:             emissive,
375:             surface_depth.representative_depth(),
376:             lighting.hero,
377:         );
378:         self.shade_predecoded_and_splat_with_frame_lighting(
379:             cam,
380:             chunks,
381:             frame_lighting(lighting.fixtures, hero_visibility),
382:             projected.center,
383:             visit.size,
384:             projected.footprint.center[0],
385:             projected.footprint.center[1],
386:             half_px,
387:             surface_depth,
388:             if emissive {
389:                 mip.emitted_radiance_density
390:             } else {
391:                 mip.linear_albedo
392:             },
393:             mip.baked_rgb,
394:             emissive.then_some(1.0),
395:             mip_voxel_type,
396:             mip.exposed_area,
397:             visit.crowded_siblings,
398:         );
399:     }
400: 
401:     /// Visits occupied octants either near-to-far or in reference index
402:     /// order. Virtual subdivision reuses one leaf payload at the next depth.
403:     fn visit_children(
404:         &mut self,
405:         cam: &Camera,
406:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
407:         lighting: ChunkLighting<'_>,
408:         parent: NodeVisit,
409:         children: VoxelChildren,
410:         crowding: u32,
411:     ) {
412:         for child in voxel_child_visits(
413:             parent,
414:             children,
415:             crowding,
416:             cam.pos,
417:             self.settings.toggles.front_to_back,
418:         )
419:         .into_iter()
420:         .flatten()
421:         {
422:             self.traverse_voxel_node(cam, chunks, lighting, child);
423:         }
424:     }
425: }
426: 
427: fn frame_lighting(
428:     scene_lights: &[LightSource],
429:     hero_visibility: Option<HeroLightVisibility>,
430: ) -> FrameLighting<'_> {
431:     match hero_visibility {
432:         Some(hero) => {
433:             FrameLighting::with_hero_visibility(scene_lights, hero.light_id, hero.visibility)
434:         }
435:         None => FrameLighting::unshadowed(scene_lights),
436:     }
437: }

## File: wasm_frontend/src/adapters/cpu_splatter/rasterizer/traverse_voxel_scene/project_voxel_node.rs
````rust
 1: //! Project one voxel node and conservatively reject invisible bounds.
 2: 
 3: use super::super::super::camera::{Camera, dot};
 4: use super::super::SoftwareRasterizer;
 5: use super::super::project_aabb_footprint::{
 6:     NEAR_PLANE_DEPTH, ScreenFootprint, aabb_camera_depth_interval, project_screen_footprint,
 7: };
 8: use super::NodeVisit;
 9: 
10: /// Screen-space facts shared by traversal, LOD selection, and splat drawing.
11: pub(super) struct ProjectedVoxelNode {
12:     pub(super) center: [f32; 3],
13:     pub(super) relative_to_camera: [f32; 3],
14:     pub(super) camera_depth: f32,
15:     /// One eight-corner projection shared by culling, LOD, splitting, HZ,
16:     /// deferred-depth rejection, and the final splat write.
17:     pub(super) footprint: ScreenFootprint,
18: }
19: 
20: /// Returns `None` when the node cannot contribute a visible pixel.
21: pub(super) fn project_voxel_node(
22:     renderer: &SoftwareRasterizer,
23:     camera: &Camera,
24:     visit: NodeVisit,
25: ) -> Option<ProjectedVoxelNode> {
26:     let half_size = visit.size * 0.5;
27:     let center = [
28:         visit.min[0] + half_size,
29:         visit.min[1] + half_size,
30:         visit.min[2] + half_size,
31:     ];
32:     let relative_to_camera = [
33:         center[0] - camera.pos[0],
34:         center[1] - camera.pos[1],
35:         center[2] - camera.pos[2],
36:     ];
37:     let camera_depth = dot(relative_to_camera, camera.forward);
38:     let depth_interval = aabb_camera_depth_interval(camera, relative_to_camera, half_size);
39:     if depth_interval[1] <= NEAR_PLANE_DEPTH {
40:         return None;
41:     }
42: 
43:     let footprint = project_screen_footprint(camera, visit.min, visit.size, depth_interval[0])?;
44: 
45:     if footprint.outside_framebuffer(renderer.target.width(), renderer.target.height()) {
46:         return None;
47:     }
48: 
49:     // OPTIMIZATION (hierarchical z): every overlapping tile must be fully
50:     // covered and its farthest pixel nearer than the node's nearest bound.
51:     if renderer.settings.toggles.hierarchical_z
52:         && renderer.target.coarse_rect_occludes(
53:             footprint.center,
54:             footprint.half_extent,
55:             footprint.nearest_depth.max(0.0),
56:         )
57:     {
58:         return None;
59:     }
60: 
61:     Some(ProjectedVoxelNode {
62:         center,
63:         relative_to_camera,
64:         camera_depth,
65:         footprint,
66:     })
67: }
68: 
69: /// True when a projected node may use the bounded flashlight-focus reserve
70: /// between the soft degradation threshold and the absolute hard cap.
71: pub(super) fn node_is_in_flashlight_focus(camera: &Camera, projected: &ProjectedVoxelNode) -> bool {
72:     if !camera.flashlight {
73:         return false;
74:     }
75:     let distance = projected.camera_depth.max(0.001);
76:     if distance >= 15.0 {
77:         return false;
78:     }
79:     let direction = projected
80:         .relative_to_camera
81:         .map(|component| component / distance);
82:     dot(direction, camera.forward) > 0.88
83: }
````

 1: //! Select real-node MIP detail and virtual leaf subdivision.
 2: //!
 3: //! These predicates are the complete LOD policy. Traversal performs the
 4: //! chosen action but does not hide additional quality thresholds.
 5: 
 6: use super::super::super::settings::CpuRenderSettings;
 7: use super::NodeVisit;
 8: use super::project_voxel_node::ProjectedVoxelNode;

10: pub(super) fn should_subdivide_leaf(
11:     settings: &CpuRenderSettings,
12:     visit: NodeVisit,
13:     projected: &ProjectedVoxelNode,
14: ) -> bool {
15:     projected.footprint.enclosing_radius() > settings.max_splat_radius_px
16:         && visit.size > settings.min_split_size
17:         && visit.virtual_depth < settings.max_virtual_depth as usize
18: }
19: 
20: /// OPTIMIZATION (MIP LOD): a subtree fitting in roughly one pixel becomes
21: /// one prefiltered splat instead of a full descendant walk.

23:     settings: &CpuRenderSettings,
24:     projected: &ProjectedVoxelNode,
25: ) -> bool {
26:     settings.toggles.mip_lod && projected.footprint.enclosing_radius() < settings.lod_cutoff_px
27: }

## File: wasm_frontend/src/adapters/cpu_splatter/rasterizer/traverse_voxel_scene/visit_voxel_octants.rs
````rust
 1: //! Construct occupied child visits in the configured traversal order.
 2: 
 3: use super::super::super::surface_geometry::exposure_for_octant;
 4: use super::{LeafPayload, NodeVisit};
 5: 
 6: #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
 7: pub(super) enum VoxelChildren {
 8:     Atlas { base: usize, mask: u32 },
 9:     Virtual(LeafPayload),
10: }
11: 
12: impl VoxelChildren {
13:     fn occupied_mask(self) -> u32 {
14:         match self {
15:             Self::Atlas { mask, .. } => mask,
16:             Self::Virtual(_) => 0xFF,
17:         }
18:     }
19: 
20:     fn atlas_or_virtual_child(
21:         self,
22:         octant: u32,
23:         parent_virtual_depth: usize,
24:     ) -> (usize, Option<LeafPayload>, usize) {
25:         match self {
26:             Self::Atlas { base, .. } => (base + octant as usize, None, 0),
27:             Self::Virtual(payload) => (usize::MAX, Some(payload), parent_virtual_depth + 1),
28:         }
29:     }
30: }
31: 
32: /// Occupied child visits in near-to-far order, or plain atlas order when the
33: /// optimization is disabled. Empty slots let the caller use one stack-free,
34: /// fixed-size result without allocation.
35: pub(super) fn voxel_child_visits(
36:     parent: NodeVisit,
37:     children: VoxelChildren,
38:     crowded_siblings: u32,
39:     camera_position: [f32; 3],
40:     front_to_back: bool,
41: ) -> [Option<NodeVisit>; 8] {
42:     let half_size = parent.size * 0.5;
43:     let parent_center = [
44:         parent.min[0] + half_size,
45:         parent.min[1] + half_size,
46:         parent.min[2] + half_size,
47:     ];
48:     let camera_octant = (camera_position[0] >= parent_center[0]) as u32
49:         | (((camera_position[1] >= parent_center[1]) as u32) << 1)
50:         | (((camera_position[2] >= parent_center[2]) as u32) << 2);
51: 
52:     // XOR distances grouped by popcount: camera octant first, opposite last.
53:     const NEAR_TO_FAR_XOR: [u32; 8] = [0, 1, 2, 4, 3, 5, 6, 7];
54:     let occupied_mask = children.occupied_mask();
55:     let mut visits = [None; 8];
56:     for (index, relative_octant) in NEAR_TO_FAR_XOR.into_iter().enumerate() {
57:         let octant = if front_to_back {
58:             camera_octant ^ relative_octant
59:         } else {
60:             index as u32
61:         };
62:         if occupied_mask & (1 << octant) == 0 {
63:             continue;
64:         }
65: 
66:         let min = [
67:             parent.min[0] + (octant & 1) as f32 * half_size,
68:             parent.min[1] + ((octant >> 1) & 1) as f32 * half_size,
69:             parent.min[2] + ((octant >> 2) & 1) as f32 * half_size,
70:         ];
71:         let (node_idx, virtual_leaf, virtual_depth) =
72:             children.atlas_or_virtual_child(octant, parent.virtual_depth);
73:         visits[index] = Some(NodeVisit {
74:             node_idx,
75:             min,
76:             size: half_size,
77:             crowded_siblings,
78:             virtual_leaf,
79:             virtual_depth,
80:             exposure: exposure_for_octant(parent.exposure, occupied_mask, octant),
81:         });
82:     }
83:     visits
84: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/adapters/cpu_splatter/rasterizer/draw_visible_flare_cores.rs
````rust
 1: //! Draw the visible cores of dynamic flare lights.
 2: //!
 3: //! A core is an ordinary depth-tested splat. Drawing it after scene geometry
 4: //! lets the fine depth buffer provide wall occlusion without another raycast.
 5: 
 6: use crate::application::ports::FrameParams;
 7: 
 8: use super::super::camera::{Camera, dot};
 9: use super::SoftwareRasterizer;
10: 
11: impl SoftwareRasterizer {
12:     pub(super) fn draw_visible_flare_cores(&mut self, frame: &FrameParams, camera: &Camera) {
13:         for light in frame.active_dynamic_lights() {
14:             let Some(core) = project_flare_core(light.position, light.intensity, camera) else {
15:                 continue;
16:             };
17:             if core.depth > self.settings.max_draw_distance {
18:                 continue;
19:             }
20: 
21:             self.splat(
22:                 core.pixel[0],
23:                 core.pixel[1],
24:                 core.half_extent,
25:                 core.depth - 0.05,
26:                 core.color,
27:             );
28:         }
29:     }
30: }
31: 
32: struct ProjectedFlareCore {
33:     pixel: [f32; 2],
34:     half_extent: f32,
35:     depth: f32,
36:     color: [u8; 3],
37: }
38: 
39: fn project_flare_core(
40:     position: [f32; 3],
41:     intensity: f32,
42:     camera: &Camera,
43: ) -> Option<ProjectedFlareCore> {
44:     let relative = [
45:         position[0] - camera.pos[0],
46:         position[1] - camera.pos[1],
47:         position[2] - camera.pos[2],
48:     ];
49:     let depth = dot(relative, camera.forward);
50:     if depth <= 0.1 {
51:         return None;
52:     }
53: 
54:     let normalized_intensity = intensity.clamp(0.0, 1.6) / 1.6;
55:     Some(ProjectedFlareCore {
56:         pixel: [
57:             camera.half_w + dot(relative, camera.right) / depth * camera.focal_px,
58:             camera.half_h - dot(relative, camera.up) / depth * camera.focal_px,
59:         ],
60:         half_extent: (0.06 / depth * camera.focal_px).clamp(1.0, 6.0),
61:         depth,
62:         color: [
63:             (255.0 * normalized_intensity) as u8,
64:             (150.0 * normalized_intensity) as u8,
65:             (60.0 * normalized_intensity) as u8,
66:         ],
67:     })
68: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/adapters/cpu_splatter/rasterizer/frame_work_budget.rs
````rust
  1: //! Derive one bounded frame-work envelope from the actual render target.
  2: //!
  3: //! A fixed global cap makes a quality preset self-defeating: increasing the
  4: //! backing size or asking for smaller splats spends the same allowance over
  5: //! more pixels and can therefore reveal *less* of the scene.  This policy
  6: //! instead assigns work per target pixel, then raises that density as the
  7: //! validated geometry settings request more detail.
  8: //!
  9: //! The limits are safety valves, not quality targets.  Ordinary frames finish
 10: //! well below them.  Absolute ceilings remain so a corrupt target size or
 11: //! pathological atlas cannot monopolize the browser indefinitely.
 12: 
 13: use super::super::settings::CpuRenderSettings;
 14: 
 15: /// Hard stop for malformed/pathological traversal, independent of target
 16: /// dimensions.  The 1920x1080 Maximum regression remains below this ceiling.
 17: pub(super) const ABSOLUTE_NODE_VISIT_CEILING: usize = 8_000_000;
 18: /// Hard stop for fine-depth writes.  Large enough for several layers over a
 19: /// 1920x1080 Maximum target, but finite even if dimensions are corrupted.
 20: pub(super) const ABSOLUTE_PIXEL_WRITE_CEILING: usize = 16_000_000;
 21: 
 22: const MINIMUM_NODE_VISITS: usize = 16_384;
 23: const MINIMUM_PIXEL_WRITES: usize = 4_096;
 24: const FOCUS_RESERVE_FRACTION: f64 = 0.90;
 25: 
 26: /// Immutable work limits for one framebuffer/settings snapshot.
 27: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 28: pub(super) struct FrameWorkBudget {
 29:     node_visit_limit: usize,
 30:     soft_node_visit_limit: usize,
 31:     pixel_write_limit: usize,
 32: }
 33: 
 34: impl FrameWorkBudget {
 35:     /// Builds a target-aware envelope from validated renderer settings.
 36:     ///
 37:     /// The density functions deliberately use only existing, user-visible
 38:     /// quality controls.  A custom profile therefore reproduces its budget
 39:     /// from its URL/settings values without another hidden preset identity.
 40:     pub(super) fn for_target(settings: &CpuRenderSettings, width: usize, height: usize) -> Self {
 41:         let settings = settings.validated();
 42:         let target_pixels = width.saturating_mul(height).max(1);
 43: 
 44:         let node_visit_limit = scaled_limit(
 45:             target_pixels,
 46:             node_visits_per_pixel(&settings),
 47:             MINIMUM_NODE_VISITS,
 48:             ABSOLUTE_NODE_VISIT_CEILING,
 49:         );
 50:         let soft_node_visit_limit = ((node_visit_limit as f64 * FOCUS_RESERVE_FRACTION).floor()
 51:             as usize)
 52:             .max(1)
 53:             .min(node_visit_limit);
 54: 
 55:         // At supported target sizes the fine-write allowance can always
 56:         // cover the framebuffer at least once.  Successful depth rewrites,
 57:         // rather than rejected fragments, consume the remaining allowance.
 58:         let one_full_coverage = target_pixels.min(ABSOLUTE_PIXEL_WRITE_CEILING);
 59:         let pixel_write_limit = scaled_limit(
 60:             target_pixels,
 61:             pixel_writes_per_pixel(&settings),
 62:             MINIMUM_PIXEL_WRITES.max(one_full_coverage),
 63:             ABSOLUTE_PIXEL_WRITE_CEILING,
 64:         );
 65: 
 66:         Self {
 67:             node_visit_limit,
 68:             soft_node_visit_limit,
 69:             pixel_write_limit,
 70:         }
 71:     }
 72: 
 73:     pub(super) const fn node_visit_limit(self) -> usize {
 74:         self.node_visit_limit
 75:     }
 76: 
 77:     pub(super) const fn soft_node_visit_limit(self) -> usize {
 78:         self.soft_node_visit_limit
 79:     }
 80: 
 81:     pub(super) const fn pixel_write_limit(self) -> usize {
 82:         self.pixel_write_limit
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     pub(super) const fn nodes_exhausted(self, visited_nodes: usize) -> bool {
 86:         visited_nodes >= self.node_visit_limit
 87:     }
 88: 
 89:     pub(super) const fn outside_focus_reserve(self, visited_nodes: usize) -> bool {
 90:         visited_nodes >= self.soft_node_visit_limit
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     pub(super) const fn writes_exhausted(self, pixel_writes: usize) -> bool {
 94:         pixel_writes >= self.pixel_write_limit
 95:     }
 96: 
 97:     pub(super) const fn remaining_pixel_writes(self, pixel_writes: usize) -> usize {
 98:         self.pixel_write_limit.saturating_sub(pixel_writes)
 99:     }
100: }
101: 
102: impl Default for FrameWorkBudget {
103:     fn default() -> Self {
104:         Self::for_target(&CpuRenderSettings::default(), 1, 1)
105:     }
106: }
107: 
108: fn scaled_limit(pixels: usize, density: f64, minimum: usize, ceiling: usize) -> usize {
109:     let requested = (pixels as f64 * density).ceil();
110:     if !requested.is_finite() || requested >= ceiling as f64 {
111:         return ceiling;
112:     }
113:     (requested as usize).max(minimum).min(ceiling)
114: }
115: 
116: /// Traversal density rises monotonically with virtual depth, smaller maximum
117: /// splats, and a smaller MIP cutoff.  Coefficients keep Balanced close to one
118: /// node allowance per target pixel while giving Maximum room for its much
119: /// finer geometry without restoring an effectively unbounded walk.
120: fn node_visits_per_pixel(settings: &CpuRenderSettings) -> f64 {
121:     0.35 + f64::from(settings.max_virtual_depth) * 0.08
122:         + 0.4 / f64::from(settings.max_splat_radius_px)
123:         + 0.15 / f64::from(settings.lod_cutoff_px)
124: }
125: 
126: /// Fine-write density is always greater than one complete coverage and rises
127: /// with detail.  This budget counts only successful depth writes; conservative
128: /// footprint scans and rejected pixels do not consume it.
129: fn pixel_writes_per_pixel(settings: &CpuRenderSettings) -> f64 {
130:     1.0 + f64::from(settings.max_virtual_depth) * 0.12
131:         + 1.0 / f64::from(settings.max_splat_radius_px).sqrt()
132:         + 0.2 / f64::from(settings.lod_cutoff_px)
133: }
134: 
135: #[cfg(test)]
136: mod tests {
137:     use super::*;
138:     use crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::settings::CpuQualityPreset;
139: 
140:     #[test]
141:     fn preset_work_density_never_decreases() {
142:         let budgets = [
143:             CpuQualityPreset::Performance,
144:             CpuQualityPreset::Balanced,
145:             CpuQualityPreset::Quality,
146:             CpuQualityPreset::Maximum,
147:         ]
148:         .map(|preset| FrameWorkBudget::for_target(&preset.settings(), 960, 540));
149: 
150:         for pair in budgets.windows(2) {
151:             assert!(pair[0].node_visit_limit() <= pair[1].node_visit_limit());
152:             assert!(pair[0].pixel_write_limit() <= pair[1].pixel_write_limit());
153:         }
154:     }
155: 
156:     #[test]
157:     fn maximum_1920_by_1080_can_cover_the_target_before_exhaustion() {
158:         let pixels = 1920 * 1080;
159:         let budget = FrameWorkBudget::for_target(&CpuQualityPreset::Maximum.settings(), 1920, 1080);
160: 
161:         assert!(budget.pixel_write_limit() >= pixels);
162:         assert!(budget.pixel_write_limit() < ABSOLUTE_PIXEL_WRITE_CEILING);
163:         assert!(budget.node_visit_limit() > 150_000);
164:         assert!(budget.node_visit_limit() < ABSOLUTE_NODE_VISIT_CEILING);
165:     }
166: 
167:     #[test]
168:     fn custom_finer_geometry_receives_more_work_per_pixel() {
169:         let coarse = CpuQualityPreset::Balanced.settings();
170:         let mut fine = coarse;
171:         fine.max_splat_radius_px = 2.0;
172:         fine.lod_cutoff_px = 0.35;
173:         fine.max_virtual_depth = 8;
174: 
175:         let coarse = FrameWorkBudget::for_target(&coarse, 640, 360);
176:         let fine = FrameWorkBudget::for_target(&fine, 640, 360);
177:         assert!(fine.node_visit_limit() > coarse.node_visit_limit());
178:         assert!(fine.pixel_write_limit() > coarse.pixel_write_limit());
179:     }
180: 
181:     #[test]
182:     fn absurd_target_dimensions_stop_at_absolute_ceilings() {
183:         let budget = FrameWorkBudget::for_target(
184:             &CpuQualityPreset::Maximum.settings(),
185:             usize::MAX,
186:             usize::MAX,
187:         );
188: 
189:         assert_eq!(budget.node_visit_limit(), ABSOLUTE_NODE_VISIT_CEILING);
190:         assert_eq!(budget.pixel_write_limit(), ABSOLUTE_PIXEL_WRITE_CEILING);
191:         assert!(budget.soft_node_visit_limit() < budget.node_visit_limit());
192:     }
193: }
