````rust
100:     /// Applies deliberate choices first, then the optional accessibility
101:     /// assist. This order ensures a deliberate drink that restores the reserve
102:     /// does not immediately trigger a second automatic drink.
103:     pub fn consume(&mut self, intent: ConsumptionIntent) {
104:         if intent.drink {
105:             self.drink_carried();
106:         }
107:         if intent.eat {
108:             self.eat_carried();
109:         }
110:         if self.assisted_consumption {
111:             self.auto_consume_supplies();
112:         }
113:     }
114: 
115:     /// Attempts to stock one world pickup. `false` means the matching pocket
116:     /// is full, so the caller must leave the pickup and reality state intact.
117:     pub fn try_pickup(&mut self, kind: SupplyKind) -> bool {
118:         let carried = match kind {
119:             SupplyKind::AlmondWater => &mut self.almond_bottles,
120:             SupplyKind::Ration => &mut self.rations,
121:         };
122:         if *carried >= CARRY_CAP {
123:             return false;
124:         }
125:         *carried += 1;
126:         true
127:     }
128: 
129:     /// Applies attrition exactly once. The caller owns relocation and other
130:     /// world-facing consequences of the death.
131:     pub fn succumb_if_dead(&mut self) -> bool {
132:         if !self.vitals.is_dead() {
133:             return false;
134:         }
135:         self.deaths += 1;
136:         self.vitals = PlayerVitals::default();
137:         self.almond_bottles = 0;
138:         self.rations = 0;
139:         true
140:     }
141: 
142:     /// Advances overconsumption recovery and returns the reality delirium
143:     /// tier induced by either deprivation or excess.
144:     pub fn advance_strain(&mut self, dt: f32) -> u8 {
145:         self.excess = (self.excess - dt * EXCESS_DECAY_PER_S).max(0.0);
146:         let thirst_tier = match self.vitals.hydration {
147:             h if h > 0.6 => 0,
148:             h if h > 0.35 => 1,
149:             h if h > 0.15 => 2,
150:             _ => 3,
151:         };
152:         let excess_tier = match self.excess {
153:             e if e < 0.25 => 0,
154:             e if e < 0.5 => 1,
155:             e if e < 0.75 => 2,
156:             _ => 3,
157:         };
158:         thirst_tier.max(excess_tier)
159:     }
160: 
161:     /// World's aggression dial: deprivation and waste are symmetric forms of
162:     /// mismanagement.
163:     pub fn mismanagement(&self) -> f32 {
164:         let dehydration = (1.0 - self.vitals.hydration).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
165:         dehydration.max(self.excess)
166:     }

171:         self.vitals = vitals;

178:         self.register_waste(reserve_before, restores);
179:     }

181:     fn drink_carried(&mut self) {
182:         if self.almond_bottles == 0 {
183:             return;
184:         }
185:         self.almond_bottles -= 1;
186:         self.register_waste(self.vitals.hydration, ALMOND_WATER_HYDRATION);
187:         self.vitals = self.vitals.drank_almond_water();
188:     }
189: 
190:     fn eat_carried(&mut self) {
191:         if self.rations == 0 {
192:             return;
193:         }
194:         self.rations -= 1;
195:         self.register_waste(self.vitals.satiety, RATION_SATIETY);
196:         self.vitals = self.vitals.ate_ration();
197:     }

199:     fn auto_consume_supplies(&mut self) {
200:         if self.vitals.hydration < AUTO_CONSUME_AT && self.almond_bottles > 0 {
201:             self.drink_carried();
202:         }
203:         if self.vitals.satiety < AUTO_CONSUME_AT && self.rations > 0 {
204:             self.eat_carried();
205:         }
206:     }

208:     fn register_waste(&mut self, reserve_before: f32, restores: f32) {
209:         let waste = (reserve_before + restores - 1.0).max(0.0);
210:         self.excess = (self.excess + waste * EXCESS_PER_WASTE).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
211:     }
212: }
````

````rust
  1: //! Ambient temperature felt by the player, derived from the lit scene.
  2: //!
  3: //! The Backrooms' heat *is* its lighting: fluorescent tubes bake the air,
  4: //! so standing under working fixtures warms the wanderer while darkness
  5: //! (blackouts, dead bays, Level 1's failing grid) lets the air fall back to
  6: //! the level's unlit baseline. Enclosure matters too — a lit closet cooks
  7: //! faster than a lit atrium — approximated here by how much collision mass
  8: //! crowds the player. Everything is pure math over the same deduplicated,
  9: //! flicker-scaled fixture list every renderer sees: a sputtering tube that
 10: //! is dark this instant radiates nothing this instant.
 11: 
 12: use crate::application::collision::Aabb;
 13: use crate::application::ports::LightSource;
 14: 
 15: /// Unlit-air baseline per level, °C. Level 0's dark corners still hold the
 16: /// building's stale warmth; Level 1's raw concrete is genuinely cold.
 17: pub fn dark_baseline_c(level: u32) -> f32 {
 18:     match level {
 19:         0 => 24.0,
 20:         1 => 13.0,
 21:         _ => 21.0,
 22:     }
 23: }
 24: 
 25: /// Maximum heating the fixture field can add above the baseline, °C.
 26: const MAX_LIGHT_HEAT_C: f32 = 13.0;
 27: /// Scales summed fixture irradiance into °C before the cap.
 28: const HEAT_PER_IRRADIANCE: f32 = 9.0;
 29: /// Enclosure raises effective heating by up to this factor.
 30: const ENCLOSURE_GAIN: f32 = 0.6;
 31: /// Radius probed for enclosing collision mass.
 32: const ENCLOSURE_RADIUS: f32 = 6.0;
 33: /// Collision-box count that reads as "fully enclosed".
 34: const ENCLOSURE_SATURATION: f32 = 36.0;
 35: 
 36: /// The instantaneous ambient temperature at the player position.
 37: ///
 38: /// `lights` must already carry this frame's flicker gain so failing tubes
 39: /// heat exactly as much as they shine. The result is *unsmoothed*; the
 40: /// engine applies thermal inertia so doorways don't flip the rate per frame.
 41: pub fn ambient_celsius(
 42:     level: u32,
 43:     player: [f32; 3],
 44:     lights: &[LightSource],
 45:     collision: &[Aabb],
 46: ) -> f32 {
 47:     let mut irradiance = 0.0f32;
 48:     for light in lights {
 49:         let dx = light.position[0] - player[0];
 50:         let dy = light.position[1] - player[1];
 51:         let dz = light.position[2] - player[2];
 52:         let distance = (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz).sqrt();
 53:         let range = light.radius.max(0.01);
 54:         let falloff = (1.0 - distance / range).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
 55:         irradiance += light.intensity * falloff * falloff;
 56:     }
 57: 
 58:     let mut enclosing = 0usize;
 59:     for aabb in collision {
 60:         let center = [
 61:             (aabb.min[0] + aabb.max[0]) * 0.5,
 62:             (aabb.min[2] + aabb.max[2]) * 0.5,
 63:         ];
 64:         let dx = center[0] - player[0];
 65:         let dz = center[1] - player[2];
 66:         if dx * dx + dz * dz <= ENCLOSURE_RADIUS * ENCLOSURE_RADIUS {
 67:             enclosing += 1;
 68:         }
 69:     }
 70:     let enclosure = (enclosing as f32 / ENCLOSURE_SATURATION).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
 71: 
 72:     let heat = (irradiance * HEAT_PER_IRRADIANCE).min(MAX_LIGHT_HEAT_C)
 73:         * (1.0 + ENCLOSURE_GAIN * enclosure);
 74:     dark_baseline_c(level) + heat.min(MAX_LIGHT_HEAT_C * (1.0 + ENCLOSURE_GAIN))
 75: }
 76: 
 77: #[cfg(test)]
 78: mod tests {
 79:     use super::*;
 80:     use crate::application::ports::LightKind;
 81: 
 82:     fn fixture(position: [f32; 3], intensity: f32) -> LightSource {
 83:         LightSource {
 84:             id: 1,
 85:             position,
 86:             half_size: [0.5, 0.5],
 87:             color: [1.0, 1.0, 1.0],
 88:             radius: 16.0,
 89:             intensity,
 90:             kind: LightKind::CeilingPanel,
 91:             flicker_mode: 0,
 92:             enabled: true,
 93:         }
 94:     }
 95: 
 96:     fn walls_around(count: usize) -> Vec<Aabb> {
 97:         (0..count)
 98:             .map(|i| {
 99:                 let angle = i as f32;
100:                 Aabb::new(
101:                     [angle.cos() * 2.0, 0.0, angle.sin() * 2.0],
102:                     [angle.cos() * 2.0 + 0.4, 3.0, angle.sin() * 2.0 + 0.4],
103:                 )
104:             })
105:             .collect()
106:     }
107: 
108:     #[test]
109:     fn darkness_rests_at_the_level_baseline() {
110:         let ambient = ambient_celsius(0, [0.0, 1.7, 0.0], &[], &[]);
111:         assert_eq!(ambient, dark_baseline_c(0));
112:         assert!(dark_baseline_c(1) < dark_baseline_c(0), "Level 1 runs cold");
113:     }
114: 
115:     #[test]
116:     fn standing_under_a_fixture_heats_the_air() {
117:         let lit = ambient_celsius(0, [0.0, 1.7, 0.0], &[fixture([0.0, 3.0, 0.0], 1.5)], &[]);
118:         let far = ambient_celsius(0, [14.0, 1.7, 0.0], &[fixture([0.0, 3.0, 0.0], 1.5)], &[]);
119:         assert!(lit > dark_baseline_c(0) + 2.0, "lit air must run hot: {lit}");
120:         assert!(far < lit, "heat falls off with distance");
121:     }
122: 
123:     #[test]
124:     fn enclosure_amplifies_lit_spaces_but_not_dark_ones() {
125:         let light = [fixture([0.0, 3.0, 0.0], 1.5)];
126:         let open = ambient_celsius(0, [0.0, 1.7, 0.0], &light, &[]);
127:         let tight = ambient_celsius(0, [0.0, 1.7, 0.0], &light, &walls_around(40));
128:         assert!(tight > open, "small lit rooms cook: {tight} vs {open}");
129: 
130:         let dark_open = ambient_celsius(0, [0.0, 1.7, 0.0], &[], &[]);
131:         let dark_tight = ambient_celsius(0, [0.0, 1.7, 0.0], &[], &walls_around(40));
132:         assert_eq!(dark_open, dark_tight, "enclosure without light is inert");
133:     }
134: 
135:     #[test]
136:     fn a_flickered_out_tube_radiates_nothing() {
137:         // The engine multiplies flicker gain into intensity before calling;
138:         // a dropout frame arrives here as near-zero intensity.
139:         let out = ambient_celsius(0, [0.0, 1.7, 0.0], &[fixture([0.0, 3.0, 0.0], 0.02)], &[]);
140:         assert!(out - dark_baseline_c(0) < 0.5);
141:     }
142: }
````

````rust
  1: //! Browser input bindings for keyboard, pointer-lock mouse, and touch play.
  2: //!
  3: //! This module owns DOM listener lifetime setup only. Raw browser events are
  4: //! translated into the platform-free [`InputCollector`], which remains the
  5: //! application's input boundary.
  6: 
  7: use std::cell::RefCell;
  8: use std::rc::Rc;
  9: 
 10: use wasm_bindgen::JsCast;
 11: use wasm_bindgen::prelude::*;
 12: use web_sys::{Document, HtmlCanvasElement, HtmlElement, KeyboardEvent, MouseEvent, TouchEvent};
 13: 
 14: use crate::adapters::input::InputCollector;
 15: 
 16: use super::element;
 17: 
 18: /// Radius of the virtual joystick in CSS pixels (full deflection).
 19: const JOYSTICK_RADIUS: f64 = 60.0;
 20: /// Touch-look sensitivity relative to raw mouse pixels.
 21: const TOUCH_LOOK_SCALE: f32 = 2.2;
 22: 
 23: /// Touch-play session state. On touch devices there is no pointer lock:
 24: /// tapping the overlay enters "touch play" directly, the left half of the
 25: /// screen is a virtual joystick (drag from touch-down point), and the right
 26: /// half is a look surface. On-screen buttons cover flashlight and menu.
 27: #[derive(Default)]
 28: pub(super) struct TouchState {
 29:     /// True while playing in touch mode.
 30:     active: bool,
 31:     move_id: Option<i32>,
 32:     move_origin: (f64, f64),
 33:     look_id: Option<i32>,
 34:     look_last: (f64, f64),
 35: }
 36: 
 37: pub(super) fn attach_input_listeners(
 38:     document: &Document,
 39:     canvas: &HtmlCanvasElement,
 40:     overlay: &HtmlElement,
 41:     input: &Rc<RefCell<InputCollector>>,
 42:     touch: &Rc<RefCell<TouchState>>,
 43: ) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
 44:     // Keyboard: KeyboardEvent.code -> MoveIntent, mapped by the input adapter.
 45:     for (event, pressed) in [("keydown", true), ("keyup", false)] {
 46:         let input = input.clone();
 47:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(KeyboardEvent)>::new(move |e: KeyboardEvent| {
 48:             // F3 toggles the anomaly debug overlay (and never reaches the
 49:             // browser's own F3 find shortcut).
 50:             if pressed && e.code() == "F3" {
 51:                 e.prevent_default();
 52:                 if !e.repeat() {
 53:                     let on = crate::ANOMALY_DEBUG.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
 54:                     crate::ANOMALY_DEBUG.store(!on, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
 55:                 }
 56:                 return;
 57:             }
 58:             if !e.repeat() {
 59:                 input.borrow_mut().key_event(&e.code(), pressed);
 60:             }
 61:         });
 62:         document.add_event_listener_with_callback(event, closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
 63:         closure.forget();
 64:     }
 65: 
 66:     // Mouse look (deltas are ignored by the adapter unless pointer-locked).
 67:     {
 68:         let input = input.clone();
 69:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(MouseEvent)>::new(move |e: MouseEvent| {
 70:             input
 71:                 .borrow_mut()
 72:                 .mouse_delta(e.movement_x() as f32, e.movement_y() as f32);
 73:         });
 74:         document.add_event_listener_with_callback("mousemove", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
 75:         closure.forget();
 76:     }
 77: 
 78:     // Click-to-play: the overlay requests pointer lock on the render canvas.
 79:     {
 80:         let canvas = canvas.clone();
 81:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut()>::new(move || {
 82:             canvas.request_pointer_lock();
 83:         });
 84:         overlay.add_event_listener_with_callback("click", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
 85:         closure.forget();
 86:     }
 87: 
 88:     // Pointer-lock state drives both the input adapter and overlay
 89:     // visibility — unless a touch session owns them.
 90:     {
 91:         let input = input.clone();
 92:         let touch = touch.clone();
 93:         let doc_for_closure = document.clone();
 94:         let overlay = overlay.clone();
 95:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut()>::new(move || {
 96:             if touch.borrow().active {
 97:                 return;
 98:             }
 99:             let locked = doc_for_closure.pointer_lock_element().is_some();
100:             input.borrow_mut().set_locked(locked);
101:             let _ = overlay
102:                 .style()
103:                 .set_property("display", if locked { "none" } else { "flex" });
104:         });
105:         document.add_event_listener_with_callback(
106:             "pointerlockchange",
107:             closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref(),
108:         )?;
109:         closure.forget();
110:     }
111: 
112:     Ok(())
113: }
114: 
115: /// Wires the touch controls: overlay tap-to-play, split-screen virtual
116: /// joystick + look surface on the canvas, and the on-screen flashlight and
117: /// menu buttons (`#btn-flashlight`, `#btn-menu`, inside `#touch-ui`).
118: pub(super) fn attach_touch_listeners(
119:     document: &Document,
120:     canvas: &HtmlCanvasElement,
121:     overlay: &HtmlElement,
122:     input: &Rc<RefCell<InputCollector>>,
123:     touch: &Rc<RefCell<TouchState>>,
124: ) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
125:     let touch_ui: Option<HtmlElement> = element(document, "touch-ui").ok();
126: 
127:     let set_touch_play = {
128:         let input = input.clone();
129:         let touch = touch.clone();
130:         let overlay = overlay.clone();
131:         let touch_ui = touch_ui.clone();
132:         Rc::new(move |on: bool| {
133:             touch.borrow_mut().active = on;
134:             let mut input = input.borrow_mut();
135:             input.set_locked(on);
136:             if !on {
137:                 input.set_move_axes(0.0, 0.0);
138:             }
139:             let _ = overlay
140:                 .style()
141:                 .set_property("display", if on { "none" } else { "flex" });
142:             if let Some(ui) = &touch_ui {
143:                 let _ = ui
144:                     .style()
145:                     .set_property("display", if on { "flex" } else { "none" });
146:             }
147:         })
148:     };
149: 
150:     // Tap the overlay -> enter touch play (the desktop path uses `click` +
151:     // pointer lock instead). prevent_default suppresses the synthetic click
152:     // that would otherwise also request pointer lock.
153:     {
154:         let enter = set_touch_play.clone();
155:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(TouchEvent)>::new(move |e: TouchEvent| {
156:             e.prevent_default();
157:             enter(true);
158:         });
159:         overlay.add_event_listener_with_callback("touchend", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
160:         closure.forget();
161:     }
162: 
163:     // Canvas touches: left 45% of the screen is the movement joystick,
164:     // the rest is the look surface.
165:     {
166:         let touch = touch.clone();
167:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(TouchEvent)>::new(move |e: TouchEvent| {
168:             let mut st = touch.borrow_mut();
169:             if !st.active {
170:                 return;
171:             }
172:             e.prevent_default();
173:             let move_split = web_sys::window()
174:                 .and_then(|w| w.inner_width().ok())
175:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_f64())
176:                 .unwrap_or(800.0)
177:                 * 0.45;
178:             let changed = e.changed_touches();
179:             for i in 0..changed.length() {
180:                 let Some(t) = changed.item(i) else { continue };
181:                 let (x, y) = (t.client_x() as f64, t.client_y() as f64);
182:                 if x < move_split && st.move_id.is_none() {
183:                     st.move_id = Some(t.identifier());
184:                     st.move_origin = (x, y);
185:                 } else if st.look_id.is_none() {
186:                     st.look_id = Some(t.identifier());
187:                     st.look_last = (x, y);
188:                 }
189:             }
190:         });
191:         canvas.add_event_listener_with_callback("touchstart", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
192:         closure.forget();
193:     }
194: 
195:     {
196:         let input = input.clone();
197:         let touch = touch.clone();
198:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(TouchEvent)>::new(move |e: TouchEvent| {
199:             let mut st = touch.borrow_mut();
200:             if !st.active {
201:                 return;
202:             }
203:             e.prevent_default();
204:             let changed = e.changed_touches();
205:             for i in 0..changed.length() {
206:                 let Some(t) = changed.item(i) else { continue };
207:                 let (x, y) = (t.client_x() as f64, t.client_y() as f64);
208:                 if st.move_id == Some(t.identifier()) {
209:                     let dx = ((x - st.move_origin.0) / JOYSTICK_RADIUS).clamp(-1.0, 1.0);
210:                     let dy = ((y - st.move_origin.1) / JOYSTICK_RADIUS).clamp(-1.0, 1.0);
211:                     // Screen-space up (negative dy) walks forward.
212:                     input.borrow_mut().set_move_axes(dx as f32, -dy as f32);
213:                 } else if st.look_id == Some(t.identifier()) {
214:                     let (lx, ly) = st.look_last;
215:                     st.look_last = (x, y);
216:                     input.borrow_mut().mouse_delta(
217:                         (x - lx) as f32 * TOUCH_LOOK_SCALE,
218:                         (y - ly) as f32 * TOUCH_LOOK_SCALE,
219:                     );
220:                 }
221:             }
222:         });
223:         canvas.add_event_listener_with_callback("touchmove", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
224:         closure.forget();
225:     }
226: 
227:     for event in ["touchend", "touchcancel"] {
228:         let input = input.clone();
229:         let touch = touch.clone();

231:             let mut st = touch.borrow_mut();
232:             if !st.active {
233:                 return;
234:             }
235:             e.prevent_default();
236:             let changed = e.changed_touches();
237:             for i in 0..changed.length() {
238:                 let Some(t) = changed.item(i) else { continue };
239:                 if st.move_id == Some(t.identifier()) {
240:                     st.move_id = None;
241:                     input.borrow_mut().set_move_axes(0.0, 0.0);
242:                 } else if st.look_id == Some(t.identifier()) {
243:                     st.look_id = None;
244:                 }
245:             }
246:         });
247:         canvas.add_event_listener_with_callback(event, closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
248:         closure.forget();
249:     }

252:     if let Ok(btn) = element::<HtmlElement>(document, "btn-flare") {
253:         let input = input.clone();

255:             e.prevent_default();

261:         closure.forget();
262:     }

265:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(web_sys::Event)>::new(move |e: web_sys::Event| {
266:             e.prevent_default();
267:             e.stop_propagation();
268:             input.borrow_mut().queue_drink();
269:         });
270:         btn.add_event_listener_with_callback("touchend", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
271:         btn.add_event_listener_with_callback("click", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
272:         closure.forget();
273:     }
274:     if let Ok(btn) = element::<HtmlElement>(document, "btn-eat") {

277:             e.prevent_default();
278:             e.stop_propagation();
279:             input.borrow_mut().queue_eat();

283:         closure.forget();

288:             e.prevent_default();
````

````rust
100:     pub fn resize(&mut self, device: &wgpu::Device, width: u32, height: u32) {

124:             "CPU/WebGPU V:{}/{}{} (D:{})/S:{}/P:{}K/{}K{}{}",
125:             stats.visited_nodes,
126:             stats.node_visit_limit,
127:             if stats.node_budget_limited { "N!" } else { "" },
128:             stats.max_virtual_depth,
129:             stats.splat_count,
130:             stats.pixel_writes / 1000,

132:             if stats.pixel_budget_limited { "P!" } else { "" },

137:     #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
138:     pub fn draw(
139:         &mut self,
140:         queue: &wgpu::Queue,
141:         encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
142:         target: &wgpu::TextureView,
143:         frame: &FrameParams,
144:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
145:         settings: CpuRenderSettings,
146:     ) {
147:         self.rasterizer.settings = settings;
148:         self.rasterizer.draw(frame, chunks);
149:         queue.write_texture(
150:             self.texture.as_image_copy(),
151:             self.rasterizer.framebuffer(),
152:             wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout {
153:                 offset: 0,
154:                 bytes_per_row: Some(self.width * 4),
155:                 rows_per_image: Some(self.height),
156:             },
157:             wgpu::Extent3d {
158:                 width: self.width,
159:                 height: self.height,
160:                 depth_or_array_layers: 1,
161:             },
162:         );
163: 
164:         let color_attachments = [Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
165:             view: target,
166:             resolve_target: None,
167:             depth_slice: None,
168:             ops: wgpu::Operations {
169:                 load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color::BLACK),
170:                 store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
171:             },
172:         })];
173:         let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
174:             label: Some("webgpu.cpu-present.pass"),
175:             color_attachments: &color_attachments,
176:             ..Default::default()
177:         });
178:         pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline);
179:         pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.bind_group, &[]);
180:         pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
181:     }
182: }

184: fn create_texture_resources(
185:     device: &wgpu::Device,
186:     layout: &wgpu::BindGroupLayout,
187:     sampler: &wgpu::Sampler,
188:     width: u32,
189:     height: u32,
190: ) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::BindGroup) {
191:     let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
192:         label: Some("webgpu.cpu-present.frame"),
193:         size: wgpu::Extent3d {
194:             width,
195:             height,
196:             depth_or_array_layers: 1,
197:         },
198:         mip_level_count: 1,
199:         sample_count: 1,
200:         dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
201:         format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm,
202:         usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST | wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING,
203:         view_formats: &[],
204:     });
205:     let view = texture.create_view(&Default::default());
206:     let bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
207:         label: Some("webgpu.cpu-present.texture-bind-group"),
208:         layout,
209:         entries: &[
210:             wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
211:                 binding: 0,
212:                 resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(&view),
213:             },
214:             wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
215:                 binding: 1,
216:                 resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(sampler),
217:             },
218:         ],
219:     });
220:     (texture, bind_group)
221: }
````

````rust
  1: //! Hero-fixture shadow resources shared by both raster strategies.
  2: //!
  3: //! The resource contract is intentionally independent from caster geometry:
  4: //! indexed surfaces render their existing vertex/index buffers, while splats
  5: //! expand their existing packed face records. This module owns only the
  6: //! light selection, transform, depth target, and the two bind-group views of
  7: //! one uniform buffer (depth-caster input and lit-receiver input).
  8: 
  9: use std::num::NonZeroU64;

 13: use crate::application::ports::{FrameParams, LightKind, LightSource};
 14: use crate::application::rendering::multiply_column_major;
 15: use crate::drivers::webgpu::config::ShadowMapConfig;
 16: 
 17: const SHADOW_NEAR: f32 = 0.03;
 18: const MINIMUM_RECEIVER_BIAS: f32 = 0.0005;
 19: const SLOPE_RECEIVER_BIAS: f32 = 0.0015;
 20: 
 21: /// Profile-owned raster shadow capability and quality.
 22: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 23: pub struct HeroShadowOptions {
 24:     pub map: ShadowMapConfig,
 25:     pub profile_enabled: bool,
 26: }
 27: 
 28: impl HeroShadowOptions {

 30:         Self {
 31:             map,
 32:             profile_enabled,
 33:         }
 34:     }
 35: }
 36: 
 37: impl Default for HeroShadowOptions {
 38:     fn default() -> Self {
 39:         Self::new(ShadowMapConfig::low(), true)
 40:     }
 41: }
 42: 
 43: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
 44: struct HeroShadowSelection {

 46:     light: LightSource,
 47: }
 48: 
 49: /// Matches the static-light prefix written by `collect_frame_lights`.
 50: /// Runtime point lights are appended later and can never own a top-down map.
 51: fn select_hero_shadow_light(frame: &FrameParams) -> Option<HeroShadowSelection> {
 52:     let mut gpu_light_index = 0u32;
 53:     for light in frame.active_scene_lights() {
 54:         if !light.enabled {
 55:             continue;
 56:         }
 57:         if light.kind != LightKind::Point {
 58:             return Some(HeroShadowSelection {
 59:                 gpu_light_index,
 60:                 light: *light,
 61:             });
 62:         }
 63:         gpu_light_index = gpu_light_index.saturating_add(1);
 64:     }
 65:     None
 66: }

 68: /// One record is consumed by both the caster and receiver pipelines.
 69: #[repr(C)]

 71: struct GpuHeroShadow {
 72:     light_view_projection: [f32; 16],
 73:     /// xy: inverse map extent; z: minimum bias; w: slope-scaled bias.
 74:     sampling: [f32; 4],
 75:     /// x: enabled; y: absolute GPU-light index; z: taps; w: map extent.
 76:     options: [u32; 4],
 77: }
 78: 
 79: impl GpuHeroShadow {
 80:     fn disabled(options: HeroShadowOptions) -> Self {
 81:         let size = options.map.size.max(1);
 82:         Self {
 83:             light_view_projection: [0.0; 16],
 84:             sampling: [
 85:                 1.0 / size as f32,
 86:                 1.0 / size as f32,
 87:                 MINIMUM_RECEIVER_BIAS,
 88:                 SLOPE_RECEIVER_BIAS,
 89:             ],
 90:             options: [0, 0, u32::from(options.map.filter_taps), size],
 91:         }
 92:     }
 93: 
 94:     fn enabled(options: HeroShadowOptions, hero: HeroShadowSelection) -> Self {
 95:         let mut uniforms = Self::disabled(options);
 96:         uniforms.light_view_projection = hero_light_view_projection(&hero.light);
 97:         uniforms.options[0] = 1;
 98:         uniforms.options[1] = hero.gpu_light_index;
 99:         uniforms
100:     }
101: }

197:     /// Snapshots hero identity and runtime policy once before both passes.
198:     pub(super) fn prepare(
199:         &self,
200:         queue: &wgpu::Queue,
201:         frame: &FrameParams,
202:         runtime_enabled: bool,
203:     ) -> bool {
204:         let hero = select_hero_shadow_light(frame);
205:         let enabled = self.options.profile_enabled && runtime_enabled && hero.is_some();
206:         let uniforms = if enabled {
207:             GpuHeroShadow::enabled(self.options, hero.expect("enabled requires a hero"))
208:         } else {
209:             GpuHeroShadow::disabled(self.options)
210:         };
211:         queue.write_buffer(&self.uniform, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(&uniforms));
212:         enabled

286: /// Column-major top-down fixture transform with WebGPU's `0..1` depth.
287: fn hero_light_view_projection(light: &LightSource) -> [f32; 16] {
288:     let emitter_half_diagonal =
289:         (light.half_size[0] * light.half_size[0] + light.half_size[1] * light.half_size[1]).sqrt();
290:     let extent = (light.radius + emitter_half_diagonal).max(SHADOW_NEAR + 0.01);
291:     let projection = webgpu_orthographic(-extent, extent, -extent, extent, SHADOW_NEAR, extent);
292:     let view = top_down_view(light.position);
293:     multiply_column_major(&projection, &view)
294: }
295: 
296: fn webgpu_orthographic(
297:     left: f32,
298:     right: f32,
299:     bottom: f32,
300:     top: f32,
301:     near: f32,
302:     far: f32,
303: ) -> [f32; 16] {
304:     let near = near.max(0.0);
305:     let far = far.max(near + 0.01);
306:     [
307:         2.0 / (right - left),
308:         0.0,
309:         0.0,
310:         0.0,
311:         0.0,
312:         2.0 / (top - bottom),
313:         0.0,
314:         0.0,
315:         0.0,
316:         0.0,
317:         1.0 / (near - far),
318:         0.0,
319:         -(right + left) / (right - left),
320:         -(top + bottom) / (top - bottom),
321:         near / (near - far),
322:         1.0,
323:     ]
324: }
325: 
326: /// Light looks down `-Y`; `-Z` is map up, matching ceiling rectangles in XZ.
327: fn top_down_view(eye: [f32; 3]) -> [f32; 16] {
328:     [
329:         1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, // right = +X
330:         0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, // -forward = +Y
331:         0.0, -1.0, 0.0, 0.0, // up = -Z
332:         -eye[0], eye[2], -eye[1], 1.0,
333:     ]
334: }
````

````rust
140:     pub fn upload(&mut self, device: &wgpu::Device, chunks: &[SurfaceChunk<'_>]) {
141:         for &chunk in chunks {
142:             self.chunks.remove(&chunk.key);
143:             if chunk.mesh.faces.instances.is_empty() {
144:                 continue;
145:             }
146:             let faces: Vec<_> = chunk
147:                 .mesh
148:                 .faces
149:                 .instances
150:                 .iter()
151:                 .map(GpuPackedFace::from)
152:                 .collect();
153:             let face_buffer = device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
154:                 label: Some("webgpu.splat.faces"),
155:                 contents: bytemuck::cast_slice(&faces),
156:                 usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE,
157:             });
158:             let uniform_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
159:                 label: Some("webgpu.splat.chunk-uniforms"),
160:                 size: size_of::<GpuChunkUniforms>() as u64,
161:                 usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
162:                 mapped_at_creation: false,
163:             });
164:             let bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
165:                 label: Some("webgpu.splat.chunk-bind-group"),
166:                 layout: &self.chunk_layout,
167:                 entries: &[
168:                     wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
169:                         binding: 0,
170:                         resource: uniform_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
171:                     },
172:                     wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
173:                         binding: 1,
174:                         resource: face_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
175:                     },
176:                 ],
177:             });
178:             self.chunks.insert(
179:                 chunk.key,
180:                 SplatChunkGpu {
181:                     faces: face_buffer,
182:                     uniforms: uniform_buffer,
183:                     bind_group,
184:                     face_count: faces.len().min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32,
185:                     cells: chunk.mesh.faces.cells.clone(),
186:                     cell_size: chunk.mesh.faces.cell_size,
187:                     origin: chunk.origin,
188:                     bounds_max: chunk.mesh.bounds.max,
189:                     voxel_size: chunk.mesh.voxel_scale,
190:                 },
191:             );
192:         }
193:     }

211:         &mut self,

215:         depth: &wgpu::TextureView,
216:         frame_resources: &FrameResources,
217:         frame: &FrameParams,
218:         toggles: RenderToggles,
219:         light_count: u32,
220:     ) {
221:         for chunk in self.chunks.values() {
222:             let uniforms = GpuChunkUniforms {
223:                 origin_world_size: [chunk.origin[0], chunk.origin[1], chunk.origin[2], 0.0],
224:                 bounds_voxel_size: [
225:                     chunk.bounds_max[0],
226:                     chunk.bounds_max[1],
227:                     chunk.bounds_max[2],
228:                     chunk.voxel_size,
229:                 ],
230:                 draw: [0, light_count, 0, 0],
231:             };
232:             queue.write_buffer(&chunk.uniforms, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(&uniforms));
233:         }
234:         if self.shadow.prepare(queue, frame, toggles.shadow_pass) {
235:             self.draw_shadow_pass(encoder);
236:         }
237: 
238:         let mut chunks: Vec<_> = self.chunks.values().collect();
239:         if toggles.front_to_back || toggles.face_budget {
240:             chunks.sort_by(|left, right| {
241:                 distance_squared(left.origin, frame.camera_pos)
242:                     .partial_cmp(&distance_squared(right.origin, frame.camera_pos))
243:                     .unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal)
244:             });
245:         }
246:         self.stats = SplatFrameStats::default();
247: 
248:         let environment = frame.environment;
249:         let clear_linear = if environment.outdoor {
250:             environment.sky_color
251:         } else {
252:             environment.fog_color
253:         };
254:         let clear = encode_display_color(clear_linear);
255:         let color_attachments = [Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
256:             view: target,
257:             resolve_target: None,
258:             depth_slice: None,
259:             ops: wgpu::Operations {
260:                 load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color {
261:                     r: clear[0] as f64,
262:                     g: clear[1] as f64,
263:                     b: clear[2] as f64,
264:                     a: 1.0,
265:                 }),
266:                 store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
267:             },
268:         })];
269:         let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
270:             label: Some("webgpu.splat.pass"),
271:             color_attachments: &color_attachments,
272:             depth_stencil_attachment: Some(wgpu::RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment {
273:                 view: depth,
274:                 depth_ops: Some(wgpu::Operations {
275:                     load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(1.0),
276:                     store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
277:                 }),
278:                 stencil_ops: None,
279:             }),
280:             ..Default::default()
281:         });
282:         pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline);
283:         pass.set_bind_group(0, frame_resources.bind_group(), &[]);
284:         pass.set_bind_group(2, self.shadow.receiver_bind_group(), &[]);
285: 
286:         for chunk in chunks {
287:             if toggles.distance_cull {
288:                 let (center, radius) = bounds_sphere(chunk.origin, chunk.bounds_max);
289:                 if !sphere_is_visible(center, radius, frame, self.max_draw_distance) {
290:                     self.stats.faces_dropped =
291:                         self.stats.faces_dropped.saturating_add(chunk.face_count);
292:                     continue;
293:                 }
294:             }
295:             if face_budget_is_exhausted(
296:                 toggles.face_budget,
297:                 self.stats.faces_drawn,
298:                 self.face_budget,
299:             ) {
300:                 self.stats.faces_dropped =
301:                     self.stats.faces_dropped.saturating_add(chunk.face_count);
302:                 continue;
303:             }
304:             let _keep_alive = &chunk.faces;
305:             pass.set_bind_group(1, &chunk.bind_group, &[]);
306:             if toggles.cell_culling && !chunk.cells.is_empty() {
307:                 for cell in &chunk.cells {
308:                     let center = [
309:                         chunk.origin[0] + (f32::from(cell.cell[0]) + 0.5) * chunk.cell_size,
310:                         chunk.origin[1] + (f32::from(cell.cell[1]) + 0.5) * chunk.cell_size,
311:                         chunk.origin[2] + (f32::from(cell.cell[2]) + 0.5) * chunk.cell_size,
312:                     ];
313:                     let radius = conservative_cell_radius(chunk.cell_size);
314:                     if !sphere_is_visible(center, radius, frame, self.max_draw_distance) {
315:                         self.stats.cells_culled = self.stats.cells_culled.saturating_add(1);
316:                         continue;
317:                     }
318:                     let end = cell.offset.saturating_add(cell.count).min(chunk.face_count);
319:                     if cell.offset < end {
320:                         pass.draw(0..4, cell.offset..end);
321:                         self.stats.faces_drawn =
322:                             self.stats.faces_drawn.saturating_add(end - cell.offset);
323:                         self.stats.draw_calls = self.stats.draw_calls.saturating_add(1);
324:                     }
325:                 }
326:             } else {
327:                 pass.draw(0..4, 0..chunk.face_count);
328:                 self.stats.faces_drawn = self.stats.faces_drawn.saturating_add(chunk.face_count);
329:                 self.stats.draw_calls = self.stats.draw_calls.saturating_add(1);
330:             }
331:         }
332:     }
333: 
334:     /// Every resident packed face casts, independently from camera cells and
335:     /// the visible-face budget. This path never materializes indexed geometry.
336:     fn draw_shadow_pass(&self, encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder) {
337:         let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
338:             label: Some("webgpu.splat.hero-shadow-pass"),
339:             color_attachments: &[],
340:             depth_stencil_attachment: Some(wgpu::RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment {
341:                 view: self.shadow.view(),
342:                 depth_ops: Some(wgpu::Operations {
343:                     load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(1.0),
344:                     store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
345:                 }),
346:                 stencil_ops: None,
347:             }),
348:             ..Default::default()
349:         });
350:         pass.set_pipeline(&self.shadow_pipeline);
351:         pass.set_bind_group(0, self.shadow.caster_bind_group(), &[]);
352:         for chunk in self.chunks.values() {
353:             let _keep_alive = &chunk.faces;
354:             pass.set_bind_group(1, &chunk.bind_group, &[]);
355:             pass.draw(0..4, 0..chunk.face_count);
356:         }
357:     }
358: }

366:         label: Some("webgpu.splat.hero-shadow-pipeline-layout"),
367:         bind_group_layouts: &[Some(shadow.caster_layout()), Some(chunk_layout)],
368:         immediate_size: 0,

370:     let shader = ShaderProgram::SplatShadow.create_module(device);
371:     device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
372:         label: Some("webgpu.splat.hero-shadow-pipeline"),
373:         layout: Some(&layout),
374:         vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
375:             module: &shader,
376:             entry_point: Some("splat_shadow_vertex"),
377:             compilation_options: Default::default(),

382:             strip_index_format: None,
383:             front_face: wgpu::FrontFace::Ccw,
384:             cull_mode: None,
385:             ..Default::default()
386:         },
387:         depth_stencil: Some(wgpu::DepthStencilState {
388:             format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
389:             depth_write_enabled: Some(true),
390:             depth_compare: Some(wgpu::CompareFunction::LessEqual),
391:             stencil: Default::default(),

404: 
405: fn distance_squared(left: [f32; 3], right: [f32; 3]) -> f32 {
406:     let dx = left[0] - right[0];
407:     let dy = left[1] - right[1];
408:     let dz = left[2] - right[2];
409:     dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
410: }
411: 
412: fn conservative_cell_radius(cell_size: f32) -> f32 {
413:     cell_size.max(0.0) * CONSERVATIVE_CELL_RADIUS_SCALE
414: }
415: 
416: fn face_budget_is_exhausted(enabled: bool, faces_drawn: u32, budget: u32) -> bool {
417:     enabled && faces_drawn >= budget
418: }
419: 
420: #[cfg(test)]
421: mod tests {
422:     use super::*;
423: 
424:     #[test]
425:     fn splat_cell_bound_covers_capped_faces_beyond_the_cell_cube() {
426:         assert_eq!(conservative_cell_radius(4.0), 6.0);
427:         assert_eq!(conservative_cell_radius(-1.0), 0.0);
428:     }
429: 
430:     #[test]
431:     fn nearest_whole_chunk_may_cross_the_face_budget() {
432:         let budget = 10;
433:         assert!(!face_budget_is_exhausted(true, 0, budget));
434:         // A first chunk with 25 faces is submitted whole. Only subsequent
435:         // farther chunks observe that the soft budget has been exhausted.
436:         assert!(face_budget_is_exhausted(true, 25, budget));
437:         assert!(!face_budget_is_exhausted(false, 25, budget));
438:     }
439: }
````

````rust
  3: //! The application supplies only world-space centers and atlas rows. WGSL

 54:                 // depth preserves nearest-first ordering between overlapping
 55:                 // billboards as well as ordinary world occlusion.
 56:                 depth_write_enabled: Some(true),

 98: 
 99:     /// Replaces the immutable label atlas. Invalid decoder output is ignored
100:     /// and leaves the previous valid texture intact.
101:     pub fn upload_atlas(
102:         &mut self,
103:         device: &wgpu::Device,
104:         queue: &wgpu::Queue,
105:         rgba: &[u8],
106:         width: u32,
107:         height: u32,
108:     ) {
109:         let Some(byte_len) = width
110:             .checked_mul(height)
111:             .and_then(|pixels| pixels.checked_mul(4))
112:             .and_then(|bytes| usize::try_from(bytes).ok())
113:         else {
114:             return;
115:         };
116:         if width == 0 || height == 0 || rgba.len() != byte_len {
117:             return;
118:         }
119: 
120:         let atlas = create_atlas_texture(device, width, height);
121:         queue.write_texture(
122:             atlas.as_image_copy(),
123:             rgba,
124:             wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout {
125:                 offset: 0,
126:                 bytes_per_row: Some(width * 4),
127:                 rows_per_image: Some(height),
128:             },
129:             wgpu::Extent3d {
130:                 width,
131:                 height,
132:                 depth_or_array_layers: 1,
133:             },
134:         );
135:         self.atlas = atlas;
136:         self.bind_group = create_bind_group(
137:             device,
138:             &self.layout,
139:             &self.sprites,
140:             &self.atlas,
141:             &self.sampler,
142:         );
143:         self.atlas_initialized = true;
144:     }
145: 
146:     pub fn draw(
147:         &self,
148:         queue: &wgpu::Queue,
149:         encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
150:         target: &wgpu::TextureView,
151:         depth: &wgpu::TextureView,
152:         frame_resources: &FrameResources,
153:         frame: &FrameParams,
154:     ) {
155:         let sprites: Vec<_> = frame
156:             .supply_sprites
157:             .iter()
158:             .take(MAX_SUPPLY_SPRITES)
159:             .map(GpuSupplySprite::from)
160:             .collect();
161:         if !self.atlas_initialized || sprites.is_empty() {
162:             return;
163:         }
164:         queue.write_buffer(&self.sprites, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(&sprites));
165: 
166:         let color_attachments = [Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
167:             view: target,
168:             resolve_target: None,
169:             depth_slice: None,
170:             ops: wgpu::Operations {
171:                 load: wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
172:                 store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
173:             },
174:         })];
175:         let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
176:             label: Some("webgpu.supply-labels.pass"),
177:             color_attachments: &color_attachments,
178:             depth_stencil_attachment: Some(wgpu::RenderPassDepthStencilAttachment {
179:                 view: depth,
180:                 depth_ops: Some(wgpu::Operations {
181:                     load: wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
182:                     store: wgpu::StoreOp::Discard,
183:                 }),
184:                 stencil_ops: None,
185:             }),
186:             ..Default::default()
187:         });
188:         pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline);
189:         pass.set_bind_group(0, frame_resources.bind_group(), &[]);
190:         pass.set_bind_group(1, &self.bind_group, &[]);
191:         pass.draw(0..6, 0..sprites.len() as u32);
192:     }
193: }

206:                 },

210:                 binding: 1,

214:                     view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
215:                     multisampled: false,
216:                 },
217:                 count: None,
218:             },
219:             wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
220:                 binding: 2,
221:                 visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
222:                 ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
223:                 count: None,
````

````rust
117:     pub fn upload(&mut self, device: &wgpu::Device, chunks: &[SurfaceChunk<'_>]) {
118:         for &chunk in chunks {
119:             self.chunks.remove(&chunk.key);
120:             if chunk.mesh.vertices.is_empty() || chunk.mesh.indices.is_empty() {
121:                 continue;
122:             }
123:             let vertices: Vec<_> = chunk
124:                 .mesh
125:                 .vertices
126:                 .iter()
127:                 .map(GpuPackedSurfaceVertex::from)
128:                 .collect();
129:             let vertex_buffer = device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
130:                 label: Some("webgpu.surface.vertices"),
131:                 contents: bytemuck::cast_slice(&vertices),
132:                 usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::STORAGE,
133:             });
134:             let index_buffer = device.create_buffer_init(&wgpu::util::BufferInitDescriptor {
135:                 label: Some("webgpu.surface.indices"),
136:                 contents: bytemuck::cast_slice(&chunk.mesh.indices),
137:                 usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::INDEX,
138:             });
139:             let uniform_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
140:                 label: Some("webgpu.surface.chunk-uniforms"),
141:                 size: size_of::<GpuChunkUniforms>() as u64,
142:                 usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::UNIFORM | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
143:                 mapped_at_creation: false,
144:             });
145:             let bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
146:                 label: Some("webgpu.surface.chunk-bind-group"),
147:                 layout: &self.chunk_layout,
148:                 entries: &[
149:                     wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
150:                         binding: 0,
151:                         resource: uniform_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
152:                     },
153:                     wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
154:                         binding: 1,
155:                         resource: vertex_buffer.as_entire_binding(),
156:                     },
157:                 ],
158:             });
159:             self.chunks.insert(
160:                 chunk.key,
161:                 SurfaceChunkGpu {
162:                     vertices: vertex_buffer,
163:                     indices: index_buffer,
164:                     uniforms: uniform_buffer,
165:                     bind_group,
166:                     index_count: chunk.mesh.indices.len().min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32,
167:                     origin: chunk.origin,
168:                     bounds_max: chunk.mesh.bounds.max,
169:                     voxel_size: chunk.mesh.voxel_scale,
170:                 },
171:             );
172:         }
173:     }
174: 
175:     pub fn remove(&mut self, keys: &[SurfaceChunkKey]) {
176:         for key in keys {
177:             self.chunks.remove(key);
178:         }
179:     }
180: 
181:     pub fn clear(&mut self) {
182:         self.chunks.clear();
183:     }
184: 
185:     pub fn draw(
186:         &self,
187:         queue: &wgpu::Queue,
188:         encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
189:         target: &wgpu::TextureView,
190:         depth: &wgpu::TextureView,
191:         frame_resources: &FrameResources,
192:         frame: &FrameParams,
193:         toggles: RenderToggles,
194:         light_count: u32,
195:     ) {
196:         for chunk in self.chunks.values() {
197:             let uniforms = GpuChunkUniforms {
198:                 origin_world_size: [chunk.origin[0], chunk.origin[1], chunk.origin[2], 0.0],
199:                 bounds_voxel_size: [
200:                     chunk.bounds_max[0],
201:                     chunk.bounds_max[1],
202:                     chunk.bounds_max[2],
203:                     chunk.voxel_size,
204:                 ],
205:                 draw: [0, light_count, 0, 0],
206:             };
207:             queue.write_buffer(&chunk.uniforms, 0, bytemuck::bytes_of(&uniforms));
208:         }
209:         if self.shadow.prepare(queue, frame, toggles.shadow_pass) {
210:             self.draw_shadow_pass(encoder);
211:         }
212: 
213:         let environment = frame.environment;
214:         let clear_linear = if environment.outdoor {
215:             environment.sky_color
216:         } else {
217:             environment.fog_color
218:         };
219:         let clear = encode_display_color(clear_linear);
220:         let color_attachments = [Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
221:             view: target,
222:             resolve_target: None,
223:             depth_slice: None,
224:             ops: wgpu::Operations {
225:                 load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color {
````

````rust
 1: use crate::application::ports::FrameParams;
 2: use crate::application::rendering::camera_basis;

 4: /// Conservative chunk/cell sphere test shared by raster strategies.
 5: pub(super) fn sphere_is_visible(
 6:     center: [f32; 3],
 7:     radius: f32,
 8:     frame: &FrameParams,
 9:     max_distance: f32,
10: ) -> bool {
11:     let delta = [
12:         center[0] - frame.camera_pos[0],
13:         center[1] - frame.camera_pos[1],
14:         center[2] - frame.camera_pos[2],
15:     ];
16:     let distance_squared = delta[0] * delta[0] + delta[1] * delta[1] + delta[2] * delta[2];
17:     let reach = max_distance + radius.max(0.0);
18:     if distance_squared > reach * reach {
19:         return false;
20:     }
21:     let forward = camera_basis(frame.yaw, frame.pitch).forward;
22:     let forward_distance = delta[0] * forward[0] + delta[1] * forward[1] + delta[2] * forward[2];
23:     forward_distance + radius >= -0.03
24: }
25: 
26: pub(super) fn bounds_sphere(origin: [f32; 3], bounds_max: [f32; 3]) -> ([f32; 3], f32) {
27:     let half = [
28:         bounds_max[0] * 0.5,
29:         bounds_max[1] * 0.5,
30:         bounds_max[2] * 0.5,
31:     ];
32:     (
33:         [
34:             origin[0] + half[0],
35:             origin[1] + half[1],
36:             origin[2] + half[2],
37:         ],
38:         (half[0] * half[0] + half[1] * half[1] + half[2] * half[2]).sqrt(),
39:     )
40: }
41: 
42: #[cfg(test)]
43: mod tests {
44:     use super::*;
45: 
46:     #[test]
47:     fn conservative_test_keeps_intersecting_and_rejects_far_behind() {
48:         let frame = FrameParams::default();
49:         assert!(sphere_is_visible([0.0, 0.0, -5.0], 1.0, &frame, 10.0));
50:         assert!(!sphere_is_visible([0.0, 0.0, 5.0], 1.0, &frame, 10.0));
51:         assert!(!sphere_is_visible([0.0, 0.0, -30.0], 1.0, &frame, 10.0));
52:     }
53: }
````

````wgsl
  3: // Bind group 0 is deliberately identical for every pipeline. A frame is a

 31: fn normal_for_axis(axis: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
 32:     switch axis {
 33:         case 0u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); }
 34:         case 1u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, -1.0, 0.0); }
 35:         case 2u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -1.0); }
 36:         case 3u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
 37:         case 4u: { return vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); }
 38:         default: { return vec3<f32>(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0); }

 42: fn srgb_channel_to_linear(encoded: f32) -> f32 {
 43:     if encoded <= 0.04045 {
 44:         return encoded / 12.92;
 45:     }
 46:     return pow((encoded + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
 47: }
 48: 
 49: fn packed_srgb_to_linear(packed: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
 50:     let encoded = vec3<f32>(
 51:         f32((packed >> 16u) & 255u),
 52:         f32((packed >> 8u) & 255u),
 53:         f32(packed & 255u)
 54:     ) / 255.0;
 55:     return vec3<f32>(
 56:         srgb_channel_to_linear(encoded.x),
 57:         srgb_channel_to_linear(encoded.y),
 58:         srgb_channel_to_linear(encoded.z)
 59:     );
 60: }

 62: fn hash_screen(pixel: vec2<f32>) -> f32 {
 63:     return fract(sin(dot(pixel, vec2<f32>(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453);
 64: }
 65: 
 66: const PI: f32 = 3.14159265358979323846;
 67: const LIGHT_POINT: u32 = 0u;
 68: const MINIMUM_SCENE_LIGHT_DISTANCE: f32 = 0.2;
 69: const INDOOR_AMBIENT_IRRADIANCE: vec3<f32> = vec3<f32>(0.045, 0.040, 0.024);
 70: const OUTDOOR_AMBIENT_IRRADIANCE: vec3<f32> = vec3<f32>(0.32, 0.38, 0.48);
 71: const CACHED_DIFFUSE_FILL_GAIN: f32 = 0.12;
 72: 
 73: // Mirrors application::rendering::FLASHLIGHT_SPEC; a Rust source-contract
 74: // test prevents either side from changing independently.
 75: const FLASHLIGHT_INNER_COSINE: f32 = 0.981627166;
 76: const FLASHLIGHT_OUTER_COSINE: f32 = 0.913545430;
 77: const FLASHLIGHT_RANGE: f32 = 14.0;
 78: const FLASHLIGHT_INTENSITY: f32 = 32.0;
 79: const FLASHLIGHT_MINIMUM_DISTANCE: f32 = 0.25;
 80: const FLASHLIGHT_FORWARD_OFFSET: f32 = 0.18;
 81: const FLASHLIGHT_DOWNWARD_OFFSET: f32 = 0.10;
 82: const FLASHLIGHT_TINT: vec3<f32> = vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.91, 0.72);
 83: 
 84: fn flashlight_irradiance(world: vec3<f32>, normal: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
 85:     if frame.render_options.y == 0u {
 86:         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
 87:     }
 88:     let lamp_position = frame.camera_position.xyz
 89:         + frame.camera_forward.xyz * FLASHLIGHT_FORWARD_OFFSET
 90:         - vec3<f32>(0.0, FLASHLIGHT_DOWNWARD_OFFSET, 0.0);
 91:     let lamp_to_receiver = world - lamp_position;
 92:     let distance_squared = dot(lamp_to_receiver, lamp_to_receiver);
 93:     if distance_squared <= 1e-8 {
 94:         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
 95:     }
 96:     let direction = lamp_to_receiver / sqrt(distance_squared);
 97:     let cone = smoothstep(
 98:         FLASHLIGHT_OUTER_COSINE,
 99:         FLASHLIGHT_INNER_COSINE,
100:         dot(direction, frame.camera_forward.xyz)
101:     );
102:     let receiver = receiver_cosine(normal, -direction);
103:     let attenuation = finite_range_inverse_square(
104:         distance_squared,
105:         FLASHLIGHT_RANGE,
106:         FLASHLIGHT_MINIMUM_DISTANCE
107:     );
108:     return FLASHLIGHT_TINT * FLASHLIGHT_INTENSITY * cone * receiver * attenuation;
109: }
110: 
111: fn finite_range_inverse_square(
112:     distance_squared: f32,
113:     range: f32,
114:     minimum_distance: f32,
115: ) -> f32 {
116:     if range <= 0.0 || minimum_distance <= 0.0 || distance_squared < 0.0 {
117:         return 0.0;
118:     }
119:     let range_squared = range * range;
120:     let normalized_squared = distance_squared / range_squared;
121:     let window = max(1.0 - normalized_squared * normalized_squared, 0.0);
122:     return (window * window)
123:         / max(distance_squared, minimum_distance * minimum_distance);
124: }
125: 
126: fn receiver_cosine(normal: vec3<f32>, surface_to_light: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
127:     return max(dot(normal, surface_to_light), 0.0);
128: }
129: 
130: fn emitter_cosine(kind: u32, surface_to_light: vec3<f32>) -> f32 {
131:     if kind == LIGHT_POINT {
132:         return 1.0;
133:     }
134:     // Rectangle fixtures lie in XZ and point down. A receiver below the
135:     // fixture has a positive receiver-to-emitter Y direction.
136:     return max(surface_to_light.y, 0.0);
137: }
138: 
139: /// Radiance contribution of one point-like endpoint before visibility.
140: /// Ray visibility can multiply this result by an exact finite-segment test
141: /// without reimplementing attenuation or receiver geometry.
142: fn point_light_sample_irradiance(
143:     world: vec3<f32>,
144:     normal: vec3<f32>,
145:     light: GpuLight,
146:     sample_position: vec3<f32>,
147: ) -> vec3<f32> {
148:     let delta = sample_position - world;
149:     let distance_squared = dot(delta, delta);
150:     let surface_to_light = delta / sqrt(max(distance_squared, 1e-8));
151:     let geometry = receiver_cosine(normal, surface_to_light);
152:     return max(light.color_intensity.xyz, vec3<f32>(0.0))
153:         * max(light.color_intensity.w, 0.0)
154:         * finite_range_inverse_square(
155:             distance_squared,
156:             light.position_radius.w,
157:             MINIMUM_SCENE_LIGHT_DISTANCE
158:         )
159:         * geometry;
160: }
161: 
162: fn evaluate_point_light(
163:     world: vec3<f32>,
164:     normal: vec3<f32>,
165:     light: GpuLight,
166: ) -> vec3<f32> {
167:     return point_light_sample_irradiance(
168:         world,
169:         normal,
170:         light,
171:         light.position_radius.xyz
172:     );
173: }
174: 
175: /// Position of one deterministic 2x2 Gauss endpoint on an XZ emitter.
176: fn rectangle_gauss_sample_position(light: GpuLight, sample_index: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
177:     let gauss = 0.5773502691896258;
178:     let offsets = array<vec2<f32>, 4>(
179:         vec2<f32>(-gauss, -gauss),
180:         vec2<f32>( gauss, -gauss),
181:         vec2<f32>(-gauss,  gauss),
182:         vec2<f32>( gauss,  gauss)
183:     );
184:     let offset = offsets[min(sample_index, 3u)]
185:         * max(light.half_size_kind.xy, vec2<f32>(0.0));
186:     return light.position_radius.xyz + vec3<f32>(offset.x, 0.0, offset.y);
187: }
188: 
189: /// Scalar geometry/attenuation term for one rectangle quadrature endpoint.
190: fn rectangle_light_sample_weight(
191:     world: vec3<f32>,
192:     normal: vec3<f32>,
193:     light: GpuLight,
194:     kind: u32,
195:     sample_position: vec3<f32>,
196: ) -> f32 {
197:     let delta = sample_position - world;
198:     let distance_squared = dot(delta, delta);
199:     let surface_to_light = delta / sqrt(max(distance_squared, 1e-8));
200:     return finite_range_inverse_square(
201:         distance_squared,
202:         light.position_radius.w,
203:         MINIMUM_SCENE_LIGHT_DISTANCE
204:     )
205:         * receiver_cosine(normal, surface_to_light)
206:         * emitter_cosine(kind, surface_to_light);
207: }
208: 
209: /// Converts a (possibly visibility-weighted) quadrature integral into RGB.
210: fn rectangle_light_irradiance_from_integral(
211:     light: GpuLight,
212:     integral: f32,
213: ) -> vec3<f32> {
214:     let half_size = max(light.half_size_kind.xy, vec2<f32>(0.0));
215:     let area = 4.0 * half_size.x * half_size.y;
216:     if area <= 0.0 {
217:         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
218:     }
219:     return max(light.color_intensity.xyz, vec3<f32>(0.0))
220:         * max(light.color_intensity.w, 0.0)
221:         * area
222:         * integral
223:         * 0.25;
224: }
225: 
226: fn evaluate_rectangle_light(
227:     world: vec3<f32>,
228:     normal: vec3<f32>,
229:     light: GpuLight,
230:     kind: u32,
231: ) -> vec3<f32> {
232:     let half_size = max(light.half_size_kind.xy, vec2<f32>(0.0));
233:     let area = 4.0 * half_size.x * half_size.y;
234:     if area <= 0.0 {
235:         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
236:     }
237: 
238:     var integral = 0.0;
239:     for (var sample_index = 0u; sample_index < 4u; sample_index += 1u) {
240:         let sample_position = rectangle_gauss_sample_position(light, sample_index);
241:         integral += rectangle_light_sample_weight(
242:             world,
243:             normal,
244:             light,
245:             kind,
246:             sample_position
247:         );
248:     }
249:     return rectangle_light_irradiance_from_integral(light, integral);
250: }
251: 
252: fn evaluate_scene_light(
253:     world: vec3<f32>,
254:     normal: vec3<f32>,
255:     light: GpuLight,
256: ) -> vec3<f32> {
257:     let kind = u32(max(light.half_size_kind.z, 0.0) + 0.5);
258:     if kind == LIGHT_POINT {
259:         return evaluate_point_light(world, normal, light);
260:     }
261:     return evaluate_rectangle_light(world, normal, light, kind);
262: }
263: 
264: fn ambient_irradiance() -> vec3<f32> {
265:     let base = select(
266:         INDOOR_AMBIENT_IRRADIANCE,
267:         OUTDOOR_AMBIENT_IRRADIANCE,
268:         frame.lighting_options.x != 0u
269:     );
270:     return base * max(frame.sky_color_ambient.w, 0.0);
271: }
272: 
273: fn cached_static_irradiance(baked: f32) -> vec3<f32> {
274:     if frame.lighting_options.y == 0u {
275:         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
276:     }
277:     return vec3<f32>(clamp(baked, 0.0, 1.0) * CACHED_DIFFUSE_FILL_GAIN);
278: }
279: 
280: fn surface_radiance_from_analytic_direct(
281:     world: vec3<f32>,
282:     normal: vec3<f32>,
283:     albedo: vec3<f32>,
284:     baked: f32,
285:     ao: f32,
286:     analytic_direct: vec3<f32>,
287: ) -> vec3<f32> {
288:     let ambient_visibility = mix(0.62, 1.0, clamp(ao, 0.0, 1.0));
289:     let ambient = ambient_irradiance() * ambient_visibility;
290:     let cached_static = cached_static_irradiance(baked);
291:     let flashlight = flashlight_irradiance(world, normal);
292:     let irradiance = ambient + cached_static + analytic_direct + flashlight;
293:     return albedo * irradiance * (1.0 / PI);
294: }
295: 
296: fn surface_radiance(
297:     world: vec3<f32>,
298:     normal: vec3<f32>,
299:     albedo: vec3<f32>,
300:     baked: f32,
301:     ao: f32,
302:     light_first: u32,
303:     light_count: u32,
304: ) -> vec3<f32> {
305:     var analytic_direct = vec3<f32>(0.0);
306:     let safe_count = min(light_count, frame.render_options.x - min(light_first, frame.render_options.x));
307:     for (var local = 0u; local < safe_count; local += 1u) {
308:         let light = lights[light_first + local];
309:         if light.half_size_kind.w < 0.5 {
310:             continue;
311:         }
312:         analytic_direct += evaluate_scene_light(world, normal, light);
313:     }
314:     return surface_radiance_from_analytic_direct(
315:         world,
316:         normal,
317:         albedo,
318:         baked,
319:         ao,
320:         analytic_direct
321:     );
322: }
323: 
324: fn display_color(linear_radiance: vec3<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
325:     let mapped = max(linear_radiance, vec3<f32>(0.0))
326:         / (vec3<f32>(1.0) + max(linear_radiance, vec3<f32>(0.0)));
327:     let low = mapped * 12.92;
328:     let high = 1.055 * pow(mapped, vec3<f32>(1.0 / 2.4)) - vec3<f32>(0.055);
329:     return select(high, low, mapped <= vec3<f32>(0.0031308));
330: }
331: 
332: fn present_radiance(
333:     linear_radiance: vec3<f32>,
334:     world: vec3<f32>,
335:     pixel: vec2<f32>,
336: ) -> vec4<f32> {
337:     let view_distance = length(world - frame.camera_position.xyz);
338:     let fog_distance = max(view_distance - frame.viewport_fov_start.w, 0.0);
339:     let transmittance = exp(-max(frame.fog_color_density.w, 0.0) * fog_distance);
340:     var composed = mix(frame.fog_color_density.xyz, linear_radiance, transmittance);
341:     var encoded = display_color(composed);
342:     if frame.render_options.z != 0u {
343:         encoded += vec3<f32>((hash_screen(pixel) - 0.5) / 128.0);
344:     }
345:     return vec4<f32>(clamp(encoded, vec3<f32>(0.0), vec3<f32>(1.0)), 1.0);
346: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/webgpu/shaders/cpu_present.wgsl
````wgsl
 1: // The CPU reference keeps its platform-free software rasterizer. WebGPU owns
 2: // presentation: the completed RGBA buffer is uploaded once and sampled by a
 3: // fullscreen triangle, replacing the browser-only Canvas2D blit.
 4: 
 5: @group(0) @binding(0) var cpu_frame: texture_2d<f32>;
 6: @group(0) @binding(1) var cpu_sampler: sampler;
 7: 
 8: struct PresentVertex {
 9:     @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
10:     @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
11: };
12: 
13: @vertex
14: fn cpu_present_vertex(@builtin(vertex_index) vertex_index: u32) -> PresentVertex {
15:     var output: PresentVertex;
16:     let x = select(-1.0, 3.0, vertex_index == 1u);
17:     let y = select(-1.0, 3.0, vertex_index == 2u);
18:     output.clip_position = vec4<f32>(x, y, 0.0, 1.0);
19:     output.uv = vec2<f32>((x + 1.0) * 0.5, 1.0 - (y + 1.0) * 0.5);
20:     return output;
21: }
22: 
23: @fragment
24: fn cpu_present_fragment(input: PresentVertex) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
25:     return textureSample(cpu_frame, cpu_sampler, input.uv);
26: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/webgpu/shaders/raster_shadow.wgsl
````wgsl
 1: // Receiver-side hero shadow sampling shared by Surface and Splat.
 2: 
 3: @group(2) @binding(0) var<uniform> hero_shadow: HeroShadowUniforms;
 4: @group(2) @binding(1) var hero_shadow_depth: texture_depth_2d;
 5: @group(2) @binding(2) var hero_shadow_sampler: sampler_comparison;
 6: 
 7: fn hero_shadow_visibility(
 8:     world: vec3<f32>,
 9:     normal: vec3<f32>,
10:     surface_to_light: vec3<f32>,
11: ) -> f32 {
12:     if hero_shadow.options.x == 0u {
13:         return 1.0;
14:     }
15:     let clip = hero_shadow.light_view_projection
16:         * vec4<f32>(world + normal * 0.0005, 1.0);
17:     let projected = clip.xyz / max(abs(clip.w), 1e-8);
18:     // WebGPU texture coordinates start at the top-left; NDC Y points up.
19:     let uv = vec2<f32>(projected.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - projected.y * 0.5);
20:     let receiver_depth = projected.z;
21:     if any(uv < vec2<f32>(0.0)) || any(uv > vec2<f32>(1.0))
22:         || receiver_depth <= 0.0 || receiver_depth >= 1.0 {
23:         return 1.0;
24:     }
25: 
26:     let slope = 1.0 - clamp(dot(normal, surface_to_light), 0.0, 1.0);
27:     let bias = max(hero_shadow.sampling.z, hero_shadow.sampling.w * slope);
28:     let reference_depth = receiver_depth - bias;
29:     if hero_shadow.options.z <= 1u {
30:         return textureSampleCompareLevel(
31:             hero_shadow_depth,
32:             hero_shadow_sampler,
33:             uv,
34:             reference_depth
35:         );
36:     }
37: 
38:     let offsets = array<vec2<f32>, 4>(
39:         vec2<f32>(-0.5, -0.5),
40:         vec2<f32>( 0.5, -0.5),
41:         vec2<f32>(-0.5,  0.5),
42:         vec2<f32>( 0.5,  0.5)
43:     );
44:     var visibility = 0.0;
45:     for (var tap = 0u; tap < 4u; tap += 1u) {
46:         visibility += textureSampleCompareLevel(
47:             hero_shadow_depth,
48:             hero_shadow_sampler,
49:             uv + offsets[tap] * hero_shadow.sampling.xy,
50:             reference_depth
51:         );
52:     }
53:     return visibility * 0.25;
54: }
55: 
56: fn raster_surface_radiance(
57:     world: vec3<f32>,
58:     normal: vec3<f32>,
59:     albedo: vec3<f32>,
60:     baked: f32,
61:     ao: f32,
62:     light_first: u32,
63:     light_count: u32,
64: ) -> vec3<f32> {
65:     var analytic_direct = vec3<f32>(0.0);
66:     let safe_count = min(
67:         light_count,
68:         frame.render_options.x - min(light_first, frame.render_options.x)
69:     );
70:     for (var local = 0u; local < safe_count; local += 1u) {
71:         let light_index = light_first + local;
72:         let light = lights[light_index];
73:         if light.half_size_kind.w < 0.5 {
74:             continue;
75:         }
76:         var contribution = evaluate_scene_light(world, normal, light);
77:         if hero_shadow.options.x != 0u && light_index == hero_shadow.options.y {
78:             let delta = light.position_radius.xyz - world;
79:             let surface_to_light = delta / sqrt(max(dot(delta, delta), 1e-8));
80:             contribution *= hero_shadow_visibility(world, normal, surface_to_light);
81:         }
82:         analytic_direct += contribution;
83:     }
84:     return surface_radiance_from_analytic_direct(
85:         world,
86:         normal,
87:         albedo,
88:         baked,
89:         ao,
90:         analytic_direct
91:     );
92: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/webgpu/shaders/splat_geometry.wgsl
````wgsl
 1: // Compact face expansion shared by visible and caster passes.
 2: 
 3: struct PackedFace {
 4:     xy: u32,
 5:     z_extents: u32,
 6:     surface: u32,
 7:     // low 24: domain sRGB color; high 8: authored emission over 0..=10.
 8:     visual: u32,
 9: };
10: 
11: @group(1) @binding(1) var<storage, read> packed_faces: array<PackedFace>;
12: 
13: fn face_u(axis: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
14:     if axis <= 3u { return vec3<f32>(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); }
15:     return vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
16: }
17: 
18: fn face_v(axis: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
19:     switch axis {
20:         case 0u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -1.0); }
21:         case 1u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
22:         case 2u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, -1.0, 0.0); }
23:         case 3u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); }
24:         case 4u: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
25:         default: { return vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -1.0); }
26:     }
27: }
28: 
29: fn splat_face_center(packed: PackedFace) -> vec3<f32> {
30:     let center_local = vec3<f32>(
31:         f32(packed.xy & 65535u),
32:         f32(packed.xy >> 16u),
33:         f32(packed.z_extents & 65535u)
34:     ) * (1.0 / 1024.0);
35:     return chunk.origin_world_size.xyz + center_local;
36: }
37: 
38: fn splat_face_world_position(packed: PackedFace, corner_index: u32) -> vec3<f32> {
39:     let extent_u = f32((packed.z_extents >> 16u) & 255u);
40:     let extent_v = f32(packed.z_extents >> 24u);
41:     let axis = packed.surface & 255u;
42:     let corner = vec2<f32>(
43:         select(-1.0, 1.0, corner_index == 1u || corner_index == 3u),
44:         select(-1.0, 1.0, corner_index >= 2u)
45:     );
46:     return splat_face_center(packed)
47:         + face_u(axis) * corner.x * extent_u * chunk.bounds_voxel_size.w * 0.5
48:         + face_v(axis) * corner.y * extent_v * chunk.bounds_voxel_size.w * 0.5;
49: }
````

````wgsl
 1: // Depth caster for the face-only Splat strategy. No indexed mesh exists:
 2: // each packed face expands to the same four-vertex strip as the visible pass.

 5: fn splat_shadow_vertex(
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/webgpu/shaders/splat.wgsl
````wgsl
 1: // Instanced face-splat strategy. One compact 16-byte record becomes a quad
 2: // in the vertex stage; face geometry is generated entirely on the GPU.
 3: 
 4: struct SplatVertex {
 5:     @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
 6:     @location(0) world: vec3<f32>,
 7:     @location(1) normal: vec3<f32>,
 8:     @location(2) @interpolate(flat) radiance: vec3<f32>,
 9: };
10: 
11: @vertex
12: fn splat_vertex(
13:     @builtin(vertex_index) corner_index: u32,
14:     @builtin(instance_index) face_index: u32,
15: ) -> SplatVertex {
16:     let packed = packed_faces[face_index];
17:     let axis = packed.surface & 255u;
18:     let baked = f32((packed.surface >> 16u) & 255u) / 15.0;
19:     let ao = 1.0 - f32(packed.surface >> 24u) / 255.0;
20:     let normal = normal_for_axis(axis);
21:     let center = splat_face_center(packed);
22:     let world = splat_face_world_position(packed, corner_index);
23:     let albedo = packed_srgb_to_linear(packed.visual);
24:     let emission = f32(packed.visual >> 24u) / 25.5;
25:     let emits = emission > 0.0 && normal.y < -0.5;
26: 
27:     var output: SplatVertex;
28:     output.clip_position = frame.view_projection * vec4<f32>(world, 1.0);
29:     output.world = world;
30:     output.normal = normal;
31:     output.radiance = select(
32:         raster_surface_radiance(center, normal, albedo, baked, ao, chunk.draw.x, chunk.draw.y),
33:         albedo * emission,
34:         emits
35:     );
36:     return output;
37: }
38: 
39: @fragment
40: fn splat_fragment(input: SplatVertex) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
41:     return present_radiance(input.radiance, input.world, input.clip_position.xy);
42: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/webgpu/shaders/supply_labels.wgsl
````wgsl
 1: // Supply-item label overlay. A single point record expands into a
 2: // camera-facing quad in the vertex stage, so labels require no transient
 3: // vertex or index allocation.
 4: 
 5: struct SupplySprite {
 6:     // xyz: world center; w: stacked atlas row.
 7:     position_atlas_row: vec4<f32>,
 8: };
 9: 
10: @group(1) @binding(0) var<storage, read> supply_sprites: array<SupplySprite>;
11: @group(1) @binding(1) var supply_atlas: texture_2d<f32>;
12: @group(1) @binding(2) var supply_sampler: sampler;
13: 
14: struct SupplyVertex {
15:     @builtin(position) clip_position: vec4<f32>,
16:     @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
17:     @location(1) @interpolate(flat) atlas_row: f32,
18:     @location(2) world: vec3<f32>,
19: };
20: 
21: fn supply_corner(index: u32) -> vec2<f32> {
22:     switch index {
23:         case 0u: { return vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0); }
24:         case 1u: { return vec2<f32>( 1.0, -1.0); }
25:         case 2u: { return vec2<f32>( 1.0,  1.0); }
26:         case 3u: { return vec2<f32>(-1.0, -1.0); }
27:         case 4u: { return vec2<f32>( 1.0,  1.0); }
28:         default: { return vec2<f32>(-1.0, 1.0); }
29:     }
30: }
31: 
32: @vertex
33: fn supply_label_vertex(
34:     @builtin(vertex_index) vertex_index: u32,
35:     @builtin(instance_index) sprite_index: u32,
36: ) -> SupplyVertex {
37:     let sprite = supply_sprites[sprite_index];
38:     let corner = supply_corner(vertex_index);
39:     let world = sprite.position_atlas_row.xyz
40:         + frame.camera_right.xyz * (corner.x * 0.26)
41:         + vec3<f32>(0.0, corner.y * 0.195, 0.0);
42: 
43:     var output: SupplyVertex;
44:     output.clip_position = frame.view_projection * vec4<f32>(world, 1.0);
45:     output.uv = vec2<f32>(corner.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - corner.y * 0.5);
46:     output.atlas_row = sprite.position_atlas_row.w;
47:     output.world = world;
48:     return output;
49: }
50: 
51: @fragment
52: fn supply_label_fragment(input: SupplyVertex) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
53:     let uv = vec2<f32>(input.uv.x, (input.uv.y + input.atlas_row) * 0.5);
54:     let label = textureSample(supply_atlas, supply_sampler, uv);
55:     if label.a < 0.5 {
56:         discard;
57:     }
58: 
59:     let view_distance = length(input.world - frame.camera_position.xyz);
60:     let fog_distance = max(view_distance - frame.viewport_fov_start.w, 0.0);
61:     let transmittance = exp(-max(frame.fog_color_density.w, 0.0) * fog_distance);
62:     let radiance = mix(frame.fog_color_density.xyz, label.rgb * 0.92, transmittance);
63:     return vec4<f32>(display_color(radiance), 1.0);
64: }
````
