## File: wasm_frontend/src/application/collision.rs
````rust
  1: //! Axis-aligned collision primitives and the sliding-collision world.
  2: //!
  3: //! Collision geometry is *derived from the SVO itself* (solid leaf nodes of
  4: //! type WALL / RED_WALL become world-space boxes), so the physical world and
  5: //! the rendered world can never drift apart.
  6: 
  7: /// Axis-aligned bounding box in world space.
  8: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
  9: pub struct Aabb {
 10:     pub min: [f32; 3],
 11:     pub max: [f32; 3],
 12: }
 13: 
 14: impl Aabb {
 15:     pub fn new(min: [f32; 3], max: [f32; 3]) -> Self {
 16:         Self { min, max }
 17:     }
 18: 
 19:     pub fn intersects(&self, other: &Aabb) -> bool {
 20:         self.max[0] > other.min[0]
 21:             && self.min[0] < other.max[0]
 22:             && self.max[1] > other.min[1]
 23:             && self.min[1] < other.max[1]
 24:             && self.max[2] > other.min[2]
 25:             && self.min[2] < other.max[2]
 26:     }
 27: }
 28: 
 29: /// Player capsule approximated as an AABB, matching the original client:
 30: /// radius 0.35 around the eye, extending 1.65 below and 0.1 above eye level.
 31: pub const PLAYER_RADIUS: f32 = 0.35;
 32: pub const PLAYER_EYE_TO_FEET: f32 = 1.65;
 33: pub const PLAYER_EYE_TO_HEAD: f32 = 0.1;
 34: 
 35: /// Builds the player's AABB from an eye-level position.
 36: pub fn player_aabb(eye_pos: [f32; 3]) -> Aabb {
 37:     Aabb::new(
 38:         [
 39:             eye_pos[0] - PLAYER_RADIUS,
 40:             eye_pos[1] - PLAYER_EYE_TO_FEET,
 41:             eye_pos[2] - PLAYER_RADIUS,
 42:         ],
 43:         [
 44:             eye_pos[0] + PLAYER_RADIUS,
 45:             eye_pos[1] + PLAYER_EYE_TO_HEAD,
 46:             eye_pos[2] + PLAYER_RADIUS,
 47:         ],
 48:     )
 49: }
 50: 
 51: /// The set of solid boxes the player can collide with.
 52: /// Rebuilt whenever the chunk set changes.
 53: #[derive(Debug, Default)]
 54: pub struct CollisionWorld {
 55:     boxes: Vec<Aabb>,
 56: }
 57: 
 58: impl CollisionWorld {
 59:     pub fn new() -> Self {
 60:         Self { boxes: Vec::new() }
 61:     }
 62: 
 63:     pub fn rebuild<'a, I: IntoIterator<Item = &'a Aabb>>(&mut self, boxes: I) {
 64:         self.boxes.clear();
 65:         self.boxes.extend(boxes.into_iter().copied());
 66:     }
 67: 
 68:     pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
 69:         self.boxes.len()
 70:     }
 71: 
 72:     pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
 73:         self.boxes.is_empty()
 74:     }
 75: 
 76:     pub fn boxes(&self) -> &[Aabb] {
 77:         &self.boxes
 78:     }
 79: 
 80:     /// True if a player standing at `eye_pos` overlaps any solid box.
 81:     pub fn collides(&self, eye_pos: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
 82:         let p = player_aabb(eye_pos);
 83:         self.boxes.iter().any(|b| p.intersects(b))
 84:     }
 85: }
 86: 
 87: #[cfg(test)]
 88: mod tests {
 89:     use super::*;
 90: 
 91:     #[test]
 92:     fn aabb_intersection_is_exclusive_on_touching_faces() {
 93:         let a = Aabb::new([0.0, 0.0, 0.0], [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]);
 94:         let touching = Aabb::new([1.0, 0.0, 0.0], [2.0, 1.0, 1.0]);
 95:         let overlapping = Aabb::new([0.9, 0.0, 0.0], [2.0, 1.0, 1.0]);
 96:         assert!(!a.intersects(&touching));
 97:         assert!(a.intersects(&overlapping));
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     #[test]
101:     fn player_collides_with_wall_at_waist_height() {
102:         let mut world = CollisionWorld::new();
103:         world.rebuild(&[Aabb::new([1.0, 0.0, 0.0], [1.2, 3.0, 5.0])]);
104:         // Eye at 1.7 — wall spans full height, player is 0.35 wide.
105:         assert!(world.collides([1.0, 1.7, 2.0]));
106:         assert!(!world.collides([0.0, 1.7, 2.0]));
107:     }
108: 
109:     #[test]
110:     fn player_does_not_collide_with_floor_slab_below_feet() {
111:         let mut world = CollisionWorld::new();
112:         // Floor slab 0.0..0.05 — feet bottom is at 1.7 - 1.65 = 0.05 exactly:
113:         // touching, not overlapping.
114:         world.rebuild(&[Aabb::new([-10.0, 0.0, -10.0], [10.0, 0.05, 10.0])]);
115:         assert!(!world.collides([0.0, 1.7, 0.0]));
116:     }
117: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/application/generation_worker_policy.rs
````rust
  1: //! Select concurrency for the browser's chunk-generation worker pool.
  2: //!
  3: //! This policy configures world generation and streaming only. The software
  4: //! splat renderer remains on the browser's main thread. Keeping query parsing
  5: //! and hardware clamping here makes the contract natively testable and keeps
  6: //! browser APIs out of the application layer.
  7: 
  8: /// Safety ceiling for generation workers — not a target. `Auto` should use
  9: /// every hardware thread the browser reports (minus one reserved for the
 10: /// main/render thread), including on high-core-count machines; this only
 11: /// guards against a browser misreporting an absurd `hardwareConcurrency`
 12: /// value and spawning an unreasonable number of Worker instances (each one
 13: /// duplicates the WASM module and atlas-building scratch memory).
 14: pub const MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS: u8 = 32;
 15: 
 16: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 17: pub enum GenerationWorkerPreference {
 18:     /// Reserve one reported hardware thread for the browser/render loop.
 19:     Auto,
 20:     /// Generate synchronously through `LocalChunkSource` on the main thread.
 21:     Disabled,
 22:     /// Request an explicit number, still bounded by reported hardware.
 23:     Fixed(u8),
 24: }
 25: 
 26: impl Default for GenerationWorkerPreference {
 27:     fn default() -> Self {
 28:         Self::Auto
 29:     }
 30: }
 31: 
 32: impl GenerationWorkerPreference {
 33:     /// Resolve a safe pool size from `Navigator.hardwareConcurrency`.
 34:     /// Unknown/invalid reports use the conservative historical fallback of
 35:     /// two hardware threads; automatic selection therefore uses one worker.
 36:     pub fn resolve(self, hardware_concurrency: f64) -> usize {
 37:         if self == Self::Disabled {
 38:             return 0;
 39:         }
 40: 
 41:         let reported_threads = if hardware_concurrency.is_finite() && hardware_concurrency >= 1.0 {
 42:             hardware_concurrency.floor().min(u32::MAX as f64) as u32
 43:         } else {
 44:             2
 45:         };
 46:         let auto_workers = reported_threads
 47:             .saturating_sub(1)
 48:             .clamp(1, u32::from(MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS)) as u8;
 49:         let fixed_worker_ceiling =
 50:             reported_threads.clamp(1, u32::from(MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS)) as u8;
 51:         match self {
 52:             Self::Auto => auto_workers,
 53:             Self::Fixed(requested) => requested.clamp(1, fixed_worker_ceiling),
 54:             Self::Disabled => 0,
 55:         }
 56:         .into()
 57:     }
 58: }
 59: 
 60: /// Parses the last exact `workers` query pair. Canonical values are `auto`,
 61: /// `0`, and positive integers; oversized integers clamp to the product cap.
 62: /// Missing or malformed values safely restore automatic selection.
 63: pub fn parse_generation_worker_preference(query: &str) -> GenerationWorkerPreference {
 64:     let mut preference = GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto;
 65:     for (key, value) in query
 66:         .trim_start_matches('?')
 67:         .split('&')
 68:         .filter_map(|pair| pair.split_once('='))
 69:     {
 70:         if key != "workers" {
 71:             continue;
 72:         }
 73:         preference = match value {
 74:             "auto" => GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto,
 75:             "0" => GenerationWorkerPreference::Disabled,
 76:             _ => value
 77:                 .parse::<u32>()
 78:                 .ok()
 79:                 .filter(|requested| *requested > 0)
 80:                 .map(|requested| {
 81:                     GenerationWorkerPreference::Fixed(
 82:                         requested.min(u32::from(MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS)) as u8,
 83:                     )
 84:                 })
 85:                 .unwrap_or(GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto),
 86:         };
 87:     }
 88:     preference
 89: }
 90: 
 91: #[cfg(test)]
 92: mod tests {
 93:     use super::*;
 94: 
 95:     #[test]
 96:     fn missing_and_malformed_values_restore_auto() {
 97:         assert_eq!(
 98:             parse_generation_worker_preference("?seed=7"),
 99:             GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto
100:         );
101:         assert_eq!(
102:             parse_generation_worker_preference("?workers=banana"),
103:             GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto
104:         );
105:         assert_eq!(
106:             parse_generation_worker_preference("?not_workers=0"),
107:             GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto
108:         );
109:     }
110: 
111:     #[test]
112:     fn parses_disabled_auto_and_bounded_fixed_counts() {
113:         assert_eq!(
114:             parse_generation_worker_preference("?workers=0"),
115:             GenerationWorkerPreference::Disabled
116:         );
117:         assert_eq!(
118:             parse_generation_worker_preference("?workers=auto"),
119:             GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto
120:         );
121:         assert_eq!(
122:             parse_generation_worker_preference("?workers=3"),
123:             GenerationWorkerPreference::Fixed(3)
124:         );
125:         assert_eq!(
126:             parse_generation_worker_preference("?workers=999"),
127:             GenerationWorkerPreference::Fixed(MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS)
128:         );
129:     }
130: 
131:     #[test]
132:     fn last_duplicate_pair_wins_deterministically() {
133:         assert_eq!(
134:             parse_generation_worker_preference("?workers=4&workers=0"),
135:             GenerationWorkerPreference::Disabled
136:         );
137:     }
138: 
139:     #[test]
140:     fn resolution_reserves_the_main_thread_and_clamps_to_hardware() {
141:         assert_eq!(GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto.resolve(8.0), 7);
142:         assert_eq!(GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto.resolve(4.0), 3);
143:         assert_eq!(GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto.resolve(2.0), 1);
144:         assert_eq!(GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto.resolve(1.0), 1);
145:         assert_eq!(GenerationWorkerPreference::Fixed(4).resolve(2.0), 2);
146:         assert_eq!(GenerationWorkerPreference::Fixed(2).resolve(8.0), 2);
147:         assert_eq!(GenerationWorkerPreference::Disabled.resolve(8.0), 0);
148:     }
149: 
150:     /// A 16-thread machine must not be artificially throttled to a low
151:     /// worker count: `Auto` should use (almost) every reported thread. This
152:     /// is the regression test for the historical `MAX_GENERATION_WORKERS =
153:     /// 4` ceiling, which silently capped every machine above 5 hardware
154:     /// threads regardless of what was actually available.
155:     #[test]
156:     fn auto_scales_to_high_core_counts_instead_of_a_low_fixed_cap() {
157:         assert_eq!(GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto.resolve(16.0), 15);
158:         assert_eq!(
159:             GenerationWorkerPreference::Fixed(16).resolve(16.0),
160:             16,
161:             "an explicit request for 16 workers on 16-thread hardware must not be clamped below it"
162:         );
163:     }
164: 
165:     #[test]
166:     fn invalid_hardware_reports_use_a_conservative_fallback() {
167:         assert_eq!(GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto.resolve(f64::NAN), 1);
168:         assert_eq!(GenerationWorkerPreference::Auto.resolve(0.0), 1);
169:         assert_eq!(
170:             GenerationWorkerPreference::Fixed(4).resolve(f64::INFINITY),
171:             2
172:         );
173:     }
174: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/application/prepare_frame_lighting.rs
````rust
  1: //! Prepare the immutable fixture list consumed by a render frame.
  2: //!
  3: //! Chunk payloads overlap on purpose, so the same ceiling panel can arrive
  4: //! from several neighboring halos. Selection belongs here, before any GPU
  5: //! driver: all renderers must see the same deduplicated physical scene.
  6: 
  7: use std::collections::HashMap;
  8: 
  9: use crate::application::ports::LightSource;
 10: 
 11: /// Collects every finite, enabled fixture and orders it by conservative
 12: /// contribution at `camera_position`.
 13: ///
 14: /// The ordering is not a budget: no fixture is discarded. It keeps the hero
 15: /// shadow choice stable and makes output independent of hash-map/chunk arrival
 16: /// order. Projected emitter area and authored intensity raise importance while
 17: /// squared distance lowers it.
 18: pub fn select_scene_lights<'a>(
 19:     lights: impl Iterator<Item = &'a LightSource>,
 20:     camera_position: [f32; 3],
 21: ) -> Vec<LightSource> {
 22:     let mut unique = HashMap::<u64, LightSource>::new();
 23:     for light in lights.copied() {
 24:         if light.enabled && valid(&light) {
 25:             unique.entry(light.id).or_insert(light);
 26:         }
 27:     }
 28: 
 29:     let mut ranked: Vec<(LightSource, f32)> = unique
 30:         .into_values()
 31:         .map(|light| {
 32:             let delta = [
 33:                 light.position[0] - camera_position[0],
 34:                 light.position[1] - camera_position[1],
 35:                 light.position[2] - camera_position[2],
 36:             ];
 37:             let distance_squared = delta.into_iter().map(|v| v * v).sum::<f32>();
 38:             let area = (4.0 * light.half_size[0] * light.half_size[1]).max(0.01);
 39:             let importance = light.intensity * area / (distance_squared + area);
 40:             (light, importance)
 41:         })
 42:         .collect();
 43:     ranked.sort_by(|(a, a_score), (b, b_score)| {
 44:         b_score.total_cmp(a_score).then_with(|| a.id.cmp(&b.id))
 45:     });
 46: 
 47:     ranked.into_iter().map(|(light, _)| light).collect()
 48: }
 49: 
 50: fn valid(light: &LightSource) -> bool {
 51:     light.position.into_iter().all(f32::is_finite)
 52:         && light.color.into_iter().all(f32::is_finite)
 53:         && light
 54:             .half_size
 55:             .into_iter()
 56:             .all(|v| v.is_finite() && v >= 0.0)
 57:         && light.radius.is_finite()
 58:         && light.radius > 0.0
 59:         && light.intensity.is_finite()
 60:         && light.intensity > 0.0
 61: }
 62:
````

 258:     fn window_event(&mut self, event_loop: &ActiveEventLoop, _id: WindowId, event: WindowEvent) {
 259:         let Some(state) = &mut self.state else {
 260:             return;
 261:         };
 262:         match event {
 263:             WindowEvent::CloseRequested => event_loop.exit(),
 264:             WindowEvent::Resized(size) => {
 265:                 state.renderer.resize(size.width, size.height);
 266:             }
 267:             WindowEvent::MouseInput {
 268:                 state: ElementState::Pressed,
 269:                 button: MouseButton::Left,
 270:                 ..
 271:             } => {
 272:                 if !state.input.captured {
 273:                     let grabbed = state
 274:                         .window
 275:                         .set_cursor_grab(CursorGrabMode::Confined)
 276:                         .or_else(|_| state.window.set_cursor_grab(CursorGrabMode::Locked))
 277:                         .is_ok();
 278:                     state.window.set_cursor_visible(!grabbed);
 279:                     state.input.captured = grabbed;
 280:                 }
 281:             }
 282:             WindowEvent::KeyboardInput { event, .. } => {
 283:                 let pressed = event.state == ElementState::Pressed;
 284:                 match event.physical_key {
 285:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyW | KeyCode::ArrowUp) => {
 286:                         state.input.forward = pressed;
 287:                     }
 288:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyS | KeyCode::ArrowDown) => {
 289:                         state.input.backward = pressed;
 290:                     }
 291:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyA | KeyCode::ArrowLeft) => {
 292:                         state.input.left = pressed;
 293:                     }
 294:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyD | KeyCode::ArrowRight) => {
 295:                         state.input.right = pressed;
 296:                     }
 297:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyF) if pressed => {
 298:                         state.input.flashlight = !state.input.flashlight;
 299:                     }
 300:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyG) if pressed => {
 301:                         state.input.drop_flare = true;
 302:                     }
 303:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyR) if pressed => {
 304:                         state.input.drink = true;
 305:                     }
 306:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::KeyT) if pressed => {
 307:                         state.input.eat = true;
 308:                     }
 309:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::F1) if pressed => {
 310:                         state.show_config = !state.show_config;
 311:                     }
 312:                     // Live effect-pass switches (the terminal's F1 panel
 313:                     // documents them). These are per-frame parameters, so
 314:                     // flipping them needs no pipeline rebuild.
 315:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::F5) if pressed => {
 316:                         state.toggles.shadow_pass = !state.toggles.shadow_pass;
 317:                         state.renderer.set_toggles(state.toggles);
 318:                     }
 319:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::F6) if pressed => {
 320:                         state.toggles.ambient_occlusion = !state.toggles.ambient_occlusion;
 321:                         state.renderer.set_toggles(state.toggles);
 322:                     }
 323:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::F7) if pressed => {
 324:                         state.toggles.deferred_shading = !state.toggles.deferred_shading;
 325:                         state.renderer.set_toggles(state.toggles);
 326:                     }
 327:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::F8) if pressed => {
 328:                         state.toggles.flashlight_occlusion = !state.toggles.flashlight_occlusion;
 329:                         state.renderer.set_toggles(state.toggles);
 330:                     }
 331:                     PhysicalKey::Code(KeyCode::Escape) if pressed => {
 332:                         let _ = state.window.set_cursor_grab(CursorGrabMode::None);
 333:                         state.window.set_cursor_visible(true);
 334:                         state.input.captured = false;
 335:                     }
 336:                     _ => {}
 337:                 }
 338:             }
 339:             WindowEvent::RedrawRequested => {
 340:                 let now = Instant::now();
 341:                 let dt = (now - state.last_frame).as_secs_f32().min(0.1);
 342:                 state.last_frame = now;
 343: 
 344:                 // Slow channels (fps, section locator) refresh once a second.
 345:                 state.hud_frames += 1;
 346:                 let elapsed = now - state.hud_window_start;
 347:                 if elapsed.as_secs_f32() >= 1.0 {
 348:                     state.fps = state.hud_frames as f32 / elapsed.as_secs_f32();
 349:                     state.hud_frames = 0;
 350:                     state.hud_window_start = now;
 351:                     let (level, pos) = {
 352:                         let player = state.engine.player();
 353:                         (state.engine.level(), player.position)
 354:                     };
 355:                     state.section = state.locator.describe(level, pos[0], pos[2]);
 356:                 }
 357: 
 358:                 // Last frame's stats feed this frame's terminal: the engine
 359:                 // draws (and presents) inside tick, so the snapshot must be
 360:                 // staged before it runs. One frame of latency is invisible.
 361:                 let stats = state.engine.stats();
 362:                 state.renderer.set_hud(HudSnapshot {
 363:                     hydration: stats.hydration,
 364:                     satiety: stats.satiety,
 365:                     condition: stats.condition,
 366:                     almond_bottles: stats.almond_bottles,
 367:                     rations: stats.rations,
 368:                     ready: stats.ready,
 369:                     flashlight: state.input.flashlight,
 370:                     fps: state.fps,
 371:                     fine_chunks: stats.fine_chunks,
 372:                     resident_chunks: stats.resident_chunks,
 373:                     atlas_nodes: stats.atlas_nodes,
 374:                     bpm: stats.body.bpm,
 375:                     signal: stats.body.signal,
 376:                     section: state.section.clone(),
 377:                     distance_m: stats.distance_m,
 378:                     ambient_c: stats.ambient_c,
 379:                     deaths: stats.deaths,
 380:                     seed: state.seed,
 381:                     show_config: state.show_config,
 382:                     toggles: state.toggles,
 383:                 });
 384:                 let frame_input = state.input.take_frame();
 385:                 state.engine.tick(dt, &frame_input);
 386:                 state.window.request_redraw();
 387:             }
 388:             _ => {}
 389:         }
 390:     }

 485: impl NativeRenderer {
 486:     fn new(window: Arc<Window>, profile: RendererProfile, toggles: RenderToggles) -> Self {
 487:         let mut descriptor =
 488:             wgpu::InstanceDescriptor::new_with_display_handle(Box::new(window.clone()));
 489:         descriptor.backends = wgpu::Backends::VULKAN;
 490:         let instance = wgpu::Instance::new(descriptor);
 491:         let surface = instance
 492:             .create_surface(window.clone())
 493:             .expect("create window surface");
 494:         let adapter = pollster::block_on(instance.request_adapter(&wgpu::RequestAdapterOptions {
 495:             power_preference: wgpu::PowerPreference::None,
 496:             force_fallback_adapter: false,
 497:             compatible_surface: Some(&surface),
 498:             apply_limit_buckets: false,
 499:         }))
 500:         .expect("no Vulkan adapter; install Mesa (Lavapipe works) or expose a Vulkan GPU");
 501:         let info = adapter.get_info();
 502:         eprintln!(
 503:             "Vulkan adapter: {} ({}, {})",
 504:             info.name, info.driver, info.driver_info
 505:         );
 506:         let limits = wgpu::Limits::default().or_worse_values_from(&adapter.limits());
 507:         let (device, queue) = pollster::block_on(adapter.request_device(&wgpu::DeviceDescriptor {
 508:             label: Some("vackrooms.native-play"),
 509:             required_features: wgpu::Features::empty(),
 510:             required_limits: limits,
 511:             ..Default::default()
 512:         }))
 513:         .expect("create Vulkan device");
 514: 
 515:         // Mirror the browser context: the shaders encode display color
 516:         // themselves, so present through a non-sRGB view of the swapchain.
 517:         let capabilities = surface.get_capabilities(&adapter);
 518:         let format = capabilities
 519:             .formats
 520:             .iter()
 521:             .copied()
 522:             .find(|format| !format.is_srgb())
 523:             .expect("surface exposes a linear color format");
 524:         let size = window.inner_size();
 525:         let config = wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration {
 526:             usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
 527:             format,
 528:             color_space: wgpu::SurfaceColorSpace::Auto,
 529:             width: size.width.max(1),
 530:             height: size.height.max(1),
 531:             desired_maximum_frame_latency: 2,
 532:             present_mode: wgpu::PresentMode::AutoVsync,
 533:             alpha_mode: wgpu::CompositeAlphaMode::Auto,
 534:             view_formats: vec![],
 535:         };
 536:         surface.configure(&device, &config);
 537: 
 538:         let frame_resources = FrameResources::new(&device);
 539:         let strategy = match profile {
 540:             RendererProfile::Surface(settings) => {
 541:                 Strategy::Surface(SurfacePipeline::new_with_shadow_options(
 542:                     &device,
 543:                     format,
 544:                     frame_resources.layout(),
 545:                     settings.common.maximum_draw_distance,
 546:                     HeroShadowOptions::new(
 547:                         settings.shadow_map,
 548:                         settings.optimizations.hero_light_shadow_map,
 549:                     ),
 550:                 ))
 551:             }
 552:             RendererProfile::Splat(settings) => {
 553:                 Strategy::Splat(SplatPipeline::new_with_shadow_options(
 554:                     &device,
 555:                     format,
 556:                     frame_resources.layout(),
 557:                     settings.common.maximum_draw_distance,
 558:                     settings.face_budget,
 559:                     HeroShadowOptions::new(
 560:                         settings.shadow_map,
 561:                         settings.optimizations.hero_light_shadow_map,
 562:                     ),
 563:                 ))
 564:             }
 565:             RendererProfile::Raymarch(settings) => {
 566:                 let mut pipeline = RaymarchPipeline::new(
 567:                     &device,
 568:                     format,
 569:                     frame_resources.layout(),
 570:                     settings.maximum_resident_chunks as usize,
 571:                 );
 572:                 pipeline.configure(RaymarchRuntimeOptions::new(
 573:                     settings.common.maximum_draw_distance,
 574:                     settings.optimizations.direct_light_visibility,
 575:                     settings.area_light_visibility_samples,
 576:                 ));
 577:                 Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline)
 578:             }
 579:             RendererProfile::Cpu(_) => Strategy::Cpu(CpuPresentPipeline::new(
 580:                 &device,
 581:                 format,
 582:                 config.width,
 583:                 config.height,
 584:             )),
 585:         };
 586:         let supply_labels = SupplyLabelPipeline::new(&device, format, frame_resources.layout());
 587:         let depth_view = create_depth_view(&device, config.width, config.height);
 588:         let terminal = crate::terminal::FieldTerminal::new(&device, &queue, format);
 589:         Self {
 590:             _instance: instance,
 591:             surface,
 592:             device,
 593:             queue,
 594:             config,
 595:             frame_resources,
 596:             strategy,
 597:             supply_labels,
 598:             profile,
 599:             toggles,
 600:             depth_view,
 601:             terminal,
 602:             hud_snapshot: HudSnapshot::default(),
 603:         }
 604:     }
 605: 
 606:     fn resize(&mut self, width: u32, height: u32) {
 607:         let width = width.max(1);
 608:         let height = height.max(1);
 609:         if width == self.config.width && height == self.config.height {
 610:             return;
 611:         }
 612:         self.config.width = width;
 613:         self.config.height = height;
 614:         self.surface.configure(&self.device, &self.config);
 615:         if let Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) = &mut self.strategy {
 616:             pipeline.resize(&self.device, width, height);
 617:         }
 618:         self.depth_view = create_depth_view(&self.device, width, height);
 619:     }
 620: 
 621:     fn trace_budget(&self) -> u32 {
 622:         match self.profile {
 623:             RendererProfile::Raymarch(profile) => profile.maximum_trace_steps,
 624:             _ => 1,
 625:         }
 626:     }
 627: 
 628:     fn render(&mut self, frame: &FrameParams, chunks: &[ChunkDraw]) {
 629:         let lights = collect_frame_lights(frame);
 630:         let toggles = self.profile.apply_runtime_toggles(self.toggles);
 631:         let common = self.profile.common();
 632:         let uniforms = GpuFrameUniforms::from_frame(
 633:             frame,
 634:             self.config.width,
 635:             self.config.height,
 636:             camera_state::fov_tan(),
 637:             common.maximum_draw_distance,
 638:             self.trace_budget(),
 639:             lights.len(),
 640:             toggles,
 641:         );
 642:         self.frame_resources
 643:             .write(&self.device, &self.queue, &uniforms, &lights);
 644: 
 645:         let surface_texture = match self.surface.get_current_texture() {
 646:             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Success(texture)
 647:             | wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Suboptimal(texture) => texture,
 648:             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Outdated | wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Lost => {
 649:                 self.surface.configure(&self.device, &self.config);
 650:                 return;
 651:             }
 652:             _ => return,
 653:         };
 654:         let view = surface_texture.texture.create_view(&Default::default());
 655:         let mut encoder = self
 656:             .device
 657:             .create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
 658:                 label: Some("vackrooms.native.frame"),
 659:             });
 660:         match &mut self.strategy {
 661:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.draw(
 662:                 &self.queue,
 663:                 &mut encoder,
 664:                 &view,
 665:                 &self.depth_view,
 666:                 &self.frame_resources,
 667:                 frame,
 668:                 toggles,
 669:                 lights.len().min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32,
 670:             ),
 671:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.draw(
 672:                 &self.queue,
 673:                 &mut encoder,
 674:                 &view,
 675:                 &self.depth_view,
 676:                 &self.frame_resources,
 677:                 frame,
 678:                 toggles,
 679:                 lights.len().min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32,
 680:             ),
 681:             Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline) => pipeline.draw(
 682:                 &self.queue,
 683:                 &mut encoder,
 684:                 &view,
 685:                 &self.frame_resources,
 686:                 frame,
 687:                 chunks,
 688:                 toggles,
 689:             ),
 690:             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => {
 691:                 let mut settings = CpuRenderSettings::default();
 692:                 settings.fov_tan = camera_state::fov_tan();
 693:                 settings.toggles = toggles;
 694:                 pipeline.draw(&self.queue, &mut encoder, &view, frame, chunks, settings);
 695:             }
 696:         }
 697:         if matches!(&self.strategy, Strategy::Surface(_) | Strategy::Splat(_)) {
 698:             self.supply_labels.draw(
 699:                 &self.queue,
 700:                 &mut encoder,
 701:                 &view,
 702:                 &self.depth_view,
 703:                 &self.frame_resources,
 704:                 frame,
 705:             );
 706:         }
 707:         let renderer_label = self.profile.renderer().label();
 708:         draw_field_terminal(
 709:             &mut self.terminal,
 710:             &self.hud_snapshot,
 711:             renderer_label,
 712:             self.config.width,
 713:             self.config.height,
 714:         );
 715:         self.terminal.draw(&self.queue, &mut encoder, &view);
 716:         self.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
 717:         self.queue.present(surface_texture);
 718:     }
 719: }
 720: 
 721: 
 722: fn create_depth_view(device: &wgpu::Device, width: u32, height: u32) -> wgpu::TextureView {
 723:     device
 724:         .create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
 725:             label: Some("vackrooms.native.depth"),
 726:             size: wgpu::Extent3d {
 727:                 width: width.max(1),
 728:                 height: height.max(1),
 729:                 depth_or_array_layers: 1,
 730:             },
 731:             mip_level_count: 1,
 732:             sample_count: 1,
 733:             dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
 734:             format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
 735:             usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
 736:             view_formats: &[],
 737:         })
 738:         .create_view(&Default::default())
 739: }
 740: 
 741: /// The engine owns its renderer as a boxed port while the event loop still
 742: /// needs resize access, so the native renderer is shared the same way the
 743: /// browser shares its canvas renderer.
 744: #[derive(Clone)]
 745: struct SharedNativeRenderer(std::rc::Rc<std::cell::RefCell<NativeRenderer>>);
 746: 
 747: impl SharedNativeRenderer {
 748:     fn new(renderer: NativeRenderer) -> Self {
 749:         Self(std::rc::Rc::new(std::cell::RefCell::new(renderer)))
 750:     }
 751: 
 752:     fn resize(&self, width: u32, height: u32) {
 753:         self.0.borrow_mut().resize(width, height);
 754:     }
 755: 
 756:     fn set_hud(&self, snapshot: HudSnapshot) {
 757:         self.0.borrow_mut().hud_snapshot = snapshot;
 758:     }
 759: 
 760:     /// Live effect-pass switches from the F5–F8 keys; per-frame parameters,
 761:     /// no pipeline rebuild involved.
 762:     fn set_toggles(&self, toggles: RenderToggles) {
 763:         self.0.borrow_mut().toggles = toggles;
 764:     }
 765: }
 766: 
 767: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 768: // Field-terminal layout: the same channels as static/index.html, composed
 769: // from the shared palette in `terminal`. All coordinates are window pixels.
 770: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 771: 
 772: fn draw_field_terminal(
 773:     terminal: &mut crate::terminal::FieldTerminal,
 774:     snapshot: &HudSnapshot,
 775:     renderer_label: &str,
 776:     width: u32,
 777:     height: u32,
 778: ) {
 779:     use crate::terminal::{
 780:         CRITICAL, HAZARD, INK, LOADING_PLATE, PANEL, QUIET, ROUTE, SYSTEM,
 781:     };
 782:     terminal.begin(width, height);
 783:     let w = width.max(1) as f32;
 784:     let h = height.max(1) as f32;
 785:     let px = 16.0;
 786:     let margin = 18.0;
 787: 
 788:     if !snapshot.ready {
 789:         terminal.rect(0.0, 0.0, w, h, LOADING_PLATE);
 790:         let line = "GENERATING WORLD IN WEBASSEMBLY'S ABSENCE...";
 791:         let lw = terminal.measure(line, 24.0);
 792:         terminal.text(line, (w - lw) * 0.5, h * 0.5, 24.0, INK);
 793:         let seed_line = format!("SEED {}", snapshot.seed);
 794:         let sw = terminal.measure(&seed_line, px);
 795:         terminal.text(&seed_line, (w - sw) * 0.5, h * 0.5 + 28.0, px, QUIET);
 796:         return;
 797:     }
 798: 
 799:     // Top-left: renderer / frame channels, key in quiet, value in ink.
 800:     let mut y = margin + px;
 801:     let pen = terminal.text("renderer ", margin, y, px, QUIET);
 802:     let pen = terminal.text(renderer_label, pen, y, px, INK);
 803:     let pen = terminal.text("   fps ", pen, y, px, QUIET);
 804:     let pen = terminal.text(&format!("{:.0}", snapshot.fps), pen, y, px, INK);
 805:     let pen = terminal.text("   frame ", pen, y, px, QUIET);
 806:     terminal.text("Vulkan", pen, y, px, INK);
 807:     y += terminal.line_height(px);
 808:     let pen = terminal.text("chunks ", margin, y, px, QUIET);
 809:     let pen = terminal.text(
 810:         &format!("{}/{}", snapshot.fine_chunks, snapshot.resident_chunks),
 811:         pen,
 812:         y,
 813:         px,
 814:         INK,
 815:     );
 816:     let pen = terminal.text("   nodes ", pen, y, px, QUIET);
 817:     let pen = terminal.text(&format!("{}", snapshot.atlas_nodes), pen, y, px, INK);
 818:     let pen = terminal.text("   dist ", pen, y, px, QUIET);
 819:     let pen = terminal.text(&format!("{:.0} m", snapshot.distance_m), pen, y, px, INK);
 820:     let pen = terminal.text("   amb ", pen, y, px, QUIET);
 821:     terminal.text(&format!("{:.0} C", snapshot.ambient_c), pen, y, px, INK);
 822: 
 823:     // Top-right: section locator, right-aligned (the web terminal's
 824:     // top-right channel).
 825:     if !snapshot.section.is_empty() {
 826:         let sw = terminal.measure(&snapshot.section, px);
 827:         terminal.text(&snapshot.section, w - margin - sw, margin + px, px, QUIET);
 828:     }
 829: 
 830:     // Bottom-left: body trace, vitals bars, supply pips.
 831:     let bar_w = 220.0;
 832:     let bar_h = 12.0;
 833:     let gap = 7.0;
 834:     let bars_top = h - margin - 3.0 * (bar_h + gap) + gap;
 835:     let signal_color = match snapshot.signal {
 836:         PulseSignal::Quiet => QUIET,
 837:         PulseSignal::Active => INK,
 838:         PulseSignal::Strained => ROUTE,
 839:         PulseSignal::Critical => HAZARD,
 840:     };
 841:     if snapshot.signal != PulseSignal::Quiet {
 842:         terminal.text(
 843:             &format!("{:.0} bpm", snapshot.bpm),
 844:             margin,
 845:             bars_top - 14.0,
 846:             px,
 847:             signal_color,
 848:         );
 849:     }
 850:     let bars = [
 851:         (snapshot.hydration, SYSTEM, "H2O"),
 852:         (snapshot.satiety, ROUTE, "RAT"),
 853:         (snapshot.condition, HAZARD, "BOD"),
 854:     ];
 855:     for (index, (value, color, tag)) in bars.iter().enumerate() {
 856:         let by = bars_top + index as f32 * (bar_h + gap);
 857:         terminal.text(tag, margin, by + bar_h - 1.0, 16.0, QUIET);
 858:         let bx = margin + 46.0;
 859:         terminal.rect(bx - 2.0, by - 2.0, bar_w + 4.0, bar_h + 4.0, PANEL);
 860:         terminal.rect(bx, by, bar_w * value.clamp(0.0, 1.0), bar_h, *color);
 861:     }
 862:     // Discrete supply ticks above the bars, water then rations, like
 863:     // #supply-rack.
 864:     let pip = 9.0;
 865:     let pip_gap = 5.0;
 866:     let pip_y = bars_top - 34.0;
 867:     for index in 0..snapshot.almond_bottles.min(12) {
 868:         terminal.rect(
 869:             margin + 46.0 + index as f32 * (pip + pip_gap),
 870:             pip_y,
 871:             pip,
 872:             pip,
 873:             SYSTEM,
 874:         );
 875:     }
 876:     for index in 0..snapshot.rations.min(12) {
 877:         terminal.rect(
 878:             margin + 46.0 + index as f32 * (pip + pip_gap),
 879:             pip_y - pip - pip_gap,
 880:             pip,
 881:             pip,
 882:             ROUTE,
 883:         );
 884:     }
 885: 
 886:     // Bottom-right: torch state and the config-panel hint.
 887:     let mut right_y = h - margin;
 888:     let hint = "F1 CONFIG";
 889:     let hw = terminal.measure(hint, px);
 890:     terminal.text(hint, w - margin - hw, right_y, px, QUIET);
 891:     right_y -= terminal.line_height(px);
 892:     if snapshot.flashlight {
 893:         let torch = "TORCH ON";
 894:         let tw = terminal.measure(torch, px);
 895:         terminal.text(torch, w - margin - tw, right_y, px, ROUTE);
 896:     }
 897:     if snapshot.deaths > 0 {
 898:         let text = format!("SUCCUMBED x{}", snapshot.deaths);
 899:         let tw = terminal.measure(&text, px);
 900:         terminal.text(&text, w - margin - tw, right_y - terminal.line_height(px), px, HAZARD);
 901:     }
 902: 
 903:     // Center mark: single restrained fixation point (see #reticle).
 904:     terminal.rect(w * 0.5 - 2.0, h * 0.5 - 2.0, 4.0, 4.0, [0.9, 0.9, 0.85, 0.55]);
 905: 
 906:     // F1: configuration panel — the native stand-in for the settings menu,
 907:     // documenting the flags and live switches.
 908:     if snapshot.show_config {
 909:         let pw = 560.0_f32.min(w - 2.0 * margin);
 910:         let ph = 330.0_f32.min(h - 2.0 * margin);
 911:         let px0 = (w - pw) * 0.5;
 912:         let py0 = (h - ph) * 0.5;
 913:         terminal.rect(px0, py0, pw, ph, [0.027, 0.039, 0.031, 0.92]);
 914:         let mut ly = py0 + 34.0;
 915:         let lx = px0 + 24.0;
 916:         terminal.text("CONFIGURATION - FIELD TERMINAL", lx, ly, px, CRITICAL);
 917:         ly += terminal.line_height(px) * 1.5;
 918:         let on_off = |on: bool| if on { "ON" } else { "OFF" };
 919:         let rows: Vec<(String, [f32; 4])> = vec![
 920:             (format!("RENDERER   {renderer_label}   (--renderer=surface|splat|raymarch|cpu)"), INK),
 921:             (format!("SEED       {}   (--seed=N reproduces this world)", snapshot.seed), INK),
 922:             (format!("F5 SHADOWS          {}", on_off(snapshot.toggles.shadow_pass)), SYSTEM),
 923:             (format!("F6 AMBIENT OCCL.    {}", on_off(snapshot.toggles.ambient_occlusion)), SYSTEM),
 924:             (format!("F7 DEFERRED SHADING {}", on_off(snapshot.toggles.deferred_shading)), SYSTEM),
 925:             (format!("F8 TORCH OCCLUSION  {}", on_off(snapshot.toggles.flashlight_occlusion)), SYSTEM),
 926:             ("WASD MOVE   MOUSE LOOK   F TORCH   G FLARE".to_owned(), QUIET),
 927:             ("R DRINK     T EAT        ESC RELEASE MOUSE".to_owned(), QUIET),
 928:         ];
 929:         for (row, color) in rows {
 930:             terminal.text(&row, lx, ly, px, color);
 931:             ly += terminal.line_height(px) * 1.15;
 932:         }
 933:     }
 934: }
 935: 
 936: impl RendererPort for SharedNativeRenderer {
 937:     fn artifact_needs(&self) -> RenderArtifactNeeds {
 938:         self.0.borrow().profile.artifact_needs()
 939:     }
 940: 
 941:     fn uses_surface_meshes(&self) -> bool {
 942:         self.artifact_needs().needs_surface_extraction()
 943:     }
 944: 
 945:     fn upload_surfaces(&mut self, chunks: &[SurfaceChunk<'_>]) {
 946:         let renderer = &mut *self.0.borrow_mut();
 947:         match &mut renderer.strategy {
 948:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.upload(&renderer.device, chunks),
 949:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.upload(&renderer.device, chunks),
 950:             _ => {}
 951:         }
 952:     }
 953: 
 954:     fn remove_surfaces(&mut self, keys: &[SurfaceChunkKey]) {
 955:         match &mut self.0.borrow_mut().strategy {
 956:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.remove(keys),
 957:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.remove(keys),
 958:             _ => {}
 959:         }
 960:     }
 961: 
 962:     fn clear_surfaces(&mut self) {
 963:         match &mut self.0.borrow_mut().strategy {
 964:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.clear(),
 965:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.clear(),
 966:             _ => {}
 967:         }
 968:     }
 969: 
 970:     fn upload_atlas(&mut self, texels: &[u32]) {
 971:         let renderer = &mut *self.0.borrow_mut();
 972:         match &mut renderer.strategy {
 973:             Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline) => pipeline.upload_atlas(&renderer.device, texels),
 974:             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => pipeline.upload_atlas(texels),
 975:             _ => {}
 976:         }
 977:     }
 978: 
 979:     fn upload_atlas_rows(&mut self, first_row: u32, texels: &[u32]) -> bool {
 980:         let renderer = &mut *self.0.borrow_mut();
 981:         match &mut renderer.strategy {
 982:             Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline) => {
 983:                 pipeline.upload_atlas_rows(&renderer.queue, first_row, texels)
 984:             }
 985:             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => pipeline.upload_atlas_rows(first_row, texels),
 986:             _ => false,
 987:         }
 988:     }
 989: 
 990:     fn upload_label_atlas(&mut self, rgba: &[u8], width: u32, height: u32) {
 991:         let renderer = &mut *self.0.borrow_mut();
 992:         renderer
 993:             .supply_labels
 994:             .upload_atlas(&renderer.device, &renderer.queue, rgba, width, height);
 995:     }
 996: 
 997:     fn draw(&mut self, frame: &FrameParams, chunks: &[ChunkDraw]) {
 998:         self.0.borrow_mut().render(frame, chunks);
 999:     }
1000: }

````rust
  1: //! The native field terminal: the desktop twin of the browser's DOM HUD.
  2: //!
  3: //! Same design language as `static/index.html` — research-DOS survival
  4: //! instrumentation, sparse text channels, square geometry, explicit units —
  5: //! rendered as two overlay pipelines: flat alpha-blended rects, and text
  6: //! quads sampling a glyph atlas rasterized at startup from the same
  7: //! Bytesized face the web terminal loads from Google Fonts (vendored under
  8: //! `assets/`, SIL OFL).
  9: 
 10: use std::collections::HashMap;
 11: 
 12: // ---- Palette: static/index.html :root tokens, RGBA on straight alpha. ----
 13: pub const INK: [f32; 4] = [1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0];
 14: pub const QUIET: [f32; 4] = [0.706, 0.706, 0.706, 1.0];
 15: pub const ROUTE: [f32; 4] = [0.843, 0.741, 0.439, 1.0];
 16: pub const SYSTEM: [f32; 4] = [0.486, 0.682, 0.667, 1.0];
 17: pub const HAZARD: [f32; 4] = [0.831, 0.353, 0.298, 1.0];
 18: pub const CRITICAL: [f32; 4] = [0.941, 0.875, 0.812, 1.0];
 19: pub const PANEL: [f32; 4] = [0.027, 0.039, 0.031, 0.62];
 20: pub const LOADING_PLATE: [f32; 4] = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.55];
 21: 
 22: /// Glyphs are rasterized once at this pixel size; text draws at integer
 23: /// fractions/multiples so the 8px grid of the face stays crisp.
 24: const RASTER_PX: f32 = 32.0;
 25: const FIRST_GLYPH: char = '!';
 26: const LAST_GLYPH: char = '~';
 27: 
 28: #[repr(C)]
 29: #[derive(Clone, Copy, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
 30: struct RectVertex {
 31:     pos: [f32; 2],
 32:     color: [f32; 4],
 33: }
 34: 
 35: #[repr(C)]
 36: #[derive(Clone, Copy, bytemuck::Pod, bytemuck::Zeroable)]
 37: struct TextVertex {
 38:     pos: [f32; 2],
 39:     uv: [f32; 2],
 40:     color: [f32; 4],
 41: }
 42: 
 43: const RECT_SHADER: &str = r#"
 44: struct VsOut {
 45:     @builtin(position) position: vec4<f32>,
 46:     @location(0) color: vec4<f32>,
 47: };
 48: 
 49: @vertex
 50: fn rect_vertex(@location(0) pos: vec2<f32>, @location(1) color: vec4<f32>) -> VsOut {
 51:     var out: VsOut;
 52:     out.position = vec4<f32>(pos, 0.0, 1.0);
 53:     out.color = color;
 54:     return out;
 55: }
 56: 
 57: @fragment
 58: fn rect_fragment(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
 59:     return in.color;
 60: }
 61: "#;
 62: 
 63: const TEXT_SHADER: &str = r#"
 64: struct VsOut {
 65:     @builtin(position) position: vec4<f32>,
 66:     @location(0) uv: vec2<f32>,
 67:     @location(1) color: vec4<f32>,
 68: };
 69: 
 70: @group(0) @binding(0) var glyphs: texture_2d<f32>;
 71: @group(0) @binding(1) var glyph_sampler: sampler;
 72: 
 73: @vertex
 74: fn text_vertex(
 75:     @location(0) pos: vec2<f32>,
 76:     @location(1) uv: vec2<f32>,
 77:     @location(2) color: vec4<f32>,
 78: ) -> VsOut {
 79:     var out: VsOut;
 80:     out.position = vec4<f32>(pos, 0.0, 1.0);
 81:     out.uv = uv;
 82:     out.color = color;
 83:     return out;
 84: }

 86: @fragment
 87: fn text_fragment(in: VsOut) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
 88:     let coverage = textureSample(glyphs, glyph_sampler, in.uv).r;
 89:     return vec4<f32>(in.color.rgb, in.color.a * coverage);
 90: }

 93: struct Glyph {
 94:     uv_min: [f32; 2],
 95:     uv_max: [f32; 2],
 96:     /// Pixel size of the rasterized bitmap at `RASTER_PX`.
 97:     size: [f32; 2],
 98:     /// Offset from the pen position (baseline-left) to the bitmap's
 99:     /// top-left, in raster pixels; y grows downward.
100:     bearing: [f32; 2],
101:     advance: f32,
102: }

104: pub struct FieldTerminal {
105:     rect_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
106:     text_pipeline: wgpu::RenderPipeline,
107:     _atlas: wgpu::Texture,
108:     text_bind_group: wgpu::BindGroup,
109:     rect_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
110:     text_buffer: wgpu::Buffer,
111:     glyphs: HashMap<char, Glyph>,
112:     line_height: f32,
113:     space_advance: f32,
114:     rects: Vec<RectVertex>,
115:     texts: Vec<TextVertex>,
116:     width: f32,
117:     height: f32,
118: }
119: 
120: const RECT_CAPACITY: usize = 4096;
121: const TEXT_CAPACITY: usize = 16384;

123: impl FieldTerminal {
124:     pub fn new(device: &wgpu::Device, queue: &wgpu::Queue, format: wgpu::TextureFormat) -> Self {
125:         let font = fontdue::Font::from_bytes(
126:             &include_bytes!("../../../assets/Bytesized-Regular.ttf")[..],
127:             fontdue::FontSettings {
128:                 scale: RASTER_PX,
129:                 ..Default::default()
130:             },
131:         )
132:         .expect("parse vendored Bytesized font");
133: 
134:         // Fixed-grid atlas: one cell per printable ASCII glyph.
135:         let cell = RASTER_PX as usize + 8;
136:         let columns = 12usize;
137:         let count = LAST_GLYPH as usize - FIRST_GLYPH as usize + 1;
138:         let rows = count.div_ceil(columns);
139:         let atlas_w = columns * cell;
140:         let atlas_h = rows * cell;
141:         let mut pixels = vec![0u8; atlas_w * atlas_h];
142:         let mut glyphs = HashMap::new();
143:         for (index, code) in (FIRST_GLYPH as u32..=LAST_GLYPH as u32).enumerate() {
144:             let ch = char::from_u32(code).expect("printable ascii");
145:             let (metrics, bitmap) = font.rasterize(ch, RASTER_PX);
146:             let cx = (index % columns) * cell;
147:             let cy = (index / columns) * cell;
148:             for y in 0..metrics.height.min(cell) {
149:                 for x in 0..metrics.width.min(cell) {
150:                     pixels[(cy + y) * atlas_w + cx + x] = bitmap[y * metrics.width + x];
151:                 }
152:             }
153:             glyphs.insert(
154:                 ch,
155:                 Glyph {
156:                     uv_min: [cx as f32 / atlas_w as f32, cy as f32 / atlas_h as f32],
157:                     uv_max: [
158:                         (cx + metrics.width) as f32 / atlas_w as f32,
159:                         (cy + metrics.height) as f32 / atlas_h as f32,
160:                     ],
161:                     size: [metrics.width as f32, metrics.height as f32],
162:                     bearing: [
163:                         metrics.xmin as f32,
164:                         -(metrics.height as f32 + metrics.ymin as f32),
165:                     ],
166:                     advance: metrics.advance_width,
167:                 },
168:             );
169:         }
170:         let space_advance = font
171:             .rasterize(' ', RASTER_PX)
172:             .0
173:             .advance_width
174:             .max(RASTER_PX * 0.28);
175:         let line_height = font
176:             .horizontal_line_metrics(RASTER_PX)
177:             .map(|m| m.new_line_size)
178:             .unwrap_or(RASTER_PX * 1.2);
179: 
180:         let atlas = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
181:             label: Some("native.terminal.glyphs"),
182:             size: wgpu::Extent3d {
183:                 width: atlas_w as u32,
184:                 height: atlas_h as u32,
185:                 depth_or_array_layers: 1,
186:             },
187:             mip_level_count: 1,
188:             sample_count: 1,
189:             dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
190:             format: wgpu::TextureFormat::R8Unorm,
191:             usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::TEXTURE_BINDING | wgpu::TextureUsages::COPY_DST,
192:             view_formats: &[],
193:         });
194:         queue.write_texture(
195:             atlas.as_image_copy(),
196:             &pixels,
197:             wgpu::TexelCopyBufferLayout {
198:                 offset: 0,
199:                 bytes_per_row: Some(atlas_w as u32),
200:                 rows_per_image: Some(atlas_h as u32),
201:             },
202:             wgpu::Extent3d {
203:                 width: atlas_w as u32,
204:                 height: atlas_h as u32,
205:                 depth_or_array_layers: 1,
206:             },
207:         );
208:         // Nearest sampling: Bytesized is a pixel face; interpolation would
209:         // only smear the grid.
210:         let sampler = device.create_sampler(&wgpu::SamplerDescriptor {
211:             label: Some("native.terminal.sampler"),
212:             mag_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
213:             min_filter: wgpu::FilterMode::Nearest,
214:             ..Default::default()
215:         });
216: 
217:         let text_layout = device.create_bind_group_layout(&wgpu::BindGroupLayoutDescriptor {
218:             label: Some("native.terminal.text-layout"),
219:             entries: &[
220:                 wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
221:                     binding: 0,
222:                     visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
223:                     ty: wgpu::BindingType::Texture {
224:                         sample_type: wgpu::TextureSampleType::Float { filterable: true },
225:                         view_dimension: wgpu::TextureViewDimension::D2,
226:                         multisampled: false,
227:                     },
228:                     count: None,
229:                 },
230:                 wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
231:                     binding: 1,
232:                     visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
233:                     ty: wgpu::BindingType::Sampler(wgpu::SamplerBindingType::Filtering),
234:                     count: None,
235:                 },
236:             ],
237:         });
238:         let text_bind_group = device.create_bind_group(&wgpu::BindGroupDescriptor {
239:             label: Some("native.terminal.text-bind"),
240:             layout: &text_layout,
241:             entries: &[
242:                 wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
243:                     binding: 0,
244:                     resource: wgpu::BindingResource::TextureView(
245:                         &atlas.create_view(&Default::default()),
246:                     ),
247:                 },
248:                 wgpu::BindGroupEntry {
249:                     binding: 1,
250:                     resource: wgpu::BindingResource::Sampler(&sampler),
251:                 },
252:             ],
253:         });
254: 
255:         let rect_pipeline = build_pipeline(
256:             device,
257:             format,
258:             RECT_SHADER,
259:             "rect_vertex",
260:             "rect_fragment",
261:             &[],
262:             size_of::<RectVertex>() as u64,
263:             &wgpu::vertex_attr_array![0 => Float32x2, 1 => Float32x4],
264:         );
265:         let text_pipeline = build_pipeline(
266:             device,
267:             format,
268:             TEXT_SHADER,
269:             "text_vertex",
270:             "text_fragment",
271:             std::slice::from_ref(&text_layout),
272:             size_of::<TextVertex>() as u64,
273:             &wgpu::vertex_attr_array![0 => Float32x2, 1 => Float32x2, 2 => Float32x4],
274:         );
275: 
276:         let rect_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
277:             label: Some("native.terminal.rects"),
278:             size: (RECT_CAPACITY * size_of::<RectVertex>()) as u64,
279:             usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::VERTEX | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
280:             mapped_at_creation: false,
281:         });
282:         let text_buffer = device.create_buffer(&wgpu::BufferDescriptor {
283:             label: Some("native.terminal.text"),
284:             size: (TEXT_CAPACITY * size_of::<TextVertex>()) as u64,
285:             usage: wgpu::BufferUsages::VERTEX | wgpu::BufferUsages::COPY_DST,
286:             mapped_at_creation: false,
287:         });

289:         Self {
290:             rect_pipeline,
291:             text_pipeline,
292:             _atlas: atlas,
293:             text_bind_group,
294:             rect_buffer,
295:             text_buffer,
296:             glyphs,
297:             line_height,
298:             space_advance,
299:             rects: Vec::new(),
300:             texts: Vec::new(),
301:             width: 1.0,
302:             height: 1.0,
303:         }
304:     }
305: 
306:     /// Starts a frame's overlay; all push coordinates are window pixels.
307:     pub fn begin(&mut self, width: u32, height: u32) {
308:         self.width = width.max(1) as f32;
309:         self.height = height.max(1) as f32;
310:         self.rects.clear();
311:         self.texts.clear();
312:     }
313: 
314:     pub fn rect(&mut self, x: f32, y: f32, w: f32, h: f32, color: [f32; 4]) {
315:         let x0 = x / self.width * 2.0 - 1.0;
316:         let x1 = (x + w) / self.width * 2.0 - 1.0;
317:         let y0 = 1.0 - y / self.height * 2.0;
318:         let y1 = 1.0 - (y + h) / self.height * 2.0;
319:         for pos in [[x0, y0], [x0, y1], [x1, y1], [x0, y0], [x1, y1], [x1, y0]] {
320:             self.rects.push(RectVertex { pos, color });
321:         }
322:     }
323: 
324:     /// Draws one line; `px` is the on-screen glyph size (16/24/32 keep the
325:     /// pixel grid exact). Returns the pen x after the last glyph.
326:     pub fn text(&mut self, text: &str, x: f32, y_baseline: f32, px: f32, color: [f32; 4]) -> f32 {
327:         let scale = px / RASTER_PX;
328:         let mut pen = x;
329:         for ch in text.chars() {
330:             if ch == ' ' {
331:                 pen += self.space_advance * scale;
332:                 continue;
333:             }
334:             let Some(glyph) = self.glyphs.get(&ch) else {
335:                 pen += self.space_advance * scale;
336:                 continue;
337:             };
338:             let gx = pen + glyph.bearing[0] * scale;
339:             let gy = y_baseline + glyph.bearing[1] * scale;
340:             let gw = glyph.size[0] * scale;
341:             let gh = glyph.size[1] * scale;
342:             let x0 = gx / self.width * 2.0 - 1.0;
343:             let x1 = (gx + gw) / self.width * 2.0 - 1.0;
344:             let y0 = 1.0 - gy / self.height * 2.0;
345:             let y1 = 1.0 - (gy + gh) / self.height * 2.0;
346:             let (u0, v0) = (glyph.uv_min[0], glyph.uv_min[1]);
347:             let (u1, v1) = (glyph.uv_max[0], glyph.uv_max[1]);
348:             let quad = [
349:                 ([x0, y0], [u0, v0]),
350:                 ([x0, y1], [u0, v1]),
351:                 ([x1, y1], [u1, v1]),
352:                 ([x0, y0], [u0, v0]),
353:                 ([x1, y1], [u1, v1]),
354:                 ([x1, y0], [u1, v0]),
355:             ];
356:             for (pos, uv) in quad {
357:                 self.texts.push(TextVertex { pos, uv, color });
358:             }
359:             pen += glyph.advance * scale;
360:         }
361:         pen
362:     }
363: 
364:     /// Measures a line's advance width at `px` without emitting quads.
365:     pub fn measure(&self, text: &str, px: f32) -> f32 {
366:         let scale = px / RASTER_PX;
367:         text.chars()
368:             .map(|ch| match self.glyphs.get(&ch) {
369:                 Some(glyph) => glyph.advance * scale,
370:                 None => self.space_advance * scale,
371:             })
372:             .sum()
373:     }
374: 
375:     pub fn line_height(&self, px: f32) -> f32 {
376:         self.line_height * (px / RASTER_PX)
377:     }
378: 
379:     pub fn draw(
380:         &mut self,
381:         queue: &wgpu::Queue,
382:         encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
383:         target: &wgpu::TextureView,
384:     ) {
385:         self.rects.truncate(RECT_CAPACITY);
386:         self.texts.truncate(TEXT_CAPACITY);
387:         if self.rects.is_empty() && self.texts.is_empty() {
388:             return;
389:         }
390:         if !self.rects.is_empty() {
391:             queue.write_buffer(&self.rect_buffer, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(&self.rects));
392:         }
393:         if !self.texts.is_empty() {
394:             queue.write_buffer(&self.text_buffer, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(&self.texts));
395:         }
396:         let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
397:             label: Some("native.terminal.pass"),
398:             color_attachments: &[Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
399:                 view: target,
400:                 depth_slice: None,
401:                 resolve_target: None,
402:                 ops: wgpu::Operations {
403:                     load: wgpu::LoadOp::Load,
404:                     store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
405:                 },
406:             })],
407:             depth_stencil_attachment: None,
408:             ..Default::default()
409:         });
410:         if !self.rects.is_empty() {
411:             pass.set_pipeline(&self.rect_pipeline);
412:             pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, self.rect_buffer.slice(..));
413:             pass.draw(0..self.rects.len() as u32, 0..1);
414:         }
415:         if !self.texts.is_empty() {
416:             pass.set_pipeline(&self.text_pipeline);
417:             pass.set_bind_group(0, &self.text_bind_group, &[]);
418:             pass.set_vertex_buffer(0, self.text_buffer.slice(..));
419:             pass.draw(0..self.texts.len() as u32, 0..1);
420:         }
421:     }
422: }

424: #[expect(clippy::too_many_arguments, reason = "one-shot pipeline builder")]
425: fn build_pipeline(
426:     device: &wgpu::Device,
427:     format: wgpu::TextureFormat,
428:     shader_source: &str,
429:     vertex_entry: &str,
430:     fragment_entry: &str,
431:     bind_layouts: &[wgpu::BindGroupLayout],
432:     stride: u64,
433:     attributes: &[wgpu::VertexAttribute],
434: ) -> wgpu::RenderPipeline {
435:     let shader = device.create_shader_module(wgpu::ShaderModuleDescriptor {
436:         label: Some("native.terminal.shader"),
437:         source: wgpu::ShaderSource::Wgsl(shader_source.into()),
438:     });
439:     let layout_refs: Vec<Option<&wgpu::BindGroupLayout>> =
440:         bind_layouts.iter().map(Some).collect();
441:     let pipeline_layout = device.create_pipeline_layout(&wgpu::PipelineLayoutDescriptor {
442:         label: Some("native.terminal.pipeline-layout"),
443:         bind_group_layouts: &layout_refs,
444:         immediate_size: 0,
445:     });
446:     device.create_render_pipeline(&wgpu::RenderPipelineDescriptor {
447:         label: Some("native.terminal.pipeline"),
448:         layout: Some(&pipeline_layout),
449:         vertex: wgpu::VertexState {
450:             module: &shader,
451:             entry_point: Some(vertex_entry),
452:             compilation_options: Default::default(),
453:             buffers: &[Some(wgpu::VertexBufferLayout {
454:                 array_stride: stride,
455:                 step_mode: wgpu::VertexStepMode::Vertex,
456:                 attributes,
457:             })],
458:         },
459:         primitive: wgpu::PrimitiveState {
460:             topology: wgpu::PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList,
461:             cull_mode: None,
462:             ..Default::default()
463:         },
464:         depth_stencil: None,
465:         multisample: Default::default(),
466:         fragment: Some(wgpu::FragmentState {
467:             module: &shader,
468:             entry_point: Some(fragment_entry),
469:             compilation_options: Default::default(),
470:             targets: &[Some(wgpu::ColorTargetState {
471:                 format,
472:                 blend: Some(wgpu::BlendState::ALPHA_BLENDING),
473:                 write_mask: wgpu::ColorWrites::ALL,
474:             })],
475:         }),
476:         multiview_mask: None,
477:         cache: None,
478:     })
479: }
````

````rust
162:     pub fn upload_atlas_rows(
163:         &mut self,
164:         queue: &wgpu::Queue,
165:         first_row: u32,

167:     ) -> bool {
168:         let row_words = (ATLAS_TEXELS_PER_ROW * WORDS_PER_NODE) as usize;
169:         if !self.atlas_initialized || texels.is_empty() || texels.len() % row_words != 0 {
170:             return false;

172:         let first_word = first_row as usize * row_words;
173:         let Some(end_word) = first_word.checked_add(texels.len()) else {
174:             return false;

176:         if end_word > self.atlas_word_capacity {
177:             return false;

180:             &self.atlas,
181:             (first_word * size_of::<u32>()) as u64,
182:             bytemuck::cast_slice(texels),
183:         );
184:         true
185:     }
186: 
187:     #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
188:     pub fn draw(
189:         &self,
190:         queue: &wgpu::Queue,
191:         encoder: &mut wgpu::CommandEncoder,
192:         target: &wgpu::TextureView,
193:         frame_resources: &FrameResources,
194:         frame: &FrameParams,
195:         chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
196:         toggles: RenderToggles,
197:     ) {
198:         let chunks: Vec<_> = select_ray_chunks(
199:             chunks,
200:             frame.camera_pos,
201:             self.max_chunks,
202:             toggles.front_to_back,
203:             toggles.distance_cull,
204:             self.runtime_options.maximum_draw_distance,
205:         )
206:         .into_iter()
207:         .map(|(source_index, chunk)| pack_ray_chunk(source_index, chunk))
208:         .collect();
209:         if !chunks.is_empty() {
210:             queue.write_buffer(&self.chunks, 0, bytemuck::cast_slice(&chunks));
211:         }
212:         queue.write_buffer(
213:             &self.scene,
214:             0,
215:             bytemuck::bytes_of(&GpuRayScene::from_policy(
216:                 chunks.len() as u32,
217:                 toggles.empty_space_skip,
218:                 toggles.front_to_back,
219:                 direct_light_visibility_enabled(
220:                     self.runtime_options.direct_light_visibility,
221:                     toggles.shadow_pass,
222:                 ),
223:                 self.runtime_options.area_light_visibility_samples,
224:             )),
225:         );
226: 
227:         let environment = frame.environment;
228:         let clear_linear = if environment.outdoor {
229:             environment.sky_color
230:         } else {
231:             environment.fog_color
232:         };
233:         let clear = encode_display_color(clear_linear);
234:         let color_attachments = [Some(wgpu::RenderPassColorAttachment {
235:             view: target,
236:             resolve_target: None,
237:             depth_slice: None,
238:             ops: wgpu::Operations {
239:                 load: wgpu::LoadOp::Clear(wgpu::Color {
240:                     r: clear[0] as f64,
241:                     g: clear[1] as f64,
242:                     b: clear[2] as f64,
243:                     a: 1.0,
244:                 }),
245:                 store: wgpu::StoreOp::Store,
246:             },
247:         })];
248:         let mut pass = encoder.begin_render_pass(&wgpu::RenderPassDescriptor {
249:             label: Some("webgpu.raymarch.pass"),
250:             color_attachments: &color_attachments,
251:             ..Default::default()
252:         });
253:         pass.set_pipeline(&self.pipeline);
254:         pass.set_bind_group(0, frame_resources.bind_group(), &[]);
255:         pass.set_bind_group(1, &self.bind_group, &[]);
256:         pass.draw(0..3, 0..1);
257:     }
258: }

260: const fn direct_light_visibility_enabled(profile_capability: bool, rt_shadows: bool) -> bool {
261:     profile_capability && rt_shadows
262: }
263: 
264: /// Selects the bounded resident set before packing it for the GPU. Disabled
265: /// policy preserves exact source order; enabled policy uses stable distance
266: /// to each complete chunk cube, so a large cube containing the camera wins
267: /// over a smaller cube whose origin merely happens to be nearby.
268: fn select_ray_chunks(
269:     chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
270:     camera_position: [f32; 3],
271:     maximum: usize,
272:     front_to_back: bool,
273:     distance_cull: bool,
274:     maximum_draw_distance: f32,
275: ) -> Vec<(usize, &ChunkDraw)> {
276:     let mut selected: Vec<_> = chunks.iter().enumerate().collect();
277:     if distance_cull {
278:         let maximum_distance_squared = maximum_draw_distance * maximum_draw_distance;
279:         selected.retain(|(_, chunk)| {
280:             let distance_squared = distance_squared_to_chunk(camera_position, chunk);
281:             distance_squared.is_finite()
282:                 && (maximum_distance_squared.is_infinite()
283:                     || distance_squared <= maximum_distance_squared)
284:         });
285:     }
286:     if front_to_back {
287:         selected.sort_by(|(left_index, left), (right_index, right)| {
288:             distance_squared_to_chunk(camera_position, left)
289:                 .total_cmp(&distance_squared_to_chunk(camera_position, right))
290:                 .then_with(|| left_index.cmp(right_index))
291:         });
292:     }
293:     selected.truncate(maximum);
294:     selected
295: }
296: 
297: fn distance_squared_to_chunk(camera_position: [f32; 3], chunk: &ChunkDraw) -> f32 {
298:     if camera_position.iter().any(|value| !value.is_finite())
299:         || chunk.origin.iter().any(|value| !value.is_finite())
300:         || !chunk.world_size.is_finite()
301:         || chunk.world_size <= 0.0
302:     {
303:         return f32::INFINITY;
304:     }
305: 
306:     let mut distance_squared = 0.0;
307:     for axis in 0..3 {
308:         let minimum = chunk.origin[axis];
309:         let maximum = minimum + chunk.world_size;
310:         if !maximum.is_finite() {
311:             return f32::INFINITY;
312:         }
313:         let delta = if camera_position[axis] < minimum {
314:             minimum - camera_position[axis]
315:         } else if camera_position[axis] > maximum {
316:             camera_position[axis] - maximum
317:         } else {
318:             0.0
319:         };
320:         distance_squared += delta * delta;
321:     }
322:     if distance_squared.is_finite() {
323:         distance_squared
324:     } else {
325:         f32::INFINITY
326:     }
327: }
328: 
329: fn pack_ray_chunk(source_index: usize, chunk: &ChunkDraw) -> GpuRayChunk {
330:     GpuRayChunk {
331:         origin_world_size: [
332:             chunk.origin[0],
333:             chunk.origin[1],
334:             chunk.origin[2],
335:             chunk.world_size,
336:         ],
337:         voxel_depth: [chunk.voxel_size, f32::from(chunk.svo_depth), 0.0, 0.0],
338:         // Keep the stable source ordinal so reordering cannot change which
339:         // overlapping chunk wins an exactly equal-distance hit.
340:         indices: [
341:             chunk.root_index.max(0) as u32,
342:             source_index.min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32,
343:             0,
344:             0,
345:         ],
346:     }
347: }

352:         entries: &[
353:             wgpu::BindGroupLayoutEntry {
354:                 binding: 0,
355:                 visibility: wgpu::ShaderStages::FRAGMENT,
356:                 ty: wgpu::BindingType::Buffer {

358:                     has_dynamic_offset: false,

368:                     has_dynamic_offset: false,

370:                 },
````

````wgsl
 72: fn safe_inverse(direction: f32) -> f32 {
 73:     if abs(direction) < 1e-20 {
 74:         return select(TRACE_INFINITY, -TRACE_INFINITY, direction < 0.0);
 75:     }
 76:     return 1.0 / direction;
````
