````wgsl
 91: fn box_intersection(
 92:     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
 93:     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
 94:     bounds_min: vec3<f32>,
 95:     bounds_max: vec3<f32>,
 96: ) -> BoxHit {
 97:     if (abs(ray_direction.x) < 1e-20 && (ray_origin.x < bounds_min.x || ray_origin.x > bounds_max.x))
 98:         || (abs(ray_direction.y) < 1e-20 && (ray_origin.y < bounds_min.y || ray_origin.y > bounds_max.y))
 99:         || (abs(ray_direction.z) < 1e-20 && (ray_origin.z < bounds_min.z || ray_origin.z > bounds_max.z)) {
100:         return BoxHit(false, 0.0, 0.0, vec3<f32>(0.0));
101:     }
102:     let inverse = vec3<f32>(
103:         safe_inverse(ray_direction.x),
104:         safe_inverse(ray_direction.y),
105:         safe_inverse(ray_direction.z)
106:     );
107:     var near_times = min((bounds_min - ray_origin) * inverse, (bounds_max - ray_origin) * inverse);
108:     var far_times = max((bounds_min - ray_origin) * inverse, (bounds_max - ray_origin) * inverse);
109:     if abs(ray_direction.x) < 1e-20 { near_times.x = -1e30; far_times.x = 1e30; }
110:     if abs(ray_direction.y) < 1e-20 { near_times.y = -1e30; far_times.y = 1e30; }
111:     if abs(ray_direction.z) < 1e-20 { near_times.z = -1e30; far_times.z = 1e30; }
112:     let entry = max(near_times.x, max(near_times.y, near_times.z));
113:     let exit = min(far_times.x, min(far_times.y, far_times.z));
114:     if entry > exit || exit < 0.0 {
115:         return BoxHit(false, entry, exit, vec3<f32>(0.0));
116:     }
117:     var normal = vec3<f32>(0.0);
118:     if entry <= 0.0 {
119:         let absolute = abs(ray_direction);
120:         if absolute.x >= absolute.y && absolute.x >= absolute.z {
121:             normal = vec3<f32>(-sign(ray_direction.x), 0.0, 0.0);
122:         } else if absolute.y >= absolute.z {
123:             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, -sign(ray_direction.y), 0.0);
124:         } else {
125:             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -sign(ray_direction.z));
126:         }
127:     } else if near_times.x >= near_times.y && near_times.x >= near_times.z {
128:         normal = vec3<f32>(select(1.0, -1.0, ray_direction.x > 0.0), 0.0, 0.0);
129:     } else if near_times.y >= near_times.z {
130:         normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, select(1.0, -1.0, ray_direction.y > 0.0), 0.0);
131:     } else {
132:         normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, select(1.0, -1.0, ray_direction.z > 0.0));
133:     }
134:     return BoxHit(true, max(entry, 0.0), exit, normal);
135: }
136: 
137: fn lookup_leaf(point: vec3<f32>, chunk: RayChunk) -> VoxelLeaf {
138:     var node_index = chunk.indices.x;
139:     var bounds_min = vec3<f32>(0.0);
140:     var bounds_max = vec3<f32>(chunk.origin_world_size.w);
141:     let depth = u32(chunk.voxel_depth.y);
142:     for (var level = 0u; level <= 10u; level += 1u) {
143:         let word = node_index * 4u;
144:         let node_type = atlas_words[word];
145:         let payload = atlas_words[word + 1u];
146:         let color_or_mask = atlas_words[word + 2u];
147:         let light_word = atlas_words[word + 3u];
148:         if node_type == 1u || level >= depth {
149:             return VoxelLeaf(payload, color_or_mask, light_word, bounds_min, bounds_max);
150:         }
151:         let center = (bounds_min + bounds_max) * 0.5;
152:         let child_x = select(0u, 1u, point.x >= center.x);
153:         let child_y = select(0u, 1u, point.y >= center.y);
154:         let child_z = select(0u, 1u, point.z >= center.z);
155:         let child = (child_z << 2u) | (child_y << 1u) | child_x;
156:         let child_min = vec3<f32>(
157:             select(bounds_min.x, center.x, child_x == 1u),
158:             select(bounds_min.y, center.y, child_y == 1u),
159:             select(bounds_min.z, center.z, child_z == 1u)
160:         );
161:         let child_max = vec3<f32>(
162:             select(center.x, bounds_max.x, child_x == 1u),
163:             select(center.y, bounds_max.y, child_y == 1u),
164:             select(center.z, bounds_max.z, child_z == 1u)
165:         );
166:         if (color_or_mask & (1u << child)) == 0u {
167:             return VoxelLeaf(0u, 0u, 0u, child_min, child_max);
168:         }
169:         node_index = payload + child;
170:         bounds_min = child_min;
171:         bounds_max = child_max;
172:     }
173:     return VoxelLeaf(0u, 0u, 0u, bounds_min, bounds_max);
174: }
175: 
176: fn next_leaf_exit(
177:     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
178:     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
179:     bounds_min: vec3<f32>,
180:     bounds_max: vec3<f32>,
181: ) -> vec4<f32> {
182:     var times = vec3<f32>(TRACE_INFINITY);
183:     if abs(ray_direction.x) >= 1e-20 {
184:         times.x = (select(bounds_min.x, bounds_max.x, ray_direction.x > 0.0) - ray_origin.x) / ray_direction.x;
185:     }
186:     if abs(ray_direction.y) >= 1e-20 {
187:         times.y = (select(bounds_min.y, bounds_max.y, ray_direction.y > 0.0) - ray_origin.y) / ray_direction.y;
188:     }
189:     if abs(ray_direction.z) >= 1e-20 {
190:         times.z = (select(bounds_min.z, bounds_max.z, ray_direction.z > 0.0) - ray_origin.z) / ray_direction.z;
191:     }
192:     let nearest = min(times.x, min(times.y, times.z));
193:     let tolerance = distance_tie_tolerance(nearest);
194:     // Match finest-DDA X/Y/Z precedence for mathematically tied exits. The
195:     // traversal bias is intentionally not reused as an equality tolerance.
196:     if abs(times.x - nearest) <= tolerance {
197:         return vec4<f32>(nearest, -sign(ray_direction.x), 0.0, 0.0);
198:     }
199:     if abs(times.y - nearest) <= tolerance {
200:         return vec4<f32>(nearest, 0.0, -sign(ray_direction.y), 0.0);
201:     }
202:     return vec4<f32>(nearest, 0.0, 0.0, -sign(ray_direction.z));
203: }
204: 
205: fn trace_chunk_dda(
206:     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
207:     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
208:     chunk: RayChunk,
209:     interval: BoxHit,
210: ) -> VoxelHit {
211:     let voxel_size = chunk.voxel_depth.x;
212:     let bias = traversal_sample_bias(voxel_size);
213:     var distance = interval.entry;
214:     var normal = interval.normal;
215:     var sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
216:     var cell = floor(sample / voxel_size);
217:     let direction_step = sign(ray_direction);
218:     let budget = clamp(frame.render_options.w, 1u, 4096u);
219:     for (var step = 0u; step < 4096u; step += 1u) {
220:         if step >= budget || distance > interval.exit {
221:             break;
222:         }
223:         sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
224:         let leaf = lookup_leaf(sample, chunk);
225:         if leaf.material != 0u {
226:             return VoxelHit(
227:                 true,
228:                 distance,
229:                 normal,
230:                 leaf.material,
231:                 leaf.color,
232:                 leaf.light_word,
233:                 voxel_size
234:             );
235:         }
236: 
237:         let next_boundary = (cell + max(direction_step, vec3<f32>(0.0))) * voxel_size;
238:         var next_times = vec3<f32>(TRACE_INFINITY);
239:         if abs(ray_direction.x) >= 1e-20 { next_times.x = (next_boundary.x - ray_origin.x) / ray_direction.x; }
240:         if abs(ray_direction.y) >= 1e-20 { next_times.y = (next_boundary.y - ray_origin.y) / ray_direction.y; }
241:         if abs(ray_direction.z) >= 1e-20 { next_times.z = (next_boundary.z - ray_origin.z) / ray_direction.z; }
242:         let next_distance = min(next_times.x, min(next_times.y, next_times.z));
243:         if next_distance > interval.exit { break; }
244:         let tolerance = distance_tie_tolerance(next_distance);
245:         let cross_x = abs(next_times.x - next_distance) <= tolerance;
246:         let cross_y = abs(next_times.y - next_distance) <= tolerance;
247:         let cross_z = abs(next_times.z - next_distance) <= tolerance;
248:         if cross_x { cell.x += direction_step.x; }
249:         if cross_y { cell.y += direction_step.y; }
250:         if cross_z { cell.z += direction_step.z; }
251:         if cross_x {
252:             normal = vec3<f32>(-direction_step.x, 0.0, 0.0);
253:         } else if cross_y {
254:             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, -direction_step.y, 0.0);
255:         } else {
256:             normal = vec3<f32>(0.0, 0.0, -direction_step.z);
257:         }
258:         distance = next_distance;
259:     }
260:     return VoxelHit(false, 0.0, vec3<f32>(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u, 0.0);
261: }
262: 
263: fn trace_chunk_skipping_empty_leaves(
264:     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
265:     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
266:     chunk: RayChunk,
267:     interval: BoxHit,
268: ) -> VoxelHit {
269:     let voxel_size = chunk.voxel_depth.x;
270:     let bias = traversal_sample_bias(voxel_size);
271:     var distance = interval.entry;
272:     var normal = interval.normal;
273:     var refinement_entry = interval.entry;
274:     var refinement_entry_normal = interval.normal;
275:     let budget = clamp(frame.render_options.w, 1u, 4096u);
276: 
277:     for (var step = 0u; step < 4096u; step += 1u) {
278:         if step >= budget || distance > interval.exit {
279:             break;
280:         }
281:         let sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
282:         let leaf = lookup_leaf(sample, chunk);
283:         if leaf.material != 0u {
284:             // The coarse walk proves emptiness only. Re-run the canonical
285:             // finest-cell DDA over the final short interval so skip on/off
286:             // returns one distance, material, and normal contract.
287:             let refinement_interval = BoxHit(
288:                 true,
289:                 refinement_entry,
290:                 interval.exit,
291:                 refinement_entry_normal
292:             );
293:             return trace_chunk_dda(
294:                 ray_origin,
295:                 ray_direction,
296:                 chunk,
297:                 refinement_interval
298:             );
299:         }
300: 
301:         let exit = next_leaf_exit(
302:             ray_origin,
303:             ray_direction,
304:             leaf.bounds_min,
305:             leaf.bounds_max
306:         );
307:         var next_distance = exit.x;
308:         if next_distance <= distance + bias * 0.25 {
309:             next_distance = distance + bias;
310:         }
311:         // A normalized ray travels at most one finest voxel per axis over
312:         // this retained interval, which is enough for DDA to reconstruct all
313:         // potentially competing boundary crossings.
314:         refinement_entry = max(distance, next_distance - voxel_size);
315:         refinement_entry_normal = normal;
316:         distance = next_distance;
317:         normal = exit.yzw;
318:     }
319:     return VoxelHit(false, 0.0, vec3<f32>(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u, 0.0);
320: }
321: 
322: fn trace_chunk(
323:     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
324:     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
325:     chunk: RayChunk,
326:     interval: BoxHit,
327: ) -> VoxelHit {
328:     if ray_policy_enabled(RAY_POLICY_EMPTY_SPACE_SKIP) {
329:         return trace_chunk_skipping_empty_leaves(
330:             ray_origin,
331:             ray_direction,
332:             chunk,
333:             interval
334:         );
335:     }
336:     return trace_chunk_dda(ray_origin, ray_direction, chunk, interval);
337: }
338: 
339: fn direct_visibility_bias(voxel_size: f32) -> f32 {
340:     return max(voxel_size * 1e-3, 1e-5);
341: }
342: 
343: // Secondary visibility has its own hard budget. It deliberately does not
344: // consult the primary-ray trace budget or empty-space policy toggle.
345: fn trace_visibility_chunk_dda(
346:     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
347:     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
348:     chunk: RayChunk,
349:     interval: BoxHit,
350:     step_budget: u32,
351: ) -> VisibilityTrace {
352:     let voxel_size = chunk.voxel_depth.x;
353:     let bias = traversal_sample_bias(voxel_size);
354:     var distance = interval.entry;
355:     var sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
356:     var cell = floor(sample / voxel_size);
357:     let direction_step = sign(ray_direction);
358:     var steps = 0u;
359: 
360:     for (var iteration = 0u; iteration < DIRECT_VISIBILITY_TRACE_BUDGET; iteration += 1u) {
361:         if distance > interval.exit {
362:             return VisibilityTrace(false, steps);
363:         }
364:         if steps >= step_budget {
365:             // Exhaustion is conservatively opaque, avoiding a light leak.
366:             return VisibilityTrace(true, steps);
367:         }
368:         steps += 1u;
369:         sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
370:         let leaf = lookup_leaf(sample, chunk);
371:         if leaf.material != 0u {
372:             return VisibilityTrace(true, steps);
373:         }
374: 
375:         let next_boundary = (cell + max(direction_step, vec3<f32>(0.0))) * voxel_size;
376:         var next_times = vec3<f32>(TRACE_INFINITY);
377:         if abs(ray_direction.x) >= 1e-20 { next_times.x = (next_boundary.x - ray_origin.x) / ray_direction.x; }
378:         if abs(ray_direction.y) >= 1e-20 { next_times.y = (next_boundary.y - ray_origin.y) / ray_direction.y; }
379:         if abs(ray_direction.z) >= 1e-20 { next_times.z = (next_boundary.z - ray_origin.z) / ray_direction.z; }
380:         let next_distance = min(next_times.x, min(next_times.y, next_times.z));
381:         if next_distance > interval.exit {
382:             return VisibilityTrace(false, steps);
383:         }
384:         let tolerance = distance_tie_tolerance(next_distance);
385:         let cross_x = abs(next_times.x - next_distance) <= tolerance;
386:         let cross_y = abs(next_times.y - next_distance) <= tolerance;
387:         let cross_z = abs(next_times.z - next_distance) <= tolerance;
388:         if cross_x { cell.x += direction_step.x; }
389:         if cross_y { cell.y += direction_step.y; }
390:         if cross_z { cell.z += direction_step.z; }
391:         distance = next_distance;
392:     }
393:     return VisibilityTrace(true, steps);
394: }
395: 
396: // Coarse leaves prove only that an interval is empty. A non-empty leaf is
397: // resolved by the same finest-cell DDA contract as primary traversal, while
398: // both phases share one caller-supplied secondary-ray budget.
399: fn trace_visibility_chunk_skipping_empty_leaves(
400:     ray_origin: vec3<f32>,
401:     ray_direction: vec3<f32>,
402:     chunk: RayChunk,
403:     interval: BoxHit,
404:     step_budget: u32,
405: ) -> VisibilityTrace {
406:     let voxel_size = chunk.voxel_depth.x;
407:     let bias = traversal_sample_bias(voxel_size);
408:     var distance = interval.entry;
409:     var normal = interval.normal;
410:     var refinement_entry = interval.entry;
411:     var refinement_entry_normal = interval.normal;
412:     var steps = 0u;
413: 
414:     for (var iteration = 0u; iteration < DIRECT_VISIBILITY_TRACE_BUDGET; iteration += 1u) {
415:         if distance > interval.exit {
416:             return VisibilityTrace(false, steps);
417:         }
418:         if steps >= step_budget {
419:             return VisibilityTrace(true, steps);
420:         }
421:         steps += 1u;
422:         let sample = ray_origin + ray_direction * min(distance + bias, interval.exit);
423:         let leaf = lookup_leaf(sample, chunk);
424:         if leaf.material != 0u {
425:             let refinement_interval = BoxHit(
426:                 true,
427:                 refinement_entry,
428:                 interval.exit,
429:                 refinement_entry_normal
430:             );
431:             let refined = trace_visibility_chunk_dda(
432:                 ray_origin,
433:                 ray_direction,
434:                 chunk,
435:                 refinement_interval,
436:                 step_budget - steps
437:             );
438:             return VisibilityTrace(refined.blocked, steps + refined.steps);
439:         }
440: 
441:         let exit = next_leaf_exit(
442:             ray_origin,
443:             ray_direction,
444:             leaf.bounds_min,
445:             leaf.bounds_max
446:         );
447:         var next_distance = exit.x;
448:         if next_distance <= distance + bias * 0.25 {
449:             next_distance = distance + bias;
450:         }
451:         refinement_entry = max(distance, next_distance - voxel_size);
452:         refinement_entry_normal = normal;
453:         distance = next_distance;
454:         normal = exit.yzw;
455:     }
456:     return VisibilityTrace(true, steps);
457: }
458: 
459: fn finite_segment_visible(
460:     receiver_world: vec3<f32>,
461:     receiver_normal: vec3<f32>,
462:     receiver_voxel_size: f32,
463:     endpoint_world: vec3<f32>,
464: ) -> bool {
465:     let endpoint_bias = direct_visibility_bias(receiver_voxel_size);
466:     let biased_origin = receiver_world + receiver_normal * endpoint_bias;
467:     let segment = endpoint_world - biased_origin;
468:     let endpoint_distance = length(segment);
469:     if endpoint_distance <= endpoint_bias * 2.0 {
470:         return true;
471:     }
472:     let ray_direction = segment / endpoint_distance;
473:     // Do not classify the light fixture's own endpoint as an occluder.
474:     let maximum_distance = endpoint_distance - endpoint_bias;
475:     var remaining_steps = DIRECT_VISIBILITY_TRACE_BUDGET;
476:     let chunk_count = min(ray_scene.chunk_count, 25u);
477: 
478:     for (var index = 0u; index < chunk_count; index += 1u) {
479:         if remaining_steps == 0u {
480:             return false;
481:         }
482:         let chunk = ray_chunks[index];
483:         let local_origin = biased_origin - chunk.origin_world_size.xyz;
484:         let slab = box_intersection(
485:             local_origin,
486:             ray_direction,
487:             vec3<f32>(0.0),
488:             vec3<f32>(chunk.origin_world_size.w)
489:         );
490:         let finite_exit = min(slab.exit, maximum_distance);
491:         if !slab.hit || finite_exit <= slab.entry {
492:             continue;
493:         }
494:         let interval = BoxHit(true, slab.entry, finite_exit, slab.normal);
495:         let trace = trace_visibility_chunk_skipping_empty_leaves(
496:             local_origin,
497:             ray_direction,
498:             chunk,
499:             interval,
500:             remaining_steps
501:         );
502:         remaining_steps -= min(trace.steps, remaining_steps);
503:         if trace.blocked {
504:             return false;
505:         }
506:     }
507:     return true;
508: }
509: 
510: fn has_positive_rgb(value: vec3<f32>) -> bool {
511:     return max(value.x, max(value.y, value.z)) > 0.0;
512: }
513: 
514: fn rectangle_visibility_sample_count() -> u32 {
515:     return select(1u, 4u, ray_scene._reserved.x == 4u);
516: }
517: 
518: fn evaluate_visible_scene_light(
519:     world: vec3<f32>,
520:     normal: vec3<f32>,
521:     receiver_voxel_size: f32,
522:     light: GpuLight,
523: ) -> vec3<f32> {
524:     let kind = u32(max(light.half_size_kind.z, 0.0) + 0.5);
525:     if kind == LIGHT_POINT {
526:         let endpoint = light.position_radius.xyz;
527:         let unoccluded = point_light_sample_irradiance(world, normal, light, endpoint);
528:         if !has_positive_rgb(unoccluded) {
529:             return vec3<f32>(0.0);
530:         }
531:         if finite_segment_visible(world, normal, receiver_voxel_size, endpoint) {
532:             return unoccluded;
533:         }
534:         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
535:     }
536: 
537:     if rectangle_visibility_sample_count() == 4u {
538:         var visible_integral = 0.0;
539:         for (var sample_index = 0u; sample_index < 4u; sample_index += 1u) {
540:             let endpoint = rectangle_gauss_sample_position(light, sample_index);
541:             let sample_weight = rectangle_light_sample_weight(
542:                 world,
543:                 normal,
544:                 light,
545:                 kind,
546:                 endpoint
547:             );
548:             let sample_irradiance = rectangle_light_irradiance_from_integral(
549:                 light,
550:                 sample_weight
551:             );
552:             if !has_positive_rgb(sample_irradiance) {
553:                 continue;
554:             }
555:             if finite_segment_visible(world, normal, receiver_voxel_size, endpoint) {
556:                 visible_integral += sample_weight;
557:             }
558:         }
559:         return rectangle_light_irradiance_from_integral(light, visible_integral);
560:     }
561: 
562:     // Low quality retains the existing four-point unoccluded quadrature and
563:     // gates its integral with one finite segment to the rectangle center.
564:     let unoccluded = evaluate_rectangle_light(world, normal, light, kind);
565:     if !has_positive_rgb(unoccluded) {
566:         return vec3<f32>(0.0);
567:     }
568:     if finite_segment_visible(
569:         world,
570:         normal,
571:         receiver_voxel_size,
572:         light.position_radius.xyz
573:     ) {
574:         return unoccluded;
575:     }
576:     return vec3<f32>(0.0);
577: }
578: 
579: fn raymarch_analytic_direct(
580:     world: vec3<f32>,
581:     normal: vec3<f32>,
582:     receiver_voxel_size: f32,
583: ) -> vec3<f32> {
584:     var analytic_direct = vec3<f32>(0.0);
585:     for (var index = 0u; index < frame.render_options.x; index += 1u) {
586:         let light = lights[index];
587:         if light.half_size_kind.w < 0.5 {
588:             continue;
589:         }
590:         analytic_direct += evaluate_visible_scene_light(
591:             world,
592:             normal,
593:             receiver_voxel_size,
594:             light
595:         );
596:     }
597:     return analytic_direct;
598: }
599: 
600: fn camera_ray(pixel: vec2<f32>) -> vec3<f32> {
601:     let viewport = max(frame.viewport_fov_start.xy, vec2<f32>(1.0));
602:     let normalized = pixel / viewport;
603:     let aspect = viewport.x / viewport.y;
604:     let screen = vec2<f32>(
605:         (normalized.x * 2.0 - 1.0) * aspect,
606:         1.0 - normalized.y * 2.0
607:     ) * frame.viewport_fov_start.z;
608:     return normalize(
609:         frame.camera_forward.xyz
610:         + frame.camera_right.xyz * screen.x
611:         + frame.camera_up.xyz * screen.y
612:     );
613: }
614: 
615: @fragment
616: fn raymarch_fragment(@builtin(position) pixel: vec4<f32>) -> @location(0) vec4<f32> {
617:     let direction = camera_ray(pixel.xy);
618:     var nearest = VoxelHit(false, 1e30, vec3<f32>(0.0), 0u, 0u, 0u, 0.0);
619:     var nearest_source_index = 0xffffffffu;
620:     let chunk_count = min(ray_scene.chunk_count, 25u);
621:     for (var index = 0u; index < chunk_count; index += 1u) {
622:         let chunk = ray_chunks[index];
623:         let local_origin = frame.camera_position.xyz - chunk.origin_world_size.xyz;
624:         let interval = box_intersection(
625:             local_origin,
626:             direction,
627:             vec3<f32>(0.0),
628:             vec3<f32>(chunk.origin_world_size.w)
629:         );
630:         if !interval.hit || interval.entry > nearest.distance { continue; }
631:         // Never search past the closest candidate already found: a hit in
632:         // this chunk beyond nearest.distance could not win the comparison
633:         // below regardless, so there is nothing to gain by tracing that far.
634:         // Mirrors finite_segment_visible's shadow-ray clip to a light's own
635:         // distance (line ~490) — same reasoning, applied to primary rays.
636:         let clipped_interval = BoxHit(
637:             interval.hit,
638:             interval.entry,
639:             min(interval.exit, nearest.distance),
640:             interval.normal
641:         );
642:         let hit = trace_chunk(local_origin, direction, chunk, clipped_interval);
643:         let stable_tie = hit.distance == nearest.distance
644:             && chunk.indices.y < nearest_source_index;
645:         if hit.hit && (hit.distance < nearest.distance || stable_tie) {
646:             nearest = hit;
647:             nearest_source_index = chunk.indices.y;
648:         }
649:     }
650: 
651:     if !nearest.hit {
652:         return vec4<f32>(display_color(frame.sky_color_ambient.xyz), 1.0);
653:     }
654:     let world = frame.camera_position.xyz + direction * nearest.distance;
655:     let albedo = packed_srgb_to_linear(nearest.color);
656:     let emission = authored_emission_strength(nearest.material);
657:     let emits = emission > 0.0 && nearest.normal.y < -0.5;
658:     var radiance = vec3<f32>(0.0);
659:     if emits {
660:         radiance = albedo * emission;
661:     } else if ray_policy_enabled(RAY_POLICY_DIRECT_LIGHT_VISIBILITY) {
662:         let analytic_direct = raymarch_analytic_direct(
663:             world,
664:             nearest.normal,
665:             nearest.voxel_size
666:         );
667:         radiance = surface_radiance_from_analytic_direct(
668:             world,
669:             nearest.normal,
670:             albedo,
671:             0.0,
672:             1.0,
673:             analytic_direct
674:         );
675:     } else {
676:         radiance = surface_radiance(
677:             world,
678:             nearest.normal,
679:             albedo,
680:             0.0,
681:             1.0,
682:             0u,
683:             frame.render_options.x
684:         );
685:     }
686:     return present_radiance(radiance, world, pixel.xy);
687: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/webgpu/browser_context.rs
````rust
  1: //! Browser surface/device ownership. Pipeline modules receive only ordinary
  2: //! `wgpu::Device`, `Queue`, and target views, so native Vulkan tests reuse the
  3: //! production rendering code without a DOM.
  4: 
  5: use std::sync::{
  6:     Arc,
  7:     atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering},
  8: };
  9: 
 10: use wasm_bindgen::JsValue;
 11: use web_sys::HtmlCanvasElement;
 12: 
 13: pub struct BrowserGpuContext {
 14:     _instance: wgpu::Instance,
 15:     surface: wgpu::Surface<'static>,
 16:     pub adapter_info: wgpu::AdapterInfo,
 17:     pub device: wgpu::Device,
 18:     pub queue: wgpu::Queue,
 19:     config: wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration,
 20:     device_lost: Arc<AtomicBool>,
 21: }
 22: 
 23: impl BrowserGpuContext {
 24:     pub async fn new(canvas: &HtmlCanvasElement) -> Result<Self, JsValue> {
 25:         let instance = wgpu::Instance::new(wgpu::InstanceDescriptor {
 26:             backends: wgpu::Backends::BROWSER_WEBGPU,
 27:             ..wgpu::InstanceDescriptor::new_without_display_handle()
 28:         });
 29:         let surface = instance
 30:             .create_surface(wgpu::SurfaceTarget::Canvas(canvas.clone()))
 31:             .map_err(js_error)?;
 32:         // Adapter ladder, mirroring the portable pattern the WebGPU samples
 33:         // use: default options first (mobile browsers can return null for a
 34:         // high-performance request that a plain one satisfies), then the
 35:         // software fallback adapter rather than no engine at all.
 36:         let default_options = wgpu::RequestAdapterOptions {
 37:             power_preference: wgpu::PowerPreference::None,
 38:             compatible_surface: Some(&surface),
 39:             force_fallback_adapter: false,
 40:             apply_limit_buckets: true,
 41:         };
 42:         let adapter = match instance.request_adapter(&default_options).await {
 43:             Ok(adapter) => adapter,
 44:             Err(primary_error) => instance
 45:                 .request_adapter(&wgpu::RequestAdapterOptions {
 46:                     force_fallback_adapter: true,
 47:                     ..default_options
 48:                 })
 49:                 .await
 50:                 .map_err(|fallback_error| {
 51:                     js_error(format!(
 52:                         "no WebGPU adapter: {primary_error}; fallback adapter: {fallback_error}"
 53:                     ))
 54:                 })?,
 55:         };
 56:         let adapter_info = adapter.get_info();
 57:         // Never request more than the adapter reports: desktop-default
 58:         // limits make `requestDevice` reject outright on mobile GPUs. Any
 59:         // pipeline that truly needs more than the clamped budget fails with
 60:         // a specific validation error instead.
 61:         let required_limits =
 62:             wgpu::Limits::default().or_worse_values_from(&adapter.limits());
 63:         let (device, queue) = adapter
 64:             .request_device(&wgpu::DeviceDescriptor {
 65:                 label: Some("vackrooms-webgpu-device"),
 66:                 required_features: wgpu::Features::empty(),
 67:                 required_limits,
 68:                 experimental_features: wgpu::ExperimentalFeatures::disabled(),
 69:                 memory_hints: wgpu::MemoryHints::MemoryUsage,
 70:                 trace: wgpu::Trace::Off,
 71:             })
 72:             .await
 73:             .map_err(js_error)?;
 74:         let device_lost = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
 75:         device.set_device_lost_callback({
 76:             let device_lost = Arc::clone(&device_lost);
 77:             move |reason, message| {
 78:                 device_lost.store(true, Ordering::Release);
 79:                 web_sys::console::error_1(
 80:                     &format!("WebGPU device lost ({reason:?}): {message}").into(),
 81:                 );
 82:             }
 83:         });
 84:         device.on_uncaptured_error(Arc::new(|error| {
 85:             web_sys::console::error_1(&format!("Uncaptured WebGPU error: {error}").into());
 86:         }));
 87: 
 88:         let capabilities = surface.get_capabilities(&adapter);
 89:         let format = capabilities
 90:             .formats
 91:             .iter()
 92:             .copied()
 93:             .find(|format| !format.is_srgb())
 94:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 95:                 JsValue::from_str(
 96:                     "WebGPU surface exposes no linear color format; Vackrooms encodes display color in WGSL",
 97:                 )
 98:             })?;
 99:         let present_mode = capabilities
100:             .present_modes
101:             .iter()
102:             .copied()
103:             .find(|mode| *mode == wgpu::PresentMode::AutoVsync)
104:             .or_else(|| capabilities.present_modes.first().copied())
105:             .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("WebGPU surface exposes no present modes"))?;
106:         let config = wgpu::SurfaceConfiguration {
107:             usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
108:             format,
109:             color_space: wgpu::SurfaceColorSpace::Auto,
110:             width: canvas.width().max(1),
111:             height: canvas.height().max(1),
112:             desired_maximum_frame_latency: 2,
113:             present_mode,
114:             alpha_mode: wgpu::CompositeAlphaMode::Auto,
115:             view_formats: vec![],
116:         };
117:         surface.configure(&device, &config);
118: 
119:         Ok(Self {
120:             _instance: instance,
121:             surface,
122:             adapter_info,
123:             device,
124:             queue,
125:             config,
126:             device_lost,
127:         })
128:     }
129: 
130:     pub fn format(&self) -> wgpu::TextureFormat {
131:         self.config.format
132:     }
133: 
134:     pub fn width(&self) -> u32 {
135:         self.config.width
136:     }
137: 
138:     pub fn height(&self) -> u32 {
139:         self.config.height
140:     }
141: 
142:     pub fn resize(&mut self, width: u32, height: u32) {
143:         let width = width.max(1);
144:         let height = height.max(1);
145:         if width == self.config.width && height == self.config.height {
146:             return;
147:         }
148:         self.config.width = width;
149:         self.config.height = height;
150:         self.surface.configure(&self.device, &self.config);
151:     }
152: 
153:     pub fn current_texture(&self) -> wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture {
154:         self.surface.get_current_texture()
155:     }
156: 
157:     pub fn reconfigure(&self) {
158:         self.surface.configure(&self.device, &self.config);
159:     }
160: 
161:     pub fn is_device_lost(&self) -> bool {
162:         self.device_lost.load(Ordering::Acquire)
163:     }
164: }
165: 
166: fn js_error(error: impl std::fmt::Display) -> JsValue {
167:     JsValue::from_str(&error.to_string())
168: }
````

````rust
 1: //! Browser-owned field-of-view preference, sampled once at the frame boundary.
 2: 
 3: use std::cell::Cell;
 4: 
 5: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 6: use wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen;
 7: 
 8: use crate::application::rendering::DEFAULT_FOV_TAN;
 9: 
10: thread_local! {
11:     static FOV_TAN: Cell<f32> = const { Cell::new(DEFAULT_FOV_TAN) };
12: }
13: 
14: #[cfg_attr(target_arch = "wasm32", wasm_bindgen)]
15: pub fn set_fov(degrees: f32) {
16:     let degrees = if degrees.is_finite() { degrees } else { 75.0 };
17:     FOV_TAN.with(|fov| fov.set((degrees.clamp(40.0, 110.0).to_radians() * 0.5).tan()));
18: }
19: 
20: pub fn fov_tan() -> f32 {
21:     FOV_TAN.with(Cell::get)
22: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/webgpu/renderer.rs
````rust
  1: //! WebGPU renderer facade implementing the application's existing port while
  2: //! the deeper scene-lifecycle port is migrated incrementally.
  3: 
  4: use wasm_bindgen::JsValue;
  5: use web_sys::HtmlCanvasElement;
  6: 
  7: use crate::application::ports::{
  8:     ChunkDraw, FrameParams, RenderArtifactNeeds, RendererPort, SurfaceChunk, SurfaceChunkKey,
  9: };
 10: use crate::drivers::webgpu::browser_context::BrowserGpuContext;
 11: use crate::drivers::webgpu::config::{RendererKind, RendererProfile};
 12: use crate::drivers::webgpu::frame_resources::FrameResources;
 13: use crate::drivers::webgpu::gpu_types::{GpuFrameUniforms, collect_frame_lights};
 14: use crate::drivers::webgpu::pipelines::{
 15:     CpuPresentPipeline, HeroShadowOptions, RaymarchPipeline, RaymarchRuntimeOptions, SplatPipeline,
 16:     SupplyLabelPipeline, SurfacePipeline,
 17: };
 18: 
 19: enum Strategy {
 20:     Surface(SurfacePipeline),
 21:     Splat(SplatPipeline),
 22:     Raymarch(RaymarchPipeline),
 23:     Cpu(CpuPresentPipeline),
 24: }
 25: 
 26: pub struct WebGpuRenderer {
 27:     context: BrowserGpuContext,
 28:     frame_resources: FrameResources,
 29:     strategy: Strategy,
 30:     supply_labels: SupplyLabelPipeline,
 31:     profile: RendererProfile,
 32:     depth_texture: wgpu::Texture,
 33:     depth_view: wgpu::TextureView,
 34: }
 35: 
 36: /// Picks the strategy this adapter can certainly run well when the player
 37: /// has not chosen one. A fallback adapter (`isFallbackAdapter`, surfaced by
 38: /// wgpu as `DeviceType::Cpu`) or a software rasterizer means every
 39: /// GPU-heavy path would grind; the CPU splatter is built for exactly that
 40: /// case and asks the device for nothing but one texture blit per frame.
 41: /// Real GPUs take the default surface strategy.
 42: fn most_compatible_kind(info: &wgpu::AdapterInfo) -> RendererKind {
 43:     let name = info.name.to_ascii_lowercase();
 44:     let software = matches!(info.device_type, wgpu::DeviceType::Cpu)
 45:         || name.contains("swiftshader")
 46:         || name.contains("llvmpipe")
 47:         || name.contains("lavapipe");
 48:     if software {
 49:         RendererKind::Cpu
 50:     } else {
 51:         RendererKind::Surface
 52:     }
 53: }
 54: 
 55: impl WebGpuRenderer {
 56:     /// Composition-root entry: honors an explicit `?renderer=` choice, and
 57:     /// otherwise selects the most compatible strategy for the adapter the
 58:     /// browser actually granted.
 59:     pub async fn new_auto(
 60:         canvas: &HtmlCanvasElement,
 61:         requested: Option<RendererKind>,
 62:         quality: crate::drivers::webgpu::config::GpuQualityProfile,
 63:     ) -> Result<Self, JsValue> {
 64:         let context = BrowserGpuContext::new(canvas).await?;
 65:         let kind = match requested {
 66:             Some(kind) => kind,
 67:             None => {
 68:                 let kind = most_compatible_kind(&context.adapter_info);
 69:                 if kind != RendererKind::Surface {
 70:                     web_sys::console::info_1(
 71:                         &format!(
 72:                             "auto renderer: {} (adapter \"{}\" is a software/fallback device)",
 73:                             kind.label(),
 74:                             context.adapter_info.name
 75:                         )
 76:                         .into(),
 77:                     );
 78:                 }
 79:                 kind
 80:             }
 81:         };
 82:         Self::from_context(context, kind.profile(quality))
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     pub async fn new(
 86:         canvas: &HtmlCanvasElement,
 87:         profile: RendererProfile,
 88:     ) -> Result<Self, JsValue> {
 89:         let context = BrowserGpuContext::new(canvas).await?;
 90:         Self::from_context(context, profile)
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     fn from_context(context: BrowserGpuContext, profile: RendererProfile) -> Result<Self, JsValue> {
 94:         let frame_resources = FrameResources::new(&context.device);
 95:         let strategy = match profile {
 96:             RendererProfile::Surface(settings) => {
 97:                 Strategy::Surface(SurfacePipeline::new_with_shadow_options(
 98:                     &context.device,
 99:                     context.format(),
100:                     frame_resources.layout(),
101:                     settings.common.maximum_draw_distance,
102:                     HeroShadowOptions::new(
103:                         settings.shadow_map,
104:                         settings.optimizations.hero_light_shadow_map,
105:                     ),
106:                 ))
107:             }
108:             RendererProfile::Splat(settings) => {
109:                 Strategy::Splat(SplatPipeline::new_with_shadow_options(
110:                     &context.device,
111:                     context.format(),
112:                     frame_resources.layout(),
113:                     settings.common.maximum_draw_distance,
114:                     settings.face_budget,
115:                     HeroShadowOptions::new(
116:                         settings.shadow_map,
117:                         settings.optimizations.hero_light_shadow_map,
118:                     ),
119:                 ))
120:             }
121:             RendererProfile::Raymarch(settings) => {
122:                 let mut pipeline = RaymarchPipeline::new(
123:                     &context.device,
124:                     context.format(),
125:                     frame_resources.layout(),
126:                     settings.maximum_resident_chunks as usize,
127:                 );
128:                 pipeline.configure(RaymarchRuntimeOptions::new(
129:                     settings.common.maximum_draw_distance,
130:                     settings.optimizations.direct_light_visibility,
131:                     settings.area_light_visibility_samples,
132:                 ));
133:                 Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline)
134:             }
135:             RendererProfile::Cpu(_) => Strategy::Cpu(CpuPresentPipeline::new(
136:                 &context.device,
137:                 context.format(),
138:                 context.width(),
139:                 context.height(),
140:             )),
141:         };
142:         let supply_labels =
143:             SupplyLabelPipeline::new(&context.device, context.format(), frame_resources.layout());
144:         let (depth_texture, depth_view) =
145:             create_depth_target(&context.device, context.width(), context.height());
146:         web_sys::console::info_1(
147:             &format!(
148:                 "WebGPU adapter: {} ({:?})",
149:                 context.adapter_info.name, context.adapter_info.backend
150:             )
151:             .into(),
152:         );
153:         Ok(Self {
154:             context,
155:             frame_resources,
156:             strategy,
157:             supply_labels,
158:             profile,
159:             depth_texture,
160:             depth_view,
161:         })
162:     }
163: 
164:     pub fn kind(&self) -> RendererKind {
165:         self.profile.renderer()
166:     }
167: 
168:     pub fn label(&self) -> &'static str {
169:         self.kind().label()
170:     }
171: 
172:     pub fn resize(&mut self, width: u32, height: u32) {
173:         self.context.resize(width, height);
174:         if let Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) = &mut self.strategy {
175:             pipeline.resize(&self.context.device, width, height);
176:         }
177:         (self.depth_texture, self.depth_view) =
178:             create_depth_target(&self.context.device, width.max(1), height.max(1));
179:     }
180: 
181:     pub fn resolution_factor(&self) -> f64 {
182:         match self.profile.initial_gpu_render_scale() {
183:             Some(scale) => f64::from(scale),
184:             None => crate::get_cpu_settings().canvas_resolution_factor(),
185:         }
186:     }
187: 
188:     fn trace_budget(&self) -> u32 {
189:         match self.profile {
190:             RendererProfile::Raymarch(profile) => profile.maximum_trace_steps,
191:             _ => 1,
192:         }
193:     }
194: 
195:     fn render(&mut self, frame: &FrameParams, chunks: &[ChunkDraw]) {
196:         if self.context.is_device_lost() {
197:             return;
198:         }
199:         let lights = collect_frame_lights(frame);
200:         let toggles = self
201:             .profile
202:             .apply_runtime_toggles(crate::get_render_toggles());
203:         let common = self.profile.common();
204:         let uniforms = GpuFrameUniforms::from_frame(
205:             frame,
206:             self.context.width(),
207:             self.context.height(),
208:             super::camera_state::fov_tan(),
209:             common.maximum_draw_distance,
210:             self.trace_budget(),
211:             lights.len(),
212:             toggles,
213:         );
214:         self.frame_resources.write(
215:             &self.context.device,
216:             &self.context.queue,
217:             &uniforms,
218:             &lights,
219:         );
220: 
221:         let (surface_texture, should_reconfigure) = match self.context.current_texture() {
222:             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Success(texture) => (texture, false),
223:             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Suboptimal(texture) => (texture, true),
224:             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Outdated | wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Lost => {
225:                 self.context.reconfigure();
226:                 match self.context.current_texture() {
227:                     wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Success(texture) => (texture, false),
228:                     wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Suboptimal(texture) => (texture, true),
229:                     _ => return,
230:                 }
231:             }
232:             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Timeout | wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Occluded => return,
233:             wgpu::CurrentSurfaceTexture::Validation => {
234:                 web_sys::console::error_1(&"WebGPU surface validation error".into());
235:                 return;
236:             }
237:         };
238:         let view = surface_texture.texture.create_view(&Default::default());
239:         let mut encoder =
240:             self.context
241:                 .device
242:                 .create_command_encoder(&wgpu::CommandEncoderDescriptor {
243:                     label: Some("vackrooms.webgpu.frame"),
244:                 });
245:         match &mut self.strategy {
246:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.draw(
247:                 &self.context.queue,
248:                 &mut encoder,
249:                 &view,
250:                 &self.depth_view,
251:                 &self.frame_resources,
252:                 frame,
253:                 toggles,
254:                 lights.len().min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32,
255:             ),
256:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.draw(
257:                 &self.context.queue,
258:                 &mut encoder,
259:                 &view,
260:                 &self.depth_view,
261:                 &self.frame_resources,
262:                 frame,
263:                 toggles,
264:                 lights.len().min(u32::MAX as usize) as u32,
265:             ),
266:             Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline) => pipeline.draw(
267:                 &self.context.queue,
268:                 &mut encoder,
269:                 &view,
270:                 &self.frame_resources,
271:                 frame,
272:                 chunks,
273:                 toggles,
274:             ),
275:             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => {
276:                 let mut settings = crate::get_cpu_settings();
277:                 settings.fov_tan = super::camera_state::fov_tan();
278:                 settings.toggles = toggles;
279:                 pipeline.draw(
280:                     &self.context.queue,
281:                     &mut encoder,
282:                     &view,
283:                     frame,
284:                     chunks,
285:                     settings,
286:                 );
287:             }
288:         }
289:         if matches!(&self.strategy, Strategy::Surface(_) | Strategy::Splat(_)) {
290:             self.supply_labels.draw(
291:                 &self.context.queue,
292:                 &mut encoder,
293:                 &view,
294:                 &self.depth_view,
295:                 &self.frame_resources,
296:                 frame,
297:             );
298:         }
299:         self.context.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
300:         self.context.queue.present(surface_texture);
301:         if should_reconfigure {
302:             self.context.reconfigure();
303:         }
304:     }
305: }
306: 
307: impl RendererPort for WebGpuRenderer {
308:     fn artifact_needs(&self) -> RenderArtifactNeeds {
309:         self.profile.artifact_needs()
310:     }
311: 
312:     fn uses_surface_meshes(&self) -> bool {
313:         self.profile.artifact_needs().needs_surface_extraction()
314:     }
315: 
316:     fn upload_surfaces(&mut self, chunks: &[SurfaceChunk<'_>]) {
317:         match &mut self.strategy {
318:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.upload(&self.context.device, chunks),
319:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.upload(&self.context.device, chunks),
320:             _ => {}
321:         }
322:     }
323: 
324:     fn remove_surfaces(&mut self, keys: &[SurfaceChunkKey]) {
325:         match &mut self.strategy {
326:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.remove(keys),
327:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.remove(keys),
328:             _ => {}
329:         }
330:     }
331: 
332:     fn clear_surfaces(&mut self) {
333:         match &mut self.strategy {
334:             Strategy::Surface(pipeline) => pipeline.clear(),
335:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => pipeline.clear(),
336:             _ => {}
337:         }
338:     }
339: 
340:     fn cpu_telemetry_string(&self) -> Option<String> {
341:         match &self.strategy {
342:             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => Some(pipeline.telemetry_string()),
343:             Strategy::Splat(pipeline) => {
344:                 let stats = pipeline.stats();
345:                 Some(format!(
346:                     "WebGPU splat F:{}/-{} C:{} D:{}",
347:                     stats.faces_drawn, stats.faces_dropped, stats.cells_culled, stats.draw_calls
348:                 ))
349:             }
350:             _ => None,
351:         }
352:     }
353: 
354:     fn upload_atlas(&mut self, texels: &[u32]) {
355:         match &mut self.strategy {
356:             Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline) => pipeline.upload_atlas(&self.context.device, texels),
357:             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => pipeline.upload_atlas(texels),
358:             _ => {}
359:         }
360:     }
361: 
362:     fn upload_atlas_rows(&mut self, first_row: u32, texels: &[u32]) -> bool {
363:         match &mut self.strategy {
364:             Strategy::Raymarch(pipeline) => {
365:                 pipeline.upload_atlas_rows(&self.context.queue, first_row, texels)
366:             }
367:             Strategy::Cpu(pipeline) => pipeline.upload_atlas_rows(first_row, texels),
368:             _ => false,
369:         }
370:     }
371: 
372:     fn upload_label_atlas(&mut self, rgba: &[u8], width: u32, height: u32) {
373:         self.supply_labels.upload_atlas(
374:             &self.context.device,
375:             &self.context.queue,
376:             rgba,
377:             width,
378:             height,
379:         );
380:     }
381: 
382:     fn draw(&mut self, frame: &FrameParams, chunks: &[ChunkDraw]) {
383:         self.render(frame, chunks);
384:     }
385: }
386: 
387: fn create_depth_target(
388:     device: &wgpu::Device,
389:     width: u32,
390:     height: u32,
391: ) -> (wgpu::Texture, wgpu::TextureView) {
392:     let texture = device.create_texture(&wgpu::TextureDescriptor {
393:         label: Some("webgpu.main-depth"),
394:         size: wgpu::Extent3d {
395:             width: width.max(1),
396:             height: height.max(1),
397:             depth_or_array_layers: 1,
398:         },
399:         mip_level_count: 1,
400:         sample_count: 1,
401:         dimension: wgpu::TextureDimension::D2,
402:         format: wgpu::TextureFormat::Depth32Float,
403:         usage: wgpu::TextureUsages::RENDER_ATTACHMENT,
404:         view_formats: &[],
405:     });
406:     let view = texture.create_view(&Default::default());
407:     (texture, view)
````

````rust
  1: //! Exact in-flight request bookkeeping for the generation-worker pool.
  2: //!
  3: //! Browser callbacks can arrive after a worker has failed or after the engine
  4: //! has already retried a chunk. This small ledger gives every callback one
  5: //! deterministic operation: finish the exact request it echoes, fail the
  6: //! oldest request after a malformed reply, or drain a failed worker.
  7: 
  8: use std::collections::VecDeque;
  9: 
 10: use crate::application::ports::ChunkRequest;
 11: 
 12: #[derive(Debug)]
 13: struct WorkerRequests {
 14:     accepting_work: bool,
 15:     in_flight: VecDeque<ChunkRequest>,
 16: }
 17: 
 18: /// Per-worker request ownership. Request identity is always checked through
 19: /// [`ChunkRequest::is_same_request`], never by chunk coordinates alone.
 20: #[derive(Debug)]
 21: pub(crate) struct GenerationWorkerRequests {
 22:     workers: Vec<WorkerRequests>,
 23: }
 24: 
 25: impl GenerationWorkerRequests {
 26:     pub(crate) fn new(worker_count: usize) -> Self {
 27:         assert!(
 28:             worker_count > 0,
 29:             "a worker ledger needs at least one worker"
 30:         );
 31:         Self {
 32:             workers: (0..worker_count)
 33:                 .map(|_| WorkerRequests {
 34:                     accepting_work: true,
 35:                     in_flight: VecDeque::new(),
 36:                 })
 37:                 .collect(),
 38:         }
 39:     }
 40: 
 41:     /// Finds the next healthy worker, wrapping once from `start`.
 42:     pub(crate) fn next_accepting(&self, start: usize) -> Option<usize> {
 43:         (0..self.workers.len())
 44:             .map(|offset| (start + offset) % self.workers.len())
 45:             .find(|&index| self.workers[index].accepting_work)
 46:     }
 47: 
 48:     pub(crate) fn assign(&mut self, worker_index: usize, request: ChunkRequest) {
 49:         let worker = &mut self.workers[worker_index];
 50:         debug_assert!(worker.accepting_work);
 51:         worker.in_flight.push_back(request);
 52:     }
 53: 
 54:     /// Retires only the exact request echoed by a well-formed worker reply.
 55:     /// Unknown and stale replies leave all current work untouched.
 56:     pub(crate) fn finish_exact(&mut self, worker_index: usize, echoed: &ChunkRequest) -> bool {
 57:         self.take_exact(worker_index, echoed).is_some()
 58:     }
 59: 
 60:     /// Retires an exact request reported as failed by the worker protocol.
 61:     pub(crate) fn fail_exact(
 62:         &mut self,
 63:         worker_index: usize,
 64:         echoed: &ChunkRequest,
 65:     ) -> Option<ChunkRequest> {
 66:         self.take_exact(worker_index, echoed)
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     /// A worker processes its queue serially, so a malformed response belongs
 70:     /// to its oldest outstanding request even when its envelope cannot be
 71:     /// decoded far enough to recover an id.
 72:     pub(crate) fn fail_oldest(&mut self, worker_index: usize) -> Option<ChunkRequest> {
 73:         self.workers[worker_index].in_flight.pop_front()
 74:     }
 75: 
 76:     /// Stops scheduling to a broken worker and returns all work the engine
 77:     /// must retry. Calling this more than once is harmless.
 78:     pub(crate) fn disable_and_drain(&mut self, worker_index: usize) -> Vec<ChunkRequest> {
 79:         let worker = &mut self.workers[worker_index];
 80:         worker.accepting_work = false;
 81:         worker.in_flight.drain(..).collect()
 82:     }
 83: 
 84:     fn take_exact(&mut self, worker_index: usize, echoed: &ChunkRequest) -> Option<ChunkRequest> {
 85:         let queue = &mut self.workers[worker_index].in_flight;
 86:         let position = queue
 87:             .iter()
 88:             .position(|request| request.is_same_request(echoed))?;
 89:         queue.remove(position)
 90:     }
 91: }
 92: 
 93: #[cfg(test)]
 94: mod tests {
 95:     use super::*;
 96:     use crate::application::ports::RenderArtifactNeeds;
 97:     use vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::RealitySnapshot;
 98: 
 99:     fn request(id: u32, x: f32) -> ChunkRequest {
100:         ChunkRequest {
101:             request_id: id,
102:             origin_x: x,
103:             origin_z: -4.0,
104:             level: 0,
105:             lod: 1,
106:             artifacts: RenderArtifactNeeds::RAYMARCH,
107:             reality: RealitySnapshot::default(),
108:         }
109:     }
110: 
111:     #[test]
112:     fn scheduling_wraps_and_skips_disabled_workers() {
113:         let mut requests = GenerationWorkerRequests::new(3);
114:         assert_eq!(requests.next_accepting(2), Some(2));
115:         requests.disable_and_drain(2);
116:         assert_eq!(requests.next_accepting(2), Some(0));
117:         requests.disable_and_drain(0);
118:         requests.disable_and_drain(1);
119:         assert_eq!(requests.next_accepting(0), None);
120:     }
121:

123:     fn stale_reply_cannot_retire_current_work() {
124:         let mut requests = GenerationWorkerRequests::new(1);
125:         let current = request(8, 12.0);
126:         requests.assign(0, current.clone());
127: 
128:         let mut stale = current.clone();
129:         stale.request_id = 7;
130:         assert!(!requests.finish_exact(0, &stale));
131:         assert!(requests.finish_exact(0, &current));
132:     }

139:         requests.assign(0, first.clone());
140:         requests.assign(0, second.clone());
141:

143:         assert!(requests.finish_exact(0, &second));
144:     }

151:         requests.assign(0, first.clone());
152:         requests.assign(1, second.clone());
153: 
154:         assert_eq!(requests.disable_and_drain(0), vec![first]);
155:         assert_eq!(requests.next_accepting(0), Some(1));
156:         assert!(requests.finish_exact(1, &second));
````

````rust
  1: use wasm_bindgen::prelude::*;
  2: 
  3: const VOXEL_AIR: u8 = 0;
  4: const VOXEL_LIGHT: u8 = 4;
  5: 
  6: #[wasm_bindgen]
  7: pub struct CPURaycaster {
  8:     grid_data: Vec<u8>,
  9:     light_data: Vec<u8>,
 10:     width: usize,
 11:     height: usize,
 12:     depth: usize,
 13:     frame_buffer: Vec<u8>,
 14:     screen_width: usize,
 15:     screen_height: usize,
 16: }
 17: 
 18: #[wasm_bindgen]
 19: impl CPURaycaster {
 20:     #[wasm_bindgen(constructor)]
 21:     pub fn new(screen_width: usize, screen_height: usize) -> Self {
 22:         Self {
 23:             grid_data: Vec::new(),
 24:             light_data: Vec::new(),
 25:             width: 0,
 26:             height: 0,
 27:             depth: 0,
 28:             frame_buffer: vec![255; screen_width * screen_height * 4],
 29:             screen_width,
 30:             screen_height,
 31:         }
 32:     }
 33: 
 34:     pub fn set_grid(
 35:         &mut self,
 36:         width: usize,
 37:         height: usize,
 38:         depth: usize,
 39:         data: &[u8],
 40:         light: &[u8],
 41:     ) {
 42:         self.width = width;
 43:         self.height = height;
 44:         self.depth = depth;
 45:         self.grid_data = data.to_vec();
 46:         self.light_data = light.to_vec();
 47:     }
 48: 
 49:     pub fn get_frame_buffer(&self) -> *const u8 {
 50:         self.frame_buffer.as_ptr()
 51:     }
 52: 
 53:     fn get_voxel(&self, x: isize, y: isize, z: isize) -> u8 {
 54:         if x < 0
 55:             || y < 0
 56:             || z < 0
 57:             || x >= self.width as isize
 58:             || y >= self.height as isize
 59:             || z >= self.depth as isize
 60:         {
 61:             return VOXEL_AIR;
 62:         }
 63:         self.grid_data
 64:             [(y as usize * self.width * self.depth) + (z as usize * self.width) + (x as usize)]
 65:     }
 66: 
 67:     fn get_light(&self, x: isize, y: isize, z: isize) -> u8 {
 68:         if x < 0
 69:             || y < 0
 70:             || z < 0
 71:             || x >= self.width as isize
 72:             || y >= self.height as isize
 73:             || z >= self.depth as isize
 74:         {
 75:             return 0;
 76:         }
 77:         self.light_data
 78:             [(y as usize * self.width * self.depth) + (z as usize * self.width) + (x as usize)]
 79:     }
 80: 
 81:     pub fn render(&mut self, px: f32, py: f32, pz: f32, yaw: f32, pitch: f32, fov_deg: f32) {
 82:         // Clear background to dark fog
 83:         for i in (0..self.frame_buffer.len()).step_by(4) {
 84:             self.frame_buffer[i] = 10; // R
 85:             self.frame_buffer[i + 1] = 10; // G
 86:             self.frame_buffer[i + 2] = 10; // B
 87:             self.frame_buffer[i + 3] = 255; // A
 88:         }
 89: 
 90:         if self.width == 0 {
 91:             return;
 92:         }
 93: 
 94:         let fov_rad = fov_deg * std::f32::consts::PI / 180.0;
 95:         let half_fov = fov_rad / 2.0;
 96: 
 97:         let dir_x = -yaw.sin();
 98:         let dir_z = -yaw.cos();
 99:         let plane_x = yaw.cos() * half_fov.tan();
100:         let plane_z = -yaw.sin() * half_fov.tan();
101: 
102:         for x in 0..self.screen_width {
103:             let camera_x = 2.0 * (x as f32) / (self.screen_width as f32) - 1.0;
104:             let ray_dir_x = dir_x + plane_x * camera_x;
105:             let ray_dir_z = dir_z + plane_z * camera_x;
106: 
107:             let mut map_x = px.floor() as isize;
108:             let mut map_z = pz.floor() as isize;
109: 
110:             let delta_dist_x = if ray_dir_x == 0.0 {
111:                 f32::INFINITY
112:             } else {
113:                 (1.0 / ray_dir_x).abs()
114:             };
115:             let delta_dist_z = if ray_dir_z == 0.0 {
116:                 f32::INFINITY
117:             } else {
118:                 (1.0 / ray_dir_z).abs()
119:             };
120: 
121:             let mut side_dist_x;
122:             let mut side_dist_z;
123:             let step_x: isize;
124:             let step_z: isize;
125: 
126:             if ray_dir_x < 0.0 {
127:                 step_x = -1;
128:                 side_dist_x = (px - map_x as f32) * delta_dist_x;
129:             } else {
130:                 step_x = 1;
131:                 side_dist_x = (map_x as f32 + 1.0 - px) * delta_dist_x;
132:             }
133: 
134:             if ray_dir_z < 0.0 {
135:                 step_z = -1;
136:                 side_dist_z = (pz - map_z as f32) * delta_dist_z;
137:             } else {
138:                 step_z = 1;
139:                 side_dist_z = (map_z as f32 + 1.0 - pz) * delta_dist_z;
140:             }
141: 
142:             let mut hit = 0;
143:             let mut side = 0;
144:             let mut perp_wall_dist = 0.0;
145:             let mut hit_y = 0;
146: 
147:             let map_y = py.floor() as isize;
148:             let max_steps = 200;
149:             let mut steps = 0;
150: 
151:             while hit == 0 && steps < max_steps {
152:                 if side_dist_x < side_dist_z {
153:                     side_dist_x += delta_dist_x;
154:                     map_x += step_x;
155:                     side = 0;
156:                 } else {
157:                     side_dist_z += delta_dist_z;
158:                     map_z += step_z;
159:                     side = 1;
160:                 }
161: 
162:                 let v = self.get_voxel(map_x, map_y, map_z);
163:                 if v != VOXEL_AIR {
164:                     hit = v;
165:                     hit_y = map_y;
166:                 }
167:                 steps += 1;
168:             }
169: 
170:             if hit > 0 {
171:                 if side == 0 {
172:                     perp_wall_dist = side_dist_x - delta_dist_x;
173:                 } else {
174:                     perp_wall_dist = side_dist_z - delta_dist_z;
175:                 }
176: 
177:                 let line_height = (self.screen_height as f32 / perp_wall_dist).abs() as isize;
178:                 let pitch_offset = (pitch * self.screen_height as f32) as isize;
179: 
180:                 let mut draw_start =
181:                     -line_height / 2 + self.screen_height as isize / 2 + pitch_offset;
182:                 let draw_start_clamped = if draw_start < 0 {
183:                     0
184:                 } else {
185:                     draw_start as usize
186:                 };
187:                 let mut draw_end = line_height / 2 + self.screen_height as isize / 2 + pitch_offset;
188:                 if draw_end >= self.screen_height as isize {
189:                     draw_end = self.screen_height as isize - 1;
190:                 }
191:                 let draw_end_clamped = draw_end as usize;
192: 
193:                 let mut r = 200;
194:                 let mut g = 200;
195:                 let mut b = 200;
196: 
197:                 if hit == VOXEL_LIGHT {
198:                     r = 255;
199:                     g = 255;
200:                     b = 200;
201:                 } else if hit == 5 {
202:                     r = 150;
203:                     g = 30;
204:                     b = 30;
205:                 } else if hit == 1 {
206:                     r = 180;
207:                     g = 160;
208:                     b = 100;
209:                 }
210: 
211:                 let light = self.get_light(map_x, hit_y, map_z);
212:                 let light_factor = if hit == VOXEL_LIGHT {
213:                     1.0
214:                 } else {
215:                     light as f32 / 15.0
216:                 };
217:                 let fog_factor = (-perp_wall_dist * 0.05).exp();
218: 
219:                 r = (r as f32 * light_factor * fog_factor) as u8;
220:                 g = (g as f32 * light_factor * fog_factor) as u8;
221:                 b = (b as f32 * light_factor * fog_factor) as u8;
222: 
223:                 if side == 1 && hit != VOXEL_LIGHT {
224:                     r = (r as f32 * 0.7) as u8;
225:                     g = (g as f32 * 0.7) as u8;
226:                     b = (b as f32 * 0.7) as u8;
227:                 }
228: 
229:                 for y in draw_start_clamped..=draw_end_clamped {
230:                     let pixel_idx = (y * self.screen_width + x) * 4;
231:                     self.frame_buffer[pixel_idx] = r;
232:                     self.frame_buffer[pixel_idx + 1] = g;
233:                     self.frame_buffer[pixel_idx + 2] = b;
234:                     self.frame_buffer[pixel_idx + 3] = 255;
235:                 }
236: 
237:                 let floor_fog = (-perp_wall_dist * 0.01).exp(); // less fog on floor to see shape
238:                 for y in (draw_end_clamped + 1)..self.screen_height {
239:                     let pixel_idx = (y * self.screen_width + x) * 4;
240:                     self.frame_buffer[pixel_idx] = (40.0 * floor_fog) as u8;
241:                     self.frame_buffer[pixel_idx + 1] = (40.0 * floor_fog) as u8;
242:                     self.frame_buffer[pixel_idx + 2] = (40.0 * floor_fog) as u8;
243:                     self.frame_buffer[pixel_idx + 3] = 255;
244:                 }
245: 
246:                 for y in 0..draw_start_clamped {
247:                     let pixel_idx = (y * self.screen_width + x) * 4;
248:                     self.frame_buffer[pixel_idx] = (60.0 * floor_fog) as u8;
249:                     self.frame_buffer[pixel_idx + 1] = (55.0 * floor_fog) as u8;
250:                     self.frame_buffer[pixel_idx + 2] = (50.0 * floor_fog) as u8;
251:                     self.frame_buffer[pixel_idx + 3] = 255;
252:                 }
253:             }
254:         }
255:     }
256: }
````

## File: scripts/build-wasm.mjs
````javascript
 1: #!/usr/bin/env node
 2: 
 3: /**
 4:  * Build the browser WebAssembly package without exposing a half-written
 5:  * `static/pkg` directory to the dev server.
 6:  *
 7:  * wasm-pack reads an existing output package before replacing it, and older
 8:  * wasm-pack releases cannot parse the newer `files: [...]` manifest they just
 9:  * generated. A fresh staging directory avoids that version-skew trap. Only a
10:  * successful build is copied over the live browser assets.
11:  */
12: 
13: import { cp, mkdir, mkdtemp, readdir, rename, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
14: import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
15: import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
16: import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
17: import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
18: 
19: import { wasmSourceHash } from './wasm-source-hash.mjs';
20: 
21: const root = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
22: const output = join(root, 'static', 'pkg');
23: const staging = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'vackrooms-wasm-'));
24: await mkdir(dirname(output), { recursive: true });
25: const replacement = await mkdtemp(join(dirname(output), '.pkg-next-'));
26: 
27: function run(command, args) {
28:   return new Promise((resolveRun, rejectRun) => {
29:     const child = spawn(command, args, { cwd: root, stdio: 'inherit' });
30:     child.once('error', rejectRun);
31:     child.once('exit', (code, signal) => {
32:       if (code === 0) resolveRun();
33:       else rejectRun(new Error(`${command} failed (${signal ?? `exit ${code}`})`));
34:     });
35:   });
36: }
37: 
38: try {
39:   await run('wasm-pack', [
40:     'build',
41:     'wasm_frontend',
42:     '--target',
43:     'web',
44:     '--release',
45:     '--out-dir',
46:     staging,
47:   ]);
48: 
49:   await writeFile(join(staging, '.source-sha256'), `${await wasmSourceHash(root)}\n`);
50: 
51:   // wasm-pack emits a `.gitignore` containing `*`, meant for pkg dirs that
52:   // are build output. This repo deliberately tracks static/pkg (including
53:   // the freshness stamp CI verifies), so that file must not survive.
54:   await rm(join(staging, '.gitignore'), { force: true });
55: 
56:   for (const entry of await readdir(staging, { withFileTypes: true })) {
57:     await cp(join(staging, entry.name), join(replacement, entry.name), {
58:       force: true,
59:       recursive: entry.isDirectory(),
60:     });
61:   }
62: 
63:   // Swap one complete package directory for another. This also removes files
64:   // retired by wasm-bindgen instead of leaving stale glue beside the new ABI.
65:   const previous = `${replacement}-previous`;
66:   let hadPrevious = false;
67:   try {
68:     await rename(output, previous);
69:     hadPrevious = true;
70:   } catch (error) {
71:     if (error?.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error;
72:   }
73:   try {
74:     await rename(replacement, output);
75:   } catch (error) {
76:     if (hadPrevious) await rename(previous, output);
77:     throw error;
78:   }
79:   if (hadPrevious) await rm(previous, { force: true, recursive: true });
80: } finally {
81:   await rm(staging, { force: true, recursive: true });
82:   await rm(replacement, { force: true, recursive: true });
83: }
````

````rust
 49: impl PillarLattice {
 50:     /// Variable wallpapered piers, always snapped to the shared 0.4u plan
 51:     /// lattice. Entry regularity comes from placement, not a fixed size.
 52:     pub fn pillar_size(&self, cell_x: i64, cell_z: i64) -> f32 {
 53:         let hash = mix64(
 54:             self.variation_seed
 55:                 ^ (cell_x as u64).wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15)
 56:                 ^ (cell_z as u64).rotate_left(29),
 57:         );
 58:         let steps = (((self.max_side - self.min_side) / 0.4).round() as u64).max(1);
 59:         let step = (hash % (steps + 1)) as f32;
 60:         (self.min_side + 0.4 * step).clamp(self.min_side, self.max_side)
 61:     }
 62: }

168:     }

171:         self.pillar_lattice
172:             .map(|lattice| lattice.pillar_size(cell_x, cell_z))
173:     }
174: 
175:     pub fn pit_hazards_for_bounds(&self, bounds: WorldBounds) -> Vec<PitHazard> {
176:         let Some(lattice) = self.pit_lattice else {
177:             return Vec::new();
178:         };
179:         let corners = [
180:             self.local_coords(bounds.min_x, bounds.min_z),
181:             self.local_coords(bounds.min_x, bounds.max_z),
182:             self.local_coords(bounds.max_x, bounds.min_z),
183:             self.local_coords(bounds.max_x, bounds.max_z),
184:         ];
185:         let min_lx = corners
186:             .iter()
187:             .map(|point| point.0)
188:             .fold(f32::INFINITY, f32::min);
189:         let max_lx = corners
190:             .iter()
191:             .map(|point| point.0)
192:             .fold(f32::NEG_INFINITY, f32::max);
193:         let min_lz = corners
194:             .iter()
195:             .map(|point| point.1)
196:             .fold(f32::INFINITY, f32::min);
197:         let max_lz = corners
198:             .iter()
199:             .map(|point| point.1)
200:             .fold(f32::NEG_INFINITY, f32::max);
201:         let ix0 = ((min_lx - lattice.phase_x) / lattice.spacing_x).floor() as i64 - 1;
202:         let ix1 = ((max_lx - lattice.phase_x) / lattice.spacing_x).ceil() as i64 + 1;
203:         let iz0 = ((min_lz - lattice.phase_z) / lattice.spacing_z).floor() as i64 - 1;
204:         let iz1 = ((max_lz - lattice.phase_z) / lattice.spacing_z).ceil() as i64 + 1;
205: 
206:         let mut hazards = Vec::new();
207:         for iz in iz0..=iz1 {
208:             for ix in ix0..=ix1 {
209:                 let lx = lattice.phase_x + ix as f32 * lattice.spacing_x;
210:                 let lz = lattice.phase_z + iz as f32 * lattice.spacing_z;
211:                 let center = self.world_coords(lx, lz);
212:                 if !self.contains(center.x, center.z)
213:                     || self.boundary_distance(center.x, center.z) < lattice.side
214:                     || !bounds.expanded(lattice.side).contains(center.x, center.z)
215:                 {
216:                     continue;
217:                 }
218:                 // The immutable center lane remains solid and navigable.
219:                 if lz.abs() < self.skeleton_half_width + lattice.side {
220:                     continue;
221:                 }
222:                 // The center between four pits is deterministically clear even
223:                 // when pit side and spacing vary between instances.
224:                 let recovery =
225:                     self.world_coords(lx + lattice.spacing_x * 0.5, lz + lattice.spacing_z * 0.5);
226:                 let id = mix64(self.id ^ (ix as u64).rotate_left(17) ^ (iz as u64).rotate_left(43));
227:                 hazards.push(PitHazard {
228:                     id,
229:                     instance_id: self.id,
230:                     center,
231:                     half_side: lattice.side * 0.5,
232:                     depth: lattice.depth,
233:                     recovery,
234:                 });
235:             }
236:         }
237:         hazards.sort_by_key(|hazard| hazard.id);
238:         hazards.dedup_by_key(|hazard| hazard.id);
239:         hazards
240:     }
241: }
````

````rust
 1: //! Immutable anomaly plans and deterministic encounter-state snapshots.

 3: //! The public surface remains a single `anomaly` namespace for callers, while
 4: //! its internals follow the domain's actual vocabulary:

 6: //! - [`geometry`] owns rectilinear bounds and coordinate transforms;
 7: //! - [`phenomena`] owns immutable anomaly instances and family parameters;
 8: //! - [`traversal`] owns semantic gates and hazards;
 9: //! - [`reality`] owns snapshots, transitions, and RTY v2 transport.
10: //!
11: //! The planner owns instance placement. Stateful geometry remains pure: a
12: //! chunk is sampled from an [`AnomalyInstance`] plus the matching stamp in a
13: //! [`RealitySnapshot`].

25: /// SplitMix64 finalizer shared by stable anomaly identities and fingerprints.
26: /// It stays private to the anomaly aggregate; callers consume only the stable
27: /// domain values produced from it.
28: fn mix64(mut value: u64) -> u64 {
29:     value ^= value >> 30;
30:     value = value.wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
31:     value ^= value >> 27;
32:     value = value.wrapping_mul(0x94D0_49BB_1331_11EB);
33:     value ^ (value >> 31)
34: }
````
