````rust
 1: //! CPU microvoxel splatting renderer — a software implementation of
 2: //! [`crate::application::ports::RendererPort`] selected with `?renderer=cpu`.
 3: //! World rasterization is deterministic software work; the resulting RGBA
 4: //! buffer is presented by the shared WebGPU renderer.
 5: //!
 6: //! Instead of marching a ray per pixel, the CPU path inverts the loop: it
 7: //! walks the SVO front-to-back and *splats* nodes onto a z-buffered
 8: //! framebuffer, sized by their projected footprint. The module is split by
 9: //! responsibility — each file owns exactly one concern:
10: //!
11: //! | module         | concern                                              |
12: //! |----------------|------------------------------------------------------|
13: //! | [`settings`]   | tuning knobs + the shared optimization switchboard   |
14: //! | [`atlas`]      | SVO texel decoding and per-upload MIP filtering      |
15: //! | decode_srgb_albedo | authored color -> linear albedo at upload       |
16: //! | [`raycast`]    | secondary rays (flashlight occlusion, shadow rays)   |
17: //! | [`camera`]     | yaw/pitch basis identical to the GPU shaders         |
18: //! | [`flashlight`] | the spotlight cone — the single spec of its shape    |
19: //! | surface_geometry | exposed faces and material-oriented normals       |
20: //! | [`shading`]    | linear radiometry, analytic fixtures, flares, fog    |
21: //! | [`rasterizer`] | state facade + purpose-named frame and SVO stages    |
22: //!
23: //! This module is platform-free (no web-sys): the WebGPU CPU-present strategy
24: //! only uploads its RGBA buffer. All geometry/shading logic is natively
25: //! unit-tested in [`tests`].
26: 
27: pub mod atlas;
28: pub mod camera;
29: mod decode_srgb_albedo;
30: mod flashlight;
31: pub mod rasterizer;
32: mod raycast;
33: pub mod settings;
34: pub mod shading;
35: pub mod surface_geometry;
36: mod update_atlas_rows;
37: #[cfg(test)]
38: mod tests;
39: 
40: pub use rasterizer::{SoftwareRasterizer, SoftwareRasterizerTelemetry};
41: pub use raycast::{RayHit, trace_svo};
42: pub use settings::{
43:     CpuFlashlightVisibility, CpuQualityPreset, CpuRenderSettings, CpuSettingsLimits, CpuShadowMode,
44: };
````

````rust
  1: //! Derive static direct lights from the emissive surfaces that are actually
  2: //! present in a generated voxel grid.
  3: //!
  4: //! Architectural fixture metadata is useful while planning a scene, but it
  5: //! is not authoritative after voxelization: anomalies, walls, and LOD
  6: //! quantization can remove or reshape a fixture. This adapter therefore reads
  7: //! the same halo grid that is meshed. A direct light exists exactly when a
  8: //! downward-facing emissive surface exists.
  9: 
 10: use vackrooms::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{
 11:     VOXEL_AIR, VOXEL_GLIMMER, VOXEL_LIGHT, VOXEL_RED_LIGHT, VoxelGrid,
 12:     material_color_f32, material_emission_strength,
 13: };
 14: use vackrooms::use_cases::bake_voxel_lighting::DEFAULT_MAX_LIGHT_RANGE_WORLD_UNITS;
 15: 
 16: use crate::application::ports::{LightKind, LightSource, POSITION_FIXED_SCALE};
 17: 
 18: /// The direct-light spectrum comes from the authoritative visible-material
 19: /// palette, decoded to linear RGB. The low-precision voxel bake has its own
 20: /// deliberately coarser 0--15 spectrum and must not leak into this contract.
 21: #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
 22: struct EmissionProfile {
 23:     linear_rgb: [f32; 3],
 24:     /// Linear emitted-radiance scale used by the analytic area-light model.
 25:     /// This deliberately matches `emittedRadiance`/`emittedVoxelRadiance`:
 26:     /// normalizing a 0--15 bake sample to intensity 1 made a physical area
 27:     /// integral roughly an order of magnitude too dark.
 28:     radiance: f32,
 29:     kind: LightKind,
 30: }
 31: 
 32: #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
 33: struct ComponentKey {
 34:     material: u8,
 35:     min_world_fixed: [i64; 3],
 36:     max_world_fixed: [i64; 3],
 37: }
 38: 
 39: #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
 40: struct ComponentBounds {
 41:     material: u8,
 42:     y: usize,
 43:     min_x: usize,
 44:     max_x_exclusive: usize,
 45:     min_z: usize,
 46:     max_z_exclusive: usize,
 47: }
 48: 
 49: /// Collects non-overlapping world-space rectangles that exactly cover every
 50: /// exposed emissive underside owned by the logical chunk interior.
 51: ///
 52: /// Halo cells are deliberately excluded from ownership. Neighboring chunks
 53: /// may both *inspect* those cells for meshing, but only the chunk containing a
 54: /// cell emits its light rectangle. This prevents a boundary panel from being
 55: /// counted twice. A deterministic greedy rectangle cover preserves L-shaped
 56: /// or damaged fixtures without inventing emission over their empty holes.
 57: pub fn collect_emissive_lights(
 58:     halo_grid: &VoxelGrid,
 59:     voxel_size: f32,
 60:     halo_world_origin: [f32; 3],
 61:     lateral_padding: usize,
 62: ) -> Vec<LightSource> {
 63:     if !valid_transform(voxel_size, halo_world_origin)
 64:         || halo_grid.width() <= lateral_padding * 2
 65:         || halo_grid.depth() <= lateral_padding * 2
 66:     {
 67:         return Vec::new();
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     let mut visited = vec![false; halo_grid.width() * halo_grid.height() * halo_grid.depth()];
 71:     let mut keyed_lights = Vec::new();
 72: 
 73:     // Explicit loop order plus a fixed neighbour order keeps component
 74:     // discovery deterministic without depending on a hash collection.
 75:     for y in 1..halo_grid.height() {
 76:         for z in lateral_padding..halo_grid.depth() - lateral_padding {
 77:             for x in lateral_padding..halo_grid.width() - lateral_padding {
 78:                 let index = grid_index(halo_grid, x, y, z);
 79:                 if visited[index] || !is_exposed_underside(halo_grid, x, y, z) {
 80:                     continue;
 81:                 }
 82: 
 83:                 let component =
 84:                     collect_owned_rectangle(halo_grid, x, y, z, lateral_padding, &mut visited);
 85:                 let key = component_key(component, voxel_size, halo_world_origin);
 86:                 keyed_lights.push((
 87:                     key,
 88:                     light_from_component(component, key, voxel_size, halo_world_origin),
 89:                 ));
 90:             }
 91:         }
 92:     }
 93: 
 94:     keyed_lights.sort_unstable_by_key(|(key, _)| *key);
 95:     keyed_lights.dedup_by(|(left, _), (right, _)| left == right);
 96:     keyed_lights.into_iter().map(|(_, light)| light).collect()
 97: }
 98: 
 99: fn valid_transform(voxel_size: f32, origin: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
100:     voxel_size.is_finite() && voxel_size > 0.0 && origin.into_iter().all(f32::is_finite)
101: }
102: 
103: fn is_exposed_underside(grid: &VoxelGrid, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize) -> bool {
104:     emission_profile(grid.get(x, y, z)).is_some() && grid.get(x, y - 1, z) == VOXEL_AIR
105: }
106: 
107: /// Finds the widest first row, then extends only while every cell in that row
108: /// remains the same exposed material. Marking exactly that rectangle makes
109: /// subsequent passes cover any remainder without overlaps or phantom area.
110: fn collect_owned_rectangle(
111:     grid: &VoxelGrid,
112:     start_x: usize,
113:     y: usize,
114:     start_z: usize,
115:     lateral_padding: usize,
116:     visited: &mut [bool],
117: ) -> ComponentBounds {
118:     let material = grid.get(start_x, y, start_z);
119:     let owned_x_end = grid.width() - lateral_padding;
120:     let owned_z_end = grid.depth() - lateral_padding;
121: 
122:     let mut max_x_exclusive = start_x;
123:     while max_x_exclusive < owned_x_end
124:         && rectangle_cell_matches(grid, max_x_exclusive, y, start_z, material, visited)
125:     {
126:         max_x_exclusive += 1;
127:     }
128: 
129:     let mut max_z_exclusive = start_z + 1;
130:     while max_z_exclusive < owned_z_end
131:         && (start_x..max_x_exclusive)
132:             .all(|x| rectangle_cell_matches(grid, x, y, max_z_exclusive, material, visited))
133:     {
134:         max_z_exclusive += 1;
135:     }
136: 
137:     for z in start_z..max_z_exclusive {
138:         for x in start_x..max_x_exclusive {
139:             visited[grid_index(grid, x, y, z)] = true;
140:         }
141:     }
142: 
143:     ComponentBounds {
144:         material,
145:         y,
146:         min_x: start_x,
147:         max_x_exclusive,
148:         min_z: start_z,
149:         max_z_exclusive,
150:     }
151: }
152: 
153: fn rectangle_cell_matches(
154:     grid: &VoxelGrid,
155:     x: usize,
156:     y: usize,
157:     z: usize,
158:     material: u8,
159:     visited: &[bool],
160: ) -> bool {
161:     !visited[grid_index(grid, x, y, z)]
162:         && grid.get(x, y, z) == material
163:         && is_exposed_underside(grid, x, y, z)
164: }
165: 
166: fn grid_index(grid: &VoxelGrid, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize) -> usize {
167:     y * grid.width() * grid.depth() + z * grid.width() + x
168: }
169: 
170: fn component_key(component: ComponentBounds, voxel_size: f32, origin: [f32; 3]) -> ComponentKey {
171:     let min_world = [
172:         origin[0] + component.min_x as f32 * voxel_size,
173:         origin[1] + component.y as f32 * voxel_size,
174:         origin[2] + component.min_z as f32 * voxel_size,
175:     ];
176:     let max_world = [
177:         origin[0] + component.max_x_exclusive as f32 * voxel_size,
178:         min_world[1],
179:         origin[2] + component.max_z_exclusive as f32 * voxel_size,
180:     ];
181:     ComponentKey {
182:         material: component.material,
183:         min_world_fixed: min_world.map(world_to_fixed),
184:         max_world_fixed: max_world.map(world_to_fixed),
185:     }
186: }
187: 
188: fn world_to_fixed(value: f32) -> i64 {
189:     (value * POSITION_FIXED_SCALE).round() as i64
190: }
191: 
192: fn light_from_component(
193:     component: ComponentBounds,
194:     key: ComponentKey,
195:     voxel_size: f32,
196:     origin: [f32; 3],
197: ) -> LightSource {
198:     let width = (component.max_x_exclusive - component.min_x) as f32 * voxel_size;
199:     let depth = (component.max_z_exclusive - component.min_z) as f32 * voxel_size;
200:     let profile = emission_profile(component.material)
201:         .expect("components are seeded only from emissive materials");
202:     let kind = if profile.kind == LightKind::Emergency {
203:         LightKind::Emergency
204:     } else if width > depth * 2.0 || depth > width * 2.0 {
205:         LightKind::Strip
206:     } else {
207:         LightKind::CeilingPanel
208:     };
209: 
210:     let id = stable_id(key);
211:     LightSource {
212:         id,
213:         position: [
214:             origin[0] + (component.min_x + component.max_x_exclusive) as f32 * voxel_size * 0.5,
215:             origin[1] + component.y as f32 * voxel_size,
216:             origin[2] + (component.min_z + component.max_z_exclusive) as f32 * voxel_size * 0.5,
217:         ],
218:         half_size: [width * 0.5, depth * 0.5],
219:         color: profile.linear_rgb,
220:         radius: DEFAULT_MAX_LIGHT_RANGE_WORLD_UNITS,
221:         intensity: profile.radiance,
222:         kind,
223:         flicker_mode: flicker_mode_for(component.material, id),
224:         enabled: true,
225:     }
226: }
227: 
228: /// "The lights buzz and fluctuate severely and randomly at a constant rate."
229: /// A deterministic share of the warm office panels carry a flicker mode the
230: /// application animates CPU-side each frame: most hum steadily, some shimmer
231: /// on a tired ballast, and a few are actively dying. Red pressure fixtures
232: /// and cold glimmers hold perfectly steady — their wrongness is composure.
233: fn flicker_mode_for(material: u8, id: u64) -> u8 {
234:     if material != VOXEL_LIGHT {
235:         return 0;
236:     }
237:     // The id is already an FNV hash of world-space identity; fold it once
238:     // more so the low bits used here are decorrelated from dedup ordering.
239:     let mut h = id ^ (id >> 33);
240:     h = h.wrapping_mul(0xFF51_AFD7_ED55_8CCD);
241:     match (h >> 40) % 100 {
242:         0..=11 => 1, // tired ballast shimmer
243:         12..=15 => 2, // dying tube: hard dropouts
244:         _ => 0,
245:     }
246: }
247: 
248: fn emission_profile(material: u8) -> Option<EmissionProfile> {
249:     let kind = match material {
250:         VOXEL_LIGHT | VOXEL_RED_LIGHT => LightKind::CeilingPanel,
251:         VOXEL_GLIMMER => LightKind::Emergency,
252:         _ => return None,
253:     };
254:     Some(EmissionProfile {
255:         linear_rgb: material_color_f32(material).map(srgb_channel_to_linear),
256:         radiance: material_emission_strength(material)?,
257:         kind,
258:     })
259: }
260: 
261: fn srgb_channel_to_linear(channel: f32) -> f32 {
262:     if channel <= 0.04045 {
263:         channel / 12.92
264:     } else {
265:         ((channel + 0.055) / 1.055).powf(2.4)
266:     }
267: }
268: 
269: /// FNV-1a over the full fixed-point world-space identity. Hash collisions are
270: /// not used for local deduplication (the complete key is), while the compact
271: /// `u64` remains convenient for scene-wide halo deduplication.
272: fn stable_id(key: ComponentKey) -> u64 {
273:     const FNV_OFFSET: u64 = 0xcbf2_9ce4_8422_2325;
274:     const FNV_PRIME: u64 = 0x0000_0100_0000_01b3;
275: 
276:     let mut hash = FNV_OFFSET;
277:     for byte in std::iter::once(key.material).chain(
278:         key.min_world_fixed
279:             .into_iter()
280:             .chain(key.max_world_fixed)
281:             .flat_map(i64::to_le_bytes),
282:     ) {
283:         hash ^= u64::from(byte);
284:         hash = hash.wrapping_mul(FNV_PRIME);
285:     }
286:     hash
287: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/adapters/face_instances.rs
````rust
  1: //! Converts greedy-merged quads into the splat renderer's compact face
  2: //! instances: one error-selected, axis-aligned surface rectangle each.
  3: //!
  4: //! The instances derive from the *same* [`MergedQuad`] list as the indexed
  5: //! mesh, so the splat renderer's visible boundary and the mesh-based shadow
  6: //! caster can never disagree. Two transformations happen on the way:
  7: //!
  8: //! * **Extent capping** — a merged quad longer than [`MAX_FACE_EXTENT_UNITS`]
  9: //!   on either axis is split into pieces, because the splat path lights each
 10: //!   face with one flat sample; one sample across a 10 u wall would smear.
 11: //! * **Cell bucketing** — instances are sorted by [`FACE_CELL_UNITS`] cell so
 12: //!   the driver can draw or cull contiguous ranges with zero per-frame
 13: //!   rebuild work.
 14: //!
 15: //! Like the rest of the adapters layer this is platform-free and natively
 16: //! unit-tested.
 17: 
 18: use vackrooms::adapters::voxel_mapper::{FaceDirection, MergedQuad};
 19: 
 20: use crate::adapters::surface_mesh::material_id;
 21: use crate::application::ports::{
 22:     FACE_INSTANCE_FLAG_EMISSIVE, FaceCellRange, FaceInstanceSet, POSITION_FIXED_SCALE,
 23:     PackedFaceInstance,
 24: };
 25: 
 26: /// Longest face edge in world units before a quad is split. Keeps one flat
 27: /// per-face light/shadow sample honest on large merged planes.
 28: pub const MAX_FACE_EXTENT_UNITS: f32 = 2.5;
 29: /// World size of one culling cell (matches the extent cap so a face never
 30: /// spans more than ~two cells).
 31: pub const FACE_CELL_UNITS: f32 = 2.5;
 32: 
 33: /// Builds the face-instance page for one chunk from its greedy quads.
 34: /// `voxel_scale` is the world size of one voxel cell at this LOD; quad
 35: /// geometry is exact multiples of it.
 36: pub fn build_face_instances(quads: &[MergedQuad], voxel_scale: f32) -> FaceInstanceSet {
 37:     let max_cells = ((MAX_FACE_EXTENT_UNITS / voxel_scale).floor() as u32).max(1);
 38:     let mut instances = Vec::with_capacity(quads.len());
 39:     for quad in quads {
 40:         emit_capped(quad, voxel_scale, max_cells, &mut instances);
 41:     }
 42: 
 43:     // Sort by culling cell so each cell's instances form one contiguous run.
 44:     let cell_of = |inst: &PackedFaceInstance| -> [u8; 3] {
 45:         let mut cell = [0u8; 3];
 46:         for axis in 0..3 {
 47:             let world = inst.position[axis] as f32 / POSITION_FIXED_SCALE;
 48:             cell[axis] = (world / FACE_CELL_UNITS).floor().clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8;
 49:         }
 50:         cell
 51:     };
 52:     instances.sort_by_key(|inst| {
 53:         let c = cell_of(inst);
 54:         (c[0], c[1], c[2])
 55:     });
 56: 
 57:     let mut cells: Vec<FaceCellRange> = Vec::new();
 58:     for (index, inst) in instances.iter().enumerate() {
 59:         let cell = cell_of(inst);
 60:         match cells.last_mut() {
 61:             Some(range) if range.cell == cell => range.count += 1,
 62:             _ => cells.push(FaceCellRange {
 63:                 cell,
 64:                 offset: index as u32,
 65:                 count: 1,
 66:             }),
 67:         }
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     FaceInstanceSet {
 71:         instances,
 72:         cells,
 73:         cell_size: FACE_CELL_UNITS,
 74:     }
 75: }
 76: 
 77: /// Face frame of one quad: the fixed plane coordinate plus the two in-plane
 78: /// axes. U/V axis assignment matches the splat vertex shader (U = X for
 79: /// Y/Z-normal faces, Y for X-normal faces; V = the remaining axis).
 80: struct FaceFrame {
 81:     /// World axis index the face is perpendicular to.
 82:     plane_axis: usize,
 83:     /// Face plane coordinate along `plane_axis`.
 84:     plane: f32,
 85:     u_axis: usize,
 86:     v_axis: usize,
 87:     min_u: f32,
 88:     min_v: f32,
 89:     cells_u: u32,
 90:     cells_v: u32,
 91: }
 92: 
 93: fn face_frame(quad: &MergedQuad, s: f32) -> FaceFrame {
 94:     let cells = |len: f32| ((len / s).round() as u32).max(1);
 95:     match quad.dir {
 96:         // Horizontal faces: `w` spans X, `h` spans Z (see surface_mesh).
 97:         FaceDirection::Up | FaceDirection::Down => FaceFrame {
 98:             plane_axis: 1,
 99:             plane: if quad.dir == FaceDirection::Up {
100:                 quad.y + s
101:             } else {
102:                 quad.y
103:             },
104:             u_axis: 0,
105:             v_axis: 2,
106:             min_u: quad.x,
107:             min_v: quad.z,
108:             cells_u: cells(quad.w),
109:             cells_v: cells(quad.h),
110:         },
111:         // Z-normal faces: `w` spans X, `h` spans Y.
112:         FaceDirection::North | FaceDirection::South => FaceFrame {
113:             plane_axis: 2,
114:             plane: if quad.dir == FaceDirection::South {
115:                 quad.z + s
116:             } else {
117:                 quad.z
118:             },
119:             u_axis: 0,
120:             v_axis: 1,
121:             min_u: quad.x,
122:             min_v: quad.y,
123:             cells_u: cells(quad.w),
124:             cells_v: cells(quad.h),
125:         },
126:         // X-normal faces: `h` spans Y, `w` spans Z.
127:         FaceDirection::East | FaceDirection::West => FaceFrame {
128:             plane_axis: 0,
129:             plane: if quad.dir == FaceDirection::East {
130:                 quad.x + s
131:             } else {
132:                 quad.x
133:             },
134:             u_axis: 1,
135:             v_axis: 2,
136:             min_u: quad.y,
137:             min_v: quad.z,
138:             cells_u: cells(quad.h),
139:             cells_v: cells(quad.w),
140:         },
141:     }
142: }
143: 
144: fn emit_capped(quad: &MergedQuad, s: f32, max_cells: u32, out: &mut Vec<PackedFaceInstance>) {
145:     let frame = face_frame(quad, s);
146:     let material = material_id(quad.v_type);
147:     let flags = if vackrooms::domain::entities::voxel_grid::EMISSIVE_MATERIALS.contains(&material) {
148:         FACE_INSTANCE_FLAG_EMISSIVE
149:     } else {
150:         0
151:     };
152:     let normal_axis = normal_axis(quad.dir);
153: 
154:     let mut u_off = 0;
155:     while u_off < frame.cells_u {
156:         let piece_u = max_cells.min(frame.cells_u - u_off);
157:         let mut v_off = 0;
158:         while v_off < frame.cells_v {
159:             let piece_v = max_cells.min(frame.cells_v - v_off);
160:             let center_u = frame.min_u + (u_off as f32 + piece_u as f32 * 0.5) * s;
161:             let center_v = frame.min_v + (v_off as f32 + piece_v as f32 * 0.5) * s;
162:             let mut position = [0.0f32; 3];
163:             position[frame.plane_axis] = frame.plane;
164:             position[frame.u_axis] = center_u;
165:             position[frame.v_axis] = center_v;
166:             out.push(PackedFaceInstance {
167:                 position: position.map(pack_position),
168:                 extent_u: piece_u.min(u8::MAX as u32) as u8,
169:                 extent_v: piece_v.min(u8::MAX as u32) as u8,
170:                 normal_axis,
171:                 material,
172:                 baked_light: quad.light,
173:                 ao: quad.ao,
174:                 flags,
175:                 reserved: [0; 3],
176:             });
177:             v_off += piece_v;
178:         }
179:         u_off += piece_u;
180:     }
181: }
182: 
183: fn pack_position(value: f32) -> u16 {
184:     (value * POSITION_FIXED_SCALE)
185:         .round()
186:         .clamp(0.0, u16::MAX as f32) as u16
187: }
188: 
189: /// Same encoding as `surface_mesh::normal_axis` / the shaders' `normalForAxis`.
190: fn normal_axis(dir: FaceDirection) -> u8 {
191:     match dir {
192:         FaceDirection::Up => 0,
193:         FaceDirection::Down => 1,
194:         FaceDirection::North => 2,
195:         FaceDirection::South => 3,
196:         FaceDirection::East => 4,
197:         FaceDirection::West => 5,
198:     }
199: }
200: 
201: #[cfg(test)]
202: mod tests {
203:     use super::*;
204:     use vackrooms::adapters::voxel_mapper::VoxelMapper;
205:     use vackrooms::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{VOXEL_WALL, VoxelGrid};
206: 
207:     fn world(pos: u16) -> f32 {
208:         pos as f32 / POSITION_FIXED_SCALE
209:     }
210: 
211:     #[test]
212:     fn isolated_voxel_yields_six_unit_faces_on_their_planes() {
213:         let mut grid = VoxelGrid::new(3, 2, 3);
214:         grid.set(1, 0, 1, VOXEL_WALL);
215:         let quads = VoxelMapper::new(1.0).map_voxel_grid_with_padding(&grid, 1);
216:         let set = build_face_instances(&quads, 1.0);
217: 
218:         assert_eq!(set.instances.len(), 6);
219:         for inst in &set.instances {
220:             assert_eq!((inst.extent_u, inst.extent_v), (1, 1));
221:         }
222:         // The up face sits on the voxel's top plane at its center.
223:         let up = set
224:             .instances
225:             .iter()
226:             .find(|i| i.normal_axis == 0)
227:             .expect("up face");
228:         assert_eq!(world(up.position[1]), 1.0);
229:         assert_eq!(world(up.position[0]), 0.5);
230:         assert_eq!(world(up.position[2]), 0.5);
231:         // The down face sits on y = 0.
232:         let down = set
233:             .instances
234:             .iter()
235:             .find(|i| i.normal_axis == 1)
236:             .expect("down face");
237:         assert_eq!(world(down.position[1]), 0.0);
238:     }
239: 
240:     #[test]
241:     fn extent_cap_splits_large_planes_and_conserves_area() {
242:         // A 30x30 slab with a 1-voxel halo: the mapper merges the 28x28
243:         // interior top/bottom into single quads, which must split.
244:         let mut grid = VoxelGrid::new(30, 1, 30);
245:         for z in 0..30 {
246:             for x in 0..30 {
247:                 grid.set(x, 0, z, VOXEL_WALL);
248:             }
249:         }
250:         let quads = VoxelMapper::new(1.0).map_voxel_grid_with_padding(&grid, 1);
251:         let set = build_face_instances(&quads, 1.0);
252: 
253:         let max_cells = (MAX_FACE_EXTENT_UNITS.floor() as u32).max(1);
254:         let mut area_up = 0u32;
255:         for inst in &set.instances {
256:             assert!(inst.extent_u as u32 <= max_cells);
257:             assert!(inst.extent_v as u32 <= max_cells);
258:             if inst.normal_axis == 0 {
259:                 area_up += inst.extent_u as u32 * inst.extent_v as u32;
260:             }
261:         }
262:         assert_eq!(area_up, 28 * 28, "capping must conserve covered area");
263:     }
264: 
265:     #[test]
266:     fn cell_ranges_partition_instances_exactly() {
267:         let mut grid = VoxelGrid::new(30, 4, 30);
268:         for z in 0..30 {
269:             for x in 0..30 {
270:                 grid.set(x, 0, z, VOXEL_WALL);
271:                 if (x / 7 + z / 5) % 3 == 0 {
272:                     grid.set(x, 1, z, VOXEL_WALL);
273:                 }
274:             }
275:         }
276:         let quads = VoxelMapper::new(0.5).map_voxel_grid_with_padding(&grid, 1);

278: 
279:         let mut covered = 0u32;
280:         for range in &set.cells {

282:             assert!(range.count > 0);
283:             for i in range.offset..range.offset + range.count {
284:                 let inst = &set.instances[i as usize];

287:                     assert_eq!(cell, range.cell[axis]);

297:         // Every quad corner stays covered: total instance area equals total
298:         // quad area (in cells) for every face direction.
299:         let mut grid = VoxelGrid::new(8, 3, 8);
````

````rust
 1: //! Shared WebGL2 infrastructure for every GPU driver.
 2: //!
 3: //! Before this module existed, the three GL drivers each carried private
 4: //! copies of program linking, GPU timer queries, matrix math, shadow-map
 5: //! target setup, and light selection. One definition of each now lives
 6: //! here; the drivers keep only what is genuinely theirs (their resources
 7: //! and their draw order).
 8: //!
 9: //! | module           | concern                                          |
10: //! |------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
11: //! | [`program`]      | context creation, shader compile/link            |
12: //! | [`timer`]        | `EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2` frame timing   |
13: //! | [`math`]         | camera/ortho/look-at matrices                    |
14: //! | [`lights`]       | per-frame light selection + uniform packing      |
15: //! | [`shadow_target`]| depth-only FBO + texture for the hero light      |
16: //! | [`visibility`]   | conservative sphere visibility tests             |
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/gl/program.rs
````rust
 1: //! WebGL2 context creation and shader program linking — the one copy of
 2: //! this plumbing for all drivers.
 3: 
 4: use js_sys::Reflect;
 5: use wasm_bindgen::{JsCast, JsValue};
 6: use web_sys::{HtmlCanvasElement, WebGl2RenderingContext as Gl, WebGlProgram, WebGlShader};
 7: 
 8: /// Options for [`create_context`]. Raster paths want a depth buffer; the
 9: /// fullscreen raymarcher resolves visibility itself, so depth and MSAA
10: /// would be wasted bandwidth on low-spec GPUs.
11: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
12: pub struct ContextOptions {
13:     pub depth: bool,
14: }
15: 
16: /// Creates a WebGL2 context with the engine's standard attributes
17: /// (no antialiasing, opaque, high-performance GPU preference).
18: pub fn create_context(canvas: &HtmlCanvasElement, options: ContextOptions) -> Result<Gl, JsValue> {
19:     let attrs = js_sys::Object::new();
20:     Reflect::set(&attrs, &"antialias".into(), &false.into())?;
21:     Reflect::set(&attrs, &"depth".into(), &options.depth.into())?;
22:     Reflect::set(&attrs, &"stencil".into(), &false.into())?;
23:     Reflect::set(&attrs, &"alpha".into(), &false.into())?;
24:     Reflect::set(
25:         &attrs,
26:         &"powerPreference".into(),
27:         &"high-performance".into(),
28:     )?;
29:     canvas
30:         .get_context_with_context_options("webgl2", &attrs)?
31:         .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("WebGL2 is not supported on this browser"))?
32:         .dyn_into::<Gl>()
33:         .map_err(|_| JsValue::from_str("webgl2 context has an unexpected type"))
34: }
35: 
36: pub fn compile_shader(gl: &Gl, kind: u32, source: &str) -> Result<WebGlShader, JsValue> {
37:     let shader = gl
38:         .create_shader(kind)
39:         .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("failed to create shader object"))?;
40:     gl.shader_source(&shader, source);
41:     gl.compile_shader(&shader);
42:     if gl
43:         .get_shader_parameter(&shader, Gl::COMPILE_STATUS)
44:         .as_bool()
45:         .unwrap_or(false)
46:     {
47:         Ok(shader)
48:     } else {
49:         let log = gl.get_shader_info_log(&shader).unwrap_or_default();
50:         gl.delete_shader(Some(&shader));
51:         Err(JsValue::from_str(&format!("shader compile error: {log}")))
52:     }
53: }
54: 
55: pub fn link_program(gl: &Gl, vertex: &str, fragment: &str) -> Result<WebGlProgram, JsValue> {
56:     let vs = compile_shader(gl, Gl::VERTEX_SHADER, vertex)?;
57:     let fs = compile_shader(gl, Gl::FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragment)?;
58:     let program = gl
59:         .create_program()
60:         .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("failed to create shader program"))?;
61:     gl.attach_shader(&program, &vs);
62:     gl.attach_shader(&program, &fs);
63:     gl.link_program(&program);
64:     if gl
65:         .get_program_parameter(&program, Gl::LINK_STATUS)
66:         .as_bool()
67:         .unwrap_or(false)
68:     {
69:         Ok(program)
70:     } else {
71:         let log = gl.get_program_info_log(&program).unwrap_or_default();
72:         gl.delete_program(Some(&program));
73:         Err(JsValue::from_str(&format!("shader link error: {log}")))
74:     }
75: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/render_world_surfaces/sample_static_irradiance.rs
````rust
 1: //! Sample the baked field in the air cell adjacent to a visible face.
 2: //!
 3: //! Texture texels represent voxel centers. Sampling on the geometric face
 4: //! plane blends the solid receiver with air and was the source of false
 5: //! floor patches. A half-voxel normal offset lands exactly at the adjacent
 6: //! air-cell center for every axis-aligned face.
 7: 
 8: pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
 9: vec3 sampleStaticIrradiance(vec3 worldPosition, vec3 normal) {
10:     if (uBakedLightingEnabled == 0) return vec3(0.0);
11: 
12:     ivec3 dimensions = textureSize(uLightVolume, 0);
13:     if (any(lessThanEqual(dimensions, ivec3(0)))) {
14:         float scalarFallback = clamp(vStaticIndirect * (1.0 / 15.0), 0.0, 1.0);
15:         return vec3(scalarFallback);
16:     }
17: 
18:     vec3 worldExtent = vec3(dimensions) * uVoxelSize;
19:     vec3 adjacentAirCenter = worldPosition + normal * (0.5 * uVoxelSize);
20:     vec3 uvw = (adjacentAirCenter - uLightVolumeOrigin) / worldExtent;
21:     if (any(lessThan(uvw, vec3(0.0))) || any(greaterThan(uvw, vec3(1.0)))) {
22:         return vec3(0.0);
23:     }
24:     return texture(uLightVolume, uvw).rgb;
25: }
26: "#;
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/evaluate_scene_lighting.rs
````rust
  1: //! Direct-light equations shared by the surface and voxel-hit shaders.
  2: //!
  3: //! Rectangular emitters use deterministic 2×2 Gauss quadrature over their
  4: //! physical area. Point lights use the same finite-range inverse-square law
  5: //! without the area integral. This is intentionally compact and diagnosable;
  6: //! shadow visibility is an explicit input owned by the caller.
  7: 
  8: pub const GLSL: &str = r#"
  9: const float PI = 3.14159265358979323846;
 10: const int LIGHT_POINT = 0;
 11: const int LIGHT_CEILING_PANEL = 1;
 12: const int LIGHT_STRIP = 2;
 13: const int LIGHT_EMERGENCY = 3;
 14: 
 15: float finiteRangeInverseSquare(float distanceSquared, float range) {
 16:     if (!(range > 0.0) || !(distanceSquared >= 0.0)) return 0.0;
 17:     float rangeSquared = range * range;
 18:     float normalizedSquared = distanceSquared / rangeSquared;
 19:     float window = max(1.0 - normalizedSquared * normalizedSquared, 0.0);
 20:     return (window * window) / max(distanceSquared, 0.04);
 21: }
 22: 
 23: float receiverCosine(vec3 normal, vec3 surfaceToLight) {
 24:     return max(dot(normal, surfaceToLight), 0.0);
 25: }
 26: 
 27: float emitterCosine(int kind, vec3 surfaceToLight) {
 28:     if (kind == LIGHT_POINT) return 1.0;
 29:     // Rectangular fixtures lie in XZ and point down. `surfaceToLight.y` is
 30:     // positive exactly when the receiver is in their emitting hemisphere.
 31:     return max(surfaceToLight.y, 0.0);
 32: }
 33: 
 34: vec3 evaluatePointLight(
 35:     vec3 surfacePosition,
 36:     vec3 normal,
 37:     vec3 lightPosition,
 38:     vec3 lightColor,
 39:     float range,
 40:     float intensity
 41: ) {
 42:     vec3 delta = lightPosition - surfacePosition;
 43:     float distanceSquared = dot(delta, delta);
 44:     vec3 surfaceToLight = delta * inversesqrt(max(distanceSquared, 1e-8));
 45:     float geometry = receiverCosine(normal, surfaceToLight);
 46:     return max(lightColor, vec3(0.0)) * max(intensity, 0.0)
 47:         * finiteRangeInverseSquare(distanceSquared, range) * geometry;
 48: }
 49: 
 50: vec3 evaluateRectangleLight(
 51:     vec3 surfacePosition,
 52:     vec3 normal,
 53:     vec3 lightPosition,
 54:     vec2 halfSize,
 55:     vec3 lightColor,
 56:     float range,
 57:     float intensity,
 58:     int kind
 59: ) {
 60:     const float GAUSS = 0.5773502691896258;
 61:     vec2 offsets[4] = vec2[](
 62:         vec2(-GAUSS, -GAUSS), vec2(GAUSS, -GAUSS),
 63:         vec2(-GAUSS,  GAUSS), vec2(GAUSS,  GAUSS)
 64:     );
 65:     vec3 integral = vec3(0.0);
 66:     for (int sampleIndex = 0; sampleIndex < 4; ++sampleIndex) {
 67:         vec2 offset = offsets[sampleIndex] * halfSize;
 68:         vec3 samplePosition = lightPosition + vec3(offset.x, 0.0, offset.y);
 69:         vec3 delta = samplePosition - surfacePosition;
 70:         float distanceSquared = dot(delta, delta);
 71:         vec3 surfaceToLight = delta * inversesqrt(max(distanceSquared, 1e-8));
 72:         float geometry = receiverCosine(normal, surfaceToLight)
 73:             * emitterCosine(kind, surfaceToLight);
 74:         integral += finiteRangeInverseSquare(distanceSquared, range) * geometry;
 75:     }
 76:     float area = 4.0 * max(halfSize.x, 0.0) * max(halfSize.y, 0.0);
 77:     if (!(area > 0.0)) return vec3(0.0);
 78:     return max(lightColor, vec3(0.0)) * max(intensity, 0.0)
 79:         * area * (integral * 0.25);
 80: }
 81: 
 82: vec3 evaluateSceneLight(
 83:     vec3 surfacePosition,
 84:     vec3 normal,
 85:     vec3 lightPosition,
 86:     vec2 halfSize,
 87:     vec3 lightColor,
 88:     float range,
 89:     float intensity,
 90:     int kind
 91: ) {
 92:     if (kind == LIGHT_POINT) {
 93:         return evaluatePointLight(
 94:             surfacePosition, normal, lightPosition, lightColor, range, intensity
 95:         );
 96:     }
 97:     return evaluateRectangleLight(
 98:         surfacePosition, normal, lightPosition, halfSize,
 99:         lightColor, range, intensity, kind
100:     );
101: }
102: "#;
````

````rust
 1: use crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::rasterizer::SoftwareRasterizer;

 5: 
 6: /// Stateless composition driver for the production CPU splatter. A fresh
 7: /// rasterizer per render makes repeated reference calls independent of frame
 8: /// counters, shadow caches, and earlier atlas uploads.
 9: pub struct CpuReferenceRenderer;
10: 
11: impl CpuReferenceRenderer {
12:     pub fn new() -> Self {
13:         Self
14:     }
15: }
16: 
17: impl ReferenceRendererPort for CpuReferenceRenderer {
18:     fn render(
19:         &mut self,
20:         scene: &RenderSceneSnapshot,
21:         settings: &ReferenceRenderSettings,
22:     ) -> RenderedImage {
23:         let mut rasterizer =
24:             SoftwareRasterizer::new(settings.width as usize, settings.height as usize);
25:         rasterizer.settings = settings.effective_cpu_settings();
26:         rasterizer.upload_atlas(&scene.atlas);
27:         rasterizer.draw(&settings.frame_params(&scene.scene_lights), &scene.chunks);
28: 
29:         RenderedImage {
30:             width: settings.width,
31:             height: settings.height,
32:             rgba: rasterizer.framebuffer().to_vec(),
33:         }
34:     }
35: }
````

````rust
 20: fn raymarch_pixel(
 21:     cam: &Camera,
 22:     env: &Environment,
 23:     settings: &CpuRenderSettings,
 24:     atlas: &[u32],
 25:     chunks: &[ChunkDraw],
 26:     scene_lights: &[LightSource],
 27:     ro: [f32; 3],
 28:     rd: [f32; 3],
 29: ) -> Option<[u8; 3]> {
 30:     let safe = |v: f32| {
 31:         if v.abs() < 1e-4 {
 32:             1e-4f32.copysign(v)
 33:         } else {
 34:             v
 35:         }
 36:     };
 37:     let rd = [safe(rd[0]), safe(rd[1]), safe(rd[2])];
 38:     let inv = [1.0 / rd[0], 1.0 / rd[1], 1.0 / rd[2]];
 39: 
 40:     let mut hits: Vec<(usize, f32)> = Vec::new();
 41:     for (i, d) in chunks.iter().enumerate() {
 42:         let lro = [
 43:             ro[0] - d.origin[0],
 44:             ro[1] - d.origin[1],
 45:             ro[2] - d.origin[2],
 46:         ];
 47:         let mut t_entry = f32::MIN;
 48:         let mut t_exit = f32::MAX;
 49:         for a in 0..3 {
 50:             let t1 = (0.0 - lro[a]) * inv[a];
 51:             let t2 = (d.world_size - lro[a]) * inv[a];
 52:             t_entry = t_entry.max(t1.min(t2));
 53:             t_exit = t_exit.min(t1.max(t2));
 54:         }
 55:         if t_entry < t_exit && t_exit > 0.0 {
 56:             hits.push((i, t_entry.max(0.0)));
 57:         }
 58:     }
 59:     hits.sort_by(|a, b| a.1.total_cmp(&b.1));
 60: 
 61:     for (i, t_min) in hits {
 62:         let d = &chunks[i];
 63:         let lro = [
 64:             ro[0] - d.origin[0],
 65:             ro[1] - d.origin[1],
 66:             ro[2] - d.origin[2],
 67:         ];
 68:         if let Some((t, bmin, bmax, _vt, hit_leaf_node_idx)) =
 69:             raymarch_svo(atlas, lro, rd, d.root_index as usize, t_min, d.world_size)
 70:         {
 71:             let decoded = decode_node(atlas, hit_leaf_node_idx)?;
 72: 
 73:             let center = [
 74:                 (bmin[0] + bmax[0]) * 0.5 + d.origin[0],
 75:                 (bmin[1] + bmax[1]) * 0.5 + d.origin[1],
 76:                 (bmin[2] + bmax[2]) * 0.5 + d.origin[2],
 77:             ];
 78:             let world_size = bmax[0] - bmin[0];
 79: 
 80:             let surface = SplatSurface {
 81:                 center,
 82:                 world_size,
 83:                 dist: t,
 84:                 base_color: decoded.color,
 85:                 baked_irradiance: decoded.baked_rgb.map(f32::from),
 86:                 voxel_type: decoded.voxel_type,
 87:                 is_emissive: is_emissive(decoded.voxel_type),
 88:                 // The reference raymarcher already reached a real leaf but
 89:                 // does not yet carry its exact hit face through this legacy
 90:                 // tuple. Restricting the normal to the leaf's authored
 91:                 // material plus its possible AABB faces preserves behavior;
 92:                 // production splats pass topology-derived exposure instead.
 93:                 exposure: decoded.exposure,
 94:                 crowded_siblings: 1, // Default/fallback sibling density for raymarcher
 95:             };
 96: 
 97:             let rgb = shade_with_frame_lighting(
 98:                 cam,
 99:                 env,
100:                 settings,
101:                 atlas,
102:                 chunks,
103:                 FrameLighting::unshadowed(scene_lights),
104:                 &surface,
105:             );
106:             return Some(rgb);
107:         }
108:     }
109:     None
110: }
111: 
112: fn raymarch_svo(
113:     atlas: &[u32],
114:     ro: [f32; 3],
115:     rd: [f32; 3],
116:     chunk_root_idx: usize,
117:     t_entry: f32,
118:     world_size: f32,
119: ) -> Option<(f32, [f32; 3], [f32; 3], u32, usize)> {
120:     let mut t = t_entry;
121:     let mut p = [ro[0] + t * rd[0], ro[1] + t * rd[1], ro[2] + t * rd[2]];
122: 
123:     let mut stack: Vec<(usize, [f32; 3], [f32; 3])> = Vec::new();
124:     let mut current_node = chunk_root_idx;
125:     let mut cmin = [0.0f32; 3];
126:     let mut cmax = [world_size; 3];
127: 
128:     for _ in 0..160 {
129:         if current_node * 4 + 2 >= atlas.len() {
130:             return None;
131:         }
132:         let tx = current_node * 4;
133:         let (is_leaf, a, b) = (atlas[tx] == 1, atlas[tx + 1], atlas[tx + 2]);
134: 
135:         if is_leaf {
136:             if a != 0 {
137:                 return Some((t, cmin, cmax, a, current_node));
138:             }
139:             let exit = |lo: f32, hi: f32, o: f32, d: f32| (if d > 0.0 { hi } else { lo } - o) / d;
140:             let tx = exit(cmin[0], cmax[0], ro[0], rd[0]);
141:             let ty = exit(cmin[1], cmax[1], ro[1], rd[1]);
142:             let tz = exit(cmin[2], cmax[2], ro[2], rd[2]);
143:             let t_exit = tx.min(ty).min(tz);
144:             t = t_exit;
145:             p = [ro[0] + t * rd[0], ro[1] + t * rd[1], ro[2] + t * rd[2]];
146:             if (t_exit - tx).abs() < 1e-4 {
147:                 p[0] = (if rd[0] > 0.0 { cmax[0] } else { cmin[0] })
148:                     + (if rd[0] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
149:             }
150:             if (t_exit - ty).abs() < 1e-4 {
151:                 p[1] = (if rd[1] > 0.0 { cmax[1] } else { cmin[1] })
152:                     + (if rd[1] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
153:             }
154:             if (t_exit - tz).abs() < 1e-4 {
155:                 p[2] = (if rd[2] > 0.0 { cmax[2] } else { cmin[2] })
156:                     + (if rd[2] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
157:             }
158:             while outside(p, cmin, cmax) {
159:                 let Some(f) = stack.pop() else { return None };
160:                 current_node = f.0;
161:                 cmin = f.1;
162:                 cmax = f.2;
163:             }
164:         } else {
165:             let center = [
166:                 (cmin[0] + cmax[0]) * 0.5,
167:                 (cmin[1] + cmax[1]) * 0.5,
168:                 (cmin[2] + cmax[2]) * 0.5,
169:             ];
170:             let ox = (p[0] >= center[0]) as usize;
171:             let oy = (p[1] >= center[1]) as usize;
172:             let oz = (p[2] >= center[2]) as usize;
173:             let child_idx = (oz << 2) | (oy << 1) | ox;
174: 
175:             if b & (1 << child_idx) != 0 {
176:                 if stack.len() < 8 {
177:                     stack.push((current_node, cmin, cmax));
178:                 }
179:                 if ox == 1 {
180:                     cmin[0] = center[0]
181:                 } else {
182:                     cmax[0] = center[0]
183:                 }
184:                 if oy == 1 {
185:                     cmin[1] = center[1]
186:                 } else {
187:                     cmax[1] = center[1]
188:                 }
189:                 if oz == 1 {
190:                     cmin[2] = center[2]
191:                 } else {
192:                     cmax[2] = center[2]
193:                 }
194:                 current_node = a as usize + child_idx;
195:             } else {
196:                 let omin = [
197:                     if ox == 1 { center[0] } else { cmin[0] },
198:                     if oy == 1 { center[1] } else { cmin[1] },
199:                     if oz == 1 { center[2] } else { cmin[2] },
200:                 ];
201:                 let omax = [
202:                     if ox == 1 { cmax[0] } else { center[0] },
203:                     if oy == 1 { cmax[1] } else { center[1] },
204:                     if oz == 1 { cmax[2] } else { center[2] },
205:                 ];
206:                 let exit =
207:                     |lo: f32, hi: f32, o: f32, d: f32| (if d > 0.0 { hi } else { lo } - o) / d;
208:                 let tx = exit(omin[0], omax[0], ro[0], rd[0]);
209:                 let ty = exit(omin[1], omax[1], ro[1], rd[1]);
210:                 let tz = exit(omin[2], omax[2], ro[2], rd[2]);
211:                 let t_exit = tx.min(ty).min(tz);
212:                 t = t_exit;
213:                 p = [ro[0] + t * rd[0], ro[1] + t * rd[1], ro[2] + t * rd[2]];
214:                 if (t_exit - tx).abs() < 1e-4 {
215:                     p[0] = (if rd[0] > 0.0 { omax[0] } else { omin[0] })
216:                         + (if rd[0] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
217:                 }
218:                 if (t_exit - ty).abs() < 1e-4 {
219:                     p[1] = (if rd[1] > 0.0 { omax[1] } else { omin[1] })
220:                         + (if rd[1] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
221:                 }
222:                 if (t_exit - tz).abs() < 1e-4 {
223:                     p[2] = (if rd[2] > 0.0 { omax[2] } else { omin[2] })
224:                         + (if rd[2] > 0.0 { 0.001 } else { -0.001 });
225:                 }
226:                 while outside(p, cmin, cmax) {
227:                     let Some(f) = stack.pop() else { return None };
228:                     current_node = f.0;
229:                     cmin = f.1;
230:                     cmax = f.2;
231:                 }
232:             }
233:         }
234:     }
235:     None
236: }
237: 
238: fn outside(p: [f32; 3], min: [f32; 3], max: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
239:     p[0] < min[0]
240:         || p[0] > max[0]
241:         || p[1] < min[1]
242:         || p[1] > max[1]
243:         || p[2] < min[2]
244:         || p[2] > max[2]
245: }
246: 
247: impl ReferenceRendererPort for RaymarchReferenceRenderer {
248:     fn render(
249:         &mut self,
250:         scene: &RenderSceneSnapshot,
251:         settings: &ReferenceRenderSettings,
252:     ) -> RenderedImage {
253:         let mut rgba = vec![0u8; (settings.width * settings.height * 4) as usize];
254:         let frame_params = settings.frame_params(&scene.scene_lights);
255:         let cpu_settings = settings.effective_cpu_settings();
256:         let background_radiance = if settings.environment.outdoor {
257:             settings.environment.sky_color
258:         } else {
259:             settings.environment.fog_color
260:         };
261:         let clear_color = encode_display_color(background_radiance)
262:             .map(|channel| (channel * 255.0).round().clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8);
263: 
264:         let camera = Camera::new(
265:             &frame_params,
266:             settings.width as usize,
267:             settings.height as usize,
268:             &cpu_settings,
269:         );
270: 
271:         for y in 0..settings.height {
272:             for x in 0..settings.width {
273:                 let relative_x = x as f32 - camera.half_w;
274:                 let relative_y = camera.half_h - y as f32;
275: 
276:                 let dir_camera_space = [
277:                     relative_x / camera.focal_px,
278:                     relative_y / camera.focal_px,
279:                     1.0f32,
280:                 ];
281:                 let length = (dir_camera_space[0].powi(2)
282:                     + dir_camera_space[1].powi(2)
283:                     + dir_camera_space[2].powi(2))
284:                 .sqrt();
285:                 let dir_camera_space_normalized = [
286:                     dir_camera_space[0] / length,
287:                     dir_camera_space[1] / length,
288:                     dir_camera_space[2] / length,
289:                 ];
290: 
291:                 let rd = [
292:                     dir_camera_space_normalized[0] * camera.right[0]
293:                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[1] * camera.up[0]
294:                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[2] * camera.forward[0],
295:                     dir_camera_space_normalized[0] * camera.right[1]
296:                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[1] * camera.up[1]
297:                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[2] * camera.forward[1],
298:                     dir_camera_space_normalized[0] * camera.right[2]
299:                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[1] * camera.up[2]
300:                         + dir_camera_space_normalized[2] * camera.forward[2],
301:                 ];
302: 
303:                 let color = raymarch_pixel(
304:                     &camera,
305:                     &settings.environment,
306:                     &cpu_settings,
307:                     &scene.atlas,
308:                     &scene.chunks,
309:                     &scene.scene_lights,
310:                     settings.camera.position,
311:                     rd,
312:                 )
313:                 .unwrap_or(clear_color);
314: 
315:                 let idx = ((y * settings.width + x) * 4) as usize;
316:                 rgba[idx] = color[0];
317:                 rgba[idx + 1] = color[1];
318:                 rgba[idx + 2] = color[2];
319:                 rgba[idx + 3] = 255;
320:             }
321:         }
322: 
323:         RenderedImage {
324:             width: settings.width,
325:             height: settings.height,
326:             rgba,
327:         }
328:     }
329: }
````

````rust
155: fn assert_fixture_geometry(scene: &RoomScene) {
156:     let voxels = scene.voxels();
157:     let mut emissive = Vec::new();
158:     for y in 0..voxels.height() {
159:         for z in 0..voxels.depth() {
160:             for x in 0..voxels.width() {
161:                 if EMISSIVE_MATERIALS.contains(&voxels.get(x, y, z)) {
162:                     emissive.push((x, y, z));
163:                 }
164:             }
165:         }
166:     }
167: 
168:     assert_eq!(emissive.len(), 1, "fixture must contain one emitter");
169:     let (x, y, z) = emissive[0];
170:     assert_eq!(voxels.get(x, y, z), VOXEL_LIGHT);
171:     assert!(y > 0);
172:     assert_eq!(
173:         voxels.get(x, y - 1, z),
174:         VOXEL_AIR,
175:         "panel underside must be exposed to room air"
176:     );
177:     assert_eq!(voxels.get(x - 1, y, z), VOXEL_CEILING);
178:     assert_eq!(voxels.get(x + 1, y, z), VOXEL_CEILING);
179:     assert_eq!(voxels.get(x, y, z - 1), VOXEL_CEILING);
180:     assert_eq!(voxels.get(x, y, z + 1), VOXEL_CEILING);
181: 
182:     for z in 0..voxels.depth() {
183:         for x in 0..voxels.width() {
184:             assert!(
185:                 !EMISSIVE_MATERIALS.contains(&voxels.get(x, 0, z)),
186:                 "floor voxel ({x}, 0, {z}) must not emit"
187:             );
188:         }
189:     }
190: }

192: fn assert_lit_room(renderer: &str, image: &RenderedImage) {
193:     assert_eq!((image.width, image.height), (WIDTH, HEIGHT));
194:     assert_eq!(image.rgba.len(), (WIDTH * HEIGHT * 4) as usize);
195: 
196:     let mut visible_pixels = 0usize;
197:     let mut fixture_pixels = 0usize;
198:     let mut brightest = (0u8, 0usize, [0u8; 3]);
199:     for (index, pixel) in image.rgba.chunks_exact(4).enumerate() {
200:         assert_eq!(pixel[3], 255, "{renderer} produced non-opaque output");
201:         if pixel[..3] != [0, 0, 0] {
202:             visible_pixels += 1;
203:         }
204:         let x = index % image.width as usize;
205:         let y = index / image.width as usize;
206:         let luminance =
207:             ((u16::from(pixel[0]) + u16::from(pixel[1]) + u16::from(pixel[2])) / 3) as u8;
208:         if luminance > brightest.0 {
209:             brightest = (luminance, index, [pixel[0], pixel[1], pixel[2]]);
210:         }
211:         let in_panel_window = x >= image.width as usize / 3
212:             && x <= image.width as usize * 2 / 3
213:             && y < image.height as usize / 3;
214:         if in_panel_window && pixel[0] >= 240 && pixel[1] >= 225 && pixel[2] >= 190 {
215:             fixture_pixels += 1;
216:         }
217:     }
218: 
219:     let pixel_count = (WIDTH * HEIGHT) as usize;
220:     assert!(
221:         visible_pixels > pixel_count / 20,
222:         "{renderer} failed to show the baked-lit room: {visible_pixels}/{pixel_count} visible pixels"
223:     );
224:     assert!(
225:         fixture_pixels > 0,
226:         "{renderer} failed to show the exposed fluorescent panel; brightest={brightest:?}"
227:     );
228: }
````

````rust
24:                 VoxelType::Ceiling => "\"ceiling\"",
25:                 VoxelType::Light => "\"light\"",
26:                 VoxelType::RedWall => "\"redwall\"",
27:                 VoxelType::Grass => "\"grass\"",
28:                 VoxelType::Water => "\"water\"",
29:                 VoxelType::Tree => "\"tree\"",
30:                 VoxelType::RedLight => "\"redlight\"",
31:                 VoxelType::PaleWall => "\"palewall\"",
32:                 VoxelType::DamagedWall => "\"damagedwall\"",
33:                 VoxelType::DryCarpet => "\"drycarpet\"",
34:                 VoxelType::DeepCarpet => "\"deepcarpet\"",
35:                 VoxelType::StickyCarpet => "\"stickycarpet\"",
36:                 VoxelType::Fluid => "\"fluid\"",
37:                 VoxelType::Glimmer => "\"glimmer\"",
38:                 VoxelType::ConcreteWall => "\"concretewall\"",
39:                 VoxelType::TileFloor => "\"tilefloor\"",
40:                 VoxelType::ConcreteFloor => "\"concretefloor\"",
41:                 VoxelType::Crate => "\"crate\"",
42:                 VoxelType::Pipe => "\"pipe\"",
43:                 VoxelType::MetalDoor => "\"metaldoor\"",
44:                 VoxelType::AlmondWater => "\"almondwater\"",
45:             };
46: 
47:             let obj = format!(
48:                 "{{\"x\":{},\"y\":{},\"z\":{},\"w\":{},\"h\":{},\"dir\":{},\"type\":{},\"color\":{}}}",
````
