````rust
  1: //! The endless unplanned office fabric: an irregular warren of yellow rooms
  2: //! on a hidden lattice, chained through hashed doorways (binary-tree rule
  3: //! guarantees global connectivity chunk-locally) and merged by
  4: //! porosity-driven wall dropout so no grid is ever readable. Open expanses
  5: //! and vaults punctuate it; they are never the default.
  6: 
  7: use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::RealitySnapshot;
  8: use crate::domain::entities::environment::{EnvironmentProfile, WallTreatment};
  9: use crate::entities::models::Position;
 10: use crate::use_cases::generate_chunk::LevelTuning;
 11: use crate::use_cases::ports::NoiseProvider;
 12: use crate::use_cases::region_plan::PLAN_WALL_T;
 13: 
 14: use super::{BackroomsLevel, ColumnPlan, DOOR_HEIGHT, DOOR_WIDTH};
 15: 
 16: /// The default fabric room lattice. Rooms are chained through hashed
 17: /// doorways and merged by wall dropout, so the cell size never reads as a
 18: /// grid from inside — it is the scale of the labyrinth, not its shape.
 19: pub(super) const FABRIC_CELL: f32 = 7.2;
 20: 
 21: /// Column grid spacing inside expanses.
 22: const EXPANSE_COLUMN_PERIOD: f32 = 7.2;
 23: 
 24: /// Ceiling light panel spacing. The coffer beam grid shares this period,
 25: /// but beams are a renderer shading pattern, never stepped ceiling geometry.
 26: pub(super) const LIGHT_PERIOD: f32 = 2.8;
 27: 
 28: /// The broad ceiling hierarchy that gives Level 0 scale without turning the
 29: /// whole map into a warehouse. It is local implementation detail rather than
 30: /// a world semantic: assemblies and corridors may override it.
 31: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 32: pub(super) enum FabricCeilingBand {
 33:     Compression,
 34:     Regular,
 35:     Expanse,
 36:     Vault,
 37: }
 38: 
 39: impl BackroomsLevel {
 40:     /// Smooth world-space noise in [-1, 1]. `scale` stretches the provider's
 41:     /// built-in ~20 u wavelength: wavelength = 20 / scale.
 42:     pub(super) fn n(noise: &dyn NoiseProvider, seed: u32, salt: u32, x: f32, z: f32, scale: f32) -> f32 {
 43:         noise.evaluate_2d(seed ^ salt, Position::new(x * scale, z * scale))
 44:     }
 45: 
 46:     /// Decorrelated per-cell hash in [0, 1): samples the value noise exactly
 47:     /// on its lattice (provider frequency is 0.05, so inputs that are
 48:     /// multiples of 20 hit lattice points), where it is uniform rather than
 49:     /// interpolation-smoothed toward zero.
 50:     pub(super) fn cell_hash(noise: &dyn NoiseProvider, seed: u32, salt: u32, cx: i64, cz: i64) -> f32 {
 51:         let v = noise.evaluate_2d(
 52:             seed ^ salt,
 53:             Position::new(cx as f32 * 20.0, cz as f32 * 20.0),
 54:         );
 55:         (v * 0.5 + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 0.999)
 56:     }
 57: 
 58:     /// Broad, low-frequency ceiling territory. The thresholds are chosen to
 59:     /// bias the sampled world toward regular dropped ceilings while retaining
 60:     /// meaningful regions of open volume and rare compression.
 61:     pub(super) fn fabric_ceiling_band(
 62:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 63:         seed: u32,
 64:         wx: f32,
 65:         wz: f32,
 66:     ) -> FabricCeilingBand {
 67:         // Regular dropped ceiling — the labyrinth fabric — is the default
 68:         // condition of Level 0. Expanses and vaults are deliberate
 69:         // punctuation the maze occasionally opens into, never the baseline.
 70:         let field = Self::n(noise, seed, 0xAA10, wx, wz, 0.18);
 71:         if field < -0.60 {
 72:             FabricCeilingBand::Compression
 73:         } else if field < 0.52 {
 74:             FabricCeilingBand::Regular
 75:         } else if field < 0.76 {
 76:             FabricCeilingBand::Expanse
 77:         } else {
 78:             FabricCeilingBand::Vault
 79:         }
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     /// Ceiling heights are architectural tiers, not terrain. The common
 83:     /// bands are perfectly flat; open volumes vary per fabric *cell* (the
 84:     /// same `FABRIC_CELL` lattice the wall/doorway decision reads), never
 85:     /// per column, and every height snaps to the fine voxel lattice so
 86:     /// voxelization cannot add sub-voxel stair-stepping on top.
 87:     ///
 88:     /// Sharing the wall lattice is deliberate, not cosmetic: a height
 89:     /// *step* between two neighboring cells can then only ever land on a
 90:     /// column the wall decision already has an opinion about (solid, or a
 91:     /// lintel), because a fabric cell boundary is exactly where that
 92:     /// decision is made. Before this shared a `FABRIC_CELL`-independent 8 u
 93:     /// zone instead, incommensurate with the 7.2 u wall lattice, so a
 94:     /// height step could fall in the middle of an unrelated room with no
 95:     /// wall anywhere near it to carry it — see `voxelize_columns`, which
 96:     /// only ever extends a ceiling step where this invariant holds.
 97:     pub(super) fn fabric_ceiling_height(
 98:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 99:         seed: u32,
100:         wx: f32,
101:         wz: f32,
102:         band: FabricCeilingBand,
103:     ) -> f32 {
104:         let zone_x = (wx / FABRIC_CELL).floor() * FABRIC_CELL + FABRIC_CELL * 0.5;
105:         let zone_z = (wz / FABRIC_CELL).floor() * FABRIC_CELL + FABRIC_CELL * 0.5;
106:         let detail = Self::n(noise, seed, 0xB300, zone_x, zone_z, 0.72);
107:         let (height, lo, hi) = match band {
108:             FabricCeilingBand::Compression => (2.6, 2.5, 2.8),
109:             FabricCeilingBand::Regular => (3.4, 3.2, 3.6),
110:             FabricCeilingBand::Expanse => (4.1 + 0.3 * detail, 3.8, 4.4),
111:             FabricCeilingBand::Vault => (4.95 + 0.45 * detail, 4.5, 5.4),
112:         };
113:         // Snap to the fine voxel lattice, then clamp last: 21 * 0.2 is
114:         // 4.2000003 in f32 and must not escape the band's range.
115:         ((height / 0.2).round() * 0.2).clamp(lo, hi)
116:     }
117: 
118:     /// Is (wx, wz) inside an open expanse of the fabric?
119:     pub(super) fn in_expanse(noise: &dyn NoiseProvider, seed: u32, wx: f32, wz: f32) -> bool {
120:         matches!(
121:             Self::fabric_ceiling_band(noise, seed, wx, wz),
122:             FabricCeilingBand::Expanse | FabricCeilingBand::Vault
123:         )
124:     }
125: 
126:     /// The fabric plan as it was first observed — Peripheral Shift epoch 0
127:     /// everywhere. Kept for callers that deliberately freeze the fabric.
128:     #[cfg(test)]
129:     pub(crate) fn column_plan(
130:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
131:         seed: u32,
132:         tuning: &LevelTuning,
133:         wx: f32,
134:         wz: f32,
135:     ) -> ColumnPlan {
136:         Self::column_plan_in_reality(noise, seed, tuning, &RealitySnapshot::empty(), wx, wz)
137:     }
138: 
139:     /// The *fabric* column plan at world position (wx, wz): the endless,
140:     /// unplanned office fill between planned corridors and assemblies.
141:     ///
142:     /// This is where the wiki's Peripheral Shift lives: `reality` carries a
143:     /// drift epoch per 40 u cell, advanced by the engine whenever territory
144:     /// goes unobserved. The epoch re-salts the *cosmetic and porosity*
145:     /// decisions — wall dropout, doorway direction/position/width framing,
146:     /// dead lights — while the ceiling territories, porosity climate,
147:     /// junction posts, and expanse structure stay fixed, so a returning
148:     /// wanderer recognizes the neighborhood but never the hallways. Every
149:     /// decision reads its epoch at the deciding lattice cell's own anchor,
150:     /// so a wall is rebuilt whole even when a drift-cell boundary crosses it,
151:     /// and at strain tier 0 the binary-tree doorway rule holds per cell at
152:     /// any epoch mix — a provisioned wanderer's labyrinth stays globally
153:     /// connected through every rearrangement. Under strain (`delirium` > 0,
154:     /// the price of mismanaged provisions) the guarantee erodes on purpose:
155:     /// guaranteed doorways brick over into dead-end pockets, second
156:     /// doorways thin, and at deep strain rare 0.8 u slips hide in walls
157:     /// that offer no doorway at all.
158:     pub(crate) fn column_plan_in_reality(
159:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
160:         seed: u32,
161:         tuning: &LevelTuning,
162:         reality: &RealitySnapshot,
163:         wx: f32,
164:         wz: f32,
165:     ) -> ColumnPlan {
166:         // ---- ceiling field -------------------------------------------------
167:         let ceiling_band = Self::fabric_ceiling_band(noise, seed, wx, wz);
168:         let ceiling_units = Self::fabric_ceiling_height(noise, seed, wx, wz, ceiling_band);
169: 
170:         // ---- material/decay -------------------------------------------------
171:         // Every consumer of Level 0 materials is meant to derive from one
172:         // `EnvironmentProfile` (see environment.rs's module doc); ordinary
173:         // fabric is the one caller that used to bypass it with hardcoded
174:         // constants. `institution_age` already ages the fixture survival
175:         // ratio below; sampling it once more here, at this column's own
176:         // `FABRIC_CELL` anchor (the wall lattice, not the light lattice —
177:         // each decision reads the field at its own deciding cell, same
178:         // pattern the light block already uses), gives ordinary rooms a real
179:         // decay gradient instead of one flat color everywhere.
180:         let cx = (wx / FABRIC_CELL).floor() as i64;
181:         let cz = (wz / FABRIC_CELL).floor() as i64;
182:         let cell_age = crate::use_cases::world_topology::institution_age_at(
183:             noise,
184:             seed,
185:             (cx as f32 + 0.5) * FABRIC_CELL,
186:             (cz as f32 + 0.5) * FABRIC_CELL,
187:         );
188:         let env = EnvironmentProfile {
189:             wall: if cell_age > 0.55 {
190:                 WallTreatment::AgedWallpaper
191:             } else {
192:                 WallTreatment::YellowWallpaper
193:             },
194:             ..EnvironmentProfile::level0_fabric()
195:         };
196: 
197:         // In open and vaulted regions, partitions dissolve and only sparse
198:         // structural columns remain. The cheap dropped-ceiling material is
199:         // therefore carried through unexpectedly large space.
200:         let expanse = matches!(
201:             ceiling_band,
202:             FabricCeilingBand::Expanse | FabricCeilingBand::Vault
203:         );
204: 
205:         // Coffer beams are shading detail in the renderer, not geometry: a
206:         // 0.2 u drop at a 0.2 u voxel scale turned every beam into a
207:         // full-voxel step and read as noisy terrain overhead. The splat
208:         // shader darkens the same COFFER_PERIOD grid instead.
209: 
210:         // ---- solids ------------------------------------------------------
211:         let mut solid = false;
212:         let mut lintel_from_units: Option<f32> = None;
213: 
214:         if expanse {
215:             // Sparse structural columns hold the expanse ceiling up.
216:             let cx = (wx / EXPANSE_COLUMN_PERIOD).floor() as i64;
217:             let cz = (wz / EXPANSE_COLUMN_PERIOD).floor() as i64;
218:             let on_site = wx.rem_euclid(EXPANSE_COLUMN_PERIOD) < 0.45
219:                 && wz.rem_euclid(EXPANSE_COLUMN_PERIOD) < 0.45;
220:             if on_site && Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, 0xF200, cx, cz) < 0.7 * tuning.pillars {
221:                 solid = true;
222:             }
223:         } else {
224:             // The default fabric *is* the Backrooms labyrinth: an irregular
225:             // warren of yellow rooms chained through hashed doorways.
226:             // Connectivity is a binary-tree rule — every cell knocks a
227:             // doorway through its west *or* its north wall — so all rooms
228:             // connect without a chunk ever seeing its neighbors. Smoothly
229:             // drifting porosity (whole walls dropped, wider thresholds,
230:             // second doorways) breaks the lattice read: it plays as one
231:             // endless wrong building, never as "a maze section".
232:             let t = PLAN_WALL_T;
233:             let fx = wx.rem_euclid(FABRIC_CELL);
234:             let fz = wz.rem_euclid(FABRIC_CELL);
235:             let (in_w, in_n) = (fx < t, fz < t);
236:             if in_w && in_n {
237:                 // Junction posts anchor every corner; where the walls
238:                 // around them have dropped they survive as column stubs.
239:                 solid = tuning.walls > 0.0;
240:             } else if in_w || in_n {
241:                 // The whole fabric cell rearranges as one: its epoch is read
242:                 // at the cell's own center, never at the sampled column.
243:                 let epoch = reality.fabric_drift_epoch(
244:                     (cx as f32 + 0.5) * FABRIC_CELL,
245:                     (cz as f32 + 0.5) * FABRIC_CELL,
246:                 );
247:                 let drift = |salt: u32| salt ^ epoch.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9);
248:                 // Strain is the price of poor provisioning: the delirium
249:                 // tier folds into a decision's salt only when it is nonzero,
250:                 // so a well-managed wanderer's world is byte-identical to
251:                 // the tierless one.
252:                 let tier = reality.delirium() as u32;
253:                 let strain = |salt: u32| drift(salt) ^ tier.wrapping_mul(0x85EB_CA6B);
254:                 // 0 = tight labyrinth, 1 = broken-open suites; drifts over
255:                 // ~180 u so density changes read as neighborhoods, not zones.
256:                 // The porosity climate is character, not layout: it survives
257:                 // every Peripheral Shift, so a broken-open neighborhood
258:                 // rearranges into another broken-open neighborhood.
259:                 let porosity =
260:                     (Self::n(noise, seed, 0x9010, wx, wz, 0.11) * 0.5 + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
261:                 let opens_west = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, drift(0x9200), cx, cz) < 0.5;
262:                 let (wall_salt, door_salt, opens_here) = if in_w {
263:                     (drift(0x9300u32), drift(0x9500u32), opens_west)
264:                 } else {
265:                     (drift(0x9400u32), drift(0x9600u32), !opens_west)
266:                 };
267:                 // Under strain the binary-tree guarantee itself erodes: a
268:                 // cell's guaranteed doorway can be found bricked over, and
269:                 // the warren grows dead-end pockets in proportion to how
270:                 // badly the wanderer has managed their provisions. Tier 0
271:                 // never seals, so a provisioned world stays fully connected.
272:                 let sealed = tier > 0
273:                     && Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, strain(0x9800), cx, cz)
274:                         < 0.10 * tier as f32;
275:                 let opens_here = opens_here && !sealed;
276:                 // Whole-wall dropout merges rooms into larger wrong shapes.
277:                 // Porosity varies along a run, so drops end ragged rather
278:                 // than on clean cell boundaries. The walls knob scales
279:                 // survival: 0 empties the fabric, 2 approaches a full grid.
280:                 //
281:                 // A Peripheral Shift is not a reshuffle of the same maze: an
282:                 // epoch-salted neighborhood field biases wall survival ±0.16
283:                 // (smooth like porosity, zero at epoch 0), so a returning
284:                 // wanderer finds warren where they remember openness and
285:                 // openness where they remember warren — a different tree of
286:                 // a map, still inside the porosity climate's character.
287:                 let shift_bias = if epoch == 0 {
288:                     0.0
289:                 } else {
290:                     0.16 * Self::n(noise, seed, drift(0x9700), wx, wz, 0.07)
291:                 };
292:                 let survive =
293:                     (0.92 - 0.42 * porosity + shift_bias) * tuning.walls.clamp(0.0, 1.5);
294:                 if Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, wall_salt, cx, cz) < survive {
295:                     let along = if in_w { fz } else { fx };
296:                     // The binary-tree wall usually gets its doorway; porous
297:                     // neighborhoods often cut a second one. Strain thins the
298:                     // second doorways by lowering the same threshold, so
299:                     // rising tiers close alternative routes rather than
300:                     // re-dealing them.
301:                     let extra = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, door_salt ^ 0x1F, cx, cz)
302:                         < (0.18 + 0.42 * porosity) * (1.0 - 0.22 * tier as f32);
303:                     if opens_here || extra {
304:                         let dh = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, door_salt, cx, cz);
305:                         let width = DOOR_WIDTH + 0.2 + 2.2 * porosity;
306:                         let pos = t + (FABRIC_CELL - 2.0 * t - width) * dh;
307:                         if along >= pos && along < pos + width {
308:                             // Narrow thresholds sometimes keep a lintel:
309:                             // framed evidence of doors that once existed.
310:                             if width < 2.0
311:                                 && Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, door_salt ^ 0x2E, cx, cz) < 0.35
312:                             {
313:                                 lintel_from_units = Some(DOOR_HEIGHT);
314:                             }
315:                         } else {
316:                             solid = true;
317:                         }
318:                     } else if tier >= 2
319:                         && Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, strain(0x9900), cx, cz)
320:                             < 0.06 * (tier - 1) as f32
321:                     {
322:                         // A deep-strain wall occasionally hides a slip: a
323:                         // 0.8 u lintel-framed slot barely wider than a
324:                         // wanderer, in a wall that offers no doorway at all.
325:                         // The punished labyrinth grows secrets alongside its
326:                         // dead ends — but only for those desperate enough to
327:                         // brush every wall.
328:                         let sh = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, strain(0x9A00), cx, cz);
329:                         let width = 0.8;
330:                         let pos = t + (FABRIC_CELL - 2.0 * t - width) * sh;
331:                         if along >= pos && along < pos + width {
332:                             lintel_from_units = Some(DOOR_HEIGHT);
333:                         } else {
334:                             solid = true;
335:                         }
336:                     } else {
337:                         solid = true;
338:                     }
339:                 }
340:             }
341:         }
342: 
343:         // ---- lights ------------------------------------------------------
344:         let light = if !solid {
345:             // Open regions keep a longer, sparser fluorescent rhythm; the
346:             // regular dropped ceiling retains the denser office grid.
347:             let panel_period = if expanse { 4.8 } else { LIGHT_PERIOD };
348:             let lx = (wx - panel_period * 0.5).rem_euclid(panel_period);
349:             let lz = (wz - panel_period * 0.5).rem_euclid(panel_period);
350:             let cell_x = (wx / panel_period).floor() as i64;
351:             let cell_z = (wz / panel_period).floor() as i64;
352:             let anchor_x = (cell_x as f32 + 0.5) * panel_period;
353:             let anchor_z = (cell_z as f32 + 0.5) * panel_period;
354:             // Old territory keeps fewer of its tubes alive: institution age
355:             // scales the survival ratio from ~1.15x (new wings feel almost
356:             // maintained) down to ~0.6x (ancient wings run on remnants).
357:             // Sampled at the panel's own anchor so one fixture never splits
358:             // into half-lit columns.
359:             let age = crate::use_cases::world_topology::institution_age_at(
360:                 noise, seed, anchor_x, anchor_z,
361:             );
362:             let keep = if expanse { 0.66 } else { 0.78 } * tuning.lights * (1.15 - 0.55 * age);
363:             // Which panels burned out is cosmetic memory, so the Peripheral
364:             // Shift re-deals it: the light that guided you out may be dead
365:             // when you walk back in.
366:             let epoch = reality.fabric_drift_epoch(anchor_x, anchor_z);
367:             let salt = 0xE900 ^ epoch.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9);
368:             let alive = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, salt, cell_x, cell_z) < keep;
369:             lx < 0.45 && lz < 0.45 && alive
370:         } else {
371:             false
372:         };
373: 
374:         ColumnPlan {
375:             floor: true,
376:             floor_units: 0.0,
377:             solid,
378:             ceiling_units,
379:             light,
380:             red_light: false,
381:             lintel_from_units,
382:             wall_material: env.wall_voxel(),
383:             floor_material: env.floor_voxel(),
384:             light_material: env.light_voxel(),
385:         }
386:     }
387: }
````

````rust
  1: //! Binary transport format for [`ChunkPayload`] between the generation
  2: //! workers and the main thread. One chunk becomes one contiguous byte
  3: //! buffer, so the browser can move it with a zero-copy `postMessage`
  4: //! transfer instead of structured-cloning a deep object graph.
  5: //!
  6: //! The format is little-endian, length-prefixed, and versioned by a magic
  7: //! header. Decode is defensive: any truncated or mismatched buffer yields
  8: //! `None` and the driver simply drops that chunk (the streamer re-requests).
  9: //! Platform-free and natively round-trip tested.
 10: 
 11: use crate::application::collision::Aabb;
 12: use crate::application::ports::{
 13:     ChunkPayload, FaceCellRange, FaceInstanceSet, LightKind, LightSource, PackedFaceInstance,
 14:     PackedVertex, SurfaceMeshPayload,
 15: };
 16: use vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::{LevelExit, PitHazard, TraversalGate};
 17: use vackrooms::domain::entities::supplies::SupplyItem;
 18: 
 19: /// "VKC" + version 6. Version 6 adds supply items and level exits.
 20: const MAGIC: u32 = 0x564B_4306;
 21: 
 22: pub fn encode_chunk_payload(payload: &ChunkPayload) -> Vec<u8> {
 23:     let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(
 24:         64 + payload.nodes.len() * 4
 25:             + payload.surface.vertices.len() * 10
 26:             + payload.surface.indices.len() * 4
 27:             + payload.surface.faces.instances.len() * 16
 28:             + payload.lights.len() * 51
 29:             + payload.collision.len() * 24
 30:             + payload.traversal_gates.len() * TraversalGate::WORDS * 4
 31:             + payload.pit_hazards.len() * PitHazard::TRANSPORT_WORDS * 4,
 32:     );
 33:     put_u32(&mut out, MAGIC);
 34:     put_u32(&mut out, payload.root);
 35:     put_f32(&mut out, payload.world_size);
 36:     put_f32(&mut out, payload.voxel_size);
 37:     out.push(payload.svo_depth);
 38: 
 39:     put_u32(&mut out, payload.nodes.len() as u32);
 40:     for &n in &payload.nodes {
 41:         put_u32(&mut out, n);
 42:     }
 43: 
 44:     let s = &payload.surface;
 45:     put_u32(&mut out, s.vertices.len() as u32);
 46:     for v in &s.vertices {
 47:         for c in v.position {
 48:             put_u16(&mut out, c);
 49:         }
 50:         out.extend_from_slice(&[v.normal_axis, v.material, v.static_indirect, v.ao]);
 51:     }
 52:     put_u32(&mut out, s.indices.len() as u32);
 53:     for &i in &s.indices {
 54:         put_u32(&mut out, i);
 55:     }
 56:     put_aabb(&mut out, &s.bounds);
 57:     out.push(s.lod);
 58:     put_f32(&mut out, s.voxel_scale);
 59:     // Version-six compatibility slots: legacy WebGL workers placed an RGB
 60:     // light volume here. WebGPU consumes analytic lights and compact per-face
 61:     // baked values, so new payloads encode an empty volume while retaining
 62:     // all later field offsets/order.
 63:     for _ in 0..3 {
 64:         put_u32(&mut out, 0);
 65:     }
 66:     out.push(0);
 67:     put_u32(&mut out, 0);
 68: 
 69:     put_u32(&mut out, payload.lights.len() as u32);
 70:     for l in &payload.lights {
 71:         out.extend_from_slice(&l.id.to_le_bytes());
 72:         for c in l.position {
 73:             put_f32(&mut out, c);
 74:         }
 75:         for c in l.half_size {
 76:             put_f32(&mut out, c);
 77:         }
 78:         for c in l.color {
 79:             put_f32(&mut out, c);
 80:         }
 81:         put_f32(&mut out, l.radius);
 82:         put_f32(&mut out, l.intensity);
 83:         out.push(l.kind as u8);
 84:         out.push(l.flicker_mode);
 85:         out.push(u8::from(l.enabled));
 86:     }
 87: 
 88:     put_u32(&mut out, s.faces.instances.len() as u32);
 89:     for inst in &s.faces.instances {
 90:         for c in inst.position {
 91:             put_u16(&mut out, c);
 92:         }
 93:         out.extend_from_slice(&[
 94:             inst.extent_u,
 95:             inst.extent_v,
 96:             inst.normal_axis,
 97:             inst.material,
 98:             inst.baked_light,
 99:             inst.ao,
100:             inst.flags,
101:         ]);
102:     }
103:     put_u32(&mut out, s.faces.cells.len() as u32);
104:     for cell in &s.faces.cells {
105:         out.extend_from_slice(&cell.cell);
106:         put_u32(&mut out, cell.offset);
107:         put_u32(&mut out, cell.count);
108:     }
109:     put_f32(&mut out, s.faces.cell_size);
110: 
111:     put_u32(&mut out, payload.collision.len() as u32);
112:     for aabb in &payload.collision {
113:         put_aabb(&mut out, aabb);
114:     }
115: 
116:     put_u32(&mut out, payload.traversal_gates.len() as u32);
117:     for gate in &payload.traversal_gates {
118:         for word in gate.to_words() {
119:             put_u32(&mut out, word);
120:         }
121:     }
122:     put_u32(&mut out, payload.pit_hazards.len() as u32);
123:     for hazard in &payload.pit_hazards {
124:         let mut words = Vec::with_capacity(PitHazard::TRANSPORT_WORDS);
125:         hazard.write_words(&mut words);
126:         for word in words {
127:             put_u32(&mut out, word);
128:         }
129:     }
130:     put_u32(&mut out, payload.supply_items.len() as u32);
131:     for item in &payload.supply_items {
132:         for word in item.to_words() {
133:             put_u32(&mut out, word);
134:         }
135:     }
136:     put_u32(&mut out, payload.level_exits.len() as u32);
137:     for exit in &payload.level_exits {
138:         for word in exit.to_words() {
139:             put_u32(&mut out, word);
140:         }
141:     }
142:     out
143: }

145: pub fn decode_chunk_payload(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<ChunkPayload> {
146:     let mut r = Reader { bytes, pos: 0 };
147:     if r.u32()? != MAGIC {
148:         return None;
149:     }
150:     let root = r.u32()?;
151:     let world_size = r.f32()?;
152:     let voxel_size = r.f32()?;
153:     let svo_depth = r.u8()?;
154: 
155:     let node_count = r.len(4)?;
156:     let mut nodes = Vec::with_capacity(node_count);
157:     for _ in 0..node_count {
158:         nodes.push(r.u32()?);
159:     }
160: 
161:     let vertex_count = r.len(10)?;
162:     let mut vertices = Vec::with_capacity(vertex_count);
163:     for _ in 0..vertex_count {
164:         vertices.push(PackedVertex {
165:             position: [r.u16()?, r.u16()?, r.u16()?],
166:             normal_axis: r.u8()?,
167:             material: r.u8()?,
168:             static_indirect: r.u8()?,
169:             ao: r.u8()?,
170:         });
171:     }
172:     let index_count = r.len(4)?;
173:     let mut indices = Vec::with_capacity(index_count);
174:     for _ in 0..index_count {
175:         indices.push(r.u32()?);
176:     }
177:     let bounds = r.aabb()?;
178:     let lod = r.u8()?;
179:     let voxel_scale = r.f32()?;
180:     let _legacy_light_volume_size = [r.u32()?, r.u32()?, r.u32()?];
181:     let _legacy_light_volume_padding = r.u8()?;
182:     let volume_len = r.len(1)?;
183:     let _legacy_light_volume = r.slice(volume_len)?;
184: 
185:     let light_count = r.len(51)?;
186:     let mut lights = Vec::with_capacity(light_count);
187:     for _ in 0..light_count {
188:         lights.push(LightSource {
189:             id: r.u64()?,
190:             position: [r.f32()?, r.f32()?, r.f32()?],
191:             half_size: [r.f32()?, r.f32()?],
192:             color: [r.f32()?, r.f32()?, r.f32()?],
193:             radius: r.f32()?,
194:             intensity: r.f32()?,
195:             kind: LightKind::from_u8(r.u8()?)?,
196:             flicker_mode: r.u8()?,
197:             enabled: r.u8()? != 0,
198:         });
199:     }
200: 
201:     let instance_count = r.len(13)?;
202:     let mut instances = Vec::with_capacity(instance_count);
203:     for _ in 0..instance_count {
204:         instances.push(PackedFaceInstance {
205:             position: [r.u16()?, r.u16()?, r.u16()?],
206:             extent_u: r.u8()?,
207:             extent_v: r.u8()?,
208:             normal_axis: r.u8()?,
209:             material: r.u8()?,
210:             baked_light: r.u8()?,
211:             ao: r.u8()?,
212:             flags: r.u8()?,
213:             reserved: [0; 3],
214:         });
215:     }
216:     let cell_count = r.len(11)?;
217:     let mut cells = Vec::with_capacity(cell_count);
218:     for _ in 0..cell_count {
219:         cells.push(FaceCellRange {
220:             cell: [r.u8()?, r.u8()?, r.u8()?],
221:             offset: r.u32()?,
222:             count: r.u32()?,
223:         });
224:     }
225:     let cell_size = r.f32()?;
226: 
227:     let collision_count = r.len(24)?;
228:     let mut collision = Vec::with_capacity(collision_count);
229:     for _ in 0..collision_count {
230:         collision.push(r.aabb()?);
231:     }
232: 
233:     let gate_count = r.len(TraversalGate::WORDS * 4)?;
234:     let mut traversal_gates = Vec::with_capacity(gate_count);
235:     for _ in 0..gate_count {
236:         let mut words = [0u32; TraversalGate::WORDS];
237:         for word in &mut words {
238:             *word = r.u32()?;
239:         }
240:         traversal_gates.push(TraversalGate::from_words(&words)?);
241:     }
242:     let hazard_count = r.len(PitHazard::TRANSPORT_WORDS * 4)?;
243:     let mut pit_hazards = Vec::with_capacity(hazard_count);
244:     for _ in 0..hazard_count {
245:         let mut words = [0u32; PitHazard::TRANSPORT_WORDS];
246:         for word in &mut words {
247:             *word = r.u32()?;
248:         }
249:         pit_hazards.push(PitHazard::from_transport_words(&words)?);
250:     }
251:     let supply_count = r.len(SupplyItem::WORDS * 4)?;
252:     let mut supply_items = Vec::with_capacity(supply_count);
253:     for _ in 0..supply_count {
254:         let mut words = [0u32; SupplyItem::WORDS];
255:         for word in &mut words {
256:             *word = r.u32()?;
257:         }
258:         supply_items.push(SupplyItem::from_words(&words)?);
259:     }
260:     let exit_count = r.len(LevelExit::WORDS * 4)?;
261:     let mut level_exits = Vec::with_capacity(exit_count);
262:     for _ in 0..exit_count {
263:         let mut words = [0u32; LevelExit::WORDS];
264:         for word in &mut words {
265:             *word = r.u32()?;
266:         }
267:         level_exits.push(LevelExit::from_words(&words)?);
268:     }
269: 
270:     Some(ChunkPayload {
271:         root,
272:         nodes,
273:         world_size,
274:         voxel_size,
275:         svo_depth,
276:         surface: SurfaceMeshPayload {
277:             vertices,
278:             indices,
279:             bounds,
280:             lod,
281:             faces: FaceInstanceSet {
282:                 instances,
283:                 cells,
284:                 cell_size,
285:             },
286:             voxel_scale,
287:             light_volume_bytes: vec![0, 0, 0],
288:             light_volume_dims: [1, 1, 1],
289:         },
290:         lights,
291:         collision,
292:         traversal_gates,
293:         pit_hazards,
294:         supply_items,
295:         level_exits,
296:     })
297: }

299: fn put_u16(out: &mut Vec<u8>, v: u16) {
300:     out.extend_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
301: }
302: fn put_u32(out: &mut Vec<u8>, v: u32) {
303:     out.extend_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
304: }
305: fn put_f32(out: &mut Vec<u8>, v: f32) {
306:     out.extend_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
307: }
308: fn put_aabb(out: &mut Vec<u8>, aabb: &Aabb) {
309:     for c in aabb.min {
310:         put_f32(out, c);
311:     }
312:     for c in aabb.max {
313:         put_f32(out, c);
314:     }
315: }
316: 
317: struct Reader<'a> {
318:     bytes: &'a [u8],
319:     pos: usize,
320: }
321: 
322: impl<'a> Reader<'a> {
323:     fn slice(&mut self, n: usize) -> Option<&'a [u8]> {
324:         let end = self.pos.checked_add(n)?;
325:         let s = self.bytes.get(self.pos..end)?;
326:         self.pos = end;
327:         Some(s)
328:     }
329:     fn u8(&mut self) -> Option<u8> {
330:         Some(self.slice(1)?[0])
331:     }
332:     fn u16(&mut self) -> Option<u16> {
333:         Some(u16::from_le_bytes(self.slice(2)?.try_into().ok()?))
334:     }
335:     fn u32(&mut self) -> Option<u32> {
336:         Some(u32::from_le_bytes(self.slice(4)?.try_into().ok()?))
337:     }
338:     fn u64(&mut self) -> Option<u64> {
339:         Some(u64::from_le_bytes(self.slice(8)?.try_into().ok()?))
340:     }
341:     fn f32(&mut self) -> Option<f32> {
342:         Some(f32::from_le_bytes(self.slice(4)?.try_into().ok()?))
343:     }
344:     fn aabb(&mut self) -> Option<Aabb> {
345:         Some(Aabb::new(
346:             [self.f32()?, self.f32()?, self.f32()?],
347:             [self.f32()?, self.f32()?, self.f32()?],
348:         ))
349:     }
350:     /// Reads a length prefix and sanity-bounds it: each element occupies at
351:     /// least `min_element_bytes`, so a corrupt length cannot force a huge
352:     /// allocation before the reads start failing.
353:     fn len(&mut self, min_element_bytes: usize) -> Option<usize> {
354:         let n = self.u32()? as usize;
355:         let remaining = self.bytes.len().saturating_sub(self.pos);
356:         if n.saturating_mul(min_element_bytes.max(1)) > remaining {
357:             return None;
358:         }
359:         Some(n)
360:     }
361: }
````

````rust
  1: //! Input adapter: accumulates raw browser events (key codes, mouse deltas,
  2: //! pointer-lock state) and translates them into one [`InputFrame`] per tick.
  3: //!
  4: //! The driver layer feeds this from DOM event listeners; the frame loop
  5: //! drains it with [`InputCollector::take_frame`]. Keeping the mapping here —
  6: //! not in the driver — means "which key means forward" is a testable rule,
  7: //! not something buried in an event closure.
  8: 
  9: use crate::application::engine::InputFrame;
 10: use crate::application::player::MoveIntent;
 11: 
 12: #[derive(Debug, Default)]
 13: pub struct InputCollector {
 14:     intent: MoveIntent,
 15:     pending_dx: f32,
 16:     pending_dy: f32,
 17:     locked: bool,
 18:     flashlight: bool,
 19:     /// One queued flare drop, consumed by the next frame. Edge-triggered:
 20:     /// holding G never queues a second drop until the key is released.
 21:     flare_queued: bool,
 22:     flare_key_held: bool,
 23:     /// Deliberate consumption, edge-triggered exactly like the flare:
 24:     /// R drinks one carried almond water, T eats one carried ration.
 25:     drink_queued: bool,
 26:     drink_key_held: bool,
 27:     eat_queued: bool,
 28:     eat_key_held: bool,
 29: }
 30: 
 31: impl InputCollector {
 32:     pub fn new() -> Self {
 33:         Self::default()
 34:     }
 35: 
 36:     /// Handles a keydown/keyup pair by `KeyboardEvent.code` value.
 37:     /// Unknown codes are ignored. Both WASD and arrow keys are mapped.
 38:     pub fn key_event(&mut self, code: &str, pressed: bool) {
 39:         #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 40:         let doom = crate::DOOM_CONTROLS.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
 41: 
 42:         #[cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))]
 43:         let doom = false;
 44: 
 45:         if pressed && code == "KeyF" {
 46:             self.flashlight = !self.flashlight;
 47:         }
 48: 
 49:         // Flare drop: fires once per press, only while playing (the engine
 50:         // additionally ignores drops when the session is not locked, so a
 51:         // G typed into the settings menu can never reach gameplay).
 52:         if code == "KeyG" {
 53:             if pressed && !self.flare_key_held && self.locked {
 54:                 self.flare_queued = true;
 55:             }
 56:             self.flare_key_held = pressed;
 57:         }
 58: 
 59:         // Deliberate consumption: one supply per key press, only in play.
 60:         if code == "KeyR" {
 61:             if pressed && !self.drink_key_held && self.locked {
 62:                 self.drink_queued = true;
 63:             }
 64:             self.drink_key_held = pressed;
 65:         }
 66:         if code == "KeyT" {
 67:             if pressed && !self.eat_key_held && self.locked {
 68:                 self.eat_queued = true;
 69:             }
 70:             self.eat_key_held = pressed;
 71:         }
 72: 
 73:         if doom {
 74:             match code {
 75:                 "KeyW" | "ArrowUp" => self.intent.forward = pressed,
 76:                 "KeyS" | "ArrowDown" => self.intent.backward = pressed,
 77:                 "KeyQ" => self.intent.left = pressed,
 78:                 "KeyE" => self.intent.right = pressed,
 79:                 "KeyA" | "ArrowLeft" => self.intent.turn_left = pressed,
 80:                 "KeyD" | "ArrowRight" => self.intent.turn_right = pressed,
 81:                 _ => {}
 82:             }
 83:         } else {
 84:             match code {
 85:                 "KeyW" | "ArrowUp" => self.intent.forward = pressed,
 86:                 "KeyS" | "ArrowDown" => self.intent.backward = pressed,
 87:                 "KeyA" | "ArrowLeft" => self.intent.left = pressed,
 88:                 "KeyD" | "ArrowRight" => self.intent.right = pressed,
 89:                 "KeyQ" => self.intent.turn_left = pressed,
 90:                 "KeyE" => self.intent.turn_right = pressed,
 91:                 _ => {}
 92:             }
 93:         }
 94:     }
 95: 
 96:     /// Accumulates a mouse movement (only meaningful while pointer-locked).
 97:     pub fn mouse_delta(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32) {
 98:         if self.locked {
 99:             #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
100:             let (sens, invert) = {
101:                 use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
102:                 (
103:                     f32::from_bits(crate::MOUSE_SENSITIVITY_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed)),
104:                     crate::INVERT_Y.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
105:                 )
106:             };
107:             #[cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))]
108:             let (sens, invert) = (1.0f32, false);
109: 
110:             self.pending_dx += dx * sens;
111:             self.pending_dy += dy * sens * if invert { -1.0 } else { 1.0 };
112:         }
113:     }
114: 
115:     /// Sets movement intent from an analog source (the touch joystick).
116:     /// `x` is strafe (-1..1, right positive), `y` is walk (-1..1, forward
117:     /// positive). Values inside the dead zone clear the intent, so lifting
118:     /// the thumb stops the player.
119:     pub fn set_move_axes(&mut self, x: f32, y: f32) {
120:         const DEAD_ZONE: f32 = 0.25;
121:         self.intent.forward = y > DEAD_ZONE;
122:         self.intent.backward = y < -DEAD_ZONE;
123:         self.intent.right = x > DEAD_ZONE;
124:         self.intent.left = x < -DEAD_ZONE;
125:     }
126: 
127:     /// Toggles the flashlight (touch button; keyboard uses KeyF).
128:     pub fn toggle_flashlight(&mut self) {
129:         self.flashlight = !self.flashlight;
130:     }
131: 
132:     /// Queues one flare drop (touch button; keyboard uses KeyG). One queued
133:     /// drop per frame regardless of how many events bubble in.
134:     pub fn queue_flare(&mut self) {
135:         if self.locked {
136:             self.flare_queued = true;
137:         }
138:     }
139: 
140:     /// Queues one deliberate drink (touch button; keyboard uses KeyR).
141:     pub fn queue_drink(&mut self) {
142:         if self.locked {
143:             self.drink_queued = true;
144:         }
145:     }
146: 
147:     /// Queues one deliberate meal (touch button; keyboard uses KeyT).
148:     pub fn queue_eat(&mut self) {
149:         if self.locked {
150:             self.eat_queued = true;
151:         }
152:     }
153: 
154:     /// Pointer lock engaged/released. Releasing clears held keys so the
155:     /// player doesn't keep walking while the overlay is up.
156:     pub fn set_locked(&mut self, locked: bool) {
157:         self.locked = locked;
158:         if !locked {
159:             self.intent = MoveIntent::default();
160:             self.pending_dx = 0.0;
161:             self.pending_dy = 0.0;
162:             self.flare_queued = false;
163:             self.drink_queued = false;
164:             self.eat_queued = false;
165:         }
166:     }
167: 
168:     pub fn is_locked(&self) -> bool {
169:         self.locked
170:     }
171: 
172:     /// Drains accumulated input into a frame snapshot. Mouse deltas reset;
173:     /// key intent persists until the matching keyup.
174:     pub fn take_frame(&mut self) -> InputFrame {
175:         let frame = InputFrame {
176:             intent: self.intent,
177:             look_dx: self.pending_dx,
178:             look_dy: self.pending_dy,
179:             locked: self.locked,
180:             flashlight: self.flashlight,
181:             drop_flare: self.flare_queued,
182:             drink: self.drink_queued,
183:             eat: self.eat_queued,
184:         };
185:         self.pending_dx = 0.0;
186:         self.pending_dy = 0.0;
187:         self.flare_queued = false;
188:         self.drink_queued = false;
189:         self.eat_queued = false;
190:         frame
191:     }
192: }

198:     #[test]
199:     fn wasd_maps_to_intent_and_persists_across_frames() {

206:         let f2 = input.take_frame();
207:         assert!(f2.intent.forward, "held keys persist");
208:         input.key_event("KeyW", false);
209:         assert!(!input.take_frame().intent.forward);
210:     }
211: 
212:     #[test]
213:     fn mouse_deltas_accumulate_then_drain() {
214:         let mut input = InputCollector::new();
215:         input.set_locked(true);
216:         input.mouse_delta(3.0, -1.0);
217:         input.mouse_delta(2.0, 1.0);
218:         let f = input.take_frame();
219:         assert_eq!((f.look_dx, f.look_dy), (5.0, 0.0));
220:         let f2 = input.take_frame();
221:         assert_eq!((f2.look_dx, f2.look_dy), (0.0, 0.0));
222:     }
````

````rust
 1: //! GLSL ES 3.00 programs for every GPU render path, one module per program:
 2: //!
 3: //! | module      | program                                                |
 4: //! |-------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
 5: //! | [`raymarch`]| fullscreen SVO raymarcher (`?renderer=raymarch`)       |
 6: //! | [`surface`] | indexed greedy meshes (default renderer)               |
 7: //! | [`splat`]   | instanced face splats (`?renderer=splat`)              |
 8: //! | [`shadow`]  | depth-only hero-light shadow pass (surface + splat)    |
 9: //! | [`chunks`]  | shared GLSL snippets spliced into the programs above   |
10: //!
11: //! Cross-cutting effects (the flashlight cone, the material palette, noise
12: //! helpers, tone mapping, flare cores) exist exactly once, in [`chunks`],
13: //! and are concatenated into each program's source at link time. The
14: //! flashlight cone's constants are the GLSL mirror of the CPU spec in
15: //! `adapters::cpu_splatter::flashlight` — change both together.
16: //!
17: //! The SVO node atlas texel encoding is documented in the core's
18: //! `OctreeGpuSerializer`; the compact vertex/instance formats in
19: //! `application::ports`.
20: 
21: pub mod apply_distance_fog;
22: pub mod chunks;
23: pub mod encode_display_color;
24: pub mod evaluate_scene_lighting;
25: #[path = "trace_voxel_scene/mod.rs"]
26: pub mod raymarch;
27: pub mod sample_scene_lights;
28: pub mod shadow;
29: pub mod splat;
30: pub mod supply_labels;
31: #[path = "render_world_surfaces/mod.rs"]
32: pub mod surface;
````

````rust
  1: //! Per-frame indexed-surface pipeline.
  2: //!
  3: //! The submission order is deliberately visible in [`render_frame`]:
  4: //!
  5: //! 1. clear the target and establish fixed-function state;
  6: //! 2. collect chunks accepted by the optional visibility optimization;
  7: //! 3. select fixture and dynamic lights;
  8: //! 4. optionally render the hero-light shadow map;
  9: //! 5. bind uniforms that are constant for the frame;
 10: //! 6. bind and draw each visible mesh.
 11: //!
 12: //! Each optional branch is labeled with its `rt_*` switch. Disabling an
 13: //! optimization keeps the same pipeline and selects its reference path.
 14: 
 15: use web_sys::WebGl2RenderingContext as Gl;
 16: 
 17: use crate::application::ports::{
 18:     ChunkDraw, FrameParams, RendererPort, SurfaceChunk, SurfaceChunkKey,
 19: };
 20: use crate::application::render_settings::RenderToggles;
 21: use crate::application::rendering::encode_display_color;
 22: use crate::drivers::gl::cluster_scene_lights::{LightRange, append_lights_reaching_bounds};
 23: use crate::drivers::gl::lights::flare_cores;
 24: use crate::drivers::gl::math::{
 25:     camera_matrices, look_at_matrix_down, multiply_matrices, ortho_matrix,
 26: };
 27: use crate::drivers::gl::visibility::{MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE, chunk_bounding_sphere, sphere_visible};
 28: 
 29: use super::SurfaceRenderer;
 30: use super::upload_world_surface_chunks::GpuMesh;
 31: 
 32: /// Shadow uniforms always receive a complete state. The default disables the
 33: /// lookup and supplies a deterministic matrix when no hero pass ran.
 34: struct ShadowState {
 35:     light_index: i32,
 36:     light_view_projection: [f32; 16],
 37: }
 38: 
 39: struct VisibleDraw {
 40:     key: SurfaceChunkKey,
 41:     lights: LightRange,
 42:     hero_local_index: i32,
 43: }
 44: 
 45: impl Default for ShadowState {
 46:     fn default() -> Self {
 47:         Self {
 48:             light_index: -1,
 49:             light_view_projection: [0.0; 16],
 50:         }
 51:     }
 52: }
 53: 
 54: impl RendererPort for SurfaceRenderer {
 55:     fn uses_surface_meshes(&self) -> bool {
 56:         true
 57:     }
 58: 
 59:     fn upload_surfaces(&mut self, chunks: &[SurfaceChunk<'_>]) {
 60:         for &chunk in chunks {
 61:             self.upload_surface(chunk);
 62:         }
 63:     }
 64: 
 65:     fn remove_surfaces(&mut self, keys: &[SurfaceChunkKey]) {
 66:         for key in keys {
 67:             if let Some(mesh) = self.meshes.remove(key) {
 68:                 self.destroy_mesh(mesh);
 69:             }
 70:         }
 71:     }
 72: 
 73:     fn clear_surfaces(&mut self) {
 74:         let meshes = std::mem::take(&mut self.meshes);
 75:         for (_, mesh) in meshes {
 76:             self.destroy_mesh(mesh);
 77:         }
 78:     }
 79: 
 80:     fn cpu_telemetry_string(&self) -> Option<String> {
 81:         let stats = self.stats;
 82:         let gpu_ms = self.timer.last_ms().unwrap_or(0.0);
 83:         Some(format!(
 84:             "surface {} tri / {} calls / {}/{} chunks / {} shadow casters / GPU {:.2}ms",
 85:             stats.triangles_drawn,
 86:             stats.draw_calls,
 87:             stats.visible_chunks,
 88:             stats.resident_chunks,
 89:             stats.shadow_casters,
 90:             gpu_ms,
 91:         ))
 92:     }
 93: 
 94:     fn upload_atlas(&mut self, _texels: &[u32]) {}
 95: 
 96:     fn upload_label_atlas(&mut self, rgba: &[u8], width: u32, height: u32) {
 97:         let gl = &self.gl;
 98:         let texture = gl.create_texture();
 99:         gl.active_texture(Gl::TEXTURE7);
100:         gl.bind_texture(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, texture.as_ref());
101:         let _ = gl.tex_image_2d_with_i32_and_i32_and_i32_and_format_and_type_and_opt_u8_array(
102:             Gl::TEXTURE_2D,
103:             0,
104:             Gl::RGBA as i32,
105:             width as i32,
106:             height as i32,
107:             0,
108:             Gl::RGBA,
109:             Gl::UNSIGNED_BYTE,
110:             Some(rgba),
111:         );
112:         gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Gl::TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, Gl::LINEAR as i32);
113:         gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Gl::TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, Gl::LINEAR as i32);
114:         gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Gl::TEXTURE_WRAP_S, Gl::CLAMP_TO_EDGE as i32);
115:         gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Gl::TEXTURE_WRAP_T, Gl::CLAMP_TO_EDGE as i32);
116:         self.label_atlas = texture;
117:     }
118: 
119:     fn draw(&mut self, frame: &FrameParams, _chunks: &[ChunkDraw]) {
120:         let toggles = crate::get_render_toggles();
121: 
122:         // OPTIMIZATION (rt_timer): asynchronous timing never waits for the
123:         // GPU. Disabling it prevents new queries while preserving rendering.
124:         self.timer.poll(&self.gl);
125:         let timer_started = self.timer.begin(&self.gl, false);
126: 
127:         render_frame(self, frame, toggles);
128:         self.timer.end(&self.gl, timer_started);
129:     }
130: }
131: 
132: fn render_frame(renderer: &mut SurfaceRenderer, frame: &FrameParams, toggles: RenderToggles) {
133:     begin_main_frame(renderer, frame);
134:     let (mut visible, clustered_lights) =
135:         prepare_visible_draws(renderer, frame, toggles.distance_cull);
136:     if renderer
137:         .scene_lights
138:         .upload(&renderer.gl, &clustered_lights)
139:         .is_err()
140:     {
141:         for draw in &mut visible {
142:             draw.lights.count = 0;
143:             draw.hero_local_index = -1;
144:         }
145:     }
146: 
147:     let (shadow, shadow_casters, shadow_draw_calls) =
148:         render_shadow_pass(renderer, frame, toggles.shadow_pass);
149: 
150:     bind_frame_uniforms(
151:         renderer,
152:         frame,
153:         &shadow,
154:         toggles.dither,
155:         toggles.baked_lighting,
156:     );
157:     let (triangles_drawn, main_draw_calls) = draw_visible_meshes(renderer, &visible, &shadow);
158:     draw_supply_labels(renderer, frame);
159: 
160:     renderer.stats = super::SurfaceFrameStats {
161:         visible_chunks: visible.len(),
162:         resident_chunks: renderer.meshes.len(),
163:         draw_calls: shadow_draw_calls + main_draw_calls,
164:         triangles_drawn,
165:         shadow_casters,
166:     };
167: }
168: 
169: /// Camera-facing product labels over nearby supply pickups. A cutout pass:
170: /// depth-tested and depth-writing, so it needs no ordering against the
171: /// opaque world and never x-rays through walls.
172: fn draw_supply_labels(renderer: &SurfaceRenderer, frame: &FrameParams) {
173:     use crate::drivers::shaders::supply_labels;
174: 
175:     let Some(atlas) = renderer.label_atlas.as_ref() else {
176:         return;
177:     };
178:     if frame.supply_sprites.is_empty() {
179:         return;
180:     }
181:     let gl = &renderer.gl;
182:     let uniforms = &renderer.label_uniforms;
183:     gl.use_program(Some(&renderer.label_program));
184: 
185:     let (projection, view) =
186:         camera_matrices(frame, renderer.width, renderer.height, MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE);
187:     gl.uniform_matrix4fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.projection.as_ref(), false, &projection);
188:     gl.uniform_matrix4fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.view.as_ref(), false, &view);
189: 
190:     let count = frame
191:         .supply_sprites
192:         .len()
193:         .min(supply_labels::MAX_SPRITES);
194:     let mut sprites = [0.0f32; supply_labels::MAX_SPRITES * 4];
195:     for (i, sprite) in frame.supply_sprites.iter().take(count).enumerate() {
196:         sprites[i * 4] = sprite.position[0];
197:         sprites[i * 4 + 1] = sprite.position[1];
198:         sprites[i * 4 + 2] = sprite.position[2];
199:         sprites[i * 4 + 3] = sprite.atlas_row as f32;
200:     }
201:     gl.uniform4fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.sprites.as_ref(), &sprites);
202:     // Cylindrical billboard: turn with the player's yaw, stay upright.
203:     let right = [frame.yaw.cos(), 0.0, -frame.yaw.sin()];
204:     gl.uniform3fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.cam_right.as_ref(), &right);
205:     gl.uniform2f(
206:         uniforms.half_size.as_ref(),
207:         supply_labels::HALF_WIDTH,
208:         supply_labels::HALF_HEIGHT,
209:     );
210:     gl.uniform3f(
211:         uniforms.camera_position.as_ref(),
212:         frame.camera_pos[0],
213:         frame.camera_pos[1],
214:         frame.camera_pos[2],
215:     );
216:     let environment = frame.environment;
217:     gl.uniform3f(
218:         uniforms.fog_color.as_ref(),
219:         environment.fog_color[0],
220:         environment.fog_color[1],
221:         environment.fog_color[2],
222:     );
223:     gl.uniform1f(uniforms.fog_density.as_ref(), environment.fog_density);
224:     gl.uniform1f(uniforms.fog_start.as_ref(), environment.fog_start);
225: 
226:     gl.active_texture(Gl::TEXTURE7);
227:     gl.bind_texture(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Some(atlas));
228:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.atlas.as_ref(), 7);
229: 
230:     // Both label faces read; the quad expands entirely from gl_VertexID.
231:     gl.disable(Gl::CULL_FACE);
232:     gl.bind_vertex_array(None);
233:     gl.draw_arrays(Gl::TRIANGLES, 0, (count * 6) as i32);
234:     gl.enable(Gl::CULL_FACE);
235: }
236: 
237: /// Establishes every fixed-function state relied on by either raster pass.
238: fn begin_main_frame(renderer: &SurfaceRenderer, frame: &FrameParams) {
239:     let gl = &renderer.gl;
240:     gl.viewport(0, 0, renderer.width, renderer.height);
241: 
242:     // Match unloaded space to the level atmosphere so generated chunk edges
243:     // disappear into fog rather than exposing the canvas clear color.
244:     let environment = frame.environment;
245:     let atmosphere = if environment.outdoor {
246:         environment.sky_color
247:     } else {
248:         environment.fog_color
249:     };
250:     let clear = encode_display_color(atmosphere);
251:     gl.clear_color(clear[0], clear[1], clear[2], 1.0);
252:     gl.clear_depth(1.0);
253:     gl.clear(Gl::COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | Gl::DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
254:     gl.enable(Gl::DEPTH_TEST);
255:     gl.depth_func(Gl::LEQUAL);
256:     gl.depth_mask(true);
257:     gl.enable(Gl::CULL_FACE);
258:     gl.cull_face(Gl::BACK);
259: }
260: 
261: /// OPTIMIZATION (rt_cull): conservative distance and behind-camera sphere
262: /// rejection. The disabled reference path submits every resident mesh.
263: fn prepare_visible_draws(
264:     renderer: &SurfaceRenderer,
265:     frame: &FrameParams,
266:     culling_enabled: bool,
267: ) -> (
268:     Vec<VisibleDraw>,
269:     Vec<crate::application::ports::LightSource>,
270: ) {
271:     let mut draws = Vec::new();
272:     let mut clustered = Vec::new();
273:     let hero_id = frame.active_scene_lights().first().map(|light| light.id);
274:     for (&key, mesh) in &renderer.meshes {
275:         let visible = {
276:             if !culling_enabled {
277:                 true
278:             } else {
279:                 let (center, radius) = chunk_bounding_sphere(mesh.origin, mesh.bounds_max);
280:                 sphere_visible(center, radius, frame, MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE).is_some()
281:             }
282:         };
283:         if !visible {
284:             continue;
285:         }
286:         let bounds_max = [
287:             mesh.origin[0] + mesh.bounds_max[0],
288:             mesh.origin[1] + mesh.bounds_max[1],
289:             mesh.origin[2] + mesh.bounds_max[2],
290:         ];
291:         let lights = append_lights_reaching_bounds(
292:             frame.active_scene_lights(),
293:             mesh.origin,
294:             bounds_max,
295:             &mut clustered,
296:         );
297:         let hero_local_index =
298:             if lights.count > 0 && hero_id == Some(clustered[lights.first as usize].id) {
299:                 0
300:             } else {
301:                 -1
302:             };
303:         draws.push(VisibleDraw {
304:             key,
305:             lights,
306:             hero_local_index,
307:         });
308:     }
309:     (draws, clustered)
310: }
311: 
312: /// FEATURE (rt_shadows): renders every resident greedy mesh into the selected
313: /// fixture's top-down depth map. Camera culling must not remove an off-screen
314: /// caster whose shadow lands on a visible receiver. With the feature
315: /// disabled, the returned state makes the main shader skip shadow sampling.
316: fn render_shadow_pass(
317:     renderer: &SurfaceRenderer,
318:     frame: &FrameParams,
319:     enabled: bool,
320: ) -> (ShadowState, u32, u32) {
321:     let Some(hero) = frame.active_scene_lights().first() else {
322:         return (ShadowState::default(), 0, 0);
323:     };
324:     if !enabled {
325:         return (ShadowState::default(), 0, 0);
326:     }
327: 
328:     let range = hero.radius;
329:     let emitter_half_diagonal =
330:         (hero.half_size[0] * hero.half_size[0] + hero.half_size[1] * hero.half_size[1]).sqrt();
331:     let ortho_half = range + emitter_half_diagonal;
332:     let projection = ortho_matrix(
333:         -ortho_half,
334:         ortho_half,
335:         -ortho_half,
336:         ortho_half,
337:         0.1,
338:         range + emitter_half_diagonal,
339:     );
340:     let view = look_at_matrix_down(hero.position);
341:     let light_view_projection = multiply_matrices(&projection, &view);
342: 
343:     let gl = &renderer.gl;
344:     gl.bind_framebuffer(Gl::FRAMEBUFFER, Some(&renderer.shadow.fbo));
345:     gl.viewport(0, 0, renderer.shadow.size, renderer.shadow.size);
346:     gl.color_mask(false, false, false, false);
347:     gl.clear_depth(1.0);
348:     gl.clear(Gl::DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
349:     gl.use_program(Some(&renderer.shadow_program));
350:     gl.uniform_matrix4fv_with_f32_array(
351:         renderer.shadow_uniforms.light_view_proj.as_ref(),
352:         false,
353:         &light_view_projection,
354:     );
355: 
356:     let hero_min_x = hero.position[0] - ortho_half;
357:     let hero_max_x = hero.position[0] + ortho_half;
358:     let hero_min_z = hero.position[2] - ortho_half;
359:     let hero_max_z = hero.position[2] + ortho_half;
360:     let hero_min_y = hero.position[1] - range;
361:     let hero_max_y = hero.position[1] + 2.0;
362: 
363:     let mut casters_count = 0u32;
364:     let mut draw_calls = 0u32;
365: 
366:     for mesh in renderer.meshes.values() {
367:         let chunk_max_x = mesh.origin[0] + mesh.bounds_max[0];
368:         let chunk_max_y = mesh.origin[1] + mesh.bounds_max[1];
369:         let chunk_max_z = mesh.origin[2] + mesh.bounds_max[2];
370: 
371:         // Footprint AABB intersection test for hero-light caster culling
372:         if chunk_max_x < hero_min_x
373:             || mesh.origin[0] > hero_max_x
374:             || chunk_max_z < hero_min_z
375:             || mesh.origin[2] > hero_max_z
376:             || chunk_max_y < hero_min_y
377:             || mesh.origin[1] > hero_max_y
378:         {
379:             continue;
380:         }
381: 
382:         casters_count += 1;
383:         draw_calls += 1;
384: 
385:         gl.uniform3f(
386:             renderer.shadow_uniforms.chunk_origin.as_ref(),
387:             mesh.origin[0],
388:             mesh.origin[1],
389:             mesh.origin[2],
390:         );
391:         gl.bind_vertex_array(Some(&mesh.vao));
392:         gl.draw_elements_with_i32(Gl::TRIANGLES, mesh.index_count, Gl::UNSIGNED_INT, 0);
393:     }
394: 
395:     // Restore the default target state required by the already-cleared main
396:     // pass. Depth/cull state is shared and remains intentionally unchanged.
397:     gl.bind_framebuffer(Gl::FRAMEBUFFER, None);
398:     gl.viewport(0, 0, renderer.width, renderer.height);
399:     gl.color_mask(true, true, true, true);
400: 
401:     (
402:         ShadowState {
403:             light_index: 0,
404:             light_view_projection,
405:         },
406:         casters_count,
407:         draw_calls,
408:     )
409: }
410: 
411: /// Binds state shared by every visible mesh exactly once per frame.
412: fn bind_frame_uniforms(
413:     renderer: &SurfaceRenderer,
414:     frame: &FrameParams,
415:     shadow: &ShadowState,
416:     dither_enabled: bool,
417:     baked_lighting_enabled: bool,
418: ) {
419:     let gl = &renderer.gl;
420:     let uniforms = &renderer.uniforms;
421:     gl.use_program(Some(&renderer.program));
422: 
423:     let (projection, view) =
424:         camera_matrices(frame, renderer.width, renderer.height, MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE);
425:     gl.uniform_matrix4fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.projection.as_ref(), false, &projection);
426:     gl.uniform_matrix4fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.view.as_ref(), false, &view);
427:     gl.uniform3f(
428:         uniforms.camera_position.as_ref(),
429:         frame.camera_pos[0],
430:         frame.camera_pos[1],
431:         frame.camera_pos[2],
432:     );
433: 
434:     let forward = camera_forward(frame);
435:     gl.uniform3fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.cam_forward.as_ref(), &forward);
436:     gl.uniform1i(
437:         uniforms.flashlight.as_ref(),
438:         if frame.flashlight { 1 } else { 0 },
439:     );
440:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.dither.as_ref(), if dither_enabled { 1 } else { 0 });
441:     gl.uniform1i(
442:         uniforms.baked_lighting.as_ref(),
443:         if baked_lighting_enabled { 1 } else { 0 },
444:     );
445: 
446:     let environment = frame.environment;
447:     gl.uniform1i(
448:         uniforms.outdoor.as_ref(),
449:         if environment.outdoor { 1 } else { 0 },
450:     );
451:     gl.uniform3f(
452:         uniforms.fog_color.as_ref(),
453:         environment.fog_color[0],
454:         environment.fog_color[1],
455:         environment.fog_color[2],
456:     );
457:     gl.uniform1f(uniforms.ambient_scale.as_ref(), environment.ambient_scale);
458:     gl.uniform1f(uniforms.fog_density.as_ref(), environment.fog_density);
459:     gl.uniform1f(uniforms.fog_start.as_ref(), environment.fog_start);
460: 
461:     bind_light_uniforms(renderer, frame, shadow);
462:     bind_dynamic_light_uniforms(renderer, frame);
463: }
464: 
465: fn bind_dynamic_light_uniforms(renderer: &SurfaceRenderer, frame: &FrameParams) {
466:     let gl = &renderer.gl;
467:     let lights = frame.active_dynamic_lights();
468:     let mut position_radius = [0.0f32; 16];
469:     let mut color_intensity = [0.0f32; 16];
470:     for (index, light) in lights.iter().enumerate() {
471:         let offset = index * 4;
472:         position_radius[offset..offset + 3].copy_from_slice(&light.position);
473:         position_radius[offset + 3] = light.radius;
474:         color_intensity[offset..offset + 3].copy_from_slice(&light.color);
475:         color_intensity[offset + 3] = light.intensity;
476:     }
477:     gl.uniform1i(
478:         renderer.uniforms.dynamic_light_count.as_ref(),
479:         lights.len() as i32,
480:     );
481:     gl.uniform4fv_with_f32_array(
482:         renderer.uniforms.dynamic_pos_radius.as_ref(),
483:         &position_radius,
484:     );
485:     gl.uniform4fv_with_f32_array(
486:         renderer.uniforms.dynamic_color_intensity.as_ref(),
487:         &color_intensity,
488:     );
489: }
490: 
491: fn camera_forward(frame: &FrameParams) -> [f32; 3] {
492:     let (sin_pitch, cos_pitch) = frame.pitch.sin_cos();
493:     let (sin_yaw, cos_yaw) = frame.yaw.sin_cos();
494:     [-cos_pitch * sin_yaw, sin_pitch, -cos_pitch * cos_yaw]
495: }
496: 
497: fn bind_light_uniforms(renderer: &SurfaceRenderer, frame: &FrameParams, shadow: &ShadowState) {
498:     let gl = &renderer.gl;
499:     let uniforms = &renderer.uniforms;
500:     gl.active_texture(Gl::TEXTURE2);
501:     renderer.scene_lights.bind(gl);
502:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.scene_light_texture.as_ref(), 2);
503:     gl.uniform1i(
504:         uniforms.scene_light_texture_width.as_ref(),
505:         renderer.scene_lights.width(),
506:     );
507: 
508:     // Flare cores are independent from the selected shading-light slots, so
509:     // an unselected flare still renders its small emissive ember.
510:     let cores = flare_cores(frame);
511:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.core_count.as_ref(), cores.count);
512:     gl.uniform4fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.cores.as_ref(), &cores.pos_intensity);
513:     gl.uniform3fv_with_f32_array(uniforms.core_colors.as_ref(), &cores.colors);
514: 
515:     // sampler3D and sampler2D may never alias, even when no hero is active:
516:     // WebGL rejects the draw if both default to texture unit zero.
517:     gl.active_texture(Gl::TEXTURE1);
518:     gl.bind_texture(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Some(&renderer.shadow.texture));
519:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.shadow_map.as_ref(), 1);
520:     gl.uniform_matrix4fv_with_f32_array(
521:         uniforms.light_view_proj.as_ref(),
522:         false,
523:         &shadow.light_view_projection,
524:     );
525: }
526: 
527: fn draw_visible_meshes(
528:     renderer: &SurfaceRenderer,
529:     visible: &[VisibleDraw],
530:     shadow: &ShadowState,
531: ) -> (u32, u32) {
532:     let mut triangles = 0u32;
533:     let mut draw_calls = 0u32;
534:     for draw in visible {
535:         let Some(mesh) = renderer.meshes.get(&draw.key) else {
536:             continue;
537:         };
538:         draw_mesh(renderer, mesh, draw, shadow);
539:         triangles += (mesh.index_count / 3) as u32;
540:         draw_calls += 1;
541:     }
542:     renderer.gl.bind_vertex_array(None);
543:     (triangles, draw_calls)
544: }
545: 
546: /// Binds the only per-mesh state: local transform bounds, baked light volume,
547: /// and indexed geometry.
548: fn draw_mesh(renderer: &SurfaceRenderer, mesh: &GpuMesh, draw: &VisibleDraw, shadow: &ShadowState) {
549:     let gl = &renderer.gl;
550:     let uniforms = &renderer.uniforms;
551:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.light_first.as_ref(), draw.lights.first);
552:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.light_count.as_ref(), draw.lights.count);
553:     gl.uniform1i(
554:         uniforms.shadowed_light_index.as_ref(),
555:         if shadow.light_index >= 0 {
556:             draw.hero_local_index
557:         } else {
558:             -1
559:         },
560:     );
561:     gl.uniform3f(
562:         uniforms.chunk_origin.as_ref(),
563:         mesh.origin[0],
564:         mesh.origin[1],
565:         mesh.origin[2],
566:     );
567:     gl.uniform1f(uniforms.voxel_size.as_ref(), mesh.voxel_size);
568:     gl.uniform3fv_with_f32_array(
569:         uniforms.light_volume_origin.as_ref(),
570:         &mesh.light_volume_origin,
571:     );
572:     gl.active_texture(Gl::TEXTURE0);
573:     gl.bind_texture(Gl::TEXTURE_3D, Some(&mesh.light_texture));
574:     gl.uniform1i(uniforms.light_volume.as_ref(), 0);
575: 
576:     gl.bind_vertex_array(Some(&mesh.vao));
577:     gl.draw_elements_with_i32(Gl::TRIANGLES, mesh.index_count, Gl::UNSIGNED_INT, 0);
578: }
````
