````rust
 824: /// The fabric connectivity invariant: every warren cell opens through
 825: /// its west or its north wall (doorway, dropped wall, or an override by
 826: /// corridor/assembly/expanse), so the labyrinth is globally connected
 827: /// by induction — no chunk ever needs to see its neighbors to prove it.
 828: #[test]
 829: fn every_fabric_cell_opens_west_or_north() {
 830:     let noise = TestNoise;
 831:     let config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
 832:     let tuning = LevelTuning::default();
 833:     let mut cells_checked = 0usize;
 834:     for cell_x in -40i64..40 {
 835:         for cell_z in -40i64..40 {
 836:             let x0 = cell_x as f32 * FABRIC_CELL;
 837:             let z0 = cell_z as f32 * FABRIC_CELL;
 838:             let plans = BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(
 839:                 Position::new(x0, z0),
 840:                 FABRIC_CELL,
 841:                 42,
 842:                 &config,
 843:                 &noise,
 844:             );
 845:             let plan_for = |wx: f32, wz: f32| {
 846:                 let key = (region_index(wx), region_index(wz));
 847:                 &plans.iter().find(|(k, _)| *k == key).unwrap().1
 848:             };
 849:             // The invariant belongs to *pure* fabric. Cells clipped by a
 850:             // corridor edge or an assembly take their connectivity from
 851:             // those systems instead (tested separately), so skip them.
 852:             let (cx0, cz0) = (x0 - PLAN_WALL_T, z0 - PLAN_WALL_T);
 853:             let (cx1, cz1) = (x0 + FABRIC_CELL, z0 + FABRIC_CELL);
 854:             let clipped = plans.iter().any(|(_, p)| {
 855:                 p.corridors.iter().any(|s| {
 856:                     let m = s.width * 0.5 + PLAN_WALL_T + 0.1;
 857:                     [
 858:                         (cx0, cz0),
 859:                         (cx1, cz0),
 860:                         (cx0, cz1),
 861:                         (cx1, cz1),
 862:                         ((cx0 + cx1) * 0.5, (cz0 + cz1) * 0.5),
 863:                     ]
 864:                     .iter()
 865:                     .any(|&(px, pz)| s.distance(px, pz) <= m + FABRIC_CELL)
 866:                 }) || p.assemblies.iter().any(|a| {
 867:                     let b = a.footprint.bounds();
 868:                     cx0 < b.2 + PLAN_WALL_T
 869:                         && b.0 - PLAN_WALL_T < cx1
 870:                         && cz0 < b.3 + PLAN_WALL_T
 871:                         && b.1 - PLAN_WALL_T < cz1
 872:                 }) || p.anomalies.iter().any(|an| {
 873:                     // Anomaly interiors own their connectivity rules
 874:                     // (entrances, skeleton lanes, arch openings) and are
 875:                     // tested by their own family invariants.
 876:                     an.footprint
 877:                         .bounds()
 878:                         .expanded(PLAN_WALL_T + 0.1)
 879:                         .intersects(WorldBounds::new(cx0, cz0, cx1, cz1))
 880:                 })
 881:             });
 882:             if clipped {
 883:                 continue;
 884:             }
 885:             let mut open = false;
 886:             let mut probe = |wx: f32, wz: f32| {
 887:                 let c =
 888:                     BackroomsLevel::plan_column(plan_for(wx, wz), &noise, 42, &tuning, wx, wz);
 889:                 if !c.solid {
 890:                     open = true;
 891:                 }
 892:             };
 893:             // Sample along the west and north wall bands of the cell.
 894:             let mut a = PLAN_WALL_T + 0.1;
 895:             while a < FABRIC_CELL - PLAN_WALL_T {
 896:                 probe(x0 + 0.2, z0 + a);
 897:                 probe(x0 + a, z0 + 0.2);
 898:                 a += 0.2;
 899:             }
 900:             assert!(
 901:                 open,
 902:                 "fabric cell ({cell_x},{cell_z}) is sealed on both its \
 903:                  west and north walls"
 904:             );
 905:             cells_checked += 1;
 906:         }
 907:     }
 908:     assert!(cells_checked > 1000, "sample too small: {cells_checked}");
 909: }

 911: /// Red identity is owned by whole rooms: some region must contain a red
 912: /// room whose fixtures voxelize as red lights, and crimson/peeled wall
 913: /// voxels may appear only inside a red-room footprint (plus its wall
 914: /// band) — the approach stain is telegraphy, never leakage into fabric.
 915: #[test]
 916: fn red_rooms_are_lit_red_but_never_built_red() {
 917:     use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{VOXEL_RED_LIGHT, VOXEL_RED_WALL};
 918:     let noise = TestNoise;
 919:     let config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
 920:     let tuning = LevelTuning::default();
 921: 
 922:     let mut red_room_seen = false;
 923:     'search: for rx in -4i64..=4 {
 924:         for rz in -4i64..=4 {
 925:             let plans = BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(
 926:                 Position::new(rx as f32 * REGION_SIZE, rz as f32 * REGION_SIZE),
 927:                 1.0,
 928:                 42,
 929:                 &config,
 930:                 &noise,
 931:             );
 932:             let plan = &plans.iter().find(|(k, _)| *k == (rx, rz)).unwrap().1;
 933:             for a in &plan.assemblies {
 934:                 if !a.corruption.red_room {
 935:                     continue;
 936:                 }
 937:                 assert!(!a.corruption.abandoned, "a red room must be occupied");
 938:                 // Its lit fixtures plan red lights.
 939:                 let f = a.fixtures.iter().find(|f| f.lit).expect("lit fixture");
 940:                 let c = BackroomsLevel::plan_column(plan, &noise, 42, &tuning, f.at.x, f.at.z);
 941:                 if c.light {
 942:                     assert!(c.red_light, "red-room fixture plans a warm light");
 943:                     red_room_seen = true;
 944:                     break 'search;
 945:                 }
 946:             }
 947:         }
 948:     }
 949:     assert!(red_room_seen, "no red room found within 81 regions");
 950: 
 951:     // Red walls stay contained: any crimson voxel must sit inside some
 952:     // red-room footprint (plus wall band), and red lights appear only as
 953:     // ceiling lights.
 954:     for (ox, oz) in [(0.0, 0.0), (30.0, 10.0), (-40.0, 70.0), (150.0, -90.0)] {
 955:         let grid = generate(ox, oz);
 956:         let scale = config.voxel_scale;
 957:         for z in 0..grid.depth() {
 958:             for x in 0..grid.width() {
 959:                 for y in 0..grid.height() {
 960:                     if grid.get(x, y, z) == VOXEL_RED_WALL {
 961:                         panic!(
 962:                             "VOXEL_RED_WALL should never be voxelized at {wx}, {y}, {wz}",
 963:                             wx = ox + (x as f32 + 0.5) * scale,
 964:                             wz = oz + (z as f32 + 0.5) * scale
 965:                         );
 966:                     }
 967:                 }
 968:                 // Red lights sit at ceiling height, never at floor level.
 969:                 assert_ne!(grid.get(x, 1, z), VOXEL_RED_LIGHT);
 970:             }
 971:         }
 972:     }
 973: }

 975: fn find_macro_anomaly(kind: AnomalyKind) -> (GeneratorConfig, AnomalyInstance) {
 976:     let mut config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
 977:     config.anomalies.frequency = 4.0;
 978:     config.anomalies.pillar_expanses = (kind == AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse) as u8 as f32;
 979:     config.anomalies.blackouts = (kind == AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse) as u8 as f32;
 980:     config.anomalies.pit_lattices = (kind == AnomalyKind::PitLattice) as u8 as f32;
 981:     let noise = TestNoise;
 982:     for rz in 3i64..24 {
 983:         for rx in 3i64..24 {
 984:             let plans = BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(
 985:                 Position::new(rx as f32 * REGION_SIZE, rz as f32 * REGION_SIZE),
 986:                 1.0,
 987:                 42,
 988:                 &config,
 989:                 &noise,
 990:             );
 991:             if let Some(instance) = plans
 992:                 .iter()
 993:                 .flat_map(|(_, p)| &p.anomalies)
 994:                 .find(|a| a.kind == kind)
 995:             {
 996:                 return (config, instance.clone());
 997:             }
 998:         }
 999:     }
1000:     panic!("no {kind:?} fixture found");
1001: }

1003: #[test]
1004: fn pillar_epoch_changes_only_committed_wake_and_preserves_bearing_lane() {
1005:     use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::{AnomalyStateStamp, AxisDirection};
1006:     let (mut config, instance) = find_macro_anomaly(AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse);
1007:     config.anomalies.remap_intensity = 4.0;
1008:     let gate = instance.gates[instance.gates.len() / 2];
1009:     let reality = RealitySnapshot::new(vec![AnomalyStateStamp::new(
1010:         instance.id,
1011:         1,
1012:         gate.plane,
1013:         gate.axis,
1014:         AxisDirection::Positive,
1015:         crate::domain::entities::anomaly::RedRoomPhase::Outside,
1016:         0,
1017:         0,
1018:     )]);
1019:     let empty = RealitySnapshot::empty();
1020:     let noise = TestNoise;
1021:     let mut changed = 0usize;
1022:     let mut unchanged_forward = 0usize;
1023:     let mut lz = -instance.footprint.half_z + 1.0;
1024:     while lz < instance.footprint.half_z - 1.0 {
1025:         let mut lx = -instance.footprint.half_x + 1.0;
1026:         while lx < instance.footprint.half_x - 1.0 {
1027:             let p = instance.world_coords(lx, lz);
1028:             let a = sample_anomaly(&instance, &noise, 42, &config, &empty, p.x, p.z);
1029:             let b = sample_anomaly(&instance, &noise, 42, &config, &reality, p.x, p.z);
1030:             let in_wake =
1031:                 reality.stamps()[0].point_is_in_wake(p.x, p.z, config.anomalies.remap_distance);
1032:             if a.solid != b.solid {
1033:                 assert!(in_wake, "geometry changed ahead of the crossed gate");
1034:                 assert!(lz.abs() > instance.skeleton_half_width);
1035:                 changed += 1;
1036:             } else if !in_wake {
1037:                 unchanged_forward += 1;
1038:             }
1039:             if lz.abs() <= instance.skeleton_half_width {
1040:                 assert!(!a.solid && !b.solid, "bearing lane was blocked");
1041:             }
1042:             lx += 0.4;
1043:         }
1044:         lz += 0.4;
1045:     }
1046:     assert!(changed > 0, "pillar epoch produced no changed wake infill");
1047:     assert!(unchanged_forward > 100);
1048: }

1109: #[test]
1110: fn red_threshold_closes_the_remembered_entrance_into_a_loop() {
1111:     use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::AxisDirection;
1112:     let noise = TestNoise;
1113:     let mut config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
1114:     config.anomalies.pillar_expanses = 0.0;
1115:     config.anomalies.blackouts = 0.0;
1116:     config.anomalies.pit_lattices = 0.0;
1117:     let mut fixture = None;
1118:     for rz in -6i64..=6 {
1119:         for rx in -6i64..=6 {
1120:             let plans = BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(
1121:                 Position::new(rx as f32 * REGION_SIZE, rz as f32 * REGION_SIZE),
1122:                 1.0,
1123:                 42,
1124:                 &config,
1125:                 &noise,
1126:             );
1127:             let plan = &plans.iter().find(|(k, _)| *k == (rx, rz)).unwrap().1;
1128:             if let Some(red) = plan
1129:                 .anomalies
1130:                 .iter()
1131:                 .find(|a| a.kind == AnomalyKind::RedRoom)
1132:             {
1133:                 fixture = Some((plan.clone(), red.clone()));
1134:                 break;
1135:             }
1136:         }
1137:         if fixture.is_some() {
1138:             break;
1139:         }
1140:     }
1141:     let (plan, red) = fixture.expect("red-room fixture");
1142:     let gate = red.gates[0];
1143:     let reality = RealitySnapshot::new(vec![
1144:         crate::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyStateStamp::new(
1145:             red.id,
1146:             1,
1147:             gate.plane,
1148:             gate.axis,
1149:             AxisDirection::Positive,
1150:             crate::domain::entities::anomaly::RedRoomPhase::Sealed,
1151:             0,
1152:             gate.id,
1153:         ),
1154:     ]);
1155:     let entrance = plan
1156:         .assemblies
1157:         .iter()
1158:         .find(|a| a.corruption.red_room)
1159:         .unwrap()
1160:         .entrances[0];
1161:     let open = BackroomsLevel::plan_column_in_reality(
1162:         &plan,
1163:         &noise,
1164:         42,
1165:         &config,
1166:         &RealitySnapshot::empty(),
1167:         entrance.center.x,
1168:         entrance.center.z,
1169:     );
1170:     let closed = BackroomsLevel::plan_column_in_reality(
1171:         &plan,
1172:         &noise,
1173:         42,
1174:         &config,
1175:         &reality,
1176:         entrance.center.x,
1177:         entrance.center.z,
1178:     );
1179:     assert!(!open.solid, "red room is closed before threshold entry");
1180:     assert!(closed.solid, "remembered red-room entrance did not close");
1181: 
1182:     let ring_point = red.world_coords(red.footprint.half_x - 1.0, 0.0);
1183:     let ring = sample_red_room(
1184:         &red,
1185:         ColumnPlan::open(3.4),
1186:         &config,
1187:         &reality,
1188:         ring_point.x,
1189:         ring_point.z,
1190:     );
1191:     assert!(!ring.solid, "closed red room has no traversable loop");
1192:     assert_eq!(
1193:         ring.floor_material, VOXEL_STICKY_CARPET,
1194:         "committed loop lost its red carpet identity"
1195:     );
1196: 
1197:     let mut escape_config = config;
1198:     escape_config.anomalies.red_escape_bias = 1.0;
1199:     let escape_reality = RealitySnapshot::new(vec![
1200:         crate::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyStateStamp::new(
1201:             red.id,
1202:             4,
1203:             gate.plane,
1204:             gate.axis,
1205:             AxisDirection::Positive,
1206:             crate::domain::entities::anomaly::RedRoomPhase::EscapeOpen,
1207:             3,
1208:             red.gates[1].id,
1209:         ),
1210:     ]);
1211:     let side_extent = if gate.axis == crate::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::Z {
1212:         red.footprint.half_x
1213:     } else {
1214:         red.footprint.half_z
1215:     };
1216:     let side_columns = [-side_extent, side_extent].map(|side| {
1217:         let point = if gate.axis == crate::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::Z {
1218:             red.world_coords(side, 0.0)
1219:         } else {
1220:             red.world_coords(0.0, side)
1221:         };
1222:         sample_red_room(
1223:             &red,
1224:             ColumnPlan::open(3.4),
1225:             &escape_config,
1226:             &escape_reality,
1227:             point.x,
1228:             point.z,
1229:         )
1230:     });
1231:     assert_eq!(
1232:         side_columns.iter().filter(|column| !column.solid).count(),
1233:         1,
1234:         "escape phase must open exactly one deterministic side wall"
1235:     );

1238: /// Arch rooms are the stable contrast: pale walls, deep wet carpet, no
1239: /// gates, and geometry provably identical under any encounter state —
1240: /// even a fabricated stamp for their own instance id changes nothing.
1241: #[test]
1242: fn archway_rooms_are_stable_pale_anchors() {
1243:     use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::{AnomalyStateStamp, Axis2, AxisDirection};
1244:     use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{VOXEL_DEEP_CARPET, VOXEL_PALE_WALL};
1245:     let mut config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
1246:     config.anomalies.frequency = 4.0;
1247:     config.anomalies.pillar_expanses = 0.0;
1248:     config.anomalies.blackouts = 0.0;
1249:     config.anomalies.pit_lattices = 0.0;
1250:     let noise = TestNoise;
1251:     let mut found = None;
1252:     'search: for rz in 3i64..24 {
1253:         for rx in 3i64..24 {
1254:             let plans = BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(
1255:                 Position::new(rx as f32 * REGION_SIZE, rz as f32 * REGION_SIZE),
1256:                 1.0,
1257:                 42,
1258:                 &config,
1259:                 &noise,
1260:             );
1261:             if let Some(instance) = plans
1262:                 .iter()
1263:                 .flat_map(|(_, p)| &p.anomalies)
1264:                 .find(|a| a.kind == AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom)
1265:             {
1266:                 found = Some(instance.clone());
1267:                 break 'search;
1268:             }
1269:         }
1270:     }
1271:     let instance = found.expect("no archway fixture found");
1272:     assert!(instance.gates.is_empty(), "arch rooms must carry no gates");
1273:     assert!(instance.arch.is_some());
1274: 
1275:     let forged = RealitySnapshot::new(vec![AnomalyStateStamp::new(
1276:         instance.id,
1277:         7,
1278:         0.0,
1279:         Axis2::X,
1280:         AxisDirection::Positive,
1281:         crate::domain::entities::anomaly::RedRoomPhase::Outside,
1282:         0,
1283:         0,
1284:     )]);
1285:     let empty = RealitySnapshot::empty();
1286:     let mut pale_seen = false;
1287:     let mut carpet_seen = false;
1288:     let mut lz = -instance.footprint.half_z + 0.2;
1289:     while lz < instance.footprint.half_z {
1290:         let mut lx = -instance.footprint.half_x + 0.2;
1291:         while lx < instance.footprint.half_x {
1292:             let p = instance.world_coords(lx, lz);
1293:             let a = sample_anomaly(&instance, &noise, 42, &config, &empty, p.x, p.z);
1294:             let b = sample_anomaly(&instance, &noise, 42, &config, &forged, p.x, p.z);
1295:             assert_eq!(a, b, "archway geometry moved under a forged epoch");
1296:             if a.solid && a.wall_material == VOXEL_PALE_WALL {
1297:                 pale_seen = true;
1298:             }
1299:             if !a.solid && a.floor_material == VOXEL_DEEP_CARPET {
1300:                 carpet_seen = true;
1301:             }
1302:             lx += 0.4;
1303:         }
1304:         lz += 0.4;
1305:     }
1306:     assert!(pale_seen, "no pale arch wall voxelized");
1307:     assert!(carpet_seen, "no deep wet carpet voxelized");
1308: }

1310: /// Arch rooms are stable — and passable and individual. Every non-blind
1311: /// arch of a transition room is a doorway the player can walk through
1312: /// (open at standing height on both long walls), the dead-end variant keeps
1313: /// its one entrance, and profiles vary between instances so no two arcades
1314: /// present the same rhythm.
1315: #[test]
1316: fn archways_are_walkable_and_no_two_arcades_match() {
1317:     use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::ArchLayout;
1318:     let mut config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
1319:     config.anomalies.frequency = 4.0;
1320:     config.anomalies.pillar_expanses = 0.0;
1321:     config.anomalies.blackouts = 0.0;
1322:     config.anomalies.pit_lattices = 0.0;
1323:     let noise = TestNoise;
1324:     let empty = RealitySnapshot::empty();
1325: 
1326:     let mut instances = Vec::new();
1327:     'scan: for rz in 3i64..40 {
1328:         for rx in 3i64..40 {
1329:             let plans = BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(
1330:                 Position::new(rx as f32 * REGION_SIZE, rz as f32 * REGION_SIZE),
1331:                 1.0,
1332:                 42,
1333:                 &config,
1334:                 &noise,
1335:             );
1336:             for instance in plans.iter().flat_map(|(_, p)| &p.anomalies) {
1337:                 if instance.kind == AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom
1338:                     && !instances.iter().any(|a: &AnomalyInstance| a.id == instance.id)
1339:                 {
1340:                     instances.push(instance.clone());
1341:                     if instances.len() >= 8 {
1342:                         break 'scan;
1343:                     }
1344:                 }
1345:             }
1346:         }
1347:     }
1348:     assert!(instances.len() >= 4, "only {} arch rooms found", instances.len());
1349: 
1350:     let mut profiles = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
1351:     let mut openings_walked = 0usize;
1352:     for instance in &instances {
1353:         let arch = instance.arch.expect("arch profile");
1354:         profiles.insert((
1355:             (arch.bay * 10.0) as i64,
1356:             (arch.opening * 10.0) as i64,
1357:             arch.blind_every,
1358:             (arch.spring_units * 10.0) as i64,
1359:             arch.layout == ArchLayout::Transition,
1360:         ));
1361:         let half_x = instance.footprint.half_x;
1362:         let half_z = instance.footprint.half_z;
1363:         match arch.layout {
1364:             ArchLayout::Transition => {
1365:                 // Every non-blind bay center on both long walls is an open,
1366:                 // walkable doorway with standing headroom.
1367:                 let mut bay_index = 0i64;
1368:                 loop {
1369:                     let center = arch.bay * (bay_index as f32 + 0.5);
1370:                     if center + arch.opening * 0.5 >= 2.0 * half_x {
1371:                         break;
1372:                     }
1373:                     let blind =
1374:                         bay_index.rem_euclid(arch.blind_every as i64) == arch.blind_every as i64 - 1;
1375:                     if !blind && center - arch.opening * 0.5 > 0.0 {
1376:                         for side in [-1.0f32, 1.0] {
1377:                             let p = instance
1378:                                 .world_coords(center - half_x, side * (half_z - 0.1));
1379:                             let plan =
1380:                                 sample_anomaly(instance, &noise, 42, &config, &empty, p.x, p.z);
1381:                             assert!(
1382:                                 !plan.solid,
1383:                                 "arch opening walled shut in {:x} bay {bay_index}",
1384:                                 instance.id
1385:                             );
1386:                             let head = plan.lintel_from_units.expect("arch head");
1387:                             assert!(
1388:                                 head >= 2.0,
1389:                                 "arch head {head} too low to walk through in {:x}",
1390:                                 instance.id
1391:                             );
1392:                             openings_walked += 1;
1393:                         }
1394:                     }
1395:                     bay_index += 1;
1396:                 }
1397:             }
1398:             ArchLayout::DeadEnd => {
1399:                 let p = instance.world_coords(-(half_x - 0.1), 0.0);
1400:                 let plan = sample_anomaly(instance, &noise, 42, &config, &empty, p.x, p.z);
1401:                 assert!(!plan.solid, "dead-end entrance sealed in {:x}", instance.id);
1402:                 assert!(plan.lintel_from_units.unwrap_or(0.0) >= 2.0);
1403:             }
1404:         }
1405:     }
1406:     assert!(openings_walked >= 8, "only {openings_walked} openings verified");
1407:     assert!(
1408:         profiles.len() >= instances.len() - 1,
1409:         "arcades repeat themselves: {} profiles for {} rooms",
1410:         profiles.len(),
1411:         instances.len()
1412:     );
1413: }

1415: /// Pillar expanses read calmer than ordinary Level 0 (dry shallow
1416: /// carpet) and the protected bearing lane carries an unbroken light
1417: /// rhythm — the route is architecture, not an invisible collision lane.
1418: #[test]
1419: fn pillar_expanse_is_dry_and_its_bearing_lane_is_lit_in_rhythm() {
1420:     use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::VOXEL_DRY_CARPET;
1421:     let (config, instance) = find_macro_anomaly(AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse);
1422:     let noise = TestNoise;
1423:     let empty = RealitySnapshot::empty();
1424:     let interior = instance.world_coords(1.0, 1.0);
1425:     let plan = sample_anomaly(
1426:         &instance, &noise, 42, &config, &empty, interior.x, interior.z,
1427:     );
1428:     assert_eq!(plan.floor_material, VOXEL_DRY_CARPET);
1429: 
1430:     // Every 4.8u lane module inside the footprint carries a panel.
1431:     let mut modules = 0usize;
1432:     let mut lit = 0usize;
1433:     let mut lx = (-instance.footprint.half_x / 4.8).ceil() * 4.8 + 2.4;
1434:     while lx < instance.footprint.half_x - instance.entry_band {
1435:         if lx.abs() < instance.footprint.half_x - instance.entry_band {
1436:             let p = instance.world_coords(lx, 0.0);
1437:             let c = sample_anomaly(&instance, &noise, 42, &config, &empty, p.x, p.z);
1438:             modules += 1;
1439:             if c.light {
1440:                 lit += 1;
1441:             }
1442:         }
1443:         lx += 4.8;
1444:     }
1445:     assert!(modules >= 8, "sample too small: {modules}");
1446:     assert!(
1447:         lit * 10 >= modules * 8,
1448:         "bearing lane rhythm is broken: {lit}/{modules} modules lit"
1449:     );
1450: }

1452: /// Blackout cues are semantic: skeleton fixtures voxelize as cool
1453: /// glimmers, the approach keeps warm office light, and committed-depth
1454: /// floors pool recessed fluid somewhere.
1455: #[test]
1456: fn blackout_cues_are_glimmers_and_floors_pool_fluid() {

1458:     let (config, instance) = find_macro_anomaly(AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse);

1464:     while lx < instance.footprint.half_x {
1465:         let p = instance.world_coords(lx, 0.0);

1496: /// A reality in which every fabric drift cell of a world window has
1497: /// rearranged, with epochs deliberately mixed so cell boundaries between
1498: /// different epochs are exercised.
1499: fn drifted_reality(min_cell: i64, max_cell: i64) -> RealitySnapshot {
1500:     let mut reality = RealitySnapshot::empty();
1501:     for cz in min_cell..=max_cell {
1502:         for cx in min_cell..=max_cell {
1503:             for _ in 0..=((cx + cz).rem_euclid(3) as u32) {
1504:                 reality = reality.with_fabric_drift_advanced(cx, cz);
1505:             }
1506:         }
1507:     }
1508:     reality
1509: }
1510: 
1511: /// The Peripheral Shift: after territory drifts, ordinary fabric has
1512: /// genuinely rearranged — but every planned system (corridors, assemblies
1513: /// and their thresholds, the spawn opening sequence) is byte-identical.
1514: /// "Days of traveled hallways" never replay; the navigation skeleton does.
1515: #[test]
1516: fn peripheral_shift_rearranges_fabric_but_never_the_plan() {
1517:     let noise = TestNoise;
1518:     let config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
1519:     let plans =
1520:         BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(Position::new(0.0, 0.0), REGION_SIZE, 42, &config, &noise);
1521:     let plan_for = |wx: f32, wz: f32| {
1522:         &plans
1523:             .iter()
1524:             .find(|(k, _)| *k == (region_index(wx), region_index(wz)))
1525:             .unwrap()
1526:             .1
1527:     };
1528:     // Drift cells 0..=1 on each axis (world 0..80); leave the rest pristine.
1529:     let reality = drifted_reality(0, 1);
1530:     let sp = crate::use_cases::region_plan::spawn_point(42);
1531: 
1532:     let mut fabric_changed = 0usize;
1533:     let mut fabric_compared = 0usize;
1534:     for sz in 0..200 {
1535:         for sx in 0..200 {
1536:             let (wx, wz) = (sx as f32 * 0.6 + 0.3, sz as f32 * 0.6 + 0.3);
1537:             let plan = plan_for(wx, wz);
1538:             let before = BackroomsLevel::plan_column_in_reality(
1539:                 plan,
1540:                 &noise,
1541:                 42,
1542:                 &config,
1543:                 &RealitySnapshot::empty(),
1544:                 wx,
1545:                 wz,
1546:             );
1547:             let after =
1548:                 BackroomsLevel::plan_column_in_reality(plan, &noise, 42, &config, &reality, wx, wz);
1549: 
1550:             // Corridor interiors never drift. Their edge band is
1551:             // indeterminate here: where the edge opens, the band is fabric
1552:             // and may lawfully drift, so the band is asserted neither way.
1553:             let corridor_interior = plan
1554:                 .corridors
1555:                 .iter()
1556:                 .any(|s| s.distance(wx, wz) <= s.width * 0.5);
1557:             let corridor_band = !corridor_interior
1558:                 && plan
1559:                     .corridors
1560:                     .iter()
1561:                     .any(|s| s.distance(wx, wz) <= s.width * 0.5 + PLAN_WALL_T);
1562:             if corridor_band {
1563:                 continue;
1564:             }
1565:             let planned = corridor_interior
1566:                 || plan.assemblies.iter().any(|a| {
1567:                     let b = a.footprint.bounds();
1568:                     let m = PLAN_WALL_T + 0.05;
1569:                     wx >= b.0 - m && wx <= b.2 + m && wz >= b.1 - m && wz <= b.3 + m
1570:                 })
1571:                 || plan
1572:                     .anomalies
1573:                     .iter()
1574:                     .any(|a| a.footprint.bounds().expanded(3.2 + 0.1).contains(wx, wz));
1575:             let near_spawn = (wx - sp.x).powi(2) + (wz - sp.z).powi(2) < 26.0 * 26.0;
1576:             // Fabric decisions anchor at their own lattice cell's center, so
1577:             // a column within one fabric cell of the drifted area may share
1578:             // a decision with it. Only columns clear of that band must be
1579:             // untouched; columns inside the band are asserted neither way.
1580:             let drift_edge = 2.0 * 40.0;
1581:             let outside_drift = wx > drift_edge + FABRIC_CELL || wz > drift_edge + FABRIC_CELL;
1582:             let boundary_band = !outside_drift && (wx > drift_edge || wz > drift_edge);
1583:             if boundary_band {
1584:                 continue;
1585:             }
1586: 
1587:             if planned || near_spawn || outside_drift {
1588:                 assert_eq!(
1589:                     before, after,
1590:                     "Peripheral Shift touched protected space at ({wx}, {wz})"
1591:                 );
1592:             } else {
1593:                 fabric_compared += 1;
1594:                 if before != after {
1595:                     fabric_changed += 1;
1596:                 }
1597:             }
1598:         }
1599:     }
1600:     assert!(fabric_compared > 2000, "sample too small: {fabric_compared}");
1601:     // Walls are 0.4 u bands on a 7.2 u lattice, so even a full re-deal
1602:     // moves only a few percent of *columns* — what matters is that many
1603:     // whole walls and doorways moved, not that the map inverted.
1604:     assert!(
1605:         fabric_changed * 50 >= fabric_compared,
1606:         "drift barely rearranged the fabric: {fabric_changed}/{fabric_compared}"
1607:     );
1608: }
1609: 
1610: /// The binary-tree connectivity rule holds per fabric cell at *any* epoch,
1611: /// including across boundaries between differently drifted cells: every
1612: /// warren cell still opens through its west or its north wall.
1613: #[test]
1614: fn fabric_stays_connected_through_mixed_drift_epochs() {
1615:     let noise = TestNoise;
1616:     let tuning = LevelTuning::default();
1617:     let reality = drifted_reality(-4, 4);
1618:     let mut cells_checked = 0usize;
1619:     for cell_x in -20i64..20 {
1620:         for cell_z in -20i64..20 {
1621:             let x0 = cell_x as f32 * FABRIC_CELL;
1622:             let z0 = cell_z as f32 * FABRIC_CELL;
1623:             let mut open = false;
1624:             let mut a = PLAN_WALL_T + 0.1;
1625:             while a < FABRIC_CELL - PLAN_WALL_T {
1626:                 for (wx, wz) in [(x0 + 0.2, z0 + a), (x0 + a, z0 + 0.2)] {
1627:                     if !BackroomsLevel::column_plan_in_reality(
1628:                         &noise, 42, &tuning, &reality, wx, wz,
1629:                     )
1630:                     .solid
1631:                     {
1632:                         open = true;
1633:                     }
1634:                 }
1635:                 a += 0.2;
1636:             }
1637:             assert!(
1638:                 open,
1639:                 "drifted fabric cell ({cell_x},{cell_z}) sealed both its west and north walls"
1640:             );
1641:             cells_checked += 1;
1642:         }
1643:     }
1644:     assert!(cells_checked > 1000, "sample too small: {cells_checked}");
1645: }

1647: /// Strain is the price of mismanaged provisions: at delirium tier 3 the
1648: /// binary-tree doorway guarantee itself erodes, and a meaningful share of
1649: /// warren cells seal both their west and north walls into dead-end
1650: /// pockets. A provisioned wanderer (tier 0) keeps the full guarantee.
1651: #[test]
1652: fn deep_strain_seals_doorways_into_dead_end_pockets() {
1653:     let noise = TestNoise;
1654:     let tuning = LevelTuning::default();
1655:     let sealed_cells = |reality: &RealitySnapshot| {
1656:         let mut sealed = 0usize;
1657:         for cell_x in -20i64..20 {
1658:             for cell_z in -20i64..20 {
1659:                 let x0 = cell_x as f32 * FABRIC_CELL;
1660:                 let z0 = cell_z as f32 * FABRIC_CELL;
1661:                 let mut open = false;
1662:                 let mut a = PLAN_WALL_T + 0.1;
1663:                 while a < FABRIC_CELL - PLAN_WALL_T {
1664:                     for (wx, wz) in [(x0 + 0.2, z0 + a), (x0 + a, z0 + 0.2)] {
1665:                         if !BackroomsLevel::column_plan_in_reality(
1666:                             &noise, 42, &tuning, reality, wx, wz,
1667:                         )
1668:                         .solid
1669:                         {
1670:                             open = true;
1671:                         }
1672:                     }
1673:                     a += 0.2;
1674:                 }
1675:                 sealed += usize::from(!open);
1676:             }
1677:         }
1678:         sealed
1679:     };
1680:     assert_eq!(
1681:         sealed_cells(&RealitySnapshot::empty()),
1682:         0,
1683:         "an unstrained fabric must keep the binary-tree guarantee"
1684:     );
1685:     let strained = sealed_cells(&RealitySnapshot::empty().with_delirium(3));
1686:     assert!(
1687:         strained >= 40,
1688:         "deep strain grew too few dead-end pockets: {strained}"
1689:     );
1690:     let mild = sealed_cells(&RealitySnapshot::empty().with_delirium(1));
1691:     assert!(
1692:         mild < strained,
1693:         "strain must escalate: tier 1 sealed {mild}, tier 3 sealed {strained}"
1694:     );
1695: }
1696: 
1697: /// Deep strain hides slips: sub-door-width slots in walls that offer no
1698: /// doorway at all. Doors are never narrower than 1.4 u, so any open span
1699: /// under ~1.1 u in a surviving wall is a slip — and none may exist while
1700: /// the wanderer is provisioned.
1701: #[test]
1702: fn deep_strain_hides_narrow_slips_in_solid_walls() {
1703:     let noise = TestNoise;
1704:     let tuning = LevelTuning::default();
1705:     let slip_spans = |reality: &RealitySnapshot| {
1706:         let mut slips = 0usize;
1707:         for cell_x in -20i64..20 {
1708:             for cell_z in -20i64..20 {
1709:                 // Walk this cell's west wall band and measure contiguous
1710:                 // open runs between the junction posts.
1711:                 let wx = cell_x as f32 * FABRIC_CELL + 0.2;
1712:                 let z0 = cell_z as f32 * FABRIC_CELL;
1713:                 let mut run = 0usize;
1714:                 let mut step = 0usize;
1715:                 while step <= (FABRIC_CELL * 10.0) as usize {
1716:                     let wz = z0 + step as f32 * 0.1;
1717:                     let solid = BackroomsLevel::column_plan_in_reality(
1718:                         &noise, 42, &tuning, reality, wx, wz,
1719:                     )
1720:                     .solid;
1721:                     if !solid {
1722:                         run += 1;
1723:                     } else {
1724:                         if (3..=11).contains(&run) {
1725:                             slips += 1;
1726:                         }
1727:                         run = 0;
1728:                     }
1729:                     step += 1;
1730:                 }
1731:             }
1732:         }
1733:         slips
1734:     };
1735:     // A handful of sub-door spans occur naturally where the expanse
1736:     // boundary clips the tail of a wall run; the strained fabric must grow
1737:     // far more of them — the deliberate slips.
1738:     let calm = slip_spans(&RealitySnapshot::empty());
1739:     let strained = slip_spans(&RealitySnapshot::empty().with_delirium(3));
1740:     assert!(
1741:         strained >= calm + 20,
1742:         "deep strain hid too few secret slips: {strained} vs a calm {calm}"
1743:     );
1744: }

1746: /// The corridor's mouths onto the fabric are Peripheral Shift territory:
1747: /// the drift epoch re-deals their width and phase, and deep strain narrows
1748: /// the survivors and seals whole sections — while the spawn opening
1749: /// sequence keeps its walls in every reality.
1750: #[test]
1751: fn corridor_mouths_drift_with_epochs_and_seal_under_strain() {
1752:     use crate::domain::entities::architecture::CirculationSpine;
1753:     use crate::use_cases::region_plan::spawn_point;
1754: 
1755:     let noise = TestNoise;
1756:     let spine = CirculationSpine {
1757:         id: 7,
1758:         spine_kind: SpaceProgram::MainCorridor,
1759:         path: vec![Position::new(-640.0, 2000.0), Position::new(640.0, 2000.0)],
1760:         width: 5.6,
1761:     };
1762:     let wz = 2002.0;
1763:     let calm = RealitySnapshot::empty();
1764:     let parched = calm.with_delirium(3);
1765:     let mut shifted = RealitySnapshot::empty();
1766:     for cx in -17..=17 {
1767:         shifted = shifted.with_fabric_drift_advanced(cx, (wz / 40.0) as i64);
1768:     }
1769: 
1770:     let mouth_open = |reality: &RealitySnapshot, wx: f32| {
1771:         BackroomsLevel::corridor_edge_opens(&spine, &noise, 42, reality, wx, true, wx, wz)
1772:     };
1773:     let (mut calm_open, mut parched_open, mut moved) = (0usize, 0usize, 0usize);
1774:     let mut samples = 0usize;
1775:     let mut wx = -640.0f32;
1776:     while wx < 640.0 {
1777:         let open_now = mouth_open(&calm, wx);
1778:         calm_open += usize::from(open_now);
1779:         parched_open += usize::from(mouth_open(&parched, wx));
1780:         moved += usize::from(open_now != mouth_open(&shifted, wx));
1781:         samples += 1;
1782:         wx += 0.4;
1783:     }
1784:     assert!(samples > 3000 && calm_open > 300, "sample too small");
1785:     assert!(
1786:         moved > 0,
1787:         "a drift epoch must re-deal at least one corridor mouth"
1788:     );
1789:     assert!(
1790:         parched_open * 10 < calm_open * 9,
1791:         "deep strain barely closed the mouths: {parched_open}/{calm_open}"
1792:     );
1793: 
1794:     // The spawn opening sequence stays sacred through drift and strain.
1795:     let sp = spawn_point(42);
1796:     let home = CirculationSpine {
1797:         id: 7,
1798:         spine_kind: SpaceProgram::MainCorridor,
1799:         path: vec![
1800:             Position::new(sp.x - 100.0, sp.z),
1801:             Position::new(sp.x + 100.0, sp.z),
1802:         ],
1803:         width: 5.6,
1804:     };
1805:     for reality in [&calm, &parched, &shifted] {
1806:         assert!(
1807:             !BackroomsLevel::corridor_edge_opens(
1808:                 &home, &noise, 42, reality, sp.x, true, sp.x, sp.z
1809:             ),
1810:             "spawn-readable corridor walls must hold in every reality"
1811:         );
1812:     }

1815: /// A strained reality is stingier: each tier lowers the supply-cell
1816: /// acceptance threshold under the *same* hash, so deep strain withholds
1817: /// bottles the calm world offered instead of shuffling them elsewhere.
1818: #[test]
1819: fn deep_strain_withholds_supply_cells_the_calm_world_offered() {
1820:     use crate::use_cases::anomalies::determinism::{hash, unit};
1821: 
1822:     let noise = TestNoise;
1823:     let config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
1824:     let calm = RealitySnapshot::empty();
1825:     let parched = calm.with_delirium(3);
1826:     // Default tuning: cell chance is 0.72 calm and 0.72 * 0.55 strained, so
1827:     // a cell whose roll lands between them is offered only to the calm
1828:     // world. Hunt one whose candidate spot actually stamps (open floor).
1829:     let mut verified = false;
1830:     'cells: for cz in 5i64..60 {
1831:         for cx in 5i64..60 {
1832:             let roll = hash(42, 0x0A1A_09D0_57A7_0000, cx, cz);
1833:             if !(0.45..0.65).contains(&unit(roll)) {
1834:                 continue;
1835:             }
1836:             let probe = hash(42, 0x0A1A_09D0_0000_0000, cx, cz);
1837:             let px = (cx as f32 + 0.06 + 0.88 * unit(probe)) * 40.0;
1838:             let pz = (cz as f32 + 0.06 + 0.88 * unit(probe.rotate_left(23))) * 40.0;
1839:             let chunk = Position::new(
1840:                 (px / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size,
1841:                 (pz / config.chunk_size).floor() * config.chunk_size,
1842:             );
1843:             let id = roll | 1;
1844:             let offered = BackroomsLevel
1845:                 .generate_with_reality(chunk, 42, config, &noise, &calm)
1846:                 .supply_items
1847:                 .iter()
1848:                 .any(|item| item.id == id);
1849:             if !offered {
1850:                 // The spot rolled onto solid or anomalous ground; keep
1851:                 // hunting — the assertion needs a supply that really exists.
1852:                 continue;
1853:             }
1854:             let strained = BackroomsLevel
1855:                 .generate_with_reality(chunk, 42, config, &noise, &parched)
1856:                 .supply_items
1857:                 .iter()
1858:                 .any(|item| item.id == id);
1859:             assert!(
1860:                 !strained,
1861:                 "cell ({cx},{cz}) must be withheld from a strained reality"
1862:             );
1863:             verified = true;
1864:             break 'cells;
1865:         }
1866:     }
1867:     assert!(verified, "no in-band supply cell stamped; widen the hunt");
1868: }

1870: /// Geometry priority is not presentation priority: the main corridor stays
1871: /// carved open through a blackout (you can always walk it), but past the
1872: /// approach band the blackout owns the dark — the corridor's light strips
1873: /// die like every other fixture, so circulation never reads as a lit
1874: /// tunnel through the anomaly.
1875: #[test]
1876: fn a_blackout_owns_the_dark_even_over_the_main_corridor() {
1877:     use crate::domain::entities::architecture::{CirculationSpine, RegionPlan};
1878:     let (config, instance) = find_macro_anomaly(AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse);
1879:     let noise = TestNoise;
1880:     let center = instance.footprint.center;
1881:     let start_x = center.x - 300.0;
1882:     let plan = RegionPlan {
1883:         origin_world: Position::new(0.0, 0.0),
1884:         size_world: 80.0,
1885:         architects: Vec::new(),
1886:         assemblies: Vec::new(),
1887:         corridors: vec![CirculationSpine {
1888:             id: 0,
1889:             spine_kind: SpaceProgram::MainCorridor,
1890:             path: vec![
1891:                 Position::new(start_x, center.z),
1892:                 Position::new(center.x + 300.0, center.z),
1893:             ],
1894:             width: 5.6,
1895:         }],
1896:         anomalies: vec![instance.clone()],
1897:     };
1898:     let reality = RealitySnapshot::empty();
1899: 
1900:     let mut dark_deep_modules = 0usize;
1901:     let mut lit_outside_modules = 0usize;
1902:     let first_module = (start_x / 4.0).ceil() * 4.0;
1903:     for k in 0..150i64 {
1904:         // Strip modules follow the corridor in *world* space: light where
1905:         // the absolute coordinate along the run satisfies along % 4 < 1.
1906:         let wx = first_module + 4.0 * k as f32 + 0.5;
1907:         let wz = center.z;
1908:         let column =
1909:             BackroomsLevel::plan_column_in_reality(&plan, &noise, 42, &config, &reality, wx, wz);
1910:         assert!(!column.solid, "main corridor blocked at ({wx}, {wz})");
1911:         if instance.contains(wx, wz) && instance.normalized_depth(wx, wz) > 0.25 {
1912:             assert!(
1913:                 !column.light,
1914:                 "corridor light strip survives deep blackout at ({wx}, {wz})"
1915:             );
1916:             dark_deep_modules += 1;
1917:         } else if !instance.contains(wx, wz) {
1918:             lit_outside_modules += usize::from(column.light);
1919:         }
1920:     }
1921:     assert!(
1922:         dark_deep_modules >= 5,
1923:         "corridor barely crossed the dark core ({dark_deep_modules} modules)"
1924:     );
1925:     assert!(
1926:         lit_outside_modules >= 10,
1927:         "corridor strips outside the blackout must stay lit ({lit_outside_modules})"
1928:     );
1929: }

1931: /// Inside a blackout the same drift stamps rearrange the substrate — the
1932: /// space changes behind the player in real time — while the recovery
1933: /// skeleton stays open in every epoch, so the way out is architecture,
1934: /// never luck.
1935: #[test]
1936: fn blackout_substrate_drifts_but_its_recovery_skeleton_never_does() {
1937:     let (config, instance) = find_macro_anomaly(AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse);
1938:     let noise = TestNoise;
1939:     let empty = RealitySnapshot::empty();
1940:     let bounds = instance.footprint.bounds();
1941:     let min_cx = (bounds.min_x / 40.0).floor() as i64 - 1;
1942:     let max_cx = (bounds.max_x / 40.0).floor() as i64 + 1;
1943:     let min_cz = (bounds.min_z / 40.0).floor() as i64 - 1;
1944:     let max_cz = (bounds.max_z / 40.0).floor() as i64 + 1;
1945:     let mut reality = RealitySnapshot::empty();
1946:     for cz in min_cz..=max_cz {
1947:         for cx in min_cx..=max_cx {
1948:             reality = reality.with_fabric_drift_advanced(cx, cz);
1949:         }
1950:     }
1951: 
1952:     // Step 0.4 u: the fabric's wall bands are 0.4 u wide on a 7.2 u
1953:     // lattice, and a coarser stride can cycle past every band forever.
1954:     let mut changed = 0usize;
1955:     let half_span = instance.footprint.half_x.min(40.0);
1956:     let mut lz = -instance.footprint.half_z + 1.0;
1957:     while lz < instance.footprint.half_z - 1.0 {
1958:         let mut lx = -half_span;
1959:         while lx < half_span {
1960:             let p = instance.world_coords(lx, lz);
1961:             let before = sample_anomaly(&instance, &noise, 42, &config, &empty, p.x, p.z);
1962:             let after = sample_anomaly(&instance, &noise, 42, &config, &reality, p.x, p.z);
1963:             if lz.abs() <= instance.skeleton_half_width {
1964:                 assert!(!before.solid && !after.solid, "recovery skeleton blocked");
1965:             } else if before.solid != after.solid {
1966:                 changed += 1;
1967:             }
1968:             lx += 0.4;
1969:         }
1970:         lz += 0.4;
1971:     }
1972:     assert!(
1973:         changed > 40,
1974:         "blackout interior barely drifted ({changed} columns changed)"
1975:     );
1976: }

1978: /// Institution age steers decay: old territory keeps meaningfully fewer of
1979: /// its fluorescents alive than young territory. The wiki's endless hum is
1980: /// not uniform — some wings are almost maintained, some run on remnants.
1981: #[test]
1982: fn old_territory_has_more_dead_lights_than_young_territory() {
1983:     use crate::use_cases::world_topology::institution_age_at;
1984:     let noise = TestNoise;
1985:     let tuning = LevelTuning::default();
1986:     let mut young = (0usize, 0usize); // (alive, sites)
1987:     let mut old = (0usize, 0usize);
1988:     for kz in -220i64..220 {
1989:         for kx in -220i64..220 {
1990:             // Dense-grid light sites sit at period/2 + k*period.
1991:             let wx = 1.4 + kx as f32 * 2.8 + 0.2;
1992:             let wz = 1.4 + kz as f32 * 2.8 + 0.2;
1993:             if BackroomsLevel::in_expanse(&noise, 42, wx, wz) {
1994:                 continue;
1995:             }
1996:             let column = BackroomsLevel::column_plan(&noise, 42, &tuning, wx, wz);
1997:             if column.solid {
1998:                 continue;
1999:             }
2000:             let age = institution_age_at(&noise, 42, wx, wz);
2001:             let bucket = if age < 0.35 {
2002:                 &mut young
2003:             } else if age > 0.65 {
2004:                 &mut old
2005:             } else {
2006:                 continue;
2007:             };
2008:             bucket.0 += usize::from(column.light);
2009:             bucket.1 += 1;
2010:         }
2011:     }
2012:     assert!(young.1 > 400 && old.1 > 400, "sample too small: {young:?} {old:?}");
2013:     let young_rate = young.0 as f32 / young.1 as f32;
2014:     let old_rate = old.0 as f32 / old.1 as f32;
2015:     assert!(
2016:         old_rate < young_rate * 0.82,
2017:         "age barely steers decay: young {young_rate:.3} vs old {old_rate:.3}"
2018:     );
2019: }

2021: /// Ordinary fabric now derives its wall/floor materials from
2022: /// `EnvironmentProfile` instead of hardcoded constants, with
2023: /// `institution_age` (sampled at each column's own `FABRIC_CELL` anchor)
2024: /// steering a real decay gradient: old wings should show
2025: /// `VOXEL_AGED_WALLPAPER`/`VOXEL_STAINED_CARPET`, young wings the ordinary
2026: /// `VOXEL_WALL`/`VOXEL_FLOOR`.
2027: #[test]
2028: fn old_territory_shows_stained_ordinary_materials() {
2029:     use crate::use_cases::world_topology::institution_age_at;
2030:     let noise = TestNoise;
2031:     let tuning = LevelTuning::default();
2032:     let (mut fresh_wall, mut aged_wall) = (false, false);
2033:     let (mut fresh_floor, mut aged_floor) = (false, false);
2034:     for kz in -40i64..40 {
2035:         for kx in -40i64..40 {
2036:             let anchor_x = (kx as f32 + 0.5) * FABRIC_CELL;
2037:             let anchor_z = (kz as f32 + 0.5) * FABRIC_CELL;
2038:             if BackroomsLevel::in_expanse(&noise, 42, anchor_x, anchor_z) {
2039:                 continue;
2040:             }
2041:             let age = institution_age_at(&noise, 42, anchor_x, anchor_z);
2042:             let base_x = kx as f32 * FABRIC_CELL;
2043:             let base_z = kz as f32 * FABRIC_CELL;
2044:             // A near-wall-band offset and a room-center offset per cell, so
2045:             // both a solid and a floor column get a chance every iteration
2046:             // (fabric-lattice-test-stride pitfall: a single fixed offset can
2047:             // land in the same relative spot forever and miss a class of
2048:             // column entirely).
2049:             for (ox, oz) in [(0.05, 3.6), (3.6, 3.6)] {
2050:                 let column =
2051:                     BackroomsLevel::column_plan(&noise, 42, &tuning, base_x + ox, base_z + oz);
2052:                 if column.solid {
2053:                     if age < 0.35 {
2054:                         fresh_wall |= column.wall_material == VOXEL_WALL;
2055:                     } else if age > 0.65 {
2056:                         aged_wall |= column.wall_material == VOXEL_AGED_WALLPAPER;
2057:                     }
2058:                 } else if age < 0.35 {
2059:                     fresh_floor |= column.floor_material == VOXEL_FLOOR;
2060:                 } else if age > 0.65 {
2061:                     aged_floor |= column.floor_material == VOXEL_STAINED_CARPET;
2062:                 }
2063:             }
2064:         }
2065:     }
2066:     assert!(fresh_wall, "no fresh (young-territory) wall column sampled");
2067:     assert!(aged_wall, "no aged (old-territory) wall column sampled");
2068:     assert!(fresh_floor, "no fresh (young-territory) floor column sampled");
2069:     assert!(aged_floor, "no aged (old-territory) floor column sampled");
2070: }

2102: /// The four structural systems must produce genuinely different column
2103: /// layouts, not the same `(bay, bay)` grid relabeled. `CoreAndShell` exists
2104: /// to give a big clear span (`BackroomsLevel::on_column` refuses every
2105: /// column for it — see below); `OffsetGrid` staggers alternate rows by half
2106: /// a bay; both must differ from `RegularGrid`'s plain grid even when every
2107: /// other input (bay size, phase, column side) is identical.
2108: #[test]
2109: fn structural_systems_place_columns_differently() {
2110:     use crate::domain::entities::architecture::{StructuralSystem, StructuralSystemInstance};
2111: 
2112:     let base = |system: StructuralSystem| StructuralSystemInstance {
2113:         system,
2114:         bay_x: 5.0,
2115:         bay_z: 5.0,
2116:         phase: (0.0, 0.0),
2117:         column_side: 0.6,
2118:     };
2119:     let sample = |system: StructuralSystem| -> Vec<(i32, i32)> {
2120:         let instance = base(system);
2121:         let mut hits = Vec::new();
2122:         for row in 0..6 {
2123:             for col in 0..6 {
2124:                 let (wx, wz) = (col as f32 * 1.7, row as f32 * 1.7);
2125:                 if BackroomsLevel::on_column(&instance, wx, wz) {
2126:                     hits.push((col, row));
2127:                 }
2128:             }
2129:         }
2130:         hits
2131:     };
2132: 
2133:     let regular = sample(StructuralSystem::RegularGrid);
2134:     let offset = sample(StructuralSystem::OffsetGrid);
2135:     let core_and_shell = sample(StructuralSystem::CoreAndShell);
2136:     let deep_spans = sample(StructuralSystem::DeepSpansWithBeams);
2137: 
2138:     assert!(
2139:         !regular.is_empty(),
2140:         "a regular grid over this sample area must place at least one column"
2141:     );
2142:     assert!(
2143:         core_and_shell.is_empty(),
2144:         "core-and-shell must have zero interior columns, found {core_and_shell:?}"
2145:     );
2146:     assert_ne!(
2147:         regular, offset,
2148:         "offset grid produced the same column positions as a regular grid"
2149:     );
2150:     assert_eq!(
2151:         regular, deep_spans,
2152:         "deep-spans-with-beams should place columns identically to a regular \
2153:          grid at equal bay_x/bay_z (its bay elongation is decided upstream in \
2154:          structure_for, not by on_column)"
2155:     );
2156: }
````

````rust
  1: //! In-wasm chunk source: implements the application's [`ChunkSourcePort`] by
  2: //! driving the core engine use cases directly. There is no server round-trip;
  3: //! the entire pipeline — procedural generation, renderer-selected artifacts,
  4: //! SVO build, and collision extraction — runs inside the wasm module.
  5: //!
  6: //! Pipeline per chunk:
  7: //!   GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase  (haloed VoxelGrid + lighting)
  8: //!     -> BuildOctreeUseCase           (always: collision authority)
  9: //!        -> collision walk            (solid leaves -> world-space AABBs)

 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     fn generate_payload(
 71:         &self,
 72:         origin_x: f32,
 73:         origin_z: f32,
 74:         level: u32,
 75:         lod: u8,
 76:         reality: &RealitySnapshot,
 77:         artifacts: RenderArtifactNeeds,
 78:     ) -> ChunkPayload {
 79:         let config = self.config.with_level(level).at_lod(lod);
 80:         let generator =
 81:             GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::with_telemetry(&self.noise, self.telemetry);
 82: 
 83:         // Generate one extra voxel around the X/Z perimeter, then crop the
 84:         // authoritative interior for SVO/collision. The greedy mesher reads
 85:         // the halo while deciding boundary faces, so it never invents a face
 86:         // merely because the adjacent streamed chunk has not uploaded yet.
 87:         let halo_config = GeneratorConfig {
 88:             chunk_size: config.chunk_size + config.voxel_scale * 2.0,
 89:             ..config
 90:         };
 91:         let halo_world_origin = [
 92:             origin_x - config.voxel_scale,
 93:             0.0,
 94:             origin_z - config.voxel_scale,
 95:         ];
 96:         let halo_grid = generator.execute_with_reality(
 97:             Position::new(halo_world_origin[0], halo_world_origin[2]),
 98:             self.seed,
 99:             halo_config,
100:             reality,
101:         );
102:         let grid = crop_lateral_halo(&halo_grid, 1);
103:         let lights = collect_emissive_lights(&halo_grid, config.voxel_scale, halo_world_origin, 1);
104:         let surface = if artifacts.needs_surface_extraction() {
105:             build_surface_artifacts(&halo_grid, config.voxel_scale, lod, 1, artifacts)
106:         } else {
107:             let mut empty = SurfaceMeshPayload::empty(lod);
108:             empty.voxel_scale = config.voxel_scale;
109:             empty
110:         };
111: 
112:         let svo_depth = config.svo_depth();
113:         let svo = BuildOctreeUseCase::new().execute(&grid, svo_depth, config.svo_world_size());
114: 
115:         let (root, nodes) = if artifacts.svo_nodes() {
116:             (
117:                 svo.root as u32,
118:                 OctreeGpuSerializer::serialize_to_gpu_data(&svo).texel_data,
119:             )
120:         } else {
121:             (0, Vec::new())
122:         };
123:         let collision = extract_collision_boxes(&svo, origin_x, origin_z, config.voxel_scale);
124: 
125:         ChunkPayload {
126:             root,
127:             nodes,
128:             world_size: config.svo_world_size(),
129:             voxel_size: config.voxel_scale,
130:             svo_depth: svo_depth as u8,
131:             surface,
132:             lights,
133:             collision,
134:             traversal_gates: halo_grid.traversal_gates.clone(),
135:             pit_hazards: halo_grid.pit_hazards.clone(),
136:             supply_items: halo_grid.supply_items.clone(),
137:             level_exits: halo_grid.level_exits.clone(),
138:         }
139:     }
140: }
141: 
142: impl<N: NoiseProvider> ChunkSourcePort for LocalChunkSource<N> {
143:     fn load(&self, origin_x: f32, origin_z: f32, level: u32, lod: u8) -> ChunkPayload {
144:         self.generate_payload(
145:             origin_x,
146:             origin_z,
147:             level,
148:             lod,
149:             &RealitySnapshot::default(),
150:             RenderArtifactNeeds::ALL,
151:         )
152:     }
153: 
154:     fn load_with_reality(
155:         &self,
156:         origin_x: f32,
157:         origin_z: f32,
158:         level: u32,
159:         lod: u8,
160:         reality: &RealitySnapshot,
161:     ) -> ChunkPayload {
162:         self.generate_payload(
163:             origin_x,
164:             origin_z,
165:             level,
166:             lod,
167:             reality,
168:             RenderArtifactNeeds::ALL,
169:         )
170:     }
171: 
172:     fn load_with_artifacts(
173:         &self,
174:         origin_x: f32,
175:         origin_z: f32,
176:         level: u32,
177:         lod: u8,
178:         reality: &RealitySnapshot,
179:         artifacts: RenderArtifactNeeds,
180:     ) -> ChunkPayload {
181:         self.generate_payload(origin_x, origin_z, level, lod, reality, artifacts)
182:     }
183: }

185: /// Copies the actual chunk interior out of a generated X/Z halo while
186: /// retaining voxel type and colored baked lighting, then deriving exact
187: /// six-direction neighbor occupancy while the halo is still available.
188: fn crop_lateral_halo(halo: &VoxelGrid, padding: usize) -> VoxelGrid {
189:     assert!(halo.width() > padding * 2 && halo.depth() > padding * 2);
190:     let mut inner = VoxelGrid::new(
191:         halo.width() - padding * 2,
192:         halo.height(),
193:         halo.depth() - padding * 2,
194:     );
195:     for z in 0..inner.depth() {
196:         for y in 0..inner.height() {
197:             for x in 0..inner.width() {
198:                 let hx = x + padding;
199:                 let hz = z + padding;
200:                 inner.set(x, y, z, halo.get(hx, y, hz));
201:                 inner.set_light_rgb(x, y, z, halo.get_light_rgb(hx, y, hz));
202:                 inner.set_face_occlusion(x, y, z, neighbor_occlusion_mask(halo, hx, y, hz));
203:             }
204:         }
205:     }
206:     inner
207: }
208: 
209: /// Exact face closure for one generated voxel, including the lateral halo.
210: ///
211: /// The returned bits travel unchanged through BuildOctree and the GPU atlas.
212: /// Computing them before the crop is what makes a streamed chunk boundary
213: /// authoritative even while its adjacent chunk is unloaded or represented by
214: /// an overlapping power-of-two padded SVO root.
215: fn neighbor_occlusion_mask(grid: &VoxelGrid, x: usize, y: usize, z: usize) -> u8 {
216:     if grid.get(x, y, z) == VOXEL_AIR {
217:         return 0;
218:     }
219: 
220:     let occupied = |x: isize, y: isize, z: isize| {
221:         x >= 0
222:             && y >= 0
223:             && z >= 0
224:             && (x as usize) < grid.width()
225:             && (y as usize) < grid.height()
226:             && (z as usize) < grid.depth()
227:             && grid.get(x as usize, y as usize, z as usize) != VOXEL_AIR
228:     };
229:     let x = x as isize;
230:     let y = y as isize;
231:     let z = z as isize;
232:     let mut mask = 0;
233:     if occupied(x + 1, y, z) {
234:         mask |= FACE_OCCLUDED_POSITIVE_X;
235:     }
236:     if occupied(x - 1, y, z) {
237:         mask |= FACE_OCCLUDED_NEGATIVE_X;
238:     }
239:     if occupied(x, y + 1, z) {
240:         mask |= FACE_OCCLUDED_POSITIVE_Y;
241:     }
242:     if occupied(x, y - 1, z) {
243:         mask |= FACE_OCCLUDED_NEGATIVE_Y;
244:     }
245:     if occupied(x, y, z + 1) {
246:         mask |= FACE_OCCLUDED_POSITIVE_Z;
247:     }
248:     if occupied(x, y, z - 1) {
249:         mask |= FACE_OCCLUDED_NEGATIVE_Z;
250:     }
251:     mask
252: }
253: 
254: /// Walks the SVO and emits one world-space AABB per solid leaf region.
255: /// Uniform subtrees collapsed by the SVO become single large boxes for free,
256: /// which keeps the collision set small.
257: pub fn extract_collision_boxes(
258:     svo: &SparseVoxelOctree,
259:     origin_x: f32,
260:     origin_z: f32,
261:     voxel_scale: f32,
262: ) -> Vec<Aabb> {
263:     let mut boxes = Vec::new();
264:     let size = 1u32 << svo.depth;
265:     walk(
266:         svo,
267:         svo.root,
268:         0,
269:         0,
270:         0,
271:         size,
272:         origin_x,
273:         origin_z,
274:         voxel_scale,
275:         &mut boxes,
276:     );
277:     boxes
278: }
279: 
280: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
281: fn walk(
282:     svo: &SparseVoxelOctree,
283:     node_idx: usize,
284:     x: u32,
285:     y: u32,
286:     z: u32,
287:     size: u32,
288:     origin_x: f32,
289:     origin_z: f32,
290:     voxel_scale: f32,
291:     out: &mut Vec<Aabb>,
292: ) {
293:     match svo.nodes[node_idx] {
294:         SvoNode::Leaf { voxel_type, .. } => {
295:             if SOLID_TYPES.contains(&voxel_type) {
296:                 let min = [
297:                     origin_x + x as f32 * voxel_scale,
298:                     y as f32 * voxel_scale,
299:                     origin_z + z as f32 * voxel_scale,
300:                 ];
301:                 let extent = size as f32 * voxel_scale;
302:                 out.push(Aabb::new(
303:                     min,
304:                     [min[0] + extent, min[1] + extent, min[2] + extent],
305:                 ));
306:             }
307:         }
308:         SvoNode::Internal {
309:             child_base_index,
310:             child_mask,
311:         } => {
312:             let half = size / 2;
313:             for child in 0..8u32 {
314:                 if child_mask & (1 << child) != 0 {
315:                     walk(
316:                         svo,
317:                         child_base_index as usize + child as usize,
318:                         x + (child & 1) * half,
319:                         y + ((child >> 1) & 1) * half,
320:                         z + ((child >> 2) & 1) * half,
321:                         half,
322:                         origin_x,
323:                         origin_z,
324:                         voxel_scale,
325:                         out,
326:                     );
327:                 }
328:             }
329:         }
330:     }
331: }
````

````rust
  1: //! URL query → generation settings. Lets players share worlds by URL:
  2: //!
  3: //! `?seed=1234&voxel_size=0.1&pillars=0.5&walls=1.2&anomalies=0.8`
  4: //!
  5: //! * `seed`    — world seed (u32; any text is hashed so words work too).
  6: //! * `spec`    — shared case-insensitive `low`/`high` quality decision.
  7: //! * `pillars` — structural column density multiplier (0 = none).
  8: //! * `walls`   — office wall density multiplier (0 = open plan).
  9: //! * `atria`   — how much of the world vaults into tall atria.
 10: //! * `lights`  — ceiling light panel density.
 11: //! * `voxel_size` — optional scene resolution in world units. The selected
 12: //!   profile remains in force when the value violates generator limits.
 13: //! * `anomalies`, `anomaly_size` and the per-family knobs control Level 0
 14: //!   phenomena without changing ordinary fabric density.
 15: //! * `remap_intensity`, `remap_distance` and `anomaly_safe_radius` control
 16: //!   deterministic traversal-epoch transformations.
 17: //!
 18: //! Multipliers default to 1.0 and are clamped to 0..=4; physical distances
 19: //! use narrower documented ranges. Kept free of
 20: //! web-sys so it is natively unit-tested; the browser driver only hands in
 21: //! `window.location.search`.
 22: 
 23: use vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind;
 24: use vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::{AnomalyTuning, GeneratorConfig, LevelTuning};
 25: 
 26: use crate::application::quality::QualityProfile;
 27: 
 28: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
 29: pub struct GenerationParams {
 30:     pub seed: u32,
 31:     pub voxel_size: Option<f32>,
 32:     pub tuning: LevelTuning,
 33:     pub anomalies: AnomalyTuning,
 34: }
 35: 
 36: /// Exact-key lookup in a location search string (`?a=1&b=2`, leading `?`
 37: /// optional). Every query consumer must go through this (or an equivalent
 38: /// `split('&')` loop): raw `str::find("key=")` substring probes have caused
 39: /// settings to apply that nobody asked for — `?spawn_yaw=2` silently
 40: /// matching `yaw=`, values containing `capture=1`, and the like.
 41: pub fn query_param<'a>(query: &'a str, key: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
 42:     query
 43:         .trim_start_matches('?')
 44:         .split('&')
 45:         .find_map(|pair| match pair.split_once('=') {
 46:             Some((k, v)) if k == key => Some(v),
 47:             _ => None,
 48:         })
 49: }
 50: 
 51: /// True when the query holds exactly `key=1`.
 52: pub fn query_flag(query: &str, key: &str) -> bool {
 53:     query_param(query, key) == Some("1")
 54: }
 55: 
 56: /// Parses `window.location.search` (with or without the leading `?`).
 57: /// Unknown keys are ignored; malformed values fall back to defaults.
 58: pub fn parse_generation_params(query: &str, default_seed: u32) -> GenerationParams {
 59:     let mut params = GenerationParams {
 60:         seed: default_seed,
 61:         voxel_size: None,
 62:         tuning: LevelTuning::default(),
 63:         anomalies: AnomalyTuning::default(),
 64:     };
 65: 
 66:     for pair in query.trim_start_matches('?').split('&') {
 67:         let Some((key, value)) = pair.split_once('=') else {
 68:             continue;
 69:         };
 70:         let knob = |t: &mut f32| {
 71:             if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<f32>() {
 72:                 if v.is_finite() {
 73:                     *t = v.clamp(0.0, 4.0);
 74:                 }
 75:             }
 76:         };
 77:         let ranged = |t: &mut f32, min: f32, max: f32| {
 78:             if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<f32>() {
 79:                 if v.is_finite() {
 80:                     *t = v.clamp(min, max);
 81:                 }
 82:             }
 83:         };
 84:         match key {
 85:             "seed" => {
 86:                 params.seed = value.parse::<u32>().unwrap_or_else(|_| hash_seed(value));
 87:             }
 88:             "voxel_size" => {
 89:                 params.voxel_size = value.parse::<f32>().ok().filter(|v| v.is_finite());
 90:             }
 91:             "pillars" => knob(&mut params.tuning.pillars),
 92:             "walls" => knob(&mut params.tuning.walls),
 93:             "atria" => knob(&mut params.tuning.atria),
 94:             "lights" => knob(&mut params.tuning.lights),
 95:             // World provisioning: drink, food, and level-door frequency.
 96:             // 0 removes that class of content entirely.
 97:             "almond_water" => knob(&mut params.tuning.almond_water),
 98:             "rations" => knob(&mut params.tuning.rations),
 99:             "level_doors" => knob(&mut params.tuning.level_doors),
100:             "anomalies" => knob(&mut params.anomalies.frequency),
101:             "anomaly_size" => ranged(&mut params.anomalies.size, 0.5, 2.0),
102:             "pillar_expanses" => knob(&mut params.anomalies.pillar_expanses),
103:             "blackouts" => knob(&mut params.anomalies.blackouts),
104:             "red_rooms" => knob(&mut params.anomalies.red_rooms),
105:             "pit_lattices" => knob(&mut params.anomalies.pit_lattices),
106:             "remap_intensity" => knob(&mut params.anomalies.remap_intensity),
107:             "remap_distance" => ranged(&mut params.anomalies.remap_distance, 4.0, 64.0),
108:             "anomaly_safe_radius" => ranged(&mut params.anomalies.safe_radius, 4.0, 32.0),
109:             // Gameplay tuning: the probability per closed-loop epoch that a
110:             // red room hashes a single far-side escape breach. 0 seals every
111:             // loop, 1 guarantees a breach; it is never the entrance.
112:             "red_escape_bias" => ranged(&mut params.anomalies.red_escape_bias, 0.0, 1.0),
113:             "archways" => knob(&mut params.anomalies.archways),
114:             // Deception: the fraction of blackout glimmers placed one
115:             // segment off the recovery skeleton. The default is high on
116:             // purpose — most glimmers lie.
117:             "blackout_decoys" => ranged(&mut params.anomalies.blackout_decoys, 0.0, 0.9),
118:             // Debug: guarantee one anomaly of this family on the spawn's
119:             // macro cell (settings menu "Spawn anomaly"). Unknown values
120:             // leave the world untouched.
121:             "force_anomaly" => {
122:                 params.anomalies.forced_kind = match value {
123:                     "pillars" => Some(AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse),
124:                     "blackout" => Some(AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse),
125:                     "pits" => Some(AnomalyKind::PitLattice),
126:                     "archway" => Some(AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom),
127:                     "redroom" => Some(AnomalyKind::RedRoom),
128:                     _ => None,
129:                 };
130:             }
131:             _ => {}
132:         }
133:     }
134:     params
135: }
136: 
137: /// Seed + generator configuration derived from the URL query. The main
138: /// thread and every generation worker call this with the same query string,
139: /// so all of them voxelize the identical world by construction.
140: pub fn generator_setup_from_query(query: &str, default_seed: u32) -> (u32, GeneratorConfig) {
141:     generator_setup_for_quality(query, default_seed, quality_profile_from_query(query))
142: }
143: 
144: /// Parses the shared `?spec=low|high` decision. Values are case-insensitive,
145: /// matching renderer selection, while malformed or missing values retain the
146: /// established low-profile default.
147: pub fn quality_profile_from_query(query: &str) -> QualityProfile {
148:     query_param(query, "spec")
149:         .and_then(QualityProfile::parse)
150:         .unwrap_or_default()
151: }
152: 
153: /// Resolves generation from an already parsed quality decision. The browser
154: /// composition root uses this together with renderer profile construction so
155: /// both sides are guaranteed to observe the same value.
156: pub fn generator_setup_for_quality(
157:     query: &str,
158:     default_seed: u32,
159:     quality: QualityProfile,
160: ) -> (u32, GeneratorConfig) {
161:     let params = parse_generation_params(query, default_seed);
162:     let base = match quality {
163:         QualityProfile::Low => GeneratorConfig::low_spec(),
164:         QualityProfile::High => GeneratorConfig::high_spec(),
165:     };
166:     let configured = base
167:         .with_tuning(params.tuning)
168:         .with_anomalies(params.anomalies);
169:     let configured = params
170:         .voxel_size
171:         .and_then(|voxel_size| configured.try_with_voxel_size(voxel_size).ok())
172:         .unwrap_or(configured);
173:     (params.seed, configured)
174: }
175: 
176: /// Non-numeric seeds ("?seed=kitten") hash to a stable u32 (FNV-1a).
177: fn hash_seed(text: &str) -> u32 {
178:     let mut h: u32 = 0x811C_9DC5;
179:     for b in text.bytes() {
180:         h ^= b as u32;
181:         h = h.wrapping_mul(0x0100_0193);
182:     }
183:     h
184: }
185:

192:         let p = parse_generation_params("", 42);
193:         assert_eq!(p.seed, 42);
194:         assert_eq!(p.voxel_size, None);

202:         // capture yaw, and any value containing `capture=1` froze the game.
203:         assert_eq!(query_param("?spawn_yaw=2&pitch2=9", "yaw"), None);
204:         assert_eq!(query_param("?spawn_yaw=2&yaw=0.5", "yaw"), Some("0.5"));
205:         assert_eq!(query_param("?note=capture=1", "capture"), None);
````

## File: wasm_frontend/Cargo.toml
````toml
  1: # wasm_frontend — the browser front end of the voxel engine.
  2: #
  3: # Clean Architecture placement:
  4: #   application/  Use-case layer for the interactive client (player physics,
  5: #                 chunk streaming policy, frame orchestration). Pure Rust,
  6: #                 unit-tested natively. Defines the ports (RendererPort,
  7: #                 ChunkSourcePort) that outer layers implement.
  8: #   adapters/     Interface adapters: input mapping, SVO atlas assembly, and
  9: #                 the local chunk source that drives the `vackrooms` core
 10: #                 use cases (generation -> collision SVO -> renderer-selected
 11: #                 presentation artifacts).
 12: #   drivers/      Frameworks & Drivers: portable WebGPU pipelines plus browser
 13: #                 surface/event/rAF plumbing. DOM-facing code is wasm-only;
 14: #                 native Vulkan tests execute the same pipeline modules.
 15: [package]
 16: name = "wasm_frontend"
 17: version = "0.1.0"
 18: edition = "2024"
 19: 
 20: [lib]
 21: crate-type = ["cdylib", "rlib"]
 22: 
 23: [features]
 24: vulkan-tests = []
 25: 
 26: [[test]]
 27: name = "vulkan_renderers"
 28: path = "tests/vulkan_renderers.rs"
 29: required-features = ["vulkan-tests"]
 30: 
 31: [dependencies]
 32: bytemuck = { version = "1.25", features = ["derive"] }
 33: image = { version = "0.25.10", default-features = false, features = ["png"] }
 34: vackrooms = { path = ".." }
 35: 
 36: # Keep the portable renderer pipelines buildable on the host. Native tests
 37: # select Vulkan explicitly and render into headless textures; the `play`
 38: # binary opens a real window through winit.
 39: [target.'cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))'.dependencies]
 40: wgpu = { version = "30.0", default-features = false, features = ["std", "vulkan", "wgsl"] }
 41: winit = "0.30"
 42: pollster = "1.0"
 43: # Rasterizes the vendored Bytesized face into the native HUD glyph atlas.
 44: fontdue = "0.9"
 45: 
 46: # Browser bindings are wasm-only so `cargo test` on the host runs the pure
 47: # application/adapters layers without pulling in web-sys.
 48: [target.'cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")'.dependencies]
 49: wasm-bindgen = "0.2"
 50: js-sys = "0.3"
 51: console_error_panic_hook = "0.1"
 52: wasm-bindgen-futures = "0.4"
 53: wgpu = { version = "30.0", default-features = false, features = ["std", "webgpu", "wgsl"] }
 54: web-sys = { version = "0.3", features = [
 55:     "Window",
 56:     "Location",
 57:     "Document",
 58:     "Element",
 59:     "HtmlElement",
 60:     "HtmlCanvasElement",
 61:     "CssStyleDeclaration",
 62:     "Event",
 63:     "EventTarget",
 64:     "KeyboardEvent",
 65:     "MouseEvent",
 66:     "TouchEvent",
 67:     "TouchList",
 68:     "Touch",
 69:     "Navigator",
 70:     "Performance",
 71:     "Worker",
 72:     "WorkerOptions",
 73:     "WorkerType",
 74:     "MessageEvent",
 75:     "console",
 76:     "Storage",
 77:     "CanvasRenderingContext2d",
 78:     "ImageData",
 79:     "WebGl2RenderingContext",
 80:     "WebGlProgram",
 81:     "WebGlQuery",
 82:     "WebGlShader",
 83:     "WebGlTexture",
 84:     "WebGlBuffer",
 85:     "WebGlVertexArrayObject",
 86:     "WebGlUniformLocation",
 87:     "WebGlFramebuffer",
 88: ] }
 89: 
 90: [dev-dependencies]
 91: pollster = "1.0"
 92: # Parallel pixel loops for the path-traced reference example.
 93: rayon = "1.10"
 94: criterion = "0.8"
 95: 
 96: [[bench]]
 97: name = "generation"
 98: harness = false
 99: 
100: [[bench]]
101: name = "rendering"
102: harness = false
````
