## File: wasm_frontend/src/lib.rs
````rust
   1: //! # wasm_frontend — browser client for the vackrooms voxel engine
   2: //!
   3: //! This crate is the *outer rings* of the engine's Clean Architecture when it
   4: //! runs in a browser. The dependency rule points strictly inward:
   5: //!
   6: //! ```text
   7: //! drivers (portable WebGPU + wasm DOM)  <- outer layer
   8: //!    |
   9: //! adapters (input mapping, SVO atlas, local chunk source)
  10: //!    |
  11: //! application (player physics, streaming policy, frame orchestration, ports)
  12: //!    |
  13: //! vackrooms core (entities + use cases: VoxelGrid, SVO, generation, lighting)
  14: //! ```
  15: //!
  16: //! * `application` and `adapters` are platform-agnostic and unit-tested with
  17: //!   plain `cargo test` on the host.
  18: //! * Portable WebGPU pipeline/configuration modules also compile natively for
  19: //!   headless Vulkan tests; DOM, events, surfaces, and rAF remain wasm-only.
  20: //! * The `#[wasm_bindgen(start)]` entry point below is the composition root:
  21: //!   it wires concrete drivers into the application's ports.
  22: 
  23: pub mod adapters;
  24: pub mod application;
  25: pub mod drivers;
  26: pub mod reference;
  27: 
  28: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  29: use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU32, Ordering};
  30: 
  31: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  32: pub static DOOM_CONTROLS: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
  33: 
  34: /// Mouse look inversion (Y axis).
  35: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  36: pub static INVERT_Y: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
  37: 
  38: /// Mouse sensitivity multiplier, stored as f32 bits. 1.0 = default.
  39: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  40: pub static MOUSE_SENSITIVITY_BITS: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0x3F80_0000); // 1.0f32
  41: 
  42: /// Manual internal-resolution override as f32 bits; 0.0 = automatic
  43: /// (adaptive governor).
  44: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  45: pub static RENDER_SCALE_BITS: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0);
  46: 
  47: /// Anomaly debug overlay visibility (settings switch and the F3 key).
  48: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  49: pub static ANOMALY_DEBUG: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
  50: 
  51: /// Accessibility: automatic consumption of carried supplies when a vital
  52: /// runs low. Off by default — drinking and eating are deliberate acts. The
  53: /// frame loop forwards this to the engine each HUD refresh.
  54: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  55: pub static ASSISTED_CONSUMPTION: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
  56: 
  57: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  58: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
  59: pub fn set_anomaly_debug(enabled: bool) {
  60:     ANOMALY_DEBUG.store(enabled, Ordering::Relaxed);
  61: }
  62: 
  63: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  64: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
  65: pub fn set_assisted_consumption(enabled: bool) {
  66:     ASSISTED_CONSUMPTION.store(enabled, Ordering::Relaxed);
  67: }
  68: 
  69: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  70: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
  71: pub fn set_doom_controls(enabled: bool) {
  72:     DOOM_CONTROLS.store(enabled, Ordering::Relaxed);
  73: }
  74: 
  75: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  76: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
  77: pub fn set_invert_y(enabled: bool) {
  78:     INVERT_Y.store(enabled, Ordering::Relaxed);
  79: }
  80: 
  81: /// Mouse/touch look sensitivity multiplier (clamped to 0.1–5.0).
  82: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  83: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
  84: pub fn set_mouse_sensitivity(multiplier: f32) {
  85:     let m = if multiplier.is_finite() {
  86:         multiplier.clamp(0.1, 5.0)
  87:     } else {
  88:         1.0
  89:     };
  90:     MOUSE_SENSITIVITY_BITS.store(m.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
  91: }
  92: 
  93: /// Forces the internal render resolution scale (0.25–1.0), or restores the
  94: /// adaptive governor when `scale` is 0.
  95: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  96: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
  97: pub fn set_render_scale(scale: f32) {
  98:     let s = if scale.is_finite() && scale > 0.0 {
  99:         scale.clamp(0.25, 1.0)
 100:     } else {
 101:         0.0
 102:     };
 103:     RENDER_SCALE_BITS.store(s.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 104: }
 105: 
 106: /// CPU render settings are atomics only at the browser boundary. Every

 108: /// the splatter itself never reads these globals.

 115: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]

 117: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]

 121: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]

 177: }

 179: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 180: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 181: pub fn set_cpu_shadows(mode: u32) {
 182:     update_cpu_settings(|settings| {
 183:         settings.shadows = crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuShadowMode::from_id(mode);
 184:     });
 185: }
 186: 
 187: /// Renderer optimization toggles as a bitfield — see
 188: /// [`application::render_settings::RenderToggles`]. Initialized from the URL
 189: /// query at boot; the settings menu flips individual switches afterwards.
 190: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 191: pub static RENDER_TOGGLE_BITS: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(u32::MAX);
 192: 
 193: /// Flips one renderer optimization switch by name (`"hiz"`, `"f2b"`,
 194: /// `"skip"`, `"mips"`, `"beam_occlusion"`, `"shadows"`, `"cells"`,
 195: /// `"deferred"`, `"ao"`, `"cull"`, `"budget"`, `"dither"`, and `"bake"`).
 196: /// Unknown names are ignored.
 197: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 198: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 199: pub fn set_render_toggle(name: &str, enabled: bool) {
 200:     let mut toggles = get_render_toggles();
 201:     toggles.set(name, enabled);
 202:     RENDER_TOGGLE_BITS.store(toggles.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 203: }
 204: 
 205: /// Returns one renderer switch by its short URL name. This small diagnostic
 206: /// export lets the settings UI and browser smoke tests verify the effective
 207: /// state after URL and local-preference overrides have been composed.
 208: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 209: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 210: pub fn render_toggle_enabled(name: &str) -> Option<bool> {
 211:     get_render_toggles().enabled(name)
 212: }
 213: 
 214: /// Snapshot of the toggle switchboard, taken once per frame by each driver
 215: /// and passed by value into the platform-free render code.
 216: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 217: pub fn get_render_toggles() -> crate::application::render_settings::RenderToggles {
 218:     let bits = RENDER_TOGGLE_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
 219:     if bits == u32::MAX {
 220:         crate::application::render_settings::RenderToggles::default()
 221:     } else {
 222:         crate::application::render_settings::RenderToggles::from_bits(bits)
 223:     }
 224: }
 225: 
 226: /// Boot-time initialization from the URL query (`?rt_<name>=0|1`).
 227: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 228: pub fn init_render_toggles(query: &str) {
 229:     let toggles = crate::application::render_settings::parse_render_toggles(query);
 230:     RENDER_TOGGLE_BITS.store(toggles.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 231: }
 232: 
 233: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 234: pub fn get_cpu_settings() -> crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuRenderSettings {
 235:     let scale = f32::from_bits(CPU_SCALE_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
 236:     let lod_cutoff = f32::from_bits(CPU_LOD_CUTOFF_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
 237:     let max_splat_radius = f32::from_bits(CPU_MAX_SPLAT_RADIUS_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
 238:     let max_virtual_depth = CPU_MAX_VIRTUAL_DEPTH.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as u8;
 239:     let min_mip_occupancy = f32::from_bits(CPU_MIN_MIP_OCCUPANCY_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
 240:     let max_draw_dist = f32::from_bits(CPU_MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
 241:     let shadow_mode = CPU_SHADOWS.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
 242: 
 243:     crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuRenderSettings {
 244:         internal_scale: scale,
 245:         lod_cutoff_px: lod_cutoff,
 246:         max_splat_radius_px: max_splat_radius,
 247:         max_virtual_depth,
 248:         min_mip_occupancy,
 249:         max_draw_distance: max_draw_dist,
 250:         shadows: crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuShadowMode::from_id(shadow_mode),
 251:         ..crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuRenderSettings::default()
 252:     }
 253:     .validated()
 254: }
 255: 
 256: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 257: fn update_cpu_settings(update: impl FnOnce(&mut crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuRenderSettings)) {
 258:     let mut settings = get_cpu_settings();
 259:     update(&mut settings);
 260:     store_cpu_settings(settings);
 261: }
 262: 
 263: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 264: fn store_cpu_settings(settings: crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuRenderSettings) {
 265:     let settings = settings.validated();
 266:     CPU_SCALE_BITS.store(settings.internal_scale.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 267:     CPU_LOD_CUTOFF_BITS.store(settings.lod_cutoff_px.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 268:     CPU_MAX_SPLAT_RADIUS_BITS.store(settings.max_splat_radius_px.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 269:     CPU_MAX_VIRTUAL_DEPTH.store(settings.max_virtual_depth as u32, Ordering::Relaxed);
 270:     CPU_MIN_MIP_OCCUPANCY_BITS.store(settings.min_mip_occupancy.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 271:     CPU_MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE_BITS.store(settings.max_draw_distance.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 272:     CPU_SHADOWS.store(settings.shadows.id(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 273: }

 275: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 276: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 277: pub fn get_blueprint_svg(seed: u32, rx: i32, rz: i32, voxel_scale: f32, size_world: f32) -> String {
 278:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 279:     let plan = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 280:         seed,
 281:         vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(rx as f32 * size_world, rz as f32 * size_world),
 282:         size_world,
 283:         &vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec(),
 284:         &noise,
 285:     );
 286:     let chunk_size = if voxel_scale <= 0.1 { 20.0 } else { 10.0 };
 287:     let mut chunk_bounds = Vec::new();
 288:     let steps = (size_world / chunk_size).round() as i32;
 289:     for i in 0..steps {
 290:         for j in 0..steps {
 291:             let min_x = rx as f32 * size_world + i as f32 * chunk_size;
 292:             let min_z = rz as f32 * size_world + j as f32 * chunk_size;
 293:             let chunk_coord_x = (min_x / chunk_size).round() as i64;
 294:             let chunk_coord_z = (min_z / chunk_size).round() as i64;
 295:             chunk_bounds.push(vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::ChunkBounds {
 296:                 min_x,
 297:                 min_z,
 298:                 max_x: min_x + chunk_size,
 299:                 max_z: min_z + chunk_size,
 300:                 label: format!("[{}, {}]", chunk_coord_x, chunk_coord_z),
 301:             });
 302:         }
 303:     }
 304: 
 305:     let options = vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintOptions {
 306:         pixels_per_unit: 10.0,
 307:         show_chunk_grid: true,
 308:         show_fixtures: true,
 309:         show_structure: true,
 310:         seed,
 311:         level: 0,
 312:         voxel_scale,
 313:     };
 314:     vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::render_region_blueprint_svg(
 315:         &plan,
 316:         &chunk_bounds,
 317:         options,
 318:     )
 319: }

 321: /// Compact geometry feed for the canvas debug map. This deliberately returns
 322: /// planning primitives rather than SVG so the page can redraw cheaply while
 323: /// panning, zooming, or changing overlays.
 324: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 325: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 326: pub fn get_debug_region_json(seed: u32, region_x: i32, region_z: i32) -> String {
 327:     use std::fmt::Write;
 328:     use vackrooms::domain::entities::architecture::SpaceProgram;
 329: 
 330:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 331:     let size = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::REGION_SIZE;
 332:     let origin =
 333:         vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(region_x as f32 * size, region_z as f32 * size);
 334:     let config = vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
 335:     let plan = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 336:         seed, origin, size, &config, &noise,
 337:     );
 338:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(8192);
 339:     write!(
 340:         out,
 341:         "{{\"origin\":[{:.1},{:.1}],\"size\":{:.1},\"walls\":[",
 342:         origin.x, origin.z, size
 343:     )
 344:     .unwrap();
 345:     let mut first = true;
 346:     for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 347:         let vertices = &assembly.footprint.vertices;
 348:         for pair in vertices
 349:             .iter()
 350:             .zip(vertices.iter().cycle().skip(1))
 351:             .take(vertices.len())
 352:         {
 353:             if !first {
 354:                 out.push(',');
 355:             }
 356:             first = false;
 357:             write!(
 358:                 out,
 359:                 "[{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1}]",
 360:                 pair.0.0, pair.0.1, pair.1.0, pair.1.1
 361:             )
 362:             .unwrap();
 363:         }
 364:     }
 365:     out.push_str("],\"corridors\":[");
 366:     first = true;
 367:     for corridor in &plan.corridors {
 368:         for pair in corridor.path.windows(2) {
 369:             if !first {
 370:                 out.push(',');
 371:             }
 372:             first = false;
 373:             write!(
 374:                 out,
 375:                 "[{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1}]",
 376:                 pair[0].x, pair[0].z, pair[1].x, pair[1].z, corridor.width
 377:             )
 378:             .unwrap();
 379:         }
 380:     }
 381:     out.push_str("],\"lights\":[");
 382:     first = true;
 383:     for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 384:         for fixture in &assembly.fixtures {
 385:             if !first {
 386:                 out.push(',');
 387:             }
 388:             first = false;
 389:             write!(
 390:                 out,
 391:                 "[{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{}]",
 392:                 fixture.at.x, fixture.at.z, fixture.half_x, fixture.half_z, fixture.lit
 393:             )
 394:             .unwrap();
 395:         }
 396:     }
 397:     out.push_str("],\"rooms\":[");
 398:     first = true;
 399:     for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 400:         let b = assembly.footprint.bounds();
 401:         if !first {
 402:             out.push(',');
 403:         }
 404:         first = false;
 405:         let kind = match assembly.program {
 406:             SpaceProgram::MainCorridor => "corridor",
 407:             SpaceProgram::AbandonedExpansion => "abandoned",
 408:             _ => "room",
 409:         };
 410:         write!(
 411:             out,
 412:             "[{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},\"{}\"]",
 413:             b.0, b.1, b.2, b.3, kind
 414:         )
 415:         .unwrap();
 416:     }
 417:     out.push_str("],\"anomalies\":[");
 418:     first = true;
 419:     for anomaly in &plan.anomalies {
 420:         if !first {
 421:             out.push(',');
 422:         }
 423:         first = false;
 424:         let b = anomaly.footprint.bounds();
 425:         write!(
 426:             out,
 427:             "[\"{:?}\",\"{:016x}\",{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{}]",
 428:             anomaly.kind,
 429:             anomaly.id,
 430:             b.min_x,
 431:             b.min_z,
 432:             b.max_x,
 433:             b.max_z,
 434:             anomaly.gates.len(),
 435:         )
 436:         .unwrap();
 437:     }
 438:     out.push_str("]}");
 439:     out
 440: }
 441: 
 442: /// Debug payload for one generated chunk: a compact material slice plus the
 443: /// plan objects that explain why those voxels were placed.
 444: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 445: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 446: pub fn get_debug_chunk_json(seed: u32, chunk_x: f32, chunk_z: f32, voxel_scale: f32) -> String {
 447:     use std::fmt::Write;
 448:     use vackrooms::domain::entities::architecture::SpaceProgram;
 449:     use vackrooms::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{
 450:         VOXEL_CEILING, VOXEL_DAMAGED_WALL, VOXEL_DEEP_CARPET, VOXEL_DRY_CARPET, VOXEL_FLOOR,
 451:         VOXEL_FLUID, VOXEL_GLIMMER, VOXEL_GRASS, VOXEL_LIGHT, VOXEL_PALE_WALL, VOXEL_RED_LIGHT,
 452:         VOXEL_RED_WALL, VOXEL_STICKY_CARPET, VOXEL_TREE, VOXEL_WALL, VOXEL_WATER,
 453:     };
 454: 
 455:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 456:     let config = if voxel_scale <= 0.1 {
 457:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::high_spec()
 458:     } else {
 459:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec()
 460:     };
 461:     let chunk_origin = vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(chunk_x, chunk_z);
 462:     let generator =
 463:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::new(&noise);
 464:     let grid = generator.execute(chunk_origin, seed, config.clone());
 465:     let region_size = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::REGION_SIZE;
 466:     let region_origin = vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(
 467:         (chunk_x / region_size).floor() * region_size,
 468:         (chunk_z / region_size).floor() * region_size,
 469:     );
 470:     let plan = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 471:         seed,
 472:         region_origin,
 473:         region_size,
 474:         &config,
 475:         &noise,
 476:     );
 477:     let width = grid.width().saturating_sub(2);
 478:     let depth = grid.depth().saturating_sub(2);
 479:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(width * depth + 4096);
 480:     write!(
 481:         out,
 482:         "{{\"origin\":[{:.1},{:.1}],\"scale\":{:.3},\"width\":{},\"depth\":{},\"cells\":\"",
 483:         chunk_x, chunk_z, voxel_scale, width, depth
 484:     )
 485:     .unwrap();
 486:     // One top-down material per column. Priority keeps red lights and walls
 487:     // visible while still exposing floor/ceiling coverage in the same slice.
 488:     for z in 0..depth {
 489:         for x in 0..width {
 490:             let mut material = b'.';
 491:             for y in 0..grid.height() {
 492:                 material = match grid.get(x + 1, y, z + 1) {
 493:                     VOXEL_RED_LIGHT => b'R',
 494:                     VOXEL_LIGHT => b'L',
 495:                     VOXEL_GLIMMER => b'g',
 496:                     VOXEL_RED_WALL => b'X',
 497:                     VOXEL_WALL | VOXEL_TREE => b'#',
 498:                     VOXEL_PALE_WALL => b'P',
 499:                     VOXEL_DAMAGED_WALL => b'D',
 500:                     VOXEL_CEILING => {
 501:                         if material == b'.' {
 502:                             b'^'
 503:                         } else {
 504:                             material
 505:                         }
 506:                     }
 507:                     VOXEL_FLOOR | VOXEL_GRASS | VOXEL_WATER => {
 508:                         if material == b'.' {
 509:                             b'_'
 510:                         } else {
 511:                             material
 512:                         }
 513:                     }
 514:                     VOXEL_DRY_CARPET => {
 515:                         if material == b'.' {
 516:                             b','
 517:                         } else {
 518:                             material
 519:                         }
 520:                     }
 521:                     VOXEL_DEEP_CARPET | VOXEL_STICKY_CARPET => {
 522:                         if material == b'.' {
 523:                             b'~'
 524:                         } else {
 525:                             material
 526:                         }
 527:                     }
 528:                     VOXEL_FLUID => {
 529:                         if material == b'.' {
 530:                             b'w'
 531:                         } else {
 532:                             material
 533:                         }
 534:                     }
 535:                     _ => material,
 536:                 };
 537:             }
 538:             out.push(material as char);
 539:         }
 540:     }
 541:     out.push_str("\",\"corridors\":[");
 542:     let mut first = true;
 543:     for corridor in &plan.corridors {
 544:         for pair in corridor.path.windows(2) {
 545:             if !first {
 546:                 out.push(',');
 547:             }
 548:             first = false;
 549:             write!(
 550:                 out,
 551:                 "[{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{}]",
 552:                 (pair[0].x - chunk_x) / voxel_scale,
 553:                 (pair[0].z - chunk_z) / voxel_scale,
 554:                 (pair[1].x - chunk_x) / voxel_scale,
 555:                 (pair[1].z - chunk_z) / voxel_scale,
 556:                 corridor.width / voxel_scale,
 557:                 if corridor.spine_kind == SpaceProgram::MainCorridor {
 558:                     0
 559:                 } else {
 560:                     1
 561:                 }
 562:             )
 563:             .unwrap();
 564:         }
 565:     }
 566:     out.push_str("],\"boxes\":[");
 567:     first = true;
 568:     let mut box_out = |kind: &str, label: &str, bounds: (f32, f32, f32, f32), color: u8| {
 569:         if !first {
 570:             out.push(',');
 571:         }
 572:         first = false;
 573:         write!(
 574:             out,
 575:             "[\"{}\",\"{}\",{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{}]",
 576:             kind,
 577:             label,
 578:             (bounds.0 - chunk_x) / voxel_scale,
 579:             (bounds.1 - chunk_z) / voxel_scale,
 580:             (bounds.2 - bounds.0) / voxel_scale,
 581:             (bounds.3 - bounds.1) / voxel_scale,
 582:             color
 583:         )
 584:         .unwrap();
 585:     };
 586:     for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 587:         let b = assembly.footprint.bounds();
 588:         let label = match assembly.program {
 589:             SpaceProgram::AbandonedExpansion => "ABANDONED",
 590:             _ => "ASSEMBLY",
 591:         };
 592:         box_out("assembly", label, b, 0);
 593:         for space in &assembly.spaces {
 594:             box_out("space", "SUB-ROOM", space.footprint.bounds(), 0);
 595:         }
 596:         for ceiling in &assembly.ceiling_zones {
 597:             box_out("ceiling", "CEILING ZONE", ceiling.area.bounds(), 0);
 598:         }
 599:         let s = &assembly.structure;
 600:         let b = assembly.footprint.bounds();
 601:         box_out(
 602:             "structure",
 603:             "COLUMN GRID",
 604:             (b.0 + s.phase.0, b.1 + s.phase.1, b.2, b.3),
 605:             0,
 606:         );
 607:         for opening in &assembly.entrances {
 608:             let half = opening.width * 0.5;
 609:             let b = if opening.through_x_wall {
 610:                 (
 611:                     opening.center.x - half,
 612:                     opening.center.z - 0.12,
 613:                     opening.center.x + half,
 614:                     opening.center.z + 0.12,
 615:                 )
 616:             } else {
 617:                 (
 618:                     opening.center.x - 0.12,
 619:                     opening.center.z - half,
 620:                     opening.center.x + 0.12,
 621:                     opening.center.z + half,
 622:                 )
 623:             };
 624:             box_out("portal", "PORTAL", b, 0);
 625:         }
 626:     }
 627:     for anomaly in &plan.anomalies {
 628:         let b = anomaly.footprint.bounds();
 629:         let label = match anomaly.kind {
 630:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse => "PILLAR EXPANSE",
 631:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse => "BLACKOUT",
 632:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::PitLattice => "PIT LATTICE",
 633:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::RedRoom => "RED LOOP",
 634:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom => "ARCH ANCHOR",
 635:         };
 636:         box_out("anomaly", label, (b.min_x, b.min_z, b.max_x, b.max_z), 1);
 637:         // Anomaly-aware developer visibility: gates (threshold planes) and
 638:         // the immutable skeleton lane, keyed by instance id in the label.
 639:         for gate in anomaly.traversal_gates() {
 640:             let gb = match gate.axis {
 641:                 vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::X => (
 642:                     gate.plane - 0.1,
 643:                     gate.span_min,
 644:                     gate.plane + 0.1,
 645:                     gate.span_max,
 646:                 ),
 647:                 vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::Z => (
 648:                     gate.span_min,
 649:                     gate.plane - 0.1,
 650:                     gate.span_max,
 651:                     gate.plane + 0.1,
 652:                 ),
 653:             };
 654:             let glabel = format!(
 655:                 "{} {:08X}",
 656:                 match gate.kind {
 657:                     vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::TraversalGateKind::Remap => "GATE",
 658:                     vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::TraversalGateKind::RedThreshold =>
 659:                         "THRESHOLD",
 660:                     vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::TraversalGateKind::RedLoop => "RED LOOP",
 661:                     vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::TraversalGateKind::RedEscape => "ESCAPE",
 662:                 },
 663:                 (gate.instance_id & 0xFFFF_FFFF) as u32
 664:             );
 665:             box_out("gate", &glabel, gb, 1);
 666:         }
 667:         if anomaly.kind != vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::RedRoom
 668:             && anomaly.kind != vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom
 669:         {
 670:             let lane_a = anomaly.world_coords(-anomaly.footprint.half_x, 0.0);
 671:             let lane_b = anomaly.world_coords(anomaly.footprint.half_x, 0.0);
 672:             let hw = anomaly.skeleton_half_width;
 673:             let lane = (
 674:                 lane_a.x.min(lane_b.x) - hw,
 675:                 lane_a.z.min(lane_b.z) - hw,
 676:                 lane_a.x.max(lane_b.x) + hw,
 677:                 lane_a.z.max(lane_b.z) + hw,
 678:             );
 679:             box_out("skeleton", "PROTECTED ROUTE", lane, 1);
 680:         }
 681:     }
 682:     out.push_str("],\"fixtures\":[");
 683:     first = true;
 684:     for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 685:         for fixture in &assembly.fixtures {
 686:             if !first {
 687:                 out.push(',');
 688:             }
 689:             first = false;
 690:             write!(
 691:                 out,
 692:                 "[{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{}]",
 693:                 (fixture.at.x - chunk_x) / voxel_scale,
 694:                 (fixture.at.z - chunk_z) / voxel_scale,
 695:                 fixture.half_x / voxel_scale,
 696:                 fixture.half_z / voxel_scale,
 697:                 fixture.lit
 698:             )
 699:             .unwrap();
 700:         }
 701:     }
 702:     out.push_str("]}");
 703:     out
 704: }
 705: 
 706: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 707: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 708: pub fn get_chunk_blueprint_svg(
 709:     seed: u32,
 710:     chunk_x: f32,
 711:     chunk_z: f32,
 712:     voxel_scale: f32,
 713:     layer: String,
 714: ) -> String {

 755: /// Fast single-chunk voxel blueprint with semantic overlays.
 756: ///
 757: /// Why fast? This renders only one 50×50 (or 200×200 for high-spec) voxel
 758: /// grid instead of stitching N×N chunks, so it completes in < 5 ms inside
 759: /// WASM.  The browser can call this on every keypress without delay.
 760: ///
 761: /// Arguments (all passed from JavaScript):
 762: /// * `seed`          – World seed.
 763: /// * `chunk_x`       – Chunk origin X in world units (chunk_index * chunk_size).
 764: /// * `chunk_z`       – Chunk origin Z in world units.
 765: /// * `voxel_scale`   – Metres per voxel (0.2 default, 0.1 high-spec).
 766: /// * `pixels_per_voxel` – SVG pixels per cell (8–12 is comfortable).
 767: /// * `show_grid`     – Draw hairline grid lines.
 768: /// * `show_semantics`– Draw corridor / room / door overlays.
 769: /// * `show_ceiling`  – Include ceiling and light voxels.
 770: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 771: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 772: pub fn get_chunk_voxel_blueprint_svg(
 773:     seed: u32,
 774:     chunk_x: f32,
 775:     chunk_z: f32,
 776:     voxel_scale: f32,
 777:     pixels_per_voxel: f32,
 778:     show_grid: bool,
 779:     show_semantics: bool,
 780:     show_ceiling: bool,
 781: ) -> String {
 782:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 783:     let chunk_pos = vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(chunk_x, chunk_z);
 784: 
 785:     let config = if voxel_scale <= 0.1 {
 786:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::high_spec()
 787:     } else {
 788:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec()
 789:     };
 790: 
 791:     // Generate the voxel grid for this single chunk.
 792:     let generator =
 793:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::new(&noise);
 794:     let grid = generator.execute(chunk_pos, seed, config.clone());
 795: 
 796:     // Generate the region plan covering this chunk (for semantic overlays).
 797:     let region_size = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::REGION_SIZE;
 798:     let rx = (chunk_x / region_size).floor() * region_size;
 799:     let rz = (chunk_z / region_size).floor() * region_size;
 800:     let plan = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 801:         seed,
 802:         vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(rx, rz),
 803:         region_size,
 804:         &config,
 805:         &noise,
 806:     );
 807: 
 808:     let options = vackrooms::adapters::chunk_voxel_renderer::VoxelBlueprintOptions {
 809:         pixels_per_voxel: pixels_per_voxel.max(4.0).min(20.0),
 810:         show_grid,
 811:         show_voxels: true,
 812:         show_semantics,
 813:         show_labels: show_semantics, // labels only make sense when boxes are visible
 814:         show_ceiling,
 815:     };
 816: 
 817:     vackrooms::adapters::chunk_voxel_renderer::render_chunk_voxel_blueprint_svg(
 818:         &grid,
 819:         &plan,
 820:         chunk_pos,
 821:         voxel_scale,
 822:         options,
 823:     )
 824: }

 826: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 827: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 828: pub fn get_large_voxel_blueprint_svg(
 829:     seed: u32,
 830:     rx_val: i32,
 831:     rz_val: i32,
 832:     voxel_scale: f32,
 833:     size_world: f32,
 834:     layer: String,
 835: ) -> String {
 836:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 837: 
 838:     let config = if voxel_scale <= 0.1 {
 839:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::high_spec()
 840:     } else {
 841:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec()
 842:     };
 843: 
 844:     let chunk_size = config.chunk_size;
 845:     let steps = (size_world / chunk_size).round() as i32;
 846: 
 847:     // Generate the region plan
 848:     let rx_origin = rx_val as f32 * size_world;
 849:     let rz_origin = rz_val as f32 * size_world;
 850:     let semantics = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 851:         seed,
 852:         vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(rx_origin, rz_origin),
 853:         size_world,
 854:         &config,
 855:         &noise,
 856:     );
 857: 
 858:     // Generate all chunks and combine them
 859:     let generator =
 860:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::new(&noise);
 861: 
 862:     let chunk_w = (chunk_size / voxel_scale).round() as usize;
 863:     let chunk_d = (chunk_size / voxel_scale).round() as usize;
 864: 
 865:     let total_w = steps as usize * chunk_w;
 866:     let total_d = steps as usize * chunk_d;
 867: 
 868:     let mut combined_cells = vec![0u8; total_w * total_d];
 869: 
 870:     let slice = match layer.as_str() {
 871:         "floor" => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::FloorPlan,
 872:         "wall" => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::WallPlan,
 873:         "ceiling" => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::CeilingPlan,
 874:         _ => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::Composite,
 875:     };
 876: 
 877:     for i in 0..steps {
 878:         for j in 0..steps {
 879:             let chunk_x = rx_origin + i as f32 * chunk_size;
 880:             let chunk_z = rz_origin + j as f32 * chunk_size;
 881:             let grid = generator.execute(
 882:                 vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(chunk_x, chunk_z),
 883:                 seed,
 884:                 config.clone(),
 885:             );
 886: 
 887:             // Copy chunk voxels to combined grid
 888:             for cz in 0..chunk_d {
 889:                 for cx in 0..chunk_w {
 890:                     let vx = cx + 1;
 891:                     let vz = cz + 1;
 892: 
 893:                     let mut has_wall = false;
 894:                     let mut has_red_wall = false;
 895:                     let mut has_light = false;
 896:                     let mut has_red_light = false;
 897:                     let mut has_floor = false;
 898:                     let mut has_ceiling = false;
 899:                     let mut has_tree = false;
 900:                     let mut has_grass = false;
 901:                     let mut has_water = false;
 902: 
 903:                     for y in 0..grid.height() {
 904:                         match grid.get(vx, y, vz) {
 905:                             1 => has_wall = true,
 906:                             5 => has_red_wall = true,
 907:                             4 => has_light = true,
 908:                             9 => has_red_light = true,
 909:                             2 => has_floor = true,
 910:                             3 => has_ceiling = true,
 911:                             8 => has_tree = true,
 912:                             6 => has_grass = true,
 913:                             7 => has_water = true,
 914:                             _ => {}
 915:                         }
 916:                     }
 917: 
 918:                     let cell_type = match slice {
 919:                         vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::FloorPlan => {
 920:                             if has_wall || has_red_wall || has_tree {
 921:                                 if has_red_wall { 2 } else { 1 }
 922:                             } else if has_floor || has_grass || has_water {
 923:                                 if has_water {
 924:                                     7
 925:                                 } else if has_grass {
 926:                                     6
 927:                                 } else {
 928:                                     5
 929:                                 }
 930:                             } else {
 931:                                 0
 932:                             }
 933:                         }
 934:                         vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::WallPlan => {
 935:                             if has_wall || has_red_wall || has_tree {
 936:                                 if has_red_wall { 2 } else { 1 }
 937:                             } else {
 938:                                 0
 939:                             }
 940:                         }
 941:                         vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::CeilingPlan => {
 942:                             if has_light || has_red_light {
 943:                                 if has_red_light { 4 } else { 3 }
 944:                             } else if has_ceiling {
 945:                                 9
 946:                             } else {
 947:                                 0
 948:                             }
 949:                         }
 950:                         vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::Composite => {
 951:                             if has_wall || has_red_wall || has_tree {
 952:                                 if has_red_wall { 2 } else { 1 }
 953:                             } else if has_light || has_red_light {
 954:                                 if has_red_light { 4 } else { 3 }
 955:                             } else if has_floor || has_grass || has_water {
 956:                                 if has_water {
 957:                                     7
 958:                                 } else if has_grass {
 959:                                     6
 960:                                 } else {
 961:                                     5
 962:                                 }
 963:                             } else {
 964:                                 0
 965:                             }
 966:                         }
 967:                     };
 968: 
 969:                     let target_x = i as usize * chunk_w + cx;
 970:                     let target_z = j as usize * chunk_d + cz;
 971:                     let idx = target_z * total_w + target_x;
 972:                     combined_cells[idx] = cell_type;
 973:                 }
 974:             }
 975:         }
 976:     }
 977: 
 978:     vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::render_large_voxel_blueprint_svg(
 979:         &combined_cells,
 980:         total_w,
 981:         total_d,
 982:         rx_origin,
 983:         rz_origin,
 984:         voxel_scale,
 985:         size_world,
 986:         slice,
 987:         Some(&semantics),
 988:         false,
 989:     )
 990: }

 992: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 993: mod entry {
 994:     use wasm_bindgen::prelude::*;
 995: 
 996:     /// Composition root. Runs automatically when the wasm module is
 997:     /// instantiated by `static/index.html`.
 998:     ///
 999:     /// `static/worker.js` instantiates this same module inside a Web Worker
1000:     /// with `#[wasm_bindgen(start)]` skipped (`init` is passed
1001:     /// `{ skip_start: true }` is not available for start fns, so instead the
1002:     /// worker checks for a missing DOM and bails out here).
1003:     #[wasm_bindgen(start)]
1004:     pub fn start() -> Result<(), JsValue> {
1005:         console_error_panic_hook::set_once();
1006:         // Inside a Web Worker there is no `window`/DOM: this module was
1007:         // loaded as the generation worker, which drives itself through
1008:         // `worker_init`/`worker_generate` instead of `boot`.
1009:         if web_sys::window().is_none() {
1010:             return Ok(());
1011:         }
1012:         // Adapter/device acquisition is asynchronous in WebGPU. Keep the
1013:         // wasm start hook synchronous and let the composition root own the
1014:         // future; failures are surfaced both in the console and loading HUD.
1015:         wasm_bindgen_futures::spawn_local(async {
1016:             if let Err(error) = crate::drivers::browser::boot().await {
1017:                 web_sys::console::error_2(&"Failed to start WebGPU engine:".into(), &error);
1018:                 if let Some(document) = web_sys::window().and_then(|window| window.document()) {
1019:                     if let Some(status) = document.get_element_by_id("status-msg") {
1020:                         let detail = error
1021:                             .as_string()
1022:                             .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("{error:?}"));
1023:                         status.set_text_content(Some(&format!(
1024:                             "Failed to start WebGPU engine: {detail}"
1025:                         )));
1026:                     }
1027:                 }
1028:             }
1029:         });
1030:         Ok(())
1031:     }
1032: }
1033: 
1034: /// Generation-worker entry points. A worker is a second instance of this
1035: /// same wasm module: `worker_init` builds a chunk source from the *same*
1036: /// URL query the main thread used (identical world by construction), and
1037: /// `worker_generate` runs architectural generation, lighting, the
1038: /// collision-authority SVO, and only the renderer artifacts named by the
1039: /// request bitfield. It returns one transferable byte buffer (see
1040: /// `adapters::chunk_codec`).
1041: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
1042: mod worker_entry {
1043:     use std::cell::RefCell;
1044: 
1045:     use wasm_bindgen::prelude::*;
1046: 
1047:     use crate::adapters::chunk_codec::encode_chunk_payload;
1048:     use crate::adapters::local_chunk_source::LocalChunkSource;
1049:     use crate::adapters::query_config::generator_setup_from_query;
1050:     use crate::application::ports::{ChunkSourcePort, RenderArtifactNeeds};
1051:     use vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::RealitySnapshot;
1052:     use vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider;
1053: 
1054:     thread_local! {
1055:         static SOURCE: RefCell<Option<LocalChunkSource<SimpleNoiseProvider>>> =
1056:             const { RefCell::new(None) };
1057:     }
1058: 
1059:     /// `default_seed` must match the main thread's `WORLD_SEED`.
1060:     #[wasm_bindgen]
1061:     pub fn worker_init(query: &str, default_seed: u32) {
1062:         let (seed, config) = generator_setup_from_query(query, default_seed);
1063:         SOURCE.with(|s| {
1064:             *s.borrow_mut() = Some(LocalChunkSource::new(
1065:                 SimpleNoiseProvider::new(),
1066:                 seed,
1067:                 config,
1068:             ));
1069:         });
1070:     }
1071: 
1072:     #[wasm_bindgen]
1073:     pub fn worker_generate(
1074:         _request_id: u32,
1075:         origin_x: f32,
1076:         origin_z: f32,
1077:         level: u32,
1078:         lod: u8,
1079:         artifact_bits: u8,
1080:         reality_words: Vec<u32>,
1081:     ) -> Vec<u8> {
1082:         let artifacts = RenderArtifactNeeds::from_bits(artifact_bits)
1083:             .expect("worker_generate received invalid artifact bits");
1084:         let reality = RealitySnapshot::from_words(&reality_words)
1085:             .expect("worker_generate received an invalid reality snapshot");
1086:         SOURCE.with(|s| {
1087:             let source = s.borrow();
1088:             let source = source
1089:                 .as_ref()
1090:                 .expect("worker_generate called before worker_init");
1091:             encode_chunk_payload(
1092:                 &source.load_with_artifacts(origin_x, origin_z, level, lod, &reality, artifacts),
1093:             )
1094:         })
1095:     }
1096: }

184: /// Borrowed incremental surface update. Mesh bytes are uploaded immediately;
185: /// no extra clone of a chunk's geometry is needed in the frame loop.
186: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
187: pub struct SurfaceChunk<'a> {
188:     pub key: SurfaceChunkKey,
189:     pub origin: [f32; 3],
190:     pub mesh: &'a SurfaceMeshPayload,
191: }
192: 
193: /// Per-chunk data the renderer needs to raymarch one chunk of the SVO atlas.
194: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
195: pub struct ChunkDraw {
196:     /// World-space origin (min corner) of the chunk's SVO cube.
197:     pub origin: [f32; 3],
198:     /// Root node index within the merged SVO atlas.
199:     pub root_index: i32,
200:     /// Side length of the chunk's SVO cube in world units.
201:     pub world_size: f32,
202:     /// Exact world-space edge length of a leaf voxel at this chunk's LOD.
203:     /// Never infer this from `world_size`: the SVO cube is power-of-two
204:     /// padded and deliberately larger than the logical chunk.
205:     pub voxel_size: f32,
206:     /// Exact SVO depth. Kept beside the voxel size so traversal has no
207:     /// profile-specific constants or hidden maximum-depth guesses.
208:     pub svo_depth: u8,
209: }
210: 
211: /// Upper bound on per-frame dynamic lights handed to renderers (flares).
212: pub const MAX_DYNAMIC_LIGHTS: usize = 4;
213: 
214: /// Compatibility budget for callers that still expose fixed light arrays.
215: /// Production WebGPU strategies use dynamically sized frame storage.
216: pub const MAX_SCENE_LIGHTS: usize = 16;
217: 
218: /// A short-lived runtime light (dropped flare). World-space state owned by
219: /// the engine — never part of chunk payloads, baked light volumes, or the
220: /// reality snapshot. Renderers treat it as one more point light; intensity
221: /// already includes CPU-side flicker and fade so no shader needs a clock.
222: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Default)]
223: pub struct DynamicLight {
224:     pub position: [f32; 3],
225:     pub color: [f32; 3],
226:     pub radius: f32,
227:     pub intensity: f32,
228: }
229: 
230: /// Per-level atmosphere handed to every renderer with the frame, so a level
231: /// switch (noclip) changes the sky/fog/ambient identically in the surface,
232: /// splat, raymarch, and CPU paths. `outdoor == false` means "keep your
233: /// interior Backrooms look" — the colors below are only consulted outdoors,
234: /// which keeps the four hand-tuned indoor palettes byte-identical.
235: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
236: pub struct Environment {
237:     /// True on open-sky levels (the grassland). Renderers clear to
238:     /// `sky_color`, fog toward `fog_color`, and scale ambient response.
239:     pub outdoor: bool,
240:     /// Clear color behind all geometry.
241:     pub sky_color: [f32; 3],
242:     /// Distance-fog blend target (slightly hazier than the sky).
243:     pub fog_color: [f32; 3],
244:     /// Multiplier on the ambient/indirect lighting response (>1 = daylight).
245:     pub ambient_scale: f32,
246:     /// Beer-Lambert extinction coefficient in inverse world units.
247:     pub fog_density: f32,
248:     /// Clear near-field distance before extinction begins.
249:     pub fog_start: f32,
250: }
251: 
252: impl Environment {
253:     /// Level 0 and every other interior: renderers use their own palettes.
254:     pub fn interior() -> Self {
255:         Self {
256:             outdoor: false,
257:             sky_color: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
258:             // Linear RGB; display encoding happens exactly once after fog.
259:             fog_color: [0.020, 0.014, 0.0045],
260:             ambient_scale: 1.0,
261:             fog_density: 0.018,
262:             fog_start: 12.0,
263:         }
264:     }
265: 
266:     /// Level 1, the Habitable Zone: dim concrete under a low-hanging fog
267:     /// with no discernible source, colder and murkier than Level 0.
268:     pub fn habitable() -> Self {
269:         Self {
270:             outdoor: false,
271:             sky_color: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
272:             // Linear RGB; a cold grey haze rather than Level 0's amber.
273:             fog_color: [0.016, 0.018, 0.021],
274:             ambient_scale: 0.85,
275:             fog_density: 0.045,
276:             fog_start: 5.0,
277:         }
278:     }
279: 
280:     /// Level 34 grassland: a bright daylight sky.
281:     pub fn daylight() -> Self {
282:         Self {
283:             outdoor: true,
284:             // Linear equivalents of the authored sRGB sky/haze palette.
285:             sky_color: [0.243, 0.477, 0.827],
286:             fog_color: [0.393, 0.570, 0.827],
287:             ambient_scale: 2.2,
288:             fog_density: 0.012,
289:             fog_start: 18.0,
290:         }
291:     }
292: }
293: 
294: impl Default for Environment {
295:     fn default() -> Self {
296:         Self::interior()
297:     }
298: }
