 116: /// Snapshot for the HUD presenter.
 117: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
 118: pub struct HudStats {
 119:     pub resident_chunks: usize,
 120:     /// Chunks resident at full resolution; the rest are coarse LOD.
 121:     pub fine_chunks: usize,
 122:     pub atlas_nodes: usize,
 123:     pub collision_boxes: usize,
 124:     pub resolution_scale: f32,
 125:     /// True once the spawn chunk is resident (drives the loading overlay).
 126:     pub ready: bool,
 127:     /// Session pedometer: resolved horizontal movement in world units
 128:     /// (= meters), collision already applied, relocations excluded.
 129:     pub distance_m: f32,
 130:     /// Survival vitals, normalized 0..=1 for the HUD bars.
 131:     pub hydration: f32,
 132:     pub satiety: f32,
 133:     pub condition: f32,
 134:     /// Carried supplies (auto-consumed when the matching vital runs low).
 135:     pub almond_bottles: u32,
 136:     pub rations: u32,
 137:     /// Smoothed ambient temperature at the player, °C.
 138:     pub ambient_c: f32,
 139:     /// Times the wanderer has succumbed this session.
 140:     pub deaths: u32,
 141:     /// The active Backrooms level id.
 142:     pub level: u32,
 143:     /// The embodied telemetry the body trace presents: steps, pulse,
 144:     /// signal state, beat prominence. Raw vitals above stay for diagnostics
 145:     /// only — the normal HUD never renders them as meters.
 146:     pub body: BodyReadout,
 147:     /// Present only when a real resident level door is known. `None` is the
 148:     /// truthful "route unresolved / beyond field" state.
 149:     pub route: Option<RouteAnchor>,
 150: }
 151: 
 152: /// The single coarse LOD used for progressive availability: every missing
 153: /// chunk is first loaded at this LOD (voxels 2x the size, ~1/8 the cost) so
 154: /// the whole streaming footprint becomes visible before any chunk is refined.
 155: const COARSE_LOD: u8 = 1;
 156: /// Budget units one fine load costs; a coarse load costs 1. Coarse generation
 157: /// touches ~1/8 the voxels but has fixed per-chunk overhead, so 4 (not 8)
 158: /// keeps the worst-case tick cost at the old two-fine-loads level.
 159: const FINE_LOAD_COST: u32 = 4;
 160: 
 161: /// Backrooms level ids the engine can noclip between.
 162: const LEVEL_BACKROOMS: u32 = 0;
 163: /// Level 1, the Habitable Zone (physical doors lead here from Level 0).
 164: const LEVEL_HABITABLE: u32 = 1;
 165: const LEVEL_GRASSLAND: u32 = 34;
 166: /// Horizontal reach within which a supply pickup fires.
 167: const PICKUP_REACH: f32 = 0.8;
 168: /// Seconds between level-door transits (re-arming, not gameplay pacing).
 169: const DOOR_COOLDOWN_S: f32 = 2.0;
 170: /// Route-objective reselection cadence. Selection walks the resident exits
 171: /// (a handful at most), so this is bookkeeping hygiene, not a hot path.
 172: const ROUTE_RECOMPUTE_PERIOD_S: f32 = 0.5;
 173: /// Debug-only anomaly awareness radius for the diagnostic aperture, meters.
 174: const AWARENESS_RANGE_M: f32 = 60.0;
 175: /// Where death and Level-1 arrival place the eye, per level.
 176: fn level_spawn(level: u32, config_spawn: [f32; 3]) -> [f32; 3] {
 177:     if level == LEVEL_HABITABLE {
 178:         [3.0, 1.7, 3.0]
 179:     } else {
 180:         config_spawn
 181:     }
 182: }
 183: /// Keep pushing into a wall this long before a noclip roll happens...
 184: const NOCLIP_PUSH_SECONDS: f32 = 1.2;
 185: /// ...then one roll per second of continued pushing, at this probability.
 186: const NOCLIP_CHANCE: f32 = 0.2;
 187: /// Per-frame intensity gain of one fixture's authored flicker mode.
 188: /// Deterministic in (id, time): every machine shows the same buzz.
 189: /// Mode 1 is a tired ballast — a fast shallow shimmer with slow beats.
 190: /// Mode 2 is a dying tube — mostly lit, with hard sputtering dropouts.
 191: fn fixture_flicker_gain(id: u64, mode: u8, time: f32) -> f32 {
 192:     let phase = (id % 977) as f32 * 0.61;
 193:     match mode {
 194:         1 => {
 195:             let t = time * 47.0 + phase;
 196:             (0.86 + 0.10 * t.sin() * (t * 0.093).cos() + 0.04 * (time * 3.1 + phase).sin())
 197:                 .clamp(0.7, 1.0)
 198:         }
 199:         2 => {
 200:             // Coarse deterministic gate: ~9 decisions per second per tube.
 201:             let step = (time * 9.0 + phase) as u64;
 202:             let mut h = id ^ step.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15);
 203:             h ^= h >> 31;
 204:             h = h.wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
 205:             if (h >> 40) % 100 < 24 { 0.06 } else { 0.92 }
 206:         }
 207:         _ => 1.0,
 208:     }
 209: }
 210: 
 211: /// Inside a blackout, drift cells closer than this may still be revealed by
 212: /// a flare or the flashlight cone, so the rear shift never touches them.
 213: /// Blackout ambient is near-black past a few units; 5 u is already beyond
 214: /// anything the player can resolve behind their own shoulder, and the
 215: /// tighter radius lets the dark rearrange almost at the player's heels.
 216: const BLACKOUT_HIDE_DISTANCE: f32 = 5.0;
 217: /// Cadence of the in-blackout rear shift. Aggressive on purpose: the way
 218: /// in is gone the moment it leaves the corner of the eye, so a blackout is
 219: /// almost impossible to back out of. Each firing's rebuild work is still
 220: /// metered by the ordinary install budget.
 221: const BLACKOUT_SHIFT_PERIOD_S: f32 = 0.75;
 222: pub struct Engine {
 223:     config: EngineConfig,
 224:     player: Player,
 225:     policy: StreamingPolicy,
 226:     visual_policy: StreamingPolicy,
 227:     store: ChunkStore,
 228:     pool: AtlasPool,
 229:     world: CollisionWorld,
 230:     draws: Vec<ChunkDraw>,
 231:     atlas_nodes: usize,
 232:     governor: PerfGovernor,
 233:     artifact_needs: RenderArtifactNeeds,
 234:     renderer: Box<dyn RendererPort>,
 235:     source: Box<dyn ChunkSourcePort>,
 236:     /// Outstanding background loads (async sources only). The complete
 237:     /// request is retained so a late completion can neither clear nor replace
 238:     /// a newer request for the same spatial chunk.
 239:     pending: HashMap<ChunkKey, ChunkRequest>,
 240:     /// Finished background loads waiting for install budget. Workers can
 241:     /// return several chunks in one tick; installing them all at once (mesh
 242:     /// upload + collision rebuild per chunk) is exactly the frame hitch the
 243:     /// worker pool exists to avoid, so installs are metered per tick and the
 244:     /// overflow waits here. Every entry is re-validated at install time.
 245:     completed_backlog: Vec<CompletedChunk>,
 246:     /// Monotonic worker-order identity. Kept independent from chunk/LOD so a
 247:     /// re-request after eviction is distinguishable from its predecessor.
 248:     next_request_id: u32,
 249:     /// Immutable encounter state used by every request in the active reality.
 250:     /// Traversal/event handling will replace this in a later slice; epoch zero
 251:     /// is sufficient to establish the transport and validation contract now.
 252:     reality: RealitySnapshot,
 253:     /// Resident red-room chunks that may safely rebuild after the player has
 254:     /// crossed the occluded inner threshold. Other remaps stay lazy until
 255:     /// ordinary eviction, so directly visible pillar/blackout geometry never
 256:     /// pops.
 257:     forced_reloads: HashSet<ChunkKey>,
 258:     /// Peripheral Shift bookkeeping: fabric drift cells the player is (or
 259:     /// recently was) near. A cell that leaves the far radius has become
 260:     /// genuinely unobserved and its drift epoch advances, so the fabric the
 261:     /// player walks back into has lawfully rearranged.
 262:     drift_near: HashSet<(i64, i64)>,
 263:     /// Seconds until the next in-blackout rear shift may fire.
 264:     blackout_shift_cooldown: f32,
 265:     /// Debug telemetry for the rear shift: (player inside a blackout,
 266:     /// eligible cells at last firing, total cells shifted this session).
 267:     blackout_shift_debug: (bool, usize, usize),
 268:     /// Last non-hazard eye position used by pit-lattice recovery.
 269:     last_safe_position: [f32; 3],
 270:     /// Active Backrooms level; chunks are requested for this level.
 271:     level: u32,
 272:     /// How long the player has been pushing into a wall without moving.
 273:     push_seconds: f32,
 274:     /// Seconds until the next noclip roll is allowed.
 275:     noclip_cooldown: f32,
 276:     /// xorshift state for the noclip dice.
 277:     rng: u64,
 278:     /// Transient dropped-flare state and renderer-light selection.
 279:     flares: FlareField,
 280:     /// Session pedometer: resolved horizontal movement (world units).
 281:     distance_m: f64,
 282:     /// The wanderer's embodied telemetry: pedometer, exertion, fatigue,
 283:     /// pulse. Advanced once per tick with the collision-resolved movement.
 284:     body: Body,
 285:     /// Cached navigation objective (a resident level door) plus the
 286:     /// recompute cooldown; selection re-runs on a bounded cadence and is
 287:     /// invalidated on level switches and reality transitions.
 288:     route_target: Option<RouteTarget>,
 289:     route_cooldown: f32,
 290:     /// Vitals, carried supplies, felt temperature, consumption, and
 291:     /// attrition policy form one survival aggregate.
 292:     survival: SurvivalInventory,
 293:     /// Engine-time seconds used for deterministic CPU-side light flicker.
 294:     time_seconds: f64,
 295:     /// Seconds until a level door may fire again.
 296:     door_cooldown: f32,
 297: }
 298: 
 299: impl Engine {
 300:     pub fn new(
 301:         config: EngineConfig,
 302:         renderer: Box<dyn RendererPort>,
 303:         source: Box<dyn ChunkSourcePort>,
 304:     ) -> Self {
 305:         let radius = config.chunk_radius.clamp(0, 2);
 306:         let artifact_needs = renderer.artifact_needs();
 307:         let visual_radius = if artifact_needs.needs_surface_extraction() {
 308:             4
 309:         } else {
 310:             radius
 311:         };
 312:         let mut player = Player::new(config.spawn);
 313:         player.yaw = config.spawn_yaw;
 314:         Self {
 315:             player,
 316:             policy: StreamingPolicy {
 317:                 chunk_size: config.chunk_size,
 318:                 radius,
 319:             },
 320:             visual_policy: StreamingPolicy {
 321:                 chunk_size: config.chunk_size,
 322:                 radius: visual_radius,
 323:             },
 324:             store: ChunkStore::new(),
 325:             pool: AtlasPool::new(),
 326:             world: CollisionWorld::new(),
 327:             draws: Vec::new(),
 328:             atlas_nodes: 0,
 329:             governor: PerfGovernor::new(),
 330:             artifact_needs,
 331:             renderer,
 332:             source,
 333:             pending: HashMap::new(),
 334:             completed_backlog: Vec::new(),
 335:             next_request_id: 1,
 336:             reality: RealitySnapshot::default(),
 337:             forced_reloads: HashSet::new(),
 338:             drift_near: HashSet::new(),
 339:             blackout_shift_cooldown: 0.0,
 340:             blackout_shift_debug: (false, 0, 0),
 341:             last_safe_position: config.spawn,
 342:             level: config.initial_level,
 343:             push_seconds: 0.0,
 344:             noclip_cooldown: 0.0,
 345:             rng: (config.seed as u64).wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15) | 1,
 346:             flares: FlareField::default(),
 347:             distance_m: 0.0,
 348:             body: Body::default(),
 349:             route_target: None,
 350:             route_cooldown: 0.0,
 351:             survival: SurvivalInventory::new(thermal::dark_baseline_c(config.initial_level)),
 352:             time_seconds: 0.0,
 353:             door_cooldown: 0.0,
 354:             config,
 355:         }
 356:     }
 357: 
 358: 
 359:     /// Switches the active level: drop every resident chunk so the streamer
 360:     /// rebuilds the world from the new level's generator, then optionally
 361:     /// relocate the player to an arrival point in the new coordinate space.
 362:     fn switch_level(&mut self, target: u32, arrival: Option<[f32; 3]>) {
 363:         self.level = target;
 364:         self.store.retain_keys(&[]);
 365:         // In-flight loads are for the old level; their completions will be
 366:         // rejected by the level check, and clearing pending lets the new
 367:         // level re-request the same keys immediately.
 368:         self.pending.clear();
 369:         self.completed_backlog.clear();
 370:         self.forced_reloads.clear();
 371:         // The whole world is regenerated: drop the pool so the next stream
 372:         // pass relayouts and re-uploads from scratch.
 373:         self.pool = AtlasPool::new();
 374:         self.renderer.clear_surfaces();
 375:         self.world.rebuild([].iter());
 376:         self.draws.clear();
 377:         self.push_seconds = 0.0;
 378:         // Flares are world objects of the level they were lit in.
 379:         self.flares.clear();
 380:         self.abandon_all_watched_drift_cells();
 381:         if let Some(arrival) = arrival {
 382:             self.player.relocate(arrival);
 383:         }
 384:         self.last_safe_position = self.player.position;
 385:         // Telemetry from the departed level must never survive the door.
 386:         self.invalidate_route();
 387:         // The felt air snaps toward the new level's baseline over the
 388:         // ordinary inertia; no need to reset it here.
 389:         self.door_cooldown = DOOR_COOLDOWN_S;
 390:     }
 391: 
 392:     /// The active Backrooms level id.
 393:     pub fn level(&self) -> u32 {
 394:         self.level
 395:     }
 396: 
 397:     /// Per-level atmosphere shared by every renderer: the grassland is an
 398:     /// open daylight plane, Level 1 carries its canonical low fog, and
 399:     /// everything else keeps the interior palette.
 400:     pub fn environment(&self) -> Environment {
 401:         match self.level {
 402:             LEVEL_GRASSLAND => Environment::daylight(),
 403:             LEVEL_HABITABLE => Environment::habitable(),
 404:             _ => Environment::interior(),
 405:         }
 406:     }
 407: 
 408:     /// Survival vitals (read-only view for presenters/tests).
 409:     pub fn vitals(&self) -> PlayerVitals {
 410:         self.survival.vitals()
 411:     }
 412: 
 413:     /// Test-only vitals override, for exercising attrition paths without
 414:     /// simulating twenty real minutes.
 415:     #[cfg(test)]
 416:     pub(crate) fn set_vitals_for_test(&mut self, vitals: PlayerVitals) {
 417:         self.survival.set_vitals_for_test(vitals);
 418:     }
 419: 
 420:     /// Immutable encounter-state snapshot currently used to key generation.
 421:     /// A later traversal layer will own safe snapshot transitions; exposing
 422:     /// the current value here does not itself mutate or remap the world.
 423:     pub fn reality_snapshot(&self) -> &RealitySnapshot {
 424:         &self.reality
 425:     }
 426: 
 427:     /// Advances the simulation one frame and issues the draw.
 428:     pub fn tick(&mut self, dt_seconds: f32, input: &InputFrame) {
 429:         // Clamp dt so a background-tab hitch can't teleport the player.
 430:         let dt = dt_seconds.clamp(0.0, 0.1);
 431:         self.governor.update(dt_seconds * 1000.0);
 432:         self.time_seconds += dt as f64;
 433: 
 434:         let old_pos = self.player.position;
 435:         // The body's bounded movement multiplier from the *previous* tick's
 436:         // state degrades acceleration and sustainable speed together;
 437:         // collision resolution itself is untouched.
 438:         let effort = self.body.movement_factor();
 439:         // Resolved walking distance of this tick only; feeds the pedometer
 440:         // and the exertion model.
 441:         let mut walked_m = 0.0f32;
 442:         if input.locked {
 443:             self.player.apply_look(input.look_dx, input.look_dy);
 444:             self.player
 445:                 .step_with_effort(dt, &input.intent, &self.world, effort);
 446: 
 447:             // Pedometer: measured here — immediately after the one
 448:             // collision-resolved integration step — so relocations that
 449:             // happen later in the tick (pit recovery, noclip, red-loop
 450:             // handling) and out-of-band teleports can never inflate it.
 451:             // Look input contributes nothing: only position deltas count.
 452:             let dx = self.player.position[0] - old_pos[0];
 453:             let dz = self.player.position[2] - old_pos[2];
 454:             let step = (dx * dx + dz * dz).sqrt();
 455:             // Anything faster than sprint speed in one frame is a
 456:             // discontinuity, not walking.
 457:             if step < 1.0 {
 458:                 self.distance_m += step as f64;
 459:                 walked_m = step;
 460:             }
 461:         }
 462:         self.update_flares(dt, input);
 463:         self.update_anomalies(old_pos);
 464:         self.update_provisions(dt);
 465:         self.update_peripheral_shift(dt);
 466:         self.update_noclip(dt, input, old_pos);
 467: 
 468:         self.stream_chunks();
 469: 
 470:         let mut scene_lights = select_scene_lights(
 471:             self.store
 472:                 .iter_ordered()
 473:                 .flat_map(|chunk| chunk.payload.lights.iter()),
 474:             self.player.position,
 475:         );
 476:         // Fluorescent flicker is applied here, once, CPU-side — exactly like
 477:         // flare flicker — so every renderer sees the same fluctuating world
 478:         // and no shader needs a clock.
 479:         let flicker_time = self.time_seconds as f32;
 480:         for light in &mut scene_lights {
 481:             light.intensity *= fixture_flicker_gain(light.id, light.flicker_mode, flicker_time);
 482:         }
 483: 
 484:         // Survival: the lit scene *is* the heat source. The felt ambient
 485:         // chases the instantaneous value with thermal inertia, then the
 486:         // vitals advance under it (heat accelerates thirst).
 487:         let instantaneous_c = thermal::ambient_celsius(
 488:             self.level,
 489:             self.player.position,
 490:             &scene_lights,
 491:             self.world.boxes(),
 492:         );
 493:         self.survival.advance_vitals(dt, instantaneous_c);
 494:         // Consumption is deliberate; the survival aggregate also owns the
 495:         // optional accessibility policy that acts after explicit choices.
 496:         self.survival.consume(ConsumptionIntent {
 497:             drink: input.drink,
 498:             eat: input.eat,
 499:         });
 500:         // The body listens to the same survival state the vitals own; the
 501:         // resolved walking distance is the only movement it ever sees.
 502:         let survival = self.survival.readout();
 503:         self.body.advance(
 504:             dt,
 505:             walked_m,
 506:             BodyContext {
 507:                 hydration: survival.vitals.hydration,
 508:                 satiety: survival.vitals.satiety,
 509:                 condition: survival.vitals.condition,
 510:                 ambient_c: survival.ambient_c,
 511:             },
 512:         );
 513:         self.update_route(dt);
 514:         if self.survival.succumb_if_dead() {
 515:             self.respawn_after_attrition();
 516:         }
 517:         // Strain: mismanagement in either direction raises the reality's
 518:         // delirium tier, and chunks generated from here on carry more
 519:         // anomalous infill, sealed doorways, shut corridor mouths, and
 520:         // thinner provisions. Resident chunks are untouched — the world
 521:         // worsens as it streams, never as a visible pop. Dehydration bands
 522:         // punish the underconsumer; the excess meter (wasted supplies)
 523:         // punishes the overconsumer with the very same tiers.
 524:         let tier = self.survival.advance_strain(dt);
 525:         if tier != self.reality.delirium() {
 526:             self.reality = self.reality.with_delirium(tier);
 527:         }
 528: 
 529:         let flare_lights = self
 530:             .flares
 531:             .lights(self.player.position, self.time_seconds as f32);
 532:         let frame = FrameParams {
 533:             camera_pos: self.player.position,
 534:             yaw: self.player.yaw,
 535:             pitch: self.player.pitch,
 536:             flashlight: input.flashlight,
 537:             dynamic_lights: flare_lights.lights,
 538:             dynamic_light_count: flare_lights.count,
 539:             scene_lights,
 540:             environment: self.environment(),
 541:             supply_sprites: self.collect_supply_sprites(),
 542:         };
 543:         self.renderer.draw(&frame, &self.draws);
 544:     }
 545: 
 546:     /// Supplies player intent and collision context to the flare lifecycle.
 547:     fn update_flares(&mut self, dt: f32, input: &InputFrame) {
 548:         self.flares.advance(dt);
 549:         if !(input.drop_flare && input.locked) {
 550:             return;
 551:         }
 552:         let eye = self.player.position;
 553:         let forward = self.player.forward();
 554:         self.flares.drop_from(eye, forward, &self.world);
 555:     }
 556: 
 557:     /// Active flares (world-space runtime state), oldest first.
 558:     pub fn flares(&self) -> &[Flare] {
 559:         self.flares.active()
 560:     }
 561: 
 562:     /// Session pedometer reading in meters.
 563:     pub fn distance_m(&self) -> f32 {
 564:         self.distance_m as f32
 565:     }
 566: 
 567:     /// Squared distance from the player to the nearest point of a chunk's
 568:     /// 2D footprint; 0 inside the chunk. Drives the fine/coarse LOD choice.
 569:     fn chunk_dist2(&self, origin_x: f32, origin_z: f32) -> f32 {
 570:         let cs = self.config.chunk_size;
 571:         let (px, pz) = (self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 572:         let dx = (origin_x - px).max(px - (origin_x + cs)).max(0.0);
 573:         let dz = (origin_z - pz).max(pz - (origin_z + cs)).max(0.0);
 574:         dx * dx + dz * dz
 575:     }
 576: 
 577:     fn update_anomalies(&mut self, old_pos: [f32; 3]) {
 578:         if self.level != LEVEL_BACKROOMS {
 579:             self.last_safe_position = self.player.position;
 580:             return;
 581:         }
 582: 
 583:         let hazards: Vec<_> = self.store.all_pit_hazards().copied().collect();
 584:         if let Some(hazard) = hazards
 585:             .iter()
 586:             .find(|h| h.contains(self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]))
 587:         {
 588:             let authored = [
 589:                 hazard.recovery.x,
 590:                 self.player.position[1],
 591:                 hazard.recovery.z,
 592:             ];
 593:             let recovery = if self.world.collides(authored) {
 594:                 self.last_safe_position
 595:             } else {
 596:                 authored
 597:             };
 598:             self.player.relocate(recovery);
 599:             self.last_safe_position = recovery;
 600:             return;
 601:         }
 602: 
 603:         let mut gates: Vec<_> = self.store.all_traversal_gates().copied().collect();
 604:         gates.sort_by_key(|g| g.id);
 605:         gates.dedup_by_key(|g| g.id);
 606:         for gate in gates {
 607:             let Some(direction) = gate.crossing(
 608:                 [old_pos[0], old_pos[2]],
 609:                 [self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]],
 610:             ) else {
 611:                 continue;
 612:             };
 613:             if gate.kind == TraversalGateKind::RedThreshold && direction != gate.forward {
 614:                 continue;
 615:             }
 616:             let next_reality = self.reality.with_advanced_gate(&gate, direction);
 617:             if next_reality == self.reality {
 618:                 continue;
 619:             }
 620:             self.reality = next_reality;
 621:             // A reality transition retires every cached telemetry selection:
 622:             // the route must reselect against the new address, never mix.
 623:             self.invalidate_route();
 624: 
 625:             if gate.anomaly_kind == AnomalyKind::RedRoom {
 626:                 // A committed Red Room selects another infinite Level 0
 627:                 // address. Every resident chunk belongs to the old address,
 628:                 // so replacing only the vestibule would splice two realities
 629:                 // at an arbitrary streaming boundary.
 630:                 let targets: Vec<_> = self
 631:                     .store
 632:                     .iter_ordered()
 633:                     .map(|chunk| chunk_key(chunk.origin.0, chunk.origin.1))
 634:                     .collect();
 635:                 for key in targets {
 636:                     // A pre-threshold refinement for this key is no longer
 637:                     // authoritative; its late completion cannot clear the new
 638:                     // exact request identity.
 639:                     self.force_rebuild(key);
 640:                 }
 641:             }
 642:         }
 643:         self.last_safe_position = self.player.position;
 644:     }
 645: 
 646:     /// Supply pickups and level doors, both exported by generation beside
 647:     /// the geometry. Pickups fold into the reality snapshot (a consumed
 648:     /// bottle never regenerates); doors switch the streamed level.
 649:     fn update_provisions(&mut self, dt: f32) {
 650:         self.door_cooldown = (self.door_cooldown - dt).max(0.0);
 651:         let (px, pz) = (self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 652: 
 653:         // -- pickups ---------------------------------------------------------
 654:         // Halo overlap can surface the same item from two chunks; dedupe by
 655:         // id so one bottle never quenches twice.
 656:         let mut grabbed: Vec<_> = self
 657:             .store
 658:             .all_supply_items()
 659:             .filter(|item| {
 660:                 item.within_reach(px, pz, PICKUP_REACH) && !self.reality.supply_consumed(item.id)
 661:             })
 662:             .copied()
 663:             .collect();
 664:         grabbed.sort_by_key(|item| item.id);
 665:         grabbed.dedup_by_key(|item| item.id);
 666:         for item in grabbed {
 667:             // Pickups stock the pockets; drinking and eating are deliberate
 668:             // acts. Full pockets leave the item standing in the world instead
 669:             // of force-feeding the wanderer — walking past a bottle is never
 670:             // gluttony by itself.
 671:             if !self.survival.try_pickup(item.kind) {
 672:                 continue;
 673:             }
 674:             self.reality = self.reality.with_supply_consumed(item.id);
 675:             // Rebuild the chunk holding the marker under the advanced
 676:             // reality so the bottle visibly leaves the world.
 677:             let cs = self.config.chunk_size;
 678:             let key = chunk_key(
 679:                 (item.position.x / cs).floor() * cs,
 680:                 (item.position.z / cs).floor() * cs,
 681:             );
 682:             self.force_rebuild(key);
 683:         }
 684: 
 685:         // -- level doors ------------------------------------------------------
 686:         if self.door_cooldown > 0.0 {
 687:             return;
 688:         }
 689:         let transit = self
 690:             .store
 691:             .all_level_exits()
 692:             .find(|exit| exit.contains(px, pz))
 693:             .copied();
 694:         if let Some(exit) = transit {
 695:             let arrival = [exit.arrival.x, self.player.position[1], exit.arrival.z];
 696:             self.switch_level(exit.target_level, Some(arrival));
 697:         }
 698:     }
 699: 
 700:     /// The nearest unconsumed supply labels, ready for billboard drawing.
 701:     /// Labels float a little above the marker so the logo reads over the
 702:     /// bottle/tin voxels.
 703:     pub fn collect_supply_sprites(&self) -> Vec<crate::application::ports::SupplySprite> {
 704:         use crate::application::ports::{MAX_SUPPLY_SPRITES, SupplySprite};
 705:         const LABEL_CULL: f32 = 14.0;
 706:         let (px, pz) = (self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 707:         let mut near: Vec<(f32, SupplySprite)> = self
 708:             .store
 709:             .all_supply_items()
 710:             .filter(|item| !self.reality.supply_consumed(item.id))
 711:             .filter_map(|item| {
 712:                 let dx = item.position.x - px;
 713:                 let dz = item.position.z - pz;
 714:                 let d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
 715:                 (d2 < LABEL_CULL * LABEL_CULL).then_some((
 716:                     d2,
 717:                     SupplySprite {
 718:                         position: [item.position.x, item.rest_y + 0.62, item.position.z],
 719:                         atlas_row: match item.kind {
 720:                             SupplyKind::AlmondWater => 0,
 721:                             SupplyKind::Ration => 1,
 722:                         },
 723:                     },
 724:                 ))
 725:             })
 726:             .collect();
 727:         near.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.total_cmp(&b.0));
 728:         // Halo overlap can list one item twice; identical positions dedupe.
 729:         near.dedup_by(|a, b| a.1 == b.1);
 730:         near.truncate(MAX_SUPPLY_SPRITES);
 731:         near.into_iter().map(|(_, sprite)| sprite).collect()
 732:     }
 733: 
 734:     /// Death by attrition: the wanderer wakes at the level's arrival point
 735:     /// after the survival aggregate has reset vitals and pockets. The world —
 736:     /// drift, consumed supplies, sealed rooms — remembers everything; only
 737:     /// the body's strain resets (the session pedometer keeps its count).
 738:     fn respawn_after_attrition(&mut self) {
 739:         self.body.reset_strain();
 740:         let spawn = level_spawn(self.level, self.config.spawn);
 741:         self.player.relocate(spawn);
 742:         self.last_safe_position = spawn;
 743:         self.invalidate_route();
 744:     }
 745: 
 746:     /// Accessibility option: automatic consumption of carried supplies.
 747:     pub fn set_assisted_consumption(&mut self, enabled: bool) {
 748:         self.survival.set_assisted_consumption(enabled);
 749:     }
 750: 
 751:     fn make_request_for(
 752:         &mut self,
 753:         origin_x: f32,
 754:         origin_z: f32,
 755:         lod: u8,
 756:         reality: RealitySnapshot,
 757:     ) -> ChunkRequest {
 758:         let request_id = self.next_request_id;
 759:         self.next_request_id = self.next_request_id.wrapping_add(1);
 760:         if self.next_request_id == 0 {
 761:             self.next_request_id = 1;
 762:         }
 763:         ChunkRequest {
 764:             request_id,
 765:             origin_x,
 766:             origin_z,
 767:             level: self.level,
 768:             lod,
 769:             artifacts: self.artifact_needs,
 770:             reality,
 771:         }
 772:     }
 773: 
 774:     fn make_request(&mut self, origin_x: f32, origin_z: f32, lod: u8) -> ChunkRequest {
 775:         self.make_request_for(origin_x, origin_z, lod, self.reality.clone())
 776:     }
 777: 
 778:     /// Installs finished background loads, discarding stale work: a result
 779:     /// for the wrong level (noclip happened), for a chunk that left the
 780:     /// streaming footprint, or for a LOD no better than what is already
 781:     /// resident. Refinement stays monotonic exactly like the sync path.
 782:     ///
 783:     /// Installs are metered by the same per-tick cost budget as synchronous
 784:     /// loads (coarse = 1, fine = `FINE_LOAD_COST`): when a burst of worker
 785:     /// results lands in one frame, the overflow waits in
 786:     /// `completed_backlog` instead of stacking mesh uploads and collision
 787:     /// rebuilds into a single frame.
 788:     fn install_completed(
 789:         &mut self,
 790:         keep: &[ChunkKey],
 791:         loaded: &mut Vec<ChunkKey>,
 792:         changed: &mut bool,
 793:     ) {
 794:         // A transport failure is not a completion, but it must retire the
 795:         // exact pending order or that chunk can never be scheduled again.
 796:         // Old worker callbacks cannot cancel a newer retry because request
 797:         // identity includes the engine-assigned monotonic id and reality.
 798:         for failed in self.source.poll_failed_requests() {
 799:             let key = chunk_key(failed.origin_x, failed.origin_z);
 800:             let is_current = self
 801:                 .pending
 802:                 .get(&key)
 803:                 .is_some_and(|pending| pending.is_same_request(&failed));
 804:             if is_current {
 805:                 self.pending.remove(&key);
 806:             }
 807:         }
 808: 
 809:         let fresh = self.source.poll_completed();
 810:         self.completed_backlog.extend(fresh);
 811:         let mut budget = (self.config.max_loads_per_tick as u32 * FINE_LOAD_COST).max(1);
 812:         let mut deferred: Vec<CompletedChunk> = Vec::new();
 813:         for done in self.completed_backlog.drain(..).collect::<Vec<_>>() {
 814:             let install_cost = if done.request.lod == 0 {
 815:                 FINE_LOAD_COST
 816:             } else {
 817:                 1
 818:             };
 819:             if budget < install_cost {
 820:                 deferred.push(done);
 821:                 continue;
 822:             }
 823:             let req = &done.request;
 824:             let key = chunk_key(req.origin_x, req.origin_z);
 825:             // A completion is authoritative only while the exact order it
 826:             // echoes is still pending. In particular, an old result for the
 827:             // same chunk must not remove a newer pending request.
 828:             let is_current = self
 829:                 .pending
 830:                 .get(&key)
 831:                 .is_some_and(|pending| pending.is_same_request(req));
 832:             if !is_current {
 833:                 continue;
 834:             }
 835:             self.pending.remove(&key);
 836:             if req.level != self.level || !keep.contains(&key) {
 837:                 continue;
 838:             }
 839:             let is_forced = self.forced_reloads.contains(&key);
 840:             let improves = match self.store.get(key) {
 841:                 None => true,
 842:                 // LOD is monotonic only inside one exact reality. A chunk
 843:                 // from a replaced reality is replaced even if its old LOD was
 844:                 // finer; comparing their LODs would preserve stale geometry.
 845:                 Some(resident) if resident.is_in_reality(&req.reality) => req.lod < resident.lod,
 846:                 Some(_) => is_forced,
 847:             };
 848:             if !improves {
 849:                 continue;
 850:             }
 851:             if is_forced {
 852:                 let player = player_aabb(self.player.position);
 853:                 if done
 854:                     .payload
 855:                     .collision
 856:                     .iter()
 857:                     .any(|solid| solid.intersects(&player))
 858:                 {
 859:                     // Safety beats the effect: keep the old resident reality
 860:                     // but do not abandon the transition. Defer this chunk and
 861:                     // restore its pending status so we try again next tick.
 862:                     self.pending.insert(key, req.clone());
 863:                     deferred.push(done);
 864:                     continue;
 865:                 }
 866:             }
 867:             budget -= install_cost;
 868:             self.store.insert(
 869:                 key,
 870:                 LoadedChunk::new(
 871:                     (req.origin_x, req.origin_z),
 872:                     req.lod,
 873:                     req.reality.clone(),
 874:                     done.payload,
 875:                 ),
 876:             );
 877:             if !loaded.contains(&key) {
 878:                 loaded.push(key);
 879:             }
 880:             *changed = true;
 881:             self.forced_reloads.remove(&key);
 882:         }
 883:         self.completed_backlog = deferred;
 884:         // Drop pending entries that left the footprint so their slots free
 885:         // up; a late completion for them is discarded by the keep check.
 886:         self.pending
 887:             .retain(|key, request| keep.contains(key) && request.level == self.level);
 888:     }
 889: 
 890:     /// Tops up the background request queue: coarse availability for every
 891:     /// missing chunk (nearest first), then at most one fine refinement in
 892:     /// flight at a time, mirroring the sync path's priorities.
 893:     fn issue_requests(&mut self, desired: &[(f32, f32)], desired_visual: &[(f32, f32)]) {
 894:         // Keep roughly a worker pool's worth of requests in flight; more
 895:         // would just build a stale backlog behind a moving player.
 896:         let max_pending = (self.config.max_loads_per_tick * 2).max(4);
 897: 
 898:         let forced: Vec<_> = self
 899:             .forced_reloads
 900:             .iter()
 901:             .filter_map(|&key| {
 902:                 self.store
 903:                     .get(key)
 904:                     .map(|chunk| (key, chunk.origin.0, chunk.origin.1, chunk.lod))
 905:             })
 906:             .collect();
 907:         for (key, ox, oz, lod) in forced {
 908:             if self.pending.len() >= max_pending {
 909:                 break;
 910:             }
 911:             if !self.pending.contains_key(&key) {
 912:                 let request = self.make_request(ox, oz, lod);
 913:                 self.pending.insert(key, request.clone());
 914:                 self.source.request(request);
 915:             }
 916:         }
 917: 
 918:         for &(ox, oz) in desired_visual {
 919:             if self.pending.len() >= max_pending {
 920:                 break;
 921:             }
 922:             let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
 923:             if !self.store.contains(key) && !self.pending.contains_key(&key) {
 924:                 let request = self.make_request(ox, oz, COARSE_LOD);
 925:                 self.pending.insert(key, request.clone());
 926:                 self.source.request(request);
 927:             }
 928:         }
 929: 
 930:         let fine_in_flight = self.pending.values().any(|request| request.lod == 0);
 931:         if fine_in_flight || self.pending.len() >= max_pending {
 932:             return;
 933:         }
 934:         let fine_d2 = self.config.fine_distance * self.config.fine_distance;
 935:         let target = desired.iter().copied().find(|&(ox, oz)| {
 936:             let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
 937:             self.chunk_dist2(ox, oz) <= fine_d2
 938:                 && !self.pending.contains_key(&key)
 939:                 && self.store.get(key).is_some_and(|c| c.lod > 0)
 940:         });
 941:         if let Some((ox, oz)) = target {
 942:             let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
 943:             let resident_reality = self.store.get(key).unwrap().reality.clone();
 944:             let request = self.make_request_for(ox, oz, 0, resident_reality);
 945:             self.pending.insert(key, request.clone());
 946:             self.source.request(request);
 947:         }
 948:     }
 949: 
 950:     /// Progressive, error-driven chunk streaming.
 951:     ///
 952:     /// Availability first: every missing chunk (nearest first) loads at the
 953:     /// cheap coarse LOD, so the whole footprint renders before any chunk is
 954:     /// refined. Refinement second: with leftover budget, the nearest
 955:     /// resident coarse chunk within `fine_distance` reloads at full
 956:     /// resolution in place. Chunks beyond `fine_distance` stay coarse — at
 957:     /// that range a coarse voxel projects to about a fine voxel's pixels —
 958:     /// and refinement is monotonic while resident, so there is no flapping.
 959:     ///
 960:     /// Both phases share one per-tick cost budget (coarse = 1 unit, fine =
 961:     /// `FINE_LOAD_COST`), keeping the worst-case tick at the old cost of
 962:     /// `max_loads_per_tick` fine loads. Newly loaded and refined chunks
 963:     /// upload only their own atlas slot rows; a full re-upload only happens
 964:     /// on pool relayouts (first load, bigger chunks, level switch) or on
 965:     /// back ends without partial-update support.
 966:     fn stream_chunks(&mut self) {
 967:         let surface_renderer = self.artifact_needs.needs_surface_extraction();
 968:         let desired = self
 969:             .policy
 970:             .desired_origins(self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 971:         let desired_visual = self
 972:             .visual_policy
 973:             .desired_origins(self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 974:         let keep: Vec<_> = desired_visual
 975:             .iter()
 976:             .map(|&(x, z)| chunk_key(x, z))
 977:             .collect();
 978: 
 979:         // Free the atlas slots of chunks about to be evicted.
 980:         let evicted: Vec<ChunkKey> = self
 981:             .store
 982:             .iter_ordered()
 983:             .map(|c| chunk_key(c.origin.0, c.origin.1))
 984:             .filter(|k| !keep.contains(k))
 985:             .collect();
 986:         let mut changed = self.store.retain_keys(&keep);
 987:         self.forced_reloads.retain(|key| keep.contains(key));
 988:         if surface_renderer {
 989:             if !evicted.is_empty() {
 990:                 self.renderer.remove_surfaces(&evicted);
 991:             }
 992:         } else {
 993:             for key in evicted {
 994:                 self.pool.release(key);
 995:             }
 996:         }
 997: 
 998:         let mut loaded: Vec<ChunkKey> = Vec::new();
 999:         if self.source.is_async() {
1000:             // Background pipeline: install validated completions, then top
1001:             // up the request queue. The frame never blocks on generation.
1002:             self.install_completed(&keep, &mut loaded, &mut changed);
1003:             self.issue_requests(&desired, &desired_visual);
1004:         } else {
1005:             let mut budget = self.config.max_loads_per_tick as u32 * FINE_LOAD_COST;
1006: 
1007:             // Red-room closure is a semantic transition, not ordinary LOD
1008:             // work. Rebuild the small affected set first and install each
1009:             // complete payload atomically across its geometry/collision/light
1010:             // views. The threshold bend keeps this set out of direct sight.
1011:             let forced: Vec<_> = self
1012:                 .forced_reloads
1013:                 .iter()
1014:                 .filter_map(|&key| {
1015:                     self.store
1016:                         .get(key)
1017:                         .map(|c| (key, c.origin.0, c.origin.1, c.lod))
1018:                 })
1019:                 .collect();
1020:             for (key, ox, oz, lod) in forced {
1021:                 let payload = self.source.load_with_artifacts(
1022:                     ox,
1023:                     oz,
1024:                     self.level,
1025:                     lod,
1026:                     &self.reality,
1027:                     self.artifact_needs,
1028:                 );
1029:                 let player = player_aabb(self.player.position);
1030:                 if payload
1031:                     .collision
1032:                     .iter()
1033:                     .any(|solid| solid.intersects(&player))
1034:                 {
1035:                     self.forced_reloads.remove(&key);
1036:                     continue;
1037:                 }
1038:                 self.store.insert(
1039:                     key,
1040:                     LoadedChunk::new((ox, oz), lod, self.reality.clone(), payload),
1041:                 );
1042:                 self.forced_reloads.remove(&key);
1043:                 loaded.push(key);
1044:                 changed = true;
1045:             }
1046: 
1047:             // Phase 1 — availability: missing chunks come in coarse, nearest
1048:             // first. Only a leftover budget flows into refinement, so a moving
1049:             // player always fills holes before sharpening anything.
1050:             for &(ox, oz) in &desired_visual {
1051:                 if budget == 0 {
1052:                     break;
1053:                 }
1054:                 let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
1055:                 if !self.store.contains(key) {
1056:                     let payload = self.source.load_with_artifacts(
1057:                         ox,
1058:                         oz,
1059:                         self.level,
1060:                         COARSE_LOD,
1061:                         &self.reality,
1062:                         self.artifact_needs,
1063:                     );
1064:                     self.store.insert(
1065:                         key,
1066:                         LoadedChunk::new((ox, oz), COARSE_LOD, self.reality.clone(), payload),
1067:                     );
1068:                     loaded.push(key);
1069:                     budget -= 1;
1070:                     changed = true;
1071:                 }
1072:             }
1073: 
1074:             // Phase 2 — refinement: nearest coarse chunk inside the fine ring.
1075:             let fine_d2 = self.config.fine_distance * self.config.fine_distance;
1076:             while budget >= FINE_LOAD_COST {
1077:                 let target = desired.iter().copied().find(|&(ox, oz)| {
1078:                     self.chunk_dist2(ox, oz) <= fine_d2
1079:                         && self.store.get(chunk_key(ox, oz)).is_some_and(|c| c.lod > 0)
1080:                 });
1081:                 let Some((ox, oz)) = target else { break };
1082:                 let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
1083:                 let resident_reality = self.store.get(key).unwrap().reality.clone();
1084:                 let payload = self.source.load_with_artifacts(
1085:                     ox,
1086:                     oz,
1087:                     self.level,
1088:                     0,
1089:                     &resident_reality,
1090:                     self.artifact_needs,
1091:                 );
1092:                 self.store.insert(
1093:                     key,
1094:                     LoadedChunk::new((ox, oz), 0, resident_reality, payload),
1095:                 );
1096:                 if !loaded.contains(&key) {
1097:                     loaded.push(key);
1098:                 }
1099:                 budget -= FINE_LOAD_COST;
1100:                 changed = true;
1101:             }
1102:         }
1103: 
1104:         if !changed {
1105:             return;
1106:         }
1107: 
1108:         // Raster strategies upload only changed/replaced surface artifacts.
1109:         // Collision stays resident as neutral AABBs; unrequested serialized
1110:         // SVO nodes never enter the payload or atlas.
1111:         if surface_renderer {
1112:             let surface_updates: Vec<SurfaceChunk<'_>> = loaded
1113:                 .iter()
1114:                 .filter_map(|&key| {
1115:                     self.store.get(key).map(|chunk| SurfaceChunk {
1116:                         key,
1117:                         origin: [chunk.origin.0, 0.0, chunk.origin.1],
1118:                         mesh: &chunk.payload.surface,
1119:                     })
1120:                 })
1121:                 .collect();
1122:             if !surface_updates.is_empty() {
1123:                 self.renderer.upload_surfaces(&surface_updates);
1124:             }
1125: 
1126:             self.draws.clear();
1127:             for chunk in self.store.iter_ordered() {
1128:                 self.draws.push(ChunkDraw {
1129:                     origin: [chunk.origin.0, 0.0, chunk.origin.1],
1130:                     root_index: 0,
1131:                     world_size: chunk.payload.world_size,
1132:                     voxel_size: chunk.payload.voxel_size,
1133:                     svo_depth: chunk.payload.svo_depth,
1134:                 });
1135:             }
1136:             self.draws.truncate(MAX_CHUNKS);
1137:             self.atlas_nodes = self
1138:                 .store
1139:                 .iter_ordered()
1140:                 .map(|c| c.payload.nodes.len() / 4)
1141:                 .sum();
1142:             let boxes: Vec<_> = self.store.all_collision_boxes().copied().collect();
1143:             self.world.rebuild(boxes.iter());
1144:             self.flares.extinguish_buried(self.world.boxes());
1145:             return;
1146:         }
1147: 
1148:         // Size the pool for the streaming footprint and the largest chunk.
1149:         let num_slots = ((2 * self.policy.radius + 1).pow(2) as usize).min(MAX_CHUNKS);
1150:         let rows = self
1151:             .store
1152:             .iter_ordered()
1153:             .map(|c| payload_rows(&c.payload))
1154:             .max()
1155:             .unwrap_or(1)
1156:             .max(1);
1157:         let mut need_full = self.pool.ensure_layout(num_slots, rows);
1158: 
1159:         if !need_full {
1160:             for &key in &loaded {
1161:                 let uploaded = match self.pool.assign(key) {
1162:                     Some(slot) => {
1163:                         let payload = &self.store.get(key).expect("just inserted").payload;
1164:                         let block = self.pool.rebased_block(slot, payload);
1165:                         let first_row = self.pool.slot_first_row(slot) as u32;
1166:                         self.renderer.upload_atlas_rows(first_row, &block)
1167:                     }
1168:                     None => false,
1169:                 };
1170:                 if !uploaded {
1171:                     need_full = true;
1172:                     break;
1173:                 }
1174:             }
1175:         }
1176: 
1177:         if need_full {
1178:             let keys: Vec<ChunkKey> = self
1179:                 .store
1180:                 .iter_ordered()
1181:                 .map(|c| chunk_key(c.origin.0, c.origin.1))
1182:                 .collect();
1183:             for key in keys {
1184:                 let _ = self.pool.assign(key);
1185:             }
1186:             let texels = self
1187:                 .pool
1188:                 .full_texels(|k| self.store.get(k).map(|c| &c.payload));
1189:             self.renderer.upload_atlas(&texels);
1190:         }
1191: 
1192:         self.draws.clear();
1193:         for chunk in self.store.iter_ordered() {
1194:             let key = chunk_key(chunk.origin.0, chunk.origin.1);
1195:             if let Some(offset) = self.pool.node_offset_of(key) {
1196:                 self.draws.push(ChunkDraw {
1197:                     origin: [chunk.origin.0, 0.0, chunk.origin.1],
1198:                     root_index: (offset + chunk.payload.root as usize) as i32,
1199:                     world_size: chunk.payload.world_size,
1200:                     voxel_size: chunk.payload.voxel_size,
1201:                     svo_depth: chunk.payload.svo_depth,
1202:                 });
1203:             }
1204:         }
1205:         self.draws.truncate(MAX_CHUNKS);
1206:         self.atlas_nodes = self
1207:             .store
1208:             .iter_ordered()
1209:             .map(|c| c.payload.nodes.len() / 4)
1210:             .sum();
1211: 
1212:         let boxes: Vec<_> = self.store.all_collision_boxes().copied().collect();
1213:         self.world.rebuild(boxes.iter());
1214:         self.flares.extinguish_buried(self.world.boxes());
1215:     }
1216: 
1217:     /// Forces one chunk to rebuild on its next streaming pass, dropping any
1218:     /// in-flight request for it first so a late completion under the old
1219:     /// identity can't clear the new one. The shared primitive behind every
1220:     /// "this chunk's world just changed out from under it" event: RedRoom
1221:     /// threshold crossings, a consumed supply item, and Peripheral Shift's
1222:     /// blackout rear-shift all reach for exactly this, not a bespoke pair
1223:     /// of map operations each time.
1224:     fn force_rebuild(&mut self, key: ChunkKey) {
1225:         self.pending.remove(&key);
1226:         self.forced_reloads.insert(key);
1227:     }
1228: 
1229:     pub fn player(&self) -> &Player {
1230:         &self.player
1231:     }
1232: 
1233:     pub fn teleport_player(&mut self, position: [f32; 3], yaw: f32, pitch: f32) {
1234:         self.player.position = position;
1235:         self.player.yaw = yaw;
1236:         self.player.pitch = pitch;
1237:     }
1238: 
1239:     pub fn chunk_size(&self) -> f32 {
1240:         self.config.chunk_size
1241:     }
1242: 
1243:     pub fn is_chunk_resident(&self, key: (i64, i64)) -> bool {
1244:         self.store.contains(key)
1245:     }
1246: 
1247:     pub fn collision_world(&self) -> &CollisionWorld {
1248:         &self.world
1249:     }
1250: }

1467:     #[derive(Default)]
1468:     struct RecordingRenderer {
1469:         uploads: Rc<RefCell<Vec<usize>>>,
1470:         row_uploads: Rc<RefCell<Vec<u32>>>,
1471:         draws: Rc<RefCell<Vec<usize>>>,
1472:         /// When true the renderer accepts partial row updates like the GPU
1473:         /// driver; when false it forces the full-upload fallback.
1474:         supports_rows: bool,
1475:     }
1476: 
1477:     impl RendererPort for RecordingRenderer {
1478:         fn upload_atlas(&mut self, texels: &[u32]) {
1479:             self.uploads.borrow_mut().push(texels.len());
1480:         }
1481:         fn upload_atlas_rows(&mut self, first_row: u32, _texels: &[u32]) -> bool {
1482:             if self.supports_rows {
1483:                 self.row_uploads.borrow_mut().push(first_row);
1484:             }
1485:             self.supports_rows
1486:         }
1487:         fn draw(&mut self, _frame: &FrameParams, chunks: &[ChunkDraw]) {
1488:             self.draws.borrow_mut().push(chunks.len());
1489:         }
1490:     }

1496:         removed: Rc<RefCell<Vec<usize>>>,
1497:     }

1500:         fn uses_surface_meshes(&self) -> bool {
1501:             true

1504:             self.surface_uploads.borrow_mut().push(chunks.len());
1505:         }
1506:         fn remove_surfaces(&mut self, keys: &[crate::application::ports::SurfaceChunkKey]) {
1507:             self.removed.borrow_mut().push(keys.len());
1508:         }
1509:         fn upload_atlas(&mut self, _texels: &[u32]) {
1510:             *self.atlas_uploads.borrow_mut() += 1;

1562:     /// Background source double: records requests, completes only what the
1563:     /// test explicitly finishes, and panics on any blocking load.
1564:     #[derive(Default)]
1565:     struct AsyncFakeSource {
1566:         requests: Rc<RefCell<Vec<ChunkRequest>>>,
1567:         ready: Rc<RefCell<Vec<crate::application::ports::CompletedChunk>>>,
1568:         failed: Rc<RefCell<Vec<ChunkRequest>>>,
1569:     }
1570: 
1571:     impl ChunkSourcePort for AsyncFakeSource {
1572:         fn load(&self, _x: f32, _z: f32, _level: u32, _lod: u8) -> ChunkPayload {
1573:             unreachable!("async sources must never be block-loaded by the engine");
1574:         }
1575:         fn is_async(&self) -> bool {
1576:             true
1577:         }
1578:         fn request(&mut self, request: ChunkRequest) {
1579:             self.requests.borrow_mut().push(request);
1580:         }
1581:         fn poll_completed(&mut self) -> Vec<crate::application::ports::CompletedChunk> {
1582:             self.ready.borrow_mut().drain(..).collect()
1583:         }
1584:         fn poll_failed_requests(&mut self) -> Vec<ChunkRequest> {
1585:             self.failed.borrow_mut().drain(..).collect()
1586:         }
1587:     }
1588: 
1589:     fn completed(request: ChunkRequest) -> crate::application::ports::CompletedChunk {
1590:         let payload = FlatChunkSource.load(
1591:             request.origin_x,
1592:             request.origin_z,
1593:             request.level,
1594:             request.lod,
1595:         );
1596:         crate::application::ports::CompletedChunk { request, payload }
1597:     }

1599:     fn test_request(
1600:         request_id: u32,
1601:         origin_x: f32,
1602:         origin_z: f32,
1603:         level: u32,
1604:         lod: u8,
1605:     ) -> ChunkRequest {
1606:         ChunkRequest {
1607:             request_id,
1608:             origin_x,
1609:             origin_z,
1610:             level,
1611:             lod,
1612:             artifacts: RenderArtifactNeeds::RAYMARCH,
1613:             reality: RealitySnapshot::default(),
1614:         }
1615:     }

1617:     #[test]
1618:     fn async_source_streams_without_blocking_and_refines_monotonically() {
1619:         let source = AsyncFakeSource::default();
1620:         let requests = source.requests.clone();
1621:         let ready = source.ready.clone();
1622:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
1623:             EngineConfig::default(),
1624:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
1625:             Box::new(source),
1626:         );
1627:         let input = InputFrame::default();
1628: 
1629:         // First tick issues requests but installs nothing — the frame
1630:         // never waits for generation.
1631:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1632:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 0);
1633:         assert!(!engine.stats().ready);
1634:         assert!(!requests.borrow().is_empty());
1635:         assert!(
1636:             requests
1637:                 .borrow()
1638:                 .iter()
1639:                 .all(|request| request.artifacts == RenderArtifactNeeds::RAYMARCH),
1640:             "the renderer's selected artifacts must reach every chunk order"
1641:         );
1642: 
1643:         // Fulfil whatever is asked until the footprint is fine everywhere.
1644:         for _ in 0..40 {
1645:             let fulfil: Vec<_> = requests.borrow_mut().drain(..).collect();
1646:             for req in fulfil {
1647:                 ready.borrow_mut().push(completed(req));
1648:             }
1649:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1650:         }
1651:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 9);
1652:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 9);
1653:         assert!(engine.stats().ready);
1654: 
1655:         // Steady state: no further requests.
1656:         let before = requests.borrow().len();
1657:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1658:         assert_eq!(requests.borrow().len(), before);
1659:     }

1682:     #[test]
1683:     fn worker_result_bursts_install_across_ticks_not_in_one_frame() {
1684:         let source = AsyncFakeSource::default();
1685:         let ready = source.ready.clone();
1686:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
1687:             EngineConfig::default(),
1688:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
1689:             Box::new(source),
1690:         );
1691:         let input = InputFrame::default();
1692:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1693: 
1694:         // A worst-case burst: fine results for all nine footprint chunks
1695:         // land in the same frame.
1696:         let desired = engine
1697:             .policy
1698:             .desired_origins(engine.player.position[0], engine.player.position[2]);
1699:         let mut id = 90_000;
1700:         for (ox, oz) in desired {
1701:             let req = test_request(id, ox, oz, 0, 0);
1702:             id += 1;
1703:             engine.pending.insert(chunk_key(ox, oz), req.clone());
1704:             ready.borrow_mut().push(completed(req));
1705:         }
1706: 
1707:         // Budget: max_loads_per_tick (2) fine-equivalents per tick, so the
1708:         // burst spreads over ceil(9 / 2) ticks instead of hitching one frame.
1709:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1710:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 2);
1711:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1712:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 4);
1713:         for _ in 0..3 {
1714:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1715:         }
1716:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 9, "backlog must fully drain");
1717:     }

1787:     #[test]
1788:     fn old_completion_cannot_clear_a_newer_request_for_the_same_chunk() {
1789:         let source = AsyncFakeSource::default();
1790:         let requests = source.requests.clone();
1791:         let ready = source.ready.clone();
1792:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
1793:             EngineConfig::default(),
1794:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
1795:             Box::new(source),
1796:         );
1797:         let input = InputFrame::default();
1798:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1799: 
1800:         let current = requests.borrow()[0].clone();
1801:         let key = chunk_key(current.origin_x, current.origin_z);
1802:         let mut stale = current.clone();
1803:         stale.request_id = stale.request_id.wrapping_sub(1);
1804:         ready.borrow_mut().push(completed(stale));
1805:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1806: 
1807:         assert!(
1808:             engine
1809:                 .pending
1810:                 .get(&key)
1811:                 .is_some_and(|pending| pending.is_same_request(&current)),
1812:             "a stale completion must leave the newer request pending"
1813:         );
1814:         assert!(engine.store.get(key).is_none());
1815: 
1816:         ready.borrow_mut().push(completed(current.clone()));
1817:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1818:         let installed = engine.store.get(key).expect("current completion installs");
1819:         assert!(installed.is_in_reality(&current.reality));
1820:     }

1823:     fn failed_async_request_is_retried_but_stale_failure_cannot_cancel_retry() {

1825:         let requests = source.requests.clone();
1826:         let failed = source.failed.clone();
1827:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
1828:             EngineConfig::default(),
1829:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
1830:             Box::new(source),
1831:         );
1832:         let input = InputFrame::default();
1833:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1834: 
1835:         let first = requests.borrow()[0].clone();
1836:         let key = chunk_key(first.origin_x, first.origin_z);
1837:         requests.borrow_mut().clear();
1838:         failed.borrow_mut().push(first.clone());
1839:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1840: 
1841:         let retry = engine
1842:             .pending
1843:             .get(&key)
1844:             .expect("a transport failure is retried on the same tick")
1845:             .clone();
1846:         assert_ne!(retry.request_id, first.request_id);
1847:         assert!(
1848:             requests
1849:                 .borrow()
1850:                 .iter()
1851:                 .any(|request| request.is_same_request(&retry))
1852:         );
1853: 
1854:         requests.borrow_mut().clear();
1855:         failed.borrow_mut().push(first);
1856:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1857:         assert!(
1858:             engine
1859:                 .pending
1860:                 .get(&key)
1861:                 .is_some_and(|pending| pending.is_same_request(&retry)),
1862:             "a late failure for the old order must preserve its current retry"
1863:         );
1864:         assert!(requests.borrow().is_empty(), "no duplicate may be queued");
1865:     }

1934:     #[test]
1935:     fn streams_coarse_first_then_refines_nearest_first() {
1936:         let (mut engine, uploads, _draws) = engine_with_recorder();
1937:         let input = InputFrame::default();
1938: 
1939:         // 9 chunks are desired (radius 1). The per-tick budget is
1940:         // max_loads_per_tick * FINE_LOAD_COST = 8 units; a coarse load costs
1941:         // 1, a fine load 4. Tick 1: eight coarse loads — the world is
1942:         // visible (and `ready`) after one tick instead of five.
1943:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1944:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 8);
1945:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 0);
1946:         assert!(engine.stats().ready, "coarse spawn chunk flips ready");
1947: 
1948:         // Tick 2: the last coarse load + one refinement. Ticks 3-6: two
1949:         // refinements each; every chunk is within fine_distance (15) here.
1950:         for expected_fine in [1usize, 3, 5, 7, 9] {
1951:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1952:             assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 9);
1953:             assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, expected_fine);
1954:         }
1955:         assert_eq!(uploads.borrow().len(), 6, "one upload per changed tick");
1956: 
1957:         // Subsequent ticks should not load anything or re-upload.
1958:         for _ in 0..5 {
1959:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1960:         }
1961:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 9);
1962:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 9);
1963:         assert_eq!(uploads.borrow().len(), 6);
1964:     }

2042:     /// Overconsumption is mismanagement too: wasted supply value (drinking
2043:     /// past a full reserve) raises the same delirium tier that thirst does,
2044:     /// and frugal minutes let the level calm back down.
2045:     #[test]
2046:     fn wasted_supplies_raise_strain_and_frugality_calms_it() {
2047:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
2048:             EngineConfig::default(),
2049:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
2050:             Box::new(FlatChunkSource),
2051:         );
2052:         let input = InputFrame::default();
2053:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2054:         assert_eq!(engine.reality.delirium(), 0, "a fresh wanderer is calm");
2055: 
2056:         // Two bottles drained at a full reserve are pure waste.
2057:         engine.survival.register_waste_for_test(1.0, 0.65);
2058:         engine.survival.register_waste_for_test(1.0, 0.65);
2059:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2060:         assert_eq!(
2061:             engine.reality.delirium(),
2062:             3,
2063:             "gluttony must strain reality like deep thirst does"
2064:         );
2065: 
2066:         // Frugal minutes drain the excess (tick clamps dt to 0.1 s, so this
2067:         // is four simulated minutes). Vitals are pinned full so the decay is
2068:         // measured without thirst re-raising the tier.
2069:         for _ in 0..2400 {
2070:             engine.set_vitals_for_test(PlayerVitals::default());
2071:             engine.tick(0.1, &input);
2072:         }
2073:         assert_eq!(engine.reality.delirium(), 0, "excess strain must decay");
2074:     }

2076:     /// Tier 1 of the Peripheral Shift: walking far from a neighborhood
2077:     /// advances its drift epoch, so the fabric that streams back in later is
2078:     /// keyed to a different reality — while the territory around the player
2079:     /// stays exactly as observed.
2080:     #[test]
2081:     fn abandoned_territory_gains_a_fabric_drift_epoch() {
2082:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
2083:             EngineConfig::default(),
2084:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
2085:             Box::new(FlatChunkSource),
2086:         );
2087:         let input = InputFrame::default();
2088:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2089:         assert!(
2090:             engine.reality.fabric_drifts().is_empty(),
2091:             "nothing may drift while the player stands in it"
2092:         );
2093:         let origin_cell = (
2094:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::fabric_drift_cell_of(5.0),
2095:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::fabric_drift_cell_of(5.0),
2096:         );
2097:         assert!(engine.drift_near.contains(&origin_cell));
2098: 
2099:         // Abandon the spawn neighborhood entirely.
2100:         engine.player.relocate([500.0, 1.7, 500.0]);
2101:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2102:         assert!(
2103:             engine.reality.fabric_drift_epoch(5.0, 5.0) >= 1,
2104:             "abandoned territory must rearrange"
2105:         );
2106:         assert_eq!(
2107:             engine.reality.fabric_drift_epoch(500.0, 500.0),
2108:             0,
2109:             "the territory around the player never drifts"
2110:         );
2111:         // Returning and leaving again drifts it again.
2112:         engine.player.relocate([5.0, 1.7, 5.0]);
2113:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2114:         let first = engine.reality.fabric_drift_epoch(5.0, 5.0);
2115:         engine.player.relocate([500.0, 1.7, 500.0]);
2116:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2117:         assert_eq!(engine.reality.fabric_drift_epoch(5.0, 5.0), first + 1);
2118:     }

2121:     /// any light's reach shift in real time and their chunks force-rebuild.
2122:     /// The space ahead and everything outside the blackout hold still.
2123:     #[test]
2124:     fn blackout_shifts_the_space_behind_the_player_while_inside() {
2125:         use vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::{
2126:             AnomalyKind, Axis2, AxisDirection, TraversalGate, TraversalGateKind, WorldBounds,
2127:         };
2128:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
2129:             EngineConfig::default(),
2130:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
2131:             Box::new(FlatChunkSource),
2132:         );
2133:         let gate = TraversalGate {
2134:             id: 11,
2135:             instance_id: 401,
2136:             anomaly_kind: AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse,
2137:             kind: TraversalGateKind::Remap,
2138:             axis: Axis2::X,
2139:             plane: 0.0,
2140:             span_min: -200.0,
2141:             span_max: 200.0,
2142:             forward: AxisDirection::Positive,
2143:             affected_bounds: WorldBounds::new(-200.0, -200.0, 200.0, 200.0),
2144:         };
2145:         let mut payload = FlatChunkSource.load(0.0, 0.0, 0, 0);
2146:         payload.traversal_gates.push(gate);
2147:         engine.store.insert(
2148:             chunk_key(0.0, 0.0),
2149:             LoadedChunk::new((0.0, 0.0), 0, RealitySnapshot::empty(), payload),
2150:         );
2151:         // A resident chunk in the rear cell (player at z=5 facing -Z: the
2152:         // cell z in [40, 80) is wholly behind and beyond the hide distance).
2153:         engine.store.insert(
2154:             chunk_key(0.0, 40.0),
2155:             LoadedChunk::new(
2156:                 (0.0, 40.0),
2157:                 0,
2158:                 RealitySnapshot::empty(),
2159:                 FlatChunkSource.load(0.0, 40.0, 0, 0),
2160:             ),
2161:         );
2162:         engine.player.position = [5.0, 1.7, 5.0];
2163:         engine.player.yaw = 0.0; // forward = -Z
2164:         engine.update_peripheral_shift(1.0 / 60.0);
2165: 
2166:         assert!(
2167:             engine.reality.fabric_drift_epoch(5.0, 60.0) >= 1,
2168:             "the cell behind the player must shift"
2169:         );
2170:         assert_eq!(
2171:             engine.reality.fabric_drift_epoch(5.0, -60.0),
2172:             0,
2173:             "the cell ahead of the player must hold still"
2174:         );
2175:         assert!(
2176:             engine.forced_reloads.contains(&chunk_key(0.0, 40.0)),
2177:             "resident chunks of the shifted cell must rebuild"
2178:         );
2179:         // The cadence gate: an immediate second pass changes nothing more.
2180:         let stamps = engine.reality.fabric_drifts().len();
2181:         engine.update_peripheral_shift(1.0 / 60.0);
2182:         assert_eq!(engine.reality.fabric_drifts().len(), stamps);

2185:     #[test]
2186:     fn red_threshold_advances_reality_and_replaces_the_resident_world() {
2187:         use vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::{
2188:             AnomalyKind, Axis2, AxisDirection, TraversalGate, TraversalGateKind, WorldBounds,
2189:         };
2190:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
2191:             EngineConfig::default(),
2192:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
2193:             Box::new(FlatChunkSource),
2194:         );
2195:         let gate = TraversalGate {
2196:             id: 7,
2197:             instance_id: 99,
2198:             anomaly_kind: AnomalyKind::RedRoom,
2199:             kind: TraversalGateKind::RedThreshold,
2200:             axis: Axis2::X,
2201:             plane: 5.0,
2202:             span_min: 0.0,
2203:             span_max: 10.0,
2204:             forward: AxisDirection::Positive,
2205:             affected_bounds: WorldBounds::new(0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 10.0),
2206:         };
2207:         let mut payload = FlatChunkSource.load(0.0, 0.0, 0, 0);
2208:         payload.traversal_gates.push(gate);
2209:         engine.store.insert(
2210:             chunk_key(0.0, 0.0),
2211:             LoadedChunk::new((0.0, 0.0), 0, RealitySnapshot::empty(), payload),
2212:         );
2213:         engine.store.insert(
2214:             chunk_key(20.0, 0.0),
2215:             LoadedChunk::new(
2216:                 (20.0, 0.0),
2217:                 0,
2218:                 RealitySnapshot::empty(),
2219:                 FlatChunkSource.load(20.0, 0.0, 0, 0),
2220:             ),
2221:         );
2222:         engine.player.position = [6.0, 1.7, 5.0];
2223:         engine.update_anomalies([4.0, 1.7, 5.0]);
2224:         assert_eq!(engine.reality.lookup(99).unwrap().epoch, 1);
2225:         assert!(engine.forced_reloads.contains(&chunk_key(0.0, 0.0)));
2226:         assert!(
2227:             engine.forced_reloads.contains(&chunk_key(20.0, 0.0)),
2228:             "a distant resident must not remain in the base Level 0 address"
2229:         );
2230: 
2231:         // Crossing the same directional threshold outward is not closure.

2268:     #[test]
2269:     fn pushing_into_a_wall_eventually_noclips_to_the_grassland() {
2270:         let levels = Rc::new(RefCell::new(Vec::new()));
2271:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
2272:             EngineConfig::default(),
2273:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
2274:             Box::new(TrappingChunkSource {
2275:                 levels: levels.clone(),
2276:             }),
2277:         );
2278:         assert_eq!(engine.level(), 0);
2279: 
2280:         // Hold forward into the wall. 20% per roll, one roll per second of
2281:         // pushing: 120 simulated seconds without a switch is ~1e-11 likely.
2282:         let input = InputFrame {
2283:             intent: crate::application::player::MoveIntent {
2284:                 forward: true,
2285:                 ..Default::default()
2286:             },
2287:             locked: true,
2288:             ..Default::default()
2289:         };
2290:         let mut switched_at = None;
2291:         for tick in 0..(120 * 60) {
2292:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2293:             if engine.level() != 0 {
2294:                 switched_at = Some(tick);
2295:                 break;
2296:             }
2297:         }
2298:         assert_eq!(
2299:             engine.level(),
2300:             34,
2301:             "never noclipped (switched_at={switched_at:?})"
2302:         );
2303:         // New chunks must be requested for the grassland level.
2304:         for _ in 0..5 {
2305:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
2306:         }
2307:         assert!(
2308:             levels.borrow().iter().any(|&l| l == 34),
2309:             "chunk source never asked for level 34: {:?}",
2310:             levels.borrow()
2311:         );
2312:     }
